## C012. PTRPG/제8국 폐병원 게임/multiplayer-api-test.mjs

원본: `PTRPG/제8국 폐병원 게임/multiplayer-api-test.mjs` / 2,540 bytes / SHA-256 `f0f2b488b369b936965c6d5702d2347f9fa36a288c99b453f2f057d79021b81e`

````mjs
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
const origin=process.env.TEST_ORIGIN||'http://127.0.0.1:5189';
async function post(body,token){const r=await fetch(origin+'/api/rooms',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json',Origin:origin,...(token?{Authorization:'Bearer '+token}:{})},body:JSON.stringify(body)});return {status:r.status,data:await r.json()};}
let a=(await post({type:'create',name:'호스트'}));assert.equal(a.status,200);a=a.data;
let b=(await post({type:'join',code:a.code,name:'친구'}));assert.equal(b.status,200);b=b.data;
async function get(token){const r=await fetch(origin+'/api/rooms?code='+a.code,{headers:{Authorization:'Bearer '+token}});return {status:r.status,data:await r.json()};}
let snapshot=(await get(a.token)).data;assert.equal(snapshot.room.members.length,2);
const command=(who,action,revision=snapshot.revision,id=crypto.randomUUID())=>post({code:a.code,revision,requestId:id,action},who.token);
assert.equal((await get('0'.repeat(48))).status,403);
assert.equal((await post({code:a.code,revision:snapshot.revision,requestId:'bad',action:{type:'ready'}})).status,401);
const requestId=crypto.randomUUID();let r=await command(a,{type:'ready'},snapshot.revision,requestId);assert.equal(r.status,200);snapshot=r.data;
r=await command(a,{type:'ready'},snapshot.revision,requestId);assert.equal(r.data.duplicate,true);assert.equal(r.data.room.members[0].ready,true);
r=await command(b,{type:'ready'});assert.equal(r.status,200);snapshot=r.data;
r=await command(a,{type:'start'});assert.equal(r.status,200);snapshot=r.data;
const rev=snapshot.revision,vote={type:'vote',scene:snapshot.room.state.scene,ballot:snapshot.room.ballot,index:1};const responses=await Promise.all([command(a,vote,rev),command(b,vote,rev)]);assert.deepEqual(responses.map(r=>r.status).sort(),[200,409]);snapshot=(await get(a.token)).data;assert.equal(snapshot.room.state.scene,'ward');assert.equal(snapshot.room.state.turn,0);assert.equal(Object.keys(snapshot.room.votes).length,1);const late=responses[0].status===409?a:b;r=await command(late,vote);assert.equal(r.status,200);snapshot=r.data;assert.equal(snapshot.room.state.scene,'introduce');assert.equal(snapshot.room.state.turn,1);
r=await command(b,{type:'chat',text:'우선 문을 확인하자'});assert.equal(r.status,200);snapshot=r.data;assert.equal((await get(a.token)).data.room.chat.at(-1).text,'우선 문을 확인하자');
console.log('API passed: actual D1 room join, protected reads, replay idempotency, concurrent choices, shared state and chat.');
````

````mjs
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import {createRoom,joinRoom,command,view} from './lib/room.js';
import {D,E,C} from './lib/game.js';
let n=0;const test=(name,fn)=>{fn();n++;console.log('PASS',name);};
test('scene narration has no authored spoken dialogue',()=>{for(const scene of Object.values(D.scenes))assert.ok(!/[“”]/.test(scene.text),scene.title);});
test('four people occupy distinct slots and a fifth cannot join',()=>{const r=createRoom('a','A');for(const id of ['b','c','d'])joinRoom(r,id,id);assert.equal(new Set(r.members.map(m=>m.slot)).size,4);assert.throws(()=>joinRoom(r,'e','E'));assert.equal(r.state.party[1].name,'b');});
test('start requires readiness and host authorization',()=>{const r=createRoom('a','A');joinRoom(r,'b','B');assert.throws(()=>command(r,'a',{type:'start'}));command(r,'a',{type:'ready'});command(r,'b',{type:'ready'});assert.throws(()=>command(r,'b',{type:'start'}));command(r,'a',{type:'start'});assert.equal(r.started,true);assert.throws(()=>joinRoom(r,'c','C'));});
test('character stats and traits use existing validated creation rules',()=>{const r=createRoom('a','A');joinRoom(r,'b','B');assert.throws(()=>command(r,'b',{type:'configure',name:'B',values:[100,100,100],traits:['unemployed']}));command(r,'b',{type:'configure',name:'B',values:[70,40,40],traits:['assassin']});assert.equal(r.state.party[1].id,1);assert.equal(r.state.party[1].stats['민첩'],43);});
test('exploration waits for unanimous votes and uses the host as roll leader',()=>{const r=createRoom('a','A');joinRoom(r,'b','B');r.started=true;const action={type:'vote',index:1,scene:'ward',ballot:0};command(r,'b',action);assert.equal(r.state.scene,'ward');assert.equal(r.state.turn,0);command(r,'a',action);assert.equal(r.state.actor,0);assert.equal(r.state.scene,'introduce');assert.equal(view(r).state,r.state);});
test('changing a vote moves it and does not consume resources before consensus',()=>{const r=createRoom('a','A');joinRoom(r,'b','B');r.started=true;const vote=(id,index)=>command(r,id,{type:'vote',index,scene:r.state.scene,ballot:r.ballot||0});vote('a',1);vote('b',2);assert.equal(r.state.turn,0);vote('a',2);assert.equal(r.state.scene,'consent');assert.equal(r.state.turn,1);assert.deepEqual(r.votes,{});assert.equal(r.ballot,1);});
test('same-scene choices have new ballots and stale clicks never repeat actions',()=>{const r=createRoom('a','A');r.started=true;r.state.scene='second';const action={type:'vote',index:0,scene:'second',ballot:0};command(r,'a',action);assert.equal(r.state.scene,'second');const food=r.state.inventory.food;assert.throws(()=>command(r,'a',action));assert.equal(r.state.inventory.food,food);});
test('membership changes clear ballots rather than force a remaining vote',()=>{const r=createRoom('a','A');joinRoom(r,'b','B');r.started=true;command(r,'a',{type:'vote',index:1,scene:'ward',ballot:0});command(r,'b',{type:'leave'});assert.deepEqual(r.votes,{});assert.equal(r.state.scene,'ward');});
test('all three supply rooms are independent and cannot be farmed',()=>{const s=E.create();for(const [scene,key,item] of [['ward_search','1:ward','bandage'],['medical_store','1:medical','medkit'],['pantry','1:pantry','food']]){s.scene=scene;const res=E.choose(s,0,()=>.01);assert.equal(s.scene,'supplies');assert.ok(s.searched.includes(key));assert.ok(res.rewards.some(r=>r.id===item&&r.source==='found'));E.choose(s,2,()=>.01);assert.equal(s.scene,'camp_plan');const back=D.scenes.camp_plan.choices.findIndex(c=>c.next==='lobby');E.choose(s,back,()=>.01);assert.equal(s.scene,'lobby');s.scene=scene;const before=JSON.stringify(s.inventory);E.choose(s,0,()=>.01);assert.equal(JSON.stringify(s.inventory),before);assert.equal(s.scene,scene);}assert.equal(s.searched.length,3);});
test('other people cannot plan a claimed character turn',()=>{const r=createRoom('a','A');joinRoom(r,'b','B');r.started=true;C.create(r.state,'fate','fourth',()=>.01);r.state.battle.queue=[{side:'ally',id:1,speed:90},{side:'enemy',id:0,speed:1}];r.state.battle.pointer=0;assert.throws(()=>command(r,'a',{type:'advance'}));command(r,'b',{type:'advance'});assert.equal(C.current(r.state).id,1);command(r,'b',{type:'plan',skill:'wait',target:1});command(r,'b',{type:'advance'});assert.throws(()=>command(r,'b',{type:'grow',slot:0,stat:'근력'}));});
test('leaving transfers host and unclaimed slots remain playable',()=>{const r=createRoom('a','A');joinRoom(r,'b','B');command(r,'a',{type:'leave'});assert.equal(r.host,'b');r.started=true;r.state.party[0].xp=100;command(r,'b',{type:'grow',slot:0,stat:'근력'});assert.throws(()=>command(r,'a',{type:'ready'}));});
test('chat length is bounded and no player credential leaks in views',()=>{const r=createRoom('a','A');assert.throws(()=>command(r,'a',{type:'chat',text:'x'.repeat(401)}));command(r,'a',{type:'chat',text:'같이 계단을 조사하자'});assert.equal(view(r).chat.length,1);assert.equal(view(r).receipts,undefined);});
console.log(`${n} multiplayer rules tests passed.`);
````

## C020. PTRPG/제8국 폐병원 게임/prepare-documents.cjs

원본: `PTRPG/제8국 폐병원 게임/prepare-documents.cjs` / 1,279 bytes / SHA-256 `bd3030e8582570a51fd3b725ba450df0499cd5ed7eae5d4cfb25e472eb6d968c`

````cjs
const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const source = fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname, '..', 'PTRPG EP. 제8국 병원.md'), 'utf8');
const sections = [...source.matchAll(/^### (.+)\r?\n([\s\S]*?)(?=^#{2,3} |$(?![\s\S]))/gm)];
const entries = {
  father: ['난 올라갈거다', '찢어진 메모'], girl: ['아저씨 이거 봐요', '낙서 노트'],
  office: ['내가 왜 여기서 이래야 하나', '사무소 직원의 메모'],
  orders: ['위에서 까라면 까야지', '호위 임무 기록'],
  director: ['어제 우리가 봐버린 것', '푸른 꽃 소장의 기록'],
  experiment: ['개념체 증폭 실험 일기', '연구 일기']
};
const documents = {};
for (const [id, [title, type]] of Object.entries(entries)) {
  const section = sections.find(s => s[1].includes(title));
  if (!section) throw Error(`Missing original document: ${title}`);
  documents[id] = {title, type, text: section[2].trim().replace(/\r\n/g, '\n')};
}
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(__dirname, 'web', 'documents.js'),
  '/* Readable documents extracted from the author\'s manuscript. */\nObject.assign(HospitalData.notes, ' + JSON.stringify(documents, null, 2) + ');\n');
console.log(`Prepared ${Object.keys(documents).length} complete in-game documents.`);
````

## C024. PTRPG/제8국 폐병원 게임/rank-test.cjs

````cjs
const fs=require('node:fs'),vm=require('node:vm'),assert=require('node:assert/strict');
const context=vm.createContext({console});vm.runInContext(['data','documents','expansion','engine','combat-data','combat'].map(n=>fs.readFileSync(__dirname+'/web/'+n+'.js','utf8')).join('\n')+';globalThis.E=HospitalEngine;globalThis.R=RankCombat;globalThis.D=HospitalData;',context);
const {E,R,D}=context;let tests=0;const test=(name,fn)=>{fn();tests++;console.log('PASS',name);};
function battle(type='wave',trait='unemployed'){const s=E.create('주인공',[50,50,50],[trait]);s.scene='rescue_wave';R.create(s,type,'rescue_arrival',()=>.2);return s;}
function turn(s,id){s.battle.queue=[{side:'ally',id,speed:10}];s.battle.pointer=0;s.battle.started=null;R.advance(s,()=>.2);}
test('four friendly ranks are unique and front/back are mirrored by rank',()=>{const s=battle();assert.equal(s.party[2].rank,1);assert.equal(s.party[0].rank,2);assert.equal(s.party[1].rank,3);assert.equal(s.party[3].rank,4);assert.equal(new Set(s.party.map(p=>p.rank)).size,4);assert.equal(s.battle.enemies.length,3);});
test('initiative adds random speed rather than forcing front row first',()=>{const s=battle();assert.equal(s.battle.queue[0].id,3);assert.equal(s.battle.queue[0].side,'ally');assert.ok(s.battle.queue.every(q=>Number.isInteger(q.speed)));});
test('cannot act outside the current turn or target outside allowed ranks',()=>{const s=battle();turn(s,0);assert.equal(E.plan(s,2,'attack',0),false);assert.equal(E.plan(s,0,'attack',2),false);assert.equal(E.plan(s,0,'attack',0),true);});
test('position disables skills and movement swaps adjacent allies',()=>{const s=battle();turn(s,0);R.move(s,'ally',0,2);assert.equal(s.party[0].rank,4);assert.equal(R.available(s,0,R.skill('attack')),false);assert.equal(E.plan(s,0,'move-front',0),true);R.advance(s,()=>.2);assert.equal(s.party[0].rank,3);assert.equal(s.party[3].rank,4);});
test('a stale target is not silently changed to another enemy',()=>{const s=battle();turn(s,0);E.plan(s,0,'attack',0);R.move(s,'enemy',0,2);const hp=s.battle.enemies.reduce((a,b)=>a+b.hp,0),events=R.advance(s,()=>.2);assert.ok(events.some(e=>e.text.includes(' 사거리에서')));assert.equal(s.battle.enemies.reduce((a,b)=>a+b.hp,0),hp);});
test('one action completes then waits for next friendly turn',()=>{const s=battle();s.battle.queue=[{side:'ally',id:0,speed:10},{side:'ally',id:1,speed:9}];s.battle.pointer=0;E.plan(s,0,'attack',0);const events=R.advance(s,()=>.2);assert.equal(R.current(s).id,1);assert.equal(events.filter(e=>e.type==='action').length,1);assert.equal(s.battle.pointer,1);});
test('push moves enemy behind others and pull changes rear fear into front attack',()=>{const s=battle();turn(s,2);E.plan(s,2,'break',0);R.advance(s,()=>.2);assert.equal(s.battle.enemies[0].rank,3);turn(s,1);E.plan(s,1,'pull',0);R.advance(s,()=>.2);assert.equal(s.battle.enemies[0].rank,1);const t=battle();assert.equal(t.battle.intents.find(i=>i.enemy===2).action,'fear');R.move(t,'enemy',2,-2);assert.equal(t.battle.intents.find(i=>i.enemy===2).action,'strike');});
test('boss occupies two ranks and can be targeted through either rank',()=>{const s=battle('tiger');assert.equal(s.battle.enemies[0].size,2);turn(s,1);assert.equal(R.validTargets(s,1,R.skill('aim')).length,1);});
test('corpses block a rank, clearing them compacts the back line',()=>{const s=battle();turn(s,0);s.battle.enemies[0].hp=1;E.plan(s,0,'attack',0);R.advance(s,()=>.2);assert.ok(s.battle.enemies[0].corpseHp>0);assert.equal(s.battle.enemies[1].rank,2);turn(s,0);E.plan(s,0,'attack',0);R.advance(s,()=>.2);assert.equal(s.battle.enemies[0].corpseHp,0);assert.equal(s.battle.enemies[1].rank,1);});
test('bleed occurs once per personal turn not each UI refresh',()=>{const s=battle();const p=s.party[0];p.bleed=2;const before=p.hp;turn(s,0);assert.equal(p.hp,before-6);R.advance(s,()=>.2);assert.equal(p.hp,before-6);assert.equal(p.bleed,1);});
test('stun skips one action and cannot deadlock the round',()=>{const s=battle();s.battle.queue=[{side:'ally',id:0,speed:10},{side:'ally',id:1,speed:9}];s.battle.pointer=0;s.party[0].stun=1;const events=R.advance(s,()=>.2);assert.ok(events.some(e=>e.type==='skip'));assert.equal(R.current(s).id,1);assert.equal(s.party[0].stun,0);});
test('all-target sweep affects only the first two ranks',()=>{const s=battle();turn(s,2);const before=s.battle.enemies.map(e=>e.hp);E.plan(s,2,'sweep',0);R.advance(s,()=>.2);assert.ok(s.battle.enemies[0].hp<before[0]);assert.ok(s.battle.enemies[1].hp<before[1]);assert.equal(s.battle.enemies[2].hp,before[2]);});
test('healing targets an ally, costs one item and cures bleed',()=>{const s=battle();turn(s,1);s.party[0].hp=100;s.party[0].bleed=2;const n=s.inventory.medkit;E.plan(s,1,'heal',0);R.advance(s,()=>.2);assert.ok(s.party[0].hp>=125);assert.equal(s.party[0].bleed,0);assert.equal(s.inventory.medkit,n-1);});
test('near-death ally can be revived and a boxer cannot administer medicine',()=>{const s=battle();turn(s,1);s.party[0].status='near';s.party[0].hp=0;E.plan(s,1,'heal',0);R.advance(s,()=>.2);assert.equal(s.party[0].status,'normal');assert.ok(s.party[0].hp>0);const b=battle('wave','boxer');turn(b,0);b.party[1].hp=100;assert.equal(E.plan(b,0,'heal',1),false);});
test('support refusal does not waste an item',()=>{const s=battle();turn(s,1);s.party[0].hp=100;s.affinity[0][1]=-10;const n=s.inventory.medkit;E.plan(s,1,'heal',0);const events=R.advance(s,()=>.2);assert.equal(s.inventory.medkit,n);assert.ok(events.some(e=>e.text.includes('지원 거절')));});
test('guard redirects the attack and halves damage until protector next turn',()=>{const s=battle();turn(s,2);E.plan(s,2,'guard',0);R.advance(s,()=>.2);assert.equal(s.battle.guards[0],2);assert.equal(s.party[2].guard,.5);s.battle.enemies=s.battle.enemies.slice(0,1);s.battle.queue=[{side:'enemy',id:0,speed:10},{side:'ally',id:1,speed:9}];s.battle.pointer=0;s.battle.started=null;const hp=s.party[0].hp;R.advance(s,()=>.2);assert.equal(s.party[0].hp,hp);assert.ok(s.party[2].hp<s.party[2].max);turn(s,2);assert.equal(s.party[2].guard,0);assert.equal(s.battle.guards[0],undefined);});
test('fear at 100 causes pressure damage and resets to 60',()=>{const s=battle();s.party.forEach(p=>p.stress=99);s.battle.queue=[{side:'enemy',id:2,speed:10},{side:'ally',id:0,speed:9}];s.battle.pointer=0;s.battle.started=null;const events=R.advance(s,()=>.2);assert.ok(events.some(e=>e.type==='panic'));assert.ok(s.party.some(p=>p.stress===60));});
test('saved initiative, ranks, current turn and existing trait reservations survive reload',()=>{const s=battle('wave','prophet');turn(s,0);E.traitAbility(s,0,'predict','success');const copy=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(s));E.upgrade(copy);assert.equal(copy.battle.started,s.battle.started);assert.equal(JSON.stringify(copy.battle.queue),JSON.stringify(s.battle.queue));assert.equal(copy.party[0].traitState.prediction,'success');});
test('legacy battle migration preserves health, destination and inventory',()=>{const s=E.create();s.battle={type:'tiger',next:'signal',round:4,enemies:[{...D.enemies.tiger,id:0,hp:71}],plans:{},intents:[]};const n=s.inventory.medkit;E.upgrade(s);assert.equal(s.battle.system,'ranks');assert.equal(s.battle.enemies[0].hp,71);assert.equal(s.battle.next,'signal');assert.equal(s.battle.round,4);assert.equal(s.inventory.medkit,n);});
test('sufficient combat rounds can complete every encounter and preserve reward',()=>{for(const type of ['fate','wave','tiger','human','wolf','dragon','nail','falseLight','jin','survivors']){const s=battle(type);s.party.forEach(p=>p.stats['근력']=p.stats['지능']=p.stats['민첩']=80);s.battle.rewardBattery=true;for(let n=0;n<20&&s.battle&&!s.ending;n++)E.resolve(s,()=>.01);assert.equal(s.battle,null,type);assert.equal(s.flags.battery,true,type);}});
console.log(`${tests} rank combat tests passed.`);
````

## C026. PTRPG/제8국 폐병원 게임/roller-test.mjs

원본: `PTRPG/제8국 폐병원 게임/roller-test.mjs` / 2,805 bytes / SHA-256 `5123249613e5a63cf34d34e1cbaa8d37800bb6fbd99132dee6342288cd74dd68`

````mjs
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import {createRoom,joinRoom,command,view} from './lib/room.js';
function room(scene='ward'){const r=createRoom('a','A');joinRoom(r,'b','B');r.started=true;r.state.scene=scene;return r;}
const vote=(r,id,index)=>command(r,id,{type:'vote',index,scene:r.state.scene,ballot:r.ballot||0});
const roller=(r,id,slot)=>command(r,id,{type:'roller-vote',slot,scene:r.state.scene,ballot:r.ballot});
let count=0;const test=(name,fn)=>{fn();count++;console.log('PASS',name);};
test('action consensus opens roller selection without rolling, spending or advancing',()=>{const r=room();const before=JSON.stringify(r.state);vote(r,'a',0);vote(r,'b',0);assert.deepEqual(view(r).pendingRoll,{index:0,scene:'ward'});assert.equal(JSON.stringify(r.state),before);assert.throws(()=>roller(room(),'a',0));});
test('roller votes can change and non-host stats determine the real roll',()=>{const r=room();vote(r,'a',0);vote(r,'b',0);roller(r,'a',1);roller(r,'b',0);assert.equal(r.state.turn,0);assert.equal(view(r).rollerVotes.b,0);const result=roller(r,'b',1);assert.equal(result.roll.threshold,45);assert.equal(r.state.actor,1);assert.equal(r.state.scene,'knock');assert.equal(r.state.turn,1);assert.equal(r.pendingRoll,null);assert.deepEqual(r.rollerVotes,{});assert.equal(r.ballot,1);});
test('search gets a roller and consumes one search only after both approvals',()=>{const r=room('second');vote(r,'a',0);vote(r,'b',0);assert.deepEqual(r.state.searched,[]);roller(r,'a',3);const result=roller(r,'b',3);assert.equal(result.roll.threshold,65);assert.equal(r.state.actor,3);assert.equal(r.state.turn,1);assert.equal(r.state.scene,'second');assert.deepEqual(r.state.searched,['2']);const before=JSON.stringify(r.state);assert.throws(()=>command(r,'b',{type:'roller-vote',slot:3,scene:'second',ballot:0}));assert.equal(JSON.stringify(r.state),before);});
test('inactive characters cannot roll',()=>{const r=room();vote(r,'a',0);vote(r,'b',0);r.state.party[1].status='collapsed';assert.throws(()=>roller(r,'a',1));assert.deepEqual(r.rollerVotes,{});});
test('reconsideration invalidates the pending choice and old callbacks',()=>{const r=room();vote(r,'a',0);vote(r,'b',0);roller(r,'a',1);command(r,'b',{type:'reset-roll',scene:'ward',ballot:0});assert.equal(r.pendingRoll,null);assert.deepEqual(r.votes,{});assert.equal(r.ballot,1);assert.equal(r.state.turn,0);assert.throws(()=>command(r,'a',{type:'roller-vote',slot:1,scene:'ward',ballot:0}));});
test('leaving clears both decisions and a no-check action still proceeds normally',()=>{const r=room();vote(r,'a',0);vote(r,'b',0);command(r,'b',{type:'leave'});assert.equal(view(r).pendingRoll,null);assert.deepEqual(r.rollerVotes,{});vote(r,'a',1);assert.equal(r.state.scene,'introduce');});
console.log(`${count} roller tests passed.`);
````

````cjs
const {chromium}=require('C:/Users/user/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/node/node_modules/playwright');
const path=require('node:path'),assert=require('node:assert/strict');
(async()=>{
 const browser=await chromium.launch({headless:true,channel:'msedge'});
 try{
  const page=await browser.newPage({viewport:{width:1440,height:900}}),errors=[];
  page.on('pageerror',e=>errors.push(e.message));
  await page.goto('file:///'+path.join(__dirname,'web/index.html').replaceAll('\\','/'));
  await page.locator('[name="traits"][value="brain"]').check();
  assert.equal(await page.locator('[name="traits"][value="muscle"]').isDisabled(),true);
  await page.locator('[name="traits"][value="dependent"]').check();
  await page.locator('[name="traits"][value="cautious"]').check();
  assert.equal(await page.locator('[name="traits"][value="physical"]').isDisabled(),true);
  assert.equal(await page.locator('[name="traits"][value="brain"]').isDisabled(),false);
  await page.locator('[value="cautious"]').uncheck();
  await page.locator('#unique-trait').selectOption('religious');
  assert.ok((await page.locator('#unique-description').innerText()).includes('회복량 +1'));
  assert.ok((await page.locator('#trait-preview').innerText()).includes('337'));
  for(const v of [{width:1440,height:900},{width:844,height:390},{width:390,height:844}]){
   await page.setViewportSize(v);
   assert.equal(await page.evaluate(()=>{const m=document.querySelector('#modal');return m.scrollWidth>m.clientWidth+2;}),false);
  }
  await page.setViewportSize({width:1440,height:900});
  await page.screenshot({path:path.join(__dirname,'qa-traits.png')});
  await page.locator('#character-form button[type=submit]').click();
  const s=await page.evaluate(()=>PTRPG.snapshot());
  assert.deepEqual(s.party[0].traits,['brain','dependent','religious']);assert.equal(s.party[0].max,337);assert.equal(s.affinity[0][1],2);
  await page.locator('[data-open="journal"]').click();await page.locator('[data-jtab="affinity"]').click();
  assert.equal(await page.locator('.relation-entry').count(),3);
  assert.ok((await page.locator('#journal-body').innerText()).includes('+10%'));
  await page.screenshot({path:path.join(__dirname,'qa-affinity.png')});
  await page.setViewportSize({width:390,height:844});
  assert.equal(await page.evaluate(()=>document.querySelector('#modal').scrollWidth>document.querySelector('#modal').clientWidth+2),false);
  await page.screenshot({path:path.join(__dirname,'qa-affinity-mobile.png')});
  await page.locator('.close').click();
  await page.setViewportSize({width:1440,height:900});
  await page.locator('[data-actor="0"]').dblclick();
  assert.ok((await page.locator('#modal-content').innerText()).includes('종교인'));
  await page.locator('.close').click();await page.reload();await page.waitForFunction(()=>window.PTRPG);
  assert.equal((await page.evaluate(()=>PTRPG.snapshot())).party[0].max,337);
  assert.deepEqual((await page.evaluate(()=>PTRPG.snapshot())).party[0].traits,s.party[0].traits);
  assert.deepEqual(errors,[]);
  console.log('Social UI passed: trait limits, conflicts, live preview, start effects, affinity, profiles, reload and mobile.');
 }finally{await browser.close();}
})().catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exit(1);});
````

## C028. PTRPG/제8국 폐병원 게임/test.cjs

원본: `PTRPG/제8국 폐병원 게임/test.cjs` / 15,993 bytes / SHA-256 `3099980b994bb9acc09f8f18c7d938abbb140c5a31f6e8c5ebc578ec691fe152`

````cjs
const fs=require('node:fs'),vm=require('node:vm'),assert=require('node:assert/strict');
const context=vm.createContext({console});
vm.runInContext(fs.readFileSync(__dirname+'/web/data.js','utf8')+'\n'+fs.readFileSync(__dirname+'/web/engine.js','utf8')+'\nglobalThis.E=HospitalEngine;globalThis.D=HospitalData;',context);
const {E,D}=context;let tests=0;const test=(name,fn)=>{fn();tests++;console.log('PASS',name);};
test('d100 success and critical boundaries',()=>{assert.equal(E.roll(50,()=>.24).result,'success');assert.equal(E.roll(50,()=>.11).result,'critical');assert.equal(E.roll(50,()=>.50).result,'fail');assert.equal(E.roll(0,()=>0).result,'fail');});
test('150 point character budget and proportional HP',()=>{const s=E.create();assert.equal(s.party[0].max,350);assert.throws(()=>E.create('a',[100,100,100]));});
test('search once and food/rest once per floor',()=>{const s=E.create();s.scene='second';E.choose(s,0,()=>.2);const inv=JSON.stringify(s.inventory);E.choose(s,0,()=>.2);assert.equal(JSON.stringify(s.inventory),inv);s.party[0].hp=200;E.choose(s,1);assert.equal(s.party[0].hp,242);const food=s.inventory.food;E.choose(s,1);assert.equal(s.inventory.food,food);});
test('inventory use clamps healing and honors bandage condition',()=>{const s=E.create();s.party[0].hp=340;assert.equal(E.useItem(s,'medkit',0),true);assert.equal(s.party[0].hp,350);assert.equal(E.useItem(s,'medkit',0),false);s.party[0].hp=100;assert.equal(E.useItem(s,'bandage',0),false);});
test('notes cannot be farmed for XP',()=>{const s=E.create();s.scene='barricade';E.choose(s,0,()=>.1);const xp=s.party[0].xp;E.choose(s,0,()=>.1);assert.equal(s.party[0].xp,xp);assert.equal(s.notes.length,1);});
test('failed stealth starts combat with continuation destination',()=>{const s=E.create();s.scene='whispers';E.choose(s,0,()=>.99);assert.ok(s.battle);assert.equal(s.battle.next,'fourth');});
test('one-shot defense occurs before first damage',()=>{const s=E.create();s.scene='sixth';E.choose(s,1,()=>.1);s.party.forEach(p=>{p.row='rear';p.stats['민첩']=90;});s.battle.enemies[0].agi=100;E.resolve(s,()=>.01);assert.ok(s.log.some(l=>l.text.includes('기초 방어')));assert.ok(s.log.some(l=>l.text.includes('공격 취소')));});
test('remaining party resolves and victory advances story',()=>{const s=E.create();s.scene='sixth';E.choose(s,1,()=>.1);s.battle.enemies[0].hp=1;E.resolve(s,()=>.01);assert.equal(s.battle,null);assert.equal(s.scene,'signal');});
test('collapse and resistance boundaries',()=>{const s=E.create(),p=s.party[0];E.health(s,p,999,()=>.1);assert.equal(p.status,'near');E.health(s,p,100,()=>.1);assert.equal(p.status,'collapsed');const t=E.create(),q=t.party[0];E.health(t,q,999,()=>.9);E.health(t,q,100,()=>.9);assert.equal(q.status,'resist');assert.equal(q.hp,175);});
test('growth spends XP and recalculates maximum health',()=>{const s=E.create();s.party[0].xp=5;assert.equal(E.grow(s,0,'근력'),true);assert.equal(s.party[0].level,2);assert.equal(s.party[0].max,355);assert.equal(s.party[0].xp,0);});
test('every scene destination and referenced resource exists',()=>{for(const scene of Object.values(D.scenes))for(const c of scene.choices){assert.ok(D.scenes[c.next]);if(c.note)assert.ok(D.notes[c.note]);if(c.battle)assert.ok(D.enemies[c.battle]);}});
test('complete rescue route with deterministic successful checks',()=>{const s=E.create();const route=[0,0,0,0,0,2,1,0,0,0,0,0,0];for(const i of route){if(s.scene==='barricade'&&s.once.includes('father')){}E.choose(s,i,()=>.1);if(s.battle)for(let t=0;t<20&&s.battle;t++)E.resolve(s,()=>.01);}
 while(s.scene!=='ending'&&!s.ending){const scene=D.scenes[s.scene];let i=scene.choices.findIndex(c=>c.next!==s.scene);if(i<0)throw Error('No exit');E.choose(s,i,()=>.01);while(s.battle&&!s.ending)E.resolve(s,()=>.01);}assert.equal(s.ending,'rescue');});
test('supplies stay unallocated until an explicit decision',()=>{const s=E.create();s.scene='lobby';const food=s.inventory.food;E.choose(s,0,()=>.2);assert.equal(s.inventory.food,food);assert.equal(s.pendingLoot.food,2);E.choose(s,0);assert.equal(s.inventory.food,food);assert.equal(s.camp.stock.food,2);assert.equal(s.scene,'camp_plan');});
test('half, keep and hide have distinct resource and relationship outcomes',()=>{for(const i of [1,2,3]){const s=E.create();s.scene='lobby';E.choose(s,1,()=>.2);E.choose(s,i);assert.equal(s.inventory.medkit,i===1?4:5);assert.equal(s.camp.stock.medkit,i===1?2:1);assert.equal(s.camp.trust,i===1?1:i===2?-1:0);assert.equal(!!s.flags.hiddenSupplies,i===3);}});
test('waiting does not force upstairs and consumes real food',()=>{const s=E.create();s.scene='camp_plan';const food=s.inventory.food;E.choose(s,2);assert.equal(s.scene,'camp_wait');assert.equal(s.inventory.food,food-1);E.choose(s,0);E.choose(s,0);assert.equal(s.scene,'camp_wait');assert.equal(s.camp.waits,3);assert.equal(s.camp.people,5);assert.ok(s.party[0].hp<s.party[0].max);});
test('Jin companionship is optional and hidden supplies are discovered later',()=>{const s=E.create();s.scene='knock';E.choose(s,0);s.scene='lobby';E.choose(s,0,()=>.2);E.choose(s,3);E.choose(s,0);assert.equal(s.scene,'second');assert.equal(s.jin.accompanies,false);assert.equal(s.camp.trust,-1);const t=E.create();t.scene='knock';E.choose(t,0);t.scene='camp_plan';E.choose(t,0);assert.equal(t.jin.accompanies,true);});
test('aid consumes camp stock and cannot be repeatedly farmed',()=>{const s=E.create();E.upgrade(s);s.scene='camp_return';s.camp.trust=2;const n=s.inventory.medkit;E.choose(s,2);assert.equal(s.inventory.medkit,n+1);assert.equal(s.camp.stock.medkit,0);E.choose(s,2);assert.equal(s.inventory.medkit,n+1);const t=E.create();t.scene='camp_return';const m=t.inventory.medkit;E.choose(t,2);assert.equal(t.inventory.medkit,m);});
test('warning requires evidence and keeps survivors alive later',()=>{const s=E.create();s.scene='camp_return';E.choose(s,0);assert.equal(s.camp.secured,false);s.notes.push('experiment');E.choose(s,0);assert.equal(s.camp.secured,true);s.scene='radio';E.choose(s,0);assert.notEqual(s.camp.status,'dead');assert.equal(s.camp.people,7);const t=E.create();t.scene='radio';E.choose(t,0);assert.equal(t.camp.status,'dead');assert.equal(t.camp.people,0);assert.equal(t.jin.state,'dead');});
test('return to camp remembers the exploration floor',()=>{const s=E.create();s.scene='fourth';E.choose(s,3);assert.equal(s.scene,'camp_return');E.choose(s,3);assert.equal(s.scene,'fourth');});
test('fighting Jin leads to a real battle then a mercy choice',()=>{const s=E.create();s.scene='knock';E.choose(s,3);E.choose(s,2,()=>.1);assert.equal(s.battle.type,'jin');s.battle.enemies[0].hp=1;E.resolve(s,()=>.01);assert.equal(s.scene,'jin_result');assert.equal(s.jin.state,'hostile');const n=s.inventory.medkit;E.choose(s,0);assert.equal(s.jin.state,'friendly');assert.equal(s.inventory.medkit,n-1);});
test('defeat against Jin is nonlethal and can be followed by refusal',()=>{const s=E.create();s.scene='jin_warning';E.choose(s,2,()=>.1);s.party.forEach(p=>{p.status='collapsed';p.hp=0;});s.ending='lost';E.resolve(s,()=>.01);assert.equal(s.ending,null);assert.equal(s.battle,null);assert.equal(s.scene,'bound');assert.ok(s.party.every(E.active));E.choose(s,1);assert.equal(s.scene,'second');assert.equal(s.camp.status,'hostile');});
test('killing Jin removes his dialogue and triggers survivors opposition',()=>{const s=E.create();s.scene='jin_result';E.choose(s,2);assert.equal(s.jin.state,'dead');assert.equal(s.scene,'camp_confrontation');E.choose(s,1);s.scene='radio';assert.equal(E.sceneContext(s).speaker,'나');assert.ok(!E.sceneContext(s).text.includes('진사준'));});
test('survivor fight victory removes later support',()=>{const s=E.create();s.scene='camp_confrontation';E.choose(s,2,()=>.1);assert.equal(s.battle.type,'survivors');s.battle.enemies[0].hp=1;E.resolve(s,()=>.01);assert.equal(s.camp.status,'dead');assert.equal(s.camp.people,0);s.scene='camp_return';assert.equal(E.disabled(s,D.scenes.camp_return.choices[2]),true);});
test('Jin support reduces one incoming attack per encounter',()=>{const s=E.create();E.upgrade(s);s.jin.accompanies=true;s.scene='sixth';E.choose(s,1,()=>.1);s.party.forEach(p=>{p.row='rear';p.stats['민첩']=1;});s.battle.enemies[0].agi=100;E.resolve(s,()=>.2);assert.equal(s.log.filter(l=>l.text.includes('피해 15')).length,1);E.resolve(s,()=>.2);assert.equal(s.log.filter(l=>l.text.includes('피해 15')).length,1);});
test('old saves are upgraded without losing inventory or progress',()=>{const s=E.create();s.scene='fourth';s.flags.trust=true;delete s.camp;delete s.jin;delete s.affinity;s.party.forEach(p=>{delete p.traits;delete p.socialMental;});s.inventory.food=9;E.upgrade(s);assert.equal(s.camp.trust,1);assert.equal(s.scene,'fourth');assert.equal(s.inventory.food,9);assert.equal(s.decisions.length,0);const copy=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(s));assert.equal(E.sceneContext(copy).title,D.scenes.fourth.title);});
console.log(`${tests} tests passed`);
test('discovery and personal acquisition report separate quantities',()=>{const s=E.create();s.scene='lobby';const found=E.choose(s,0,()=>.2);assert.equal(found.rewards[0].source,'found');assert.equal(found.rewards[0].quantity,2);const kept=E.choose(s,2);assert.equal(kept.rewards[0].source,'inventory');assert.equal(kept.rewards[0].quantity,2);assert.equal(E.choose(s,2).rewards?.length||0,0);});
test('donations do not falsely report inventory gains',()=>{const s=E.create();s.scene='lobby';E.choose(s,1,()=>.2);assert.equal(E.choose(s,0).rewards.length,0);});
test('search displays all gains once, and support reports the actual gain',()=>{const s=E.create();s.scene='second';const result=E.choose(s,0,()=>.01);assert.equal(result.rewards.length,2);assert.equal(result.rewards.find(x=>x.id==='medkit').quantity,2);assert.equal(E.choose(s,0).rewards?.length||0,0);s.scene='camp_return';s.camp.trust=2;assert.equal(E.choose(s,2).rewards[0].id,'medkit');});
test('new records get acquisition data without repetition',()=>{const s=E.create();s.scene='barricade';const result=E.choose(s,0,()=>.1);assert.equal(result.rewards[0].kind,'note');assert.equal(E.choose(s,0).rewards?.length||0,0);});
test('battery reward waits for battle completion',()=>{const s=E.create();s.scene='sixth';const r=E.choose(s,1,()=>.1);assert.equal(r.rewards.length,0);assert.equal(!!s.flags.battery,false);s.battle.enemies[0].hp=1;const events=E.resolve(s,()=>.01);assert.equal(s.flags.battery,true);assert.equal(events.filter(x=>x.type==='acquired').length,1);assert.equal(events.find(x=>x.type==='acquired').reward.id,'battery');});
test('battery acquisition is also reported after a successful evasion route',()=>{const s=E.create();s.scene='sixth';E.choose(s,1,()=>.1);const result=E.flee(s,()=>.01);assert.equal(result.escaped,true);assert.equal(result.rewards[0].id,'battery');});
test('every item illustration exists locally',()=>{for(const item of Object.values(D.items).concat(Object.values(D.discoveries)))assert.ok(fs.existsSync(__dirname+'/web/'+item.image));});
console.log(`${tests} tests passed including item acquisition`);
test('trait selection enforces limits, opposite traits and one unique',()=>{assert.throws(()=>E.create('a',[50,50,50],['brain','muscle','unemployed']));assert.throws(()=>E.create('a',[50,50,50],['brain','rational','physical','dependent','unemployed']));assert.throws(()=>E.create('a',[50,50,50],['veteran','cleaner']));assert.throws(()=>E.create('a',[50,50,50],['brain']));assert.throws(()=>E.create('a',[50,50,50],['fake']));assert.throws(()=>E.create('a',[50,50,50],['brain','brain','unemployed']));});
test('starting traits modify stats, proportional HP, mental and affinity',()=>{const s=E.create('a',[50,50,50],['brain','dependent','religious']);assert.equal(s.party[0].stats['근력'],47);assert.equal(s.party[0].stats['지능'],52);assert.equal(s.party[0].max,337);assert.equal(s.party[0].hp,337);assert.equal(s.party[0].mental,-1);assert.equal(E.relationship(s,0,1),2);assert.equal(E.relationship(s,1,0),2);});
test('trait stats stay within 1 to 100 and are not reapplied on reload',()=>{const s=E.create('a',[100,25,25],['muscle','unemployed']);assert.equal(s.party[0].stats['근력'],100);const copy=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(s));E.upgrade(copy);assert.equal(copy.party[0].stats['근력'],100);assert.equal(copy.party[0].stats['지능'],24);});
test('cleaner and boxer change actual check probabilities',()=>{const s=E.create('a',[50,50,50],['cleaner']);assert.equal(E.check(s,'민첩',()=>.5,1,'research').threshold,52);s.party[0].mental=-1;assert.equal(E.check(s,'민첩',()=>.5,1,'research').threshold,48);const t=E.create('a',[50,50,50],['boxer']);assert.equal(E.check(t,'근력',()=>.5).threshold,52);t.party[0].hp=100;assert.equal(E.useItem(t,'medkit',0),false);t.scene='sixth';E.choose(t,1,()=>.1);assert.equal(E.plan(t,0,'heal'),false);});
test('religious increases healing and veteran halves mental changes deterministically',()=>{const s=E.create('a',[50,50,50],['religious']);s.party[0].hp=100;E.useItem(s,'medkit',0);assert.equal(s.party[0].hp,126);const t=E.create('a',[50,50,50],['veteran']);t.scene='whispers';let call=0;E.choose(t,2,()=>call++===0?.9:.1);assert.equal(t.party[0].mental,1);});
test('affinity is directional, bounded and maps every support tier',()=>{const s=E.create();E.affinityChange(s,1,0,99,'test');assert.equal(E.relationship(s,1,0),10);assert.equal(E.relationship(s,0,1),0);assert.equal(E.supportScale(s,0,1),1.5);E.affinityChange(s,1,0,-99,'test');assert.equal(E.relationship(s,1,0),-10);assert.equal(E.supportScale(s,0,1),0);for(const [n,scale] of [[-6,.5],[-2,.75],[0,1],[2,1.1],[6,1.25],[10,1.5]]){s.affinity[1][0]=n;assert.equal(E.supportScale(s,0,1,()=>.9),scale);}s.affinity[1][0]=-6;assert.equal(E.supportScale(s,0,1,()=>.1),0);});
test('healing reflects affinity and refusal consumes no items',()=>{const s=E.create();s.affinity[1][0]=5;s.party[1].hp=100;E.useItem(s,'medkit',1,()=>.9);assert.equal(s.party[1].hp,131);assert.equal(E.relationship(s,1,0),6);s.affinity[2][0]=-10;s.party[2].hp=100;const count=s.inventory.medkit;assert.equal(E.useItem(s,'medkit',2,()=>.9),false);assert.equal(s.inventory.medkit,count);assert.ok(s.lastSocial.includes('거절'));});
test('companions evaluate supply choices individually',()=>{const s=E.create();s.scene='lobby';E.choose(s,0,()=>.2);E.choose(s,0);assert.equal(E.relationship(s,1,0),2);assert.equal(E.relationship(s,2,0),0);assert.equal(E.relationship(s,3,0),1);const t=E.create();t.scene='lobby';E.choose(t,0,()=>.2);E.choose(t,2);assert.equal(E.relationship(t,1,0),-1);assert.equal(E.relationship(t,2,0),1);});
test('relationship narrative follows thresholds without creating spoilers',()=>{const s=E.create();s.scene='second';E.bond(s,0,1,5,'test');assert.ok(E.sceneContext(s).text.includes('동행자와의 신뢰가 높습니다'));s.affinity[1][0]=-5;s.affinity[0][1]=-5;assert.ok(E.sceneContext(s).text.includes('동행자와의 불신이 높습니다'));});
test('meaning support cannot farm affinity by repeating within one encounter',()=>{const s=E.create();s.scene='sixth';E.choose(s,1,()=>.1);s.battle.enemies[0].max=s.battle.enemies[0].hp=100000;E.plan(s,0,'meaning');E.resolve(s,()=>.01);const n=E.relationship(s,1,0);E.plan(s,0,'meaning');E.resolve(s,()=>.01);assert.equal(E.relationship(s,1,0),n);});
test('legacy saves receive neutral relationships and do not gain invented traits',()=>{const s=E.create();delete s.affinity;delete s.relationshipLog;s.party.forEach(p=>{delete p.traits;delete p.socialMental;});E.upgrade(s);assert.equal(E.relationship(s,0,1),0);assert.equal(s.party[0].traits[0],'unemployed');assert.equal(s.party[0].max,350);});
console.log(`${tests} tests passed including traits and affinity`);
test('another companion can administer medicine to a boxer',()=>{const s=E.create('a',[50,50,50],['boxer']);s.party[0].hp=100;s.actor=1;assert.equal(E.useItem(s,'medkit',0),true);assert.equal(s.party[0].hp,125);assert.equal(E.relationship(s,0,1),1);});
console.log(`${tests} total tests passed`);
````

````cjs
const fs=require('node:fs'),vm=require('node:vm'),assert=require('node:assert/strict');
const context=vm.createContext({console});vm.runInContext(['data','documents','expansion','narrator','engine'].map(n=>fs.readFileSync(__dirname+'/web/'+n+'.js','utf8')).join('\n')+';globalThis.E=HospitalEngine;globalThis.D=HospitalData;',context);
const {E,D}=context;let tests=0;const test=(name,fn)=>{fn();tests++;console.log('PASS',name);};
const make=id=>E.create('참가자',[50,50,50],[id]);
const sequence=(...values)=>()=>{assert.ok(values.length,'Unexpected RNG call');return values.shift();};
test('all fourteen unique traits can start and persist',()=>{assert.equal(D.traits.filter(t=>t.kind==='unique').length,14);for(const t of D.traits.filter(t=>t.kind==='unique')){const s=make(t.id),copy=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(s));E.upgrade(copy);assert.equal(copy.party[0].traits[0],t.id);assert.equal(JSON.stringify(copy.party[0].stats),JSON.stringify(s.party[0].stats));}});
test('assassin and deceiver have correct stats and starting relationships',()=>{const a=make('assassin');assert.equal(a.party[0].stats['민첩'],53);assert.equal(a.party[0].stats['근력'],49);assert.equal(a.party[0].max,347);assert.equal(E.relationship(a,1,0),-3);const d=make('deceiver');assert.equal(d.party[0].max,336);assert.equal(d.party[0].stats['지능'],48);});
test('mental reversal applies to both positive and negative effects',()=>{const s=make('inverted');s.scene='radio';E.choose(s,1,()=>.4);assert.equal(s.party[0].mental,-3);assert.equal(s.party[1].mental,7);s.scene='whispers';E.choose(s,2,()=>.99);assert.equal(s.party[0].mental,-1);assert.equal(s.party[1].mental,5);});
test('gambler rerolls a failed roll, uses second result and cannot reuse this turn',()=>{const s=make('gambler');assert.equal(E.traitAbility(s,0,'reroll'),true);const r=E.performCheck(s,0,'지능',1,sequence(.95,.1));assert.equal(r.rerolled,96);assert.equal(r.die,11);assert.equal(r.result,'critical');assert.equal(E.traitAbility(s,0,'reroll'),false);s.turn++;assert.equal(E.traitAbility(s,0,'reroll'),true);const bad=E.performCheck(s,0,'지능',1,sequence(.9,.99));assert.equal(bad.result,'fail');});
test('gambler waits for failure and can cancel the reservation',()=>{const s=make('gambler');E.traitAbility(s,0,'reroll');E.performCheck(s,0,'지능',1,()=>.2);assert.equal(s.party[0].traitState.reroll,true);assert.equal(E.traitAbility(s,0,'reroll'),true);assert.equal(s.party[0].traitState.reroll,false);});
test('deceiver flips failure to ordinary success and critical to failure',()=>{const s=make('deceiver');E.traitAbility(s,0,'invert');const r=E.performCheck(s,0,'지능',1,()=>.99);assert.equal(r.originalResult,'fail');assert.equal(r.result,'success');assert.equal(E.traitAbility(s,0,'invert'),false);s.turn++;E.traitAbility(s,0,'invert');assert.equal(E.performCheck(s,0,'지능',1,()=>0).result,'fail');});
test('prophecy changes morale and stacks with no stacking on previews',()=>{const s=make('prophet');E.traitAbility(s,0,'predict','success');const before=s.party[1].mental;E.check(s,'지능',()=>0);assert.equal(s.party[0].traitState.prediction,'success');E.performCheck(s,0,'지능',1,()=>.1);assert.equal(s.party[1].mental,before+1);assert.equal(s.party[0].traitState.stacks,2);assert.equal(E.traitAbility(s,0,'predict','fail'),false);s.turn++;E.traitAbility(s,0,'predict','success');E.performCheck(s,0,'지능',1,()=>.99);assert.equal(s.party[1].mental,before-1);assert.equal(s.party[0].traitState.stacks,1);});
test('speaker consumes only one use per turn and rolls both morale outcomes',()=>{const s=make('speaker');assert.equal(E.traitAbility(s,0,'encourage',null,()=>.1),true);assert.equal(s.party[1].mental,4);assert.equal(E.traitAbility(s,0,'encourage',null,()=>.1),false);s.turn++;E.traitAbility(s,0,'encourage',null,()=>.9);assert.equal(s.party[1].mental,2);});
test('meddler delegates, shows the delegate probability, and repays the next roll',()=>{const s=make('meddler');E.traitAbility(s,0,'delegate',1);assert.equal(E.check(s,'지능',()=>0).threshold,70);const r=E.performCheck(s,0,'지능',1,()=>.6);assert.equal(r.result,'success');assert.equal(r.rolledBy,1);assert.equal(s.party[0].traitState.debt,1);assert.equal(E.traitAbility(s,0,'delegate',2),false);s.actor=1;assert.equal(E.check(s,'지능',()=>0).threshold,50);const paid=E.performCheck(s,1,'지능',1,()=>.6);assert.equal(paid.result,'fail');assert.equal(paid.rolledBy,0);assert.equal(s.party[0].traitState.debt,null);});
test('collapsed delegate is not used and trait reservations persist without applying twice',()=>{const s=make('meddler');assert.equal(E.traitAbility(s,0,'delegate',0),false);E.traitAbility(s,0,'delegate',1);s.party[1].status='collapsed';assert.equal(E.performCheck(s,0,'지능',1,()=>.1).rolledBy,0);const t=make('prophet');E.traitAbility(t,0,'predict','fail');const copy=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(t));E.upgrade(copy);assert.equal(copy.party[0].traitState.prediction,'fail');assert.equal(E.traitAbility(copy,0,'predict','success'),false);});
test('repentant improves group checks and grants morale only on success',()=>{const s=make('repentant');s.scene='barricade';const r=E.choose(s,2,sequence(.1,.6));assert.equal(r.roll.threshold,63);assert.equal(r.roll.result,'success');assert.ok(s.log.some(x=>x.text.includes('단체 이동 판정값 +13')));assert.ok(s.log.some(x=>x.text.includes('단체 이동 성공 · 전원 정신 상태 +1')));const t=make('repentant');t.scene='barricade';const fail=E.choose(t,2,sequence(.9,.99));assert.equal(fail.roll.threshold,50);assert.equal(fail.roll.result,'fail');});
test('vigilante protects injured ally at most once in a combat turn',()=>{const s=make('vigilante');s.scene='rescue_wave';E.choose(s,0,()=>.1);s.party[1].hp=100;s.party[0].row='rear';s.battle.intents.forEach(i=>i.target=1);E.resolve(s,()=>.2);assert.equal(s.log.filter(x=>x.text.includes('방어를 대신')).length,1);assert.ok(s.log.some(x=>x.text.includes('기초 방어')));});
test('vigilante refusing protection loses morale once per round',()=>{const s=make('vigilante');s.scene='rescue_wave';E.choose(s,0,()=>.1);E.traitAbility(s,0,'protect');s.party[1].hp=100;s.battle.intents.forEach(i=>i.target=1);const before=s.party[0].mental;E.resolve(s,()=>.2);assert.equal(s.party[0].mental,before-1);assert.equal(s.log.filter(x=>x.text.includes('방어를 대신')).length,0);});
test('battle and exploration consume reservations in actual result calculation',()=>{const s=make('deceiver');s.scene='barricade';E.traitAbility(s,0,'invert');const r=E.choose(s,2,()=>.99);assert.equal(r.roll.result,'success');assert.equal(s.battle,null);const t=make('gambler');t.scene='sixth';E.choose(t,1,()=>.1);t.party.forEach(p=>p.row='rear');t.battle.enemies.forEach(e=>e.agi=0);E.traitAbility(t,0,'reroll');E.resolve(t,()=>.99);assert.ok(t.log.some(x=>x.text.includes('재시도:')));});
console.log(`${tests} unique trait tests passed.`);
````

````ts
import vinext from "vinext";
import { defineConfig } from "vite";
import hostingConfig from "./.openai/hosting.json";
import { readExecutionProfile } from "./scripts/execution-profile.mjs";
import { sites } from "./build/sites-vite-plugin";
import { connectorPreview } from "./build/connector-preview-plugin.mjs";

const SITE_CREATOR_PLACEHOLDER_DATABASE_ID =
  "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000";

const { d1, r2 } = hostingConfig;

// macOS Seatbelt blocks FSEvents, so Codex previews need polling for HMR.
const isCodexSeatbeltSandbox = process.env.CODEX_SANDBOX === "seatbelt";
const managedLinux = readExecutionProfile() === "managed-linux";

const localBindingConfig = {
  main: "./build/sites-worker.ts",
  compatibility_flags: ["nodejs_compat"],
  d1_databases: d1
    ? [
        {
          binding: d1,
          database_name: "site-creator-d1",
          database_id: SITE_CREATOR_PLACEHOLDER_DATABASE_ID,
        },
      ]
    : [],
  r2_buckets: r2
    ? [
        {
          binding: r2,
          bucket_name: "site-creator-r2",
        },
      ]
    : [],
};

export default defineConfig(async ({ command }) => {
  // Use Miniflare's local Request.cf placeholder unless fetching is requested.
  process.env.CLOUDFLARE_CF_FETCH_ENABLED ??= "false";
  process.env.WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS ??= "false";

  // Keep Wrangler and Miniflare state project-local. These are non-secret tool
  // settings; application environment belongs in ignored `.env*` files.
  process.env.WRANGLER_WRITE_LOGS ??= "false";
  process.env.WRANGLER_LOG_PATH ??= ".wrangler/logs";
  process.env.WRANGLER_REGISTRY_PATH ??= ".wrangler/dev-registry";
  process.env.MINIFLARE_REGISTRY_PATH ??= ".wrangler/registry";

  // Wrangler snapshots its log path while the Cloudflare plugin is imported.
  const { cloudflare } = await import("@cloudflare/vite-plugin");

  return {
    server: {
      ...(managedLinux
        ? { host: "0.0.0.0", allowedHosts: ["terminal.local"] }
        : {}),
      ...(isCodexSeatbeltSandbox
        ? { watch: { useFsEvents: false, usePolling: true } }
        : {}),
    },
    plugins: [
      vinext(),
      sites({ mockAuth: !managedLinux }),
      connectorPreview(),
      cloudflare({
        viteEnvironment: { name: "rsc", childEnvironments: ["ssr"] },
        inspectorPort: false,
        config: {
          ...localBindingConfig,
          ...(command === "serve"
            ? {
                services: [
                  {
                    binding: "CONNECTORS",
                    service: "sites-connector-preview",
                    entrypoint: "ConnectorPreview",
                  },
                ],
              }
            : {}),
        },
        ...(command === "serve"
          ? {
              auxiliaryWorkers: [
                {
                  config: {
                    name: "sites-connector-preview",
                    main: "./build/connector-preview-worker.mjs",
                    compatibility_date: "2026-05-15",
                  },
                },
              ],
            }
          : {}),
      }),
    ],
  };
});
````

## C033. PTRPG/제8국 폐병원 게임/app/chatgpt-auth.ts

원본: `PTRPG/제8국 폐병원 게임/app/chatgpt-auth.ts` / 2,550 bytes / SHA-256 `4265a2e7c2dcb3a6f4b7026f762bf5b6e4caec76cc13c0a45987ee9a9f2e42cc`

````ts
import { headers } from "next/headers";
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";

export type ChatGPTUser = {
  userId: string;
  displayName: string;
  email: string;
  fullName: string | null;
};

const USER_ID_HEADER = "oai-authenticated-user-id";
const USER_EMAIL_HEADER = "oai-authenticated-user-email";
const USER_FULL_NAME_HEADER = "oai-authenticated-user-full-name";
const USER_FULL_NAME_ENCODING_HEADER =
  "oai-authenticated-user-full-name-encoding";
const PERCENT_ENCODED_UTF8 = "percent-encoded-utf-8";
const SIGN_IN_PATH = "/signin-with-chatgpt";
const SIGN_OUT_PATH = "/signout-with-chatgpt";
const CALLBACK_PATH = "/callback";

export async function getChatGPTUser(): Promise<ChatGPTUser | null> {
  const requestHeaders = await headers();
  const userId = requestHeaders.get(USER_ID_HEADER);
  const email = requestHeaders.get(USER_EMAIL_HEADER);
  if (!userId || !email) return null;

  const encodedFullName = requestHeaders.get(USER_FULL_NAME_HEADER);
  const fullName =
    encodedFullName &&
    requestHeaders.get(USER_FULL_NAME_ENCODING_HEADER) === PERCENT_ENCODED_UTF8
      ? safeDecodeURIComponent(encodedFullName)
      : null;

  return {
    userId,
    displayName: fullName ?? email,
    email,
    fullName,
  };
}

export async function requireChatGPTUser(
  returnTo: string,
): Promise<ChatGPTUser> {
  const user = await getChatGPTUser();
  if (user) return user;

  redirect(chatGPTSignInPath(returnTo));
}

export function chatGPTSignInPath(returnTo: string): string {
  const safeReturnTo = safeRelativeReturnPath(returnTo);
  return `${SIGN_IN_PATH}?return_to=${encodeURIComponent(safeReturnTo)}`;
}

export function chatGPTSignOutPath(returnTo = "/"): string {
  const safeReturnTo = safeRelativeReturnPath(returnTo);
  return `${SIGN_OUT_PATH}?return_to=${encodeURIComponent(safeReturnTo)}`;
}

function safeRelativeReturnPath(value: string): string {
  if (!value.startsWith("/") || value.startsWith("//")) return "/";

  let url: URL;
  try {
    url = new URL(value, "https://app.local");
  } catch {
    return "/";
  }
  if (url.origin !== "https://app.local") return "/";
  if (isReservedAuthPath(url.pathname)) return "/";

  return `${url.pathname}${url.search}${url.hash}`;
}

function isReservedAuthPath(pathname: string): boolean {
  return (
    pathname === SIGN_IN_PATH ||
    pathname === SIGN_OUT_PATH ||
    pathname === CALLBACK_PATH
  );
}

function safeDecodeURIComponent(value: string): string | null {
  try {
    return decodeURIComponent(value);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}
````

````ts
import {env} from 'cloudflare:workers';
import {createRoom,joinRoom,command,view,RoomError} from '../../../lib/room.js';
export const dynamic='force-dynamic';
const json=(data:unknown,status=200)=>Response.json(data,{status,headers:{'Cache-Control':'no-store'}});
async function digest(value:string){return Array.from(new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256',new TextEncoder().encode(value)))).map(n=>n.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');}
const key=()=>Array.from(crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(24))).map(n=>n.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');
async function load(code:string){if(!/^[A-F0-9]{12}$/.test(code))throw new RoomError('방 코드를 확인하세요.');const row=await env.DB!.prepare('SELECT body, revision FROM rooms WHERE code = ? AND expires > ?').bind(code,Date.now()).first<{body:string,revision:number}>();if(!row)throw new RoomError('없거나 만료된 방입니다.',404);return {room:JSON.parse(row.body),revision:row.revision};}
function authorize(room:any,id:string){if(!room.members.some((m:any)=>m.id===id))throw new RoomError('방에서 나왔거나 참가 권한이 없습니다.',403);}
export async function GET(req:Request){try{const code=new URL(req.url).searchParams.get('code')||'',token=req.headers.get('Authorization')?.replace(/^Bearer /,'')||'';if(!/^[a-f0-9]{48}$/.test(token))throw new RoomError('방에 참가하세요.',401);const id=await digest(token),{room,revision}=await load(code);authorize(room,id);return json({code,revision,room:view(room),id});}catch(e){return error(e);}}
export async function POST(req:Request){try{
 const origin=req.headers.get('origin');if(origin&&origin!==new URL(req.url).origin)throw new RoomError('허용되지 않은 출처입니다.',403);
 if(Number(req.headers.get('content-length'))>10000)throw new RoomError('요청이 너무 큽니다.',413);
 const raw=await req.text();if(raw.length>10000)throw new RoomError('요청이 너무 큽니다.',413);const body=JSON.parse(raw);
 if(['create','join'].includes(body.type)){
  await env.DB!.batch([env.DB!.prepare('DELETE FROM rooms WHERE expires < ?').bind(Date.now()),env.DB!.prepare('DELETE FROM room_limits WHERE expires < ?').bind(Date.now())]);
  const ip=await digest((req.headers.get('cf-connecting-ip')||'local')+':'+Math.floor(Date.now()/3600000));
  const quota=await env.DB!.prepare('INSERT INTO room_limits (id, count, expires) VALUES (?, 1, ?) ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET count = count + 1 RETURNING count').bind(ip,Date.now()+3600000).first<{count:number}>();if(!quota||quota.count>30)throw new RoomError('방 생성·참가 요청이 너무 많습니다. 잠시 후 시도하세요.',429);
 }
 if(body.type==='create'){
  const token=key(),id=await digest(token),room=createRoom(id,body.name),code=key().slice(0,12).toUpperCase();
  await env.DB!.prepare('INSERT INTO rooms(code,body,revision,expires) VALUES(?,?,0,?)').bind(code,JSON.stringify(room),Date.now()+86400000).run();
  return json({code,token,id,revision:0,room:view(room)});
 }
 const {room,revision}=await load(body.code);
 if(body.type==='join'){
````

````mjs
    name: "sites-connector-preview",
    apply: "serve",
    config(config) {

          host: config.server?.host ?? "127.0.0.1",
          strictPort: true,

              ".env.*",

              "**/.sites-runtime/**",

          watch: { ignored: ["**/.sites-runtime/**"] },

    load(id, options) {
````

````mjs
import { WorkerEntrypoint } from "cloudflare:workers";
import binding from "virtual:sites-connector-preview";

// Local-only RPC target. The Site entrypoint scopes it to each request; the Node
// adapter relays each call to the owning agent.
export class ConnectorPreview extends WorkerEntrypoint {
  async getContext() {
    return binding.getContext?.() ?? { status: "binding_unavailable" };
  }

  async invoke(connectorId, actionName, args) {
    return binding.invoke(connectorId, actionName, args);
  }
}
export default { fetch() { return new Response("Not found", { status: 404 }); } };
````

````ts
          .split(";")

        const signInCookies = cookies
          .filter((cookie) => cookie.startsWith(`${localCookieName}=`))
          .map((cookie) => cookie.slice(localCookieName.length + 1));
        const applicationCookies = cookies.filter(
          (cookie) => !cookie.startsWith(`${localCookieName}=`),
````

````ts
import handler from "vinext/server/fetch-handler";
import { runWithConnectorBinding } from "../lib/connector-context";
import type { ConnectorBinding } from "../lib/connector-contract.mjs";

export default {
  fetch(request: Request, env: Cloudflare.Env, ctx: ExecutionContext<{ CONNECTORS?: ConnectorBinding }>) {
    let binding = ctx.props?.CONNECTORS;
    // Local preview emulates the same request-scoped capability. This branch and
    // the auxiliary service binding are absent from production builds.
    if (import.meta.env.DEV && !binding && env.CONNECTORS) {
      const preview = env.CONNECTORS;
      const expiresAt = Date.now() + 60_000;
      binding = {
        async getContext() {
          if (Date.now() >= expiresAt) return { status: "request_context_expired" };
          return preview.getContext?.() ?? { status: "binding_unavailable" };
        },
        async invoke(connectorId, actionName, args) {
          if (Date.now() >= expiresAt) {
            return { status: "request_context_expired", message: "This request has expired. Please try again." };
          }
          return preview.invoke(connectorId, actionName, args);
        },
      };
    }
    return runWithConnectorBinding(binding, () => handler.fetch(request, env, ctx));
  },
};
````

## C046. PTRPG/제8국 폐병원 게임/lib/connector-context.ts

원본: `PTRPG/제8국 폐병원 게임/lib/connector-context.ts` / 612 bytes / SHA-256 `bbddff68689cb0f6926fecd4b8b96f12f2054277c296e97b0df07d4ad5ece24e`

````ts
import { AsyncLocalStorage } from "node:async_hooks";
import type { ConnectorBinding } from "./connector-contract.mjs";

// Capture the trusted capability before Vinext derives its revalidation context,
// which does not retain custom execution-context props. Never share across requests.
const bindings = new AsyncLocalStorage<ConnectorBinding | undefined>();

export function runWithConnectorBinding<T>(
  binding: ConnectorBinding | undefined,
  run: () => T,
): T {
  return bindings.run(binding, run);
}

export function getConnectorBinding(): ConnectorBinding | undefined {
  return bindings.getStore();
}
````

````ts
declare module "virtual:sites-connector-preview" {
  const binding: import("./connector-contract.mjs").ConnectorBinding;
  export default binding;
}

// Only the local preview uses an environment binding. Hosted Sites receive the
// request-scoped capability through ctx.props.CONNECTORS in sites-worker.ts.
declare namespace Cloudflare {
  interface Env {
    CONNECTORS?: import("./connector-contract.mjs").ConnectorBinding;
  }
}
````

````ts
import { createConnectors } from "./connector-contract.mjs";
import { getConnectorBinding } from "./connector-context";

/** Keep invocation context on this request; never cache it across visitors. */
export function connectorsForRequest() {
  return createConnectors(getConnectorBinding());
}
export type {
  ConnectorContext,
  ConnectorResult,
  ConnectorFailureStatus,
  Json,
} from "./connector-contract.mjs";
````

````js
/* Episode text is adapted from the author's hospital manuscript. */
const HospitalData = (() => {
 const c=(label,next,stat=null,opts={})=>({label,next,stat,...opts});
 const scenes={
  ward:{floor:1,title:'낯선 천장',chapter:'01 / 깨어난 사람들',speaker:'나',objective:'병실 밖의 소리를 확인하기',text:'마지막 기억은 청량 제약회사의 임상시험 동의서였다. 보수가 좋다는 말에 서명을 했고, 그 뒤는 비어 있다.\n눈을 뜨자 얼룩진 천장과 멈춘 링겔이 보인다. 다른 침대에서도 사람들이 몸을 일으킨다. 창문 밖은 거대한 벽. 문 너머에서 낮은 소리가 들린다.',choices:[c('문 너머에 귀를 기울인다','knock','민첩',{success:'노크다. 그 뒤로 떨리는 목소리가 들린다. “저기요… 안에 누구 있어요?”',fail:'소리가 작아 알아듣기 어렵다. 잠시 뒤 문을 두드리는 소리가 커진다.'}),c('함께 깨어난 사람들을 확인한다','introduce')]},
  introduce:{floor:1,title:'같은 동의서',chapter:'01 / 깨어난 사람들',speaker:'동행자',objective:'병실 밖으로 나가기',text:'“저도 계약서를 쓰고 나서는 기억이 없어요.”\n서로 이름을 확인한다. 모두 생활비가 필요했고, 모두 청량에 지원했다. 누군가 침대 난간을 잡는다. 적어도 이 방에 혼자는 아니다.\n쿵, 쿵. 문밖에서 목소리가 들려온다. “여기 사람 있나요?”',choices:[c('문을 열어 본다','knock')]},
  knock:{floor:1,title:'문밖의 생존자',chapter:'01 / 깨어난 사람들',speaker:'진사준',objective:'로비의 생존자들과 합류하기',text:'회색 곱슬머리의 다부진 남자가 문 앞에 서 있다. 손에는 무기가 없다.\n“진사준입니다. 청랑도 낭주시에서 왔어요. 저도 여기서 깨어났어요. 아래에 다른 사람들이 있어요. 해칠 생각 없습니다.”\n그의 목소리는 당황스럽지만, 길을 알려 주려는 말에는 망설임이 없다.',choices:[c('진사준을 따라 로비로 간다','lobby',{},{trust:true}),c('거리를 두고 로비로 향한다','lobby')]},
  lobby:{floor:1,title:'내려간 셔터',chapter:'01 / 병원 로비',speaker:'진사준',objective:'식량과 의료품, 병원의 정보를 확보하기',text:'로비에는 진사준을 포함해 여덟 명이 모여 있다. 정문은 잠겼고 두꺼운 셔터가 내려와 있다. 창문 너머로 이어지는 높은 벽 때문에 밖으로 나갈 수도 없다.\n“약과 병상은 있어요. 우선 쓸 수 있는 것부터 모읍시다. 먹을 것, 의료품, 건물 배치도요.”',choices:[c('탕비실에서 식량을 모은다','supplies','민첩',{loot:'food'}),c('의료 창고를 수색한다','supplies','민첩',{loot:'medkit'}),c('계단의 배치도를 조사한다','supplies','지능',{note:'map'})]},
  supplies:{floor:1,title:'돌아가기 위해',chapter:'01 / 첫 번째 정비',speaker:'진사준',objective:'2층으로 올라가기',text:'찾아온 물품을 생존자들과 나눈다. 각자 다른 방에서 가져온 물건들이 로비 탁자에 쌓인다.\n출구는 보이지 않는다. 위쪽에 더 나은 길이 있을까. 누군가는 버티자고 하고, 누군가는 여기서 굶을 수는 없다고 말한다.',choices:[c('물품을 나누고 함께 올라간다','second',null,{share:true}),c('우선 이곳에서 버텨 보자고 한다','second',null,{stress:-5})]},
  second:{floor:2,title:'텅 빈 층',chapter:'02 / 윗층으로',speaker:'나',objective:'휴식과 식량을 확보한 뒤 3층으로 이동하기',text:'2층에는 사람들이 사라진 흔적만 남아 있다. 빈 침대와 열린 서랍. 바닥에는 한쪽 신발이 떨어져 있다.\n배고픔과 피로가 몰려온다. 위로 올라가기 전, 짧게라도 눈을 붙일 곳과 먹을 것을 찾아야 한다.',choices:[c('이 층을 수색한다','second',null,{search:true}),c('식량 1개로 함께 정비한다','second',null,{rest:true}),c('3층 계단을 오른다','barricade')]},
  barricade:{floor:3,title:'철제 의자의 방벽',chapter:'03 / 더 위로',speaker:'나',objective:'막힌 복도를 통과하기',text:'계단에 의자가 엉켜 있다. 방벽 너머로 익숙한 옷차림의 사람이 쓰러져 있다. 로비에서 먼저 올라갔던 생존자다.\n피에 엉긴 옷 가까이 흩어진 이상한 가루와 메모 한 장이 보인다. 위쪽에서 쿵, 쿵, 무언가 두드리는 소리가 난다.',choices:[c('남겨진 메모를 조사한다','barricade','지능',{note:'father',once:'father'}),c('의자를 치우고 길을 연다','whispers','근력',{combat:'fate',fail:'의자가 넘어지며 큰 소리가 난다. 복도 끝의 그림자가 돌아본다.',success:'의자를 조심스럽게 치웠다. 좁은 길이 드러난다.'}),c('우회할 통로를 찾아간다','whispers','민첩',{stress:-3})]},
  whispers:{floor:3,title:'기이한 울음소리',chapter:'04 / 미지와의 조우',speaker:'나',objective:'소리를 내지 않고 위층으로 이동하기',text:'어둠 속에서 누군가 웅크린 채 울고 있다. 사람이라고 부르기에는 움직임이 이상하다.\n바닥에서 아이의 낙서가 붙은 노트를 발견한다. 뒤쪽에는 어른이 서툰 글씨로 남긴 말이 있다. “집에 혼자 있는 딸이 생각난다.”',choices:[c('숨을 죽이고 복도를 지난다','fourth','민첩',{note:'girl',combat:'fate'}),c('계단의 방벽을 뚫는다','fourth','근력',{combat:'fate'}),c('이 층의 남은 물품을 찾는다','whispers',null,{search:true})]},
  fourth:{floor:4,title:'알고 싶지 않은 사실',chapter:'05 / 실험의 흔적',speaker:'나',objective:'청량의 실험 기록을 조사하기',text:'썩은 악취. 부서진 무기. 복도에는 돌아오지 못한 사람들이 남아 있다.\n푸른 꽃 사무소가 남긴 기록에는 사람들을 보호하라는 의뢰가 통제로 바뀌었다고 적혀 있다. 실험 참가자는 하나씩 사라졌고, 개념체는 하나씩 늘어났다.\n조금 떨어진 곳에서 무거운 짐승의 숨소리가 들린다.',choices:[c('사무소의 기록과 실험 일기를 읽는다','fourth','지능',{note:'experiment',once:'experiment',stress:-5}),c('숨소리를 피해 5층으로 향한다','radio','민첩',{combat:'tiger'}),c('의료 창고를 조심스럽게 찾는다','fourth',null,{search:true})]},
  radio:{floor:5,title:'깨진 무전기',chapter:'07 / 이걸 작동하게만 한다면',speaker:'진사준',objective:'방전된 무전기의 전원 확보하기',text:'화면에 금이 간 무전기를 찾았다. 외관은 아직 쓸 만하다. 문제는 완전히 방전된 배터리다.\n계단에서 늑대의 울음이 터지더니 갑자기 뚝 멎는다. 복도 끝에 밝은 눈이 떠 있다. 검은 천에 싸인 거대한 해골이, 어느새 우리 뒤에 서 있다.',choices:[c('움직이지 않고 그를 지켜본다','hope',null,{blessing:true}),c('동행자의 손을 잡고 거리를 둔다','hope',null,{stress:5})]},
  hope:{floor:5,title:'어두운 곳에서 더욱 빛나는',chapter:'07 / 희망의 실마리',speaker:'나',objective:'배터리 또는 비상 전력망 찾기',text:'그 존재는 가장 지친 동행자를 오래 바라보았다. 공격하지는 않는다. 잠시 뒤, 마지막까지 남아 있던 안광도 사라진다.\n이제 선택해야 한다. 6층에서 무전기 배터리를 찾을 것인가. 1층으로 내려가 비상 전력을 연결할 것인가. 옥상으로 계속 오르는 길은 너무 위험하다.',choices:[c('6층에서 충전된 배터리를 찾는다','sixth'),c('1층으로 내려가 비상 전력을 찾는다','generator'),c('무전기를 수리한 뒤 6층으로 간다','sixth','지능',{stress:5})]},
  sixth:{floor:6,title:'눈 다친 산군의 영역',chapter:'07 / 배터리를 찾아서',speaker:'나',objective:'산군에게 들키지 않고 배터리 확보하기',text:'바닥을 긁는 큰 발톱 자국. 창고에는 망가진 무전기가 있다. 그 배터리는 아직 충전되어 있다.\n두 눈을 잃은 산군은 청각과 후각으로 이 층을 배회한다. 죄 없는 사람을 공격하며 이야기 속 산군과 달라진 존재. 싸우는 것보다 지나가는 편이 나을지도 모른다.',choices:[c('조용히 배터리를 빼낸다','signal','민첩',{combat:'tiger',battery:true}),c('산군을 막으며 배터리를 확보한다','signal',null,{battle:'tiger',battery:true})]},
  generator:{floor:1,title:'남겨진 전력',chapter:'07 / 다시 로비로',speaker:'나',objective:'정병헌을 무력화하고 전력망 연결하기',text:'돌아온 로비는 더 이상 사람들이 기다리던 장소가 아니다. 냉장고만 비상 전력을 끌어다 쓰고 있다.\n정병헌이 길을 가로막는다. 다른 사람들의 희생으로 버텨 온 그의 말에는 더 이상 함께 살아남겠다는 뜻이 없다. 전력망을 쓰려면 그를 지나야 한다.',choices:[c('그를 막고 전력망을 확보한다','signal',null,{battle:'human',battery:true,route:'ground'})]},
  signal:{floor:6,title:'응답',chapter:'08 / 구조 신호',speaker:'무전기 너머',objective:'구조대가 합류할 때까지 버티기',text:'배터리를 연결하자 잡음 사이로 여러 목소리가 들린다.\n“거기, 들립니까? 정확한 위치와 생존자 수를 알려 주세요.”\n상황을 설명하자 상대의 말투가 바뀐다. 밖에서 진입해 우리와 합류하겠다고 한다. 그런데 복도 너머의 개념체도 소리에 반응하기 시작했다.',choices:[c('문을 막고 구조대가 올 때까지 버틴다','ending',null,{battle:'wave'})]},
  ending:{floor:6,title:'노력의 결실',chapter:'EPILOGUE / 살아남은 사람들',speaker:'나',objective:'탈출 완료',text:'구조대가 닫힌 문을 열었다. 우리는 무기를 내려놓았다. 몸에 힘이 빠져, 이번에는 정말로 쓰러지고 말았다.\n다시 눈을 뜨자 낯선 천장이다. 하지만 코끝에 썩은 악취가 없다. 곁에는 함께 버텨 온 사람들이 있다.\n버텨 낸 시간은 헛되지 않았다. 우리는 살아남았다.',choices:[]}
 };
 // A stray empty object would otherwise be mistaken for a stat name.
 scenes.knock.choices[0].stat=null;
 const notes={
  map:{title:'훼손된 병원 배치도',text:'정문 셔터는 1층. 병실과 탕비실은 각 층에 있다. 계단은 위로 이어지지만 여러 구간에 방벽이 세워져 있다. 옥상 밖도 외곽 황야다. 출구보다 먼저 연락 수단이 필요하다.'},
  father:{title:'난 올라갈거다',text:'“집에 혼자 있는 딸이 생각난다. 돈 벌려고 이런 일을 겪을 줄이야. 좀 귀찮게 여기지 말고 놀아주기라도 할걸 그랬다.”\n남자는 함께 올라온 두 사람을 지키며 불침번을 섰다. 마지막 글씨는 일그러져 있다. “여자애 이름 물어볼걸.”'},
  girl:{title:'아저씨 이거 봐요',text:'서툰 낙서와 꾹 눌러 쓴 글씨. 사람들을 흉내 낸 그림 옆에, 집으로 돌아갈 때 하고 싶은 것들이 적혀 있다. 이 병원에서 서로를 지키려 했던 사람들이 있었다.'},
  experiment:{title:'개념체 증폭 실험 일기',text:'치릴사력 1705년 3월 18일 / 연구 담당자 차독진\n정제되지 않은 콘세타닐을 대량 주입하여 정신 그릇을 붕괴시킨다. 제4국 국제 타워 대공장 27-1 섹터 대참사를 참고했다. 인간뿐 아니라 소문과 민속신앙도 실험 대상으로 삼고 있다.\n실종된 참가자와 늘어나는 개념체. 두 가지는 하나의 실험이었다.'}
 };
 const actions=[

 scenes.knock.choices=[c('진사준을 믿고 따라간다','lobby',null,{event:'trust'}),c('정체와 상황을 더 묻는다','jin_talk'),c('거리를 두고 로비로 간다','lobby',null,{event:'distance'}),c('진사준에게 무기를 겨눈다','jin_warning',null,{event:'threat'})];
 scenes.jin_talk={floor:1,title:'믿을 수 있는 사람인가',chapter:'01 / 문밖의 생존자',speaker:'진사준',objective:'진사준에 대한 태도를 결정하기',text:'“나도 피해자예요. 셔터를 열려고 했지만 안 됐어요. 로비에 사람들이 있습니다.”\n남자는 양손을 보여 준다. 함께 움직일지, 모르는 사람을 믿지 않을지는 우리의 결정이다.',choices:[c('설명을 받아들이고 함께 간다','lobby',null,{event:'trust'}),c('동행은 거절하고 따로 간다','lobby',null,{event:'distance'}),c('거짓말이라며 공격을 준비한다','jin_warning',null,{event:'threat'})]};
 scenes.jin_warning={floor:1,title:'물러설 기회',chapter:'01 / 문밖의 생존자',speaker:'진사준',objective:'싸울지 물러설지 결정하기',text:'진사준은 뒤로 물러나 공격을 피한다. “싸우러 온 게 아닙니다. 지금 멈추면 없던 일로 하죠.”\n그는 출구를 막지 않는다. 하지만 더 공격한다면 자신도 가만히 있지는 않을 것이다.',choices:[c('무기를 내리고 사과한다','lobby',null,{event:'apologize'}),c('말없이 지나간다','lobby',null,{event:'distance'}),c('끝까지 공격한다','jin_result',null,{event:'fight',battle:'jin'})]};
 scenes.jin_result={floor:1,title:'쓰러진 생존자',chapter:'01 / 돌이킬 수 있는 선택',speaker:'나',objective:'진사준을 어떻게 대할지 결정하기',text:'진사준은 쓰러졌지만 살아 있다. 떨리는 손으로 일어나려 한다.\n그는 더 싸울 생각이 없다. 로비 쪽에서 사람들이 이쪽을 바라본다.',choices:[c('살려 두고 치료 가방 1개를 건넨다','lobby',null,{event:'spare',requires:'medkit'}),c('살려 두지만 동행은 거절한다','lobby',null,{event:'reject'}),c('끝내 목숨을 빼앗는다','camp_confrontation',null,{event:'kill'})]};
 scenes.camp_confrontation={floor:1,title:'로비의 적대',chapter:'01 / 선택의 대가',speaker:'생존자',objective:'생존자들의 반응에 대응하기',text:'“우리를 도우려던 사람을 죽였어?”\n생존자들이 물품을 끌어안고 길을 막는다. 이제 우리를 향한 시선에는 공포와 적의가 섞여 있다.',choices:[c('무기를 내려놓는다','bound'),c('로비를 버리고 위층으로 달아난다','second',null,{event:'exile'}),c('생존자들과도 싸운다','second',null,{battle:'survivors',event:'camp_fight'})]};
 scenes.bound={floor:1,title:'불신의 거리',chapter:'01 / 선택의 대가',speaker:'생존자',objective:'관계를 수습하거나 떠나기',text:'우리는 무장을 내려놓고 떨어져 앉는다. 생존자들은 우리를 감시하지만, 더 공격하지 않는다.\n“물품 정리부터 도와요. 다시 믿을 수 있을지는 모르겠지만.”',choices:[c('물품 정리를 돕는다','lobby',null,{event:'reconcile'}),c('도움을 거절하고 혼자 올라간다','second',null,{event:'exile'})]};
 scenes.supplies={floor:1,title:'누구의 물품인가',chapter:'01 / 첫 번째 정비',speaker:'나',objective:'찾아온 물품의 배분을 결정하기',text:'찾아온 물품을 탁자 앞에 내려놓는다. 아직 누구에게도 건네지 않았다.\n생존자들도 자신의 물품을 모으고 있다. 우리 몫을 챙길 수도, 함께 버틸 자원을 보탤 수도 있다.',choices:[c('찾아온 물품을 전부 나눈다','camp_plan',null,{event:'donate'}),c('절반은 챙기고 절반은 나눈다','camp_plan',null,{event:'half'}),c('우리에게 필요하다며 전부 챙긴다','camp_plan',null,{event:'keep'}),c('물품을 찾지 못했다고 숨긴다','camp_plan',null,{event:'hide'})]};
 scenes.camp_plan={floor:1,title:'남을까, 올라갈까',chapter:'01 / 출발의 결정',speaker:'생존자',objective:'다음 행동을 결정하기',text:'“밖으로 나가는 길이 위에 있을지도 몰라요.”\n다른 이는 셔터 앞에 앉아 고개를 젓는다. “구조대가 올 수도 있잖아요.”\n계단도 로비도 안전을 보장하지 않는다.',choices:[c('진사준에게 동행을 제안하고 올라간다','second',null,{event:'together'}),c('우리끼리 올라간다','second',null,{event:'alone'}),c('로비에 남아 기다린다','camp_wait',null,{event:'wait'}),c('로비의 방벽을 보강한다','camp_plan','근력',{event:'secure',once:'secure'})]};
 scenes.camp_wait={floor:1,title:'기다리는 사람들',chapter:'01 / 로비에 머물기',speaker:'나',objective:'계속 기다리거나 탐색을 시작하기',text:'셔터 밖에서는 아무런 응답이 없다. 계단 위에서 희미한 소리가 흘러내린다.\n식량은 줄어들고, 기다림이 길어질수록 사람들이 흔들린다. 그래도 아직 올라가지 않기로 선택할 수 있다.',choices:[c('조금 더 기다린다','camp_wait',null,{event:'wait'}),c('불안정해 보이는 생존자를 살핀다','camp_wait','지능',{event:'watch',once:'watch'}),c('동행을 제안하고 올라간다','second',null,{event:'together'}),c('우리끼리 올라간다','second',null,{event:'alone'})]};
````
