````js
    recordBattleExecution('attack-roll', { unitId: unit.id, planId: options.planId, hit, roll });
    const focus = getBattleStatus(unit, "집중");
    const strong = getBattleStatus(unit, "강타");
    const critical = unit.criticalReady || (focus && Math.random() * 100 < focus.power);
    const multiplier = critical ? 1.5 + ((strong?.power || 0) + (unit.criticalBonus || 0)) / 100 : 1;
    const effects = getHitEffects(action);
    const effect = effects[hit] || effects.default || "";
    livingTargets.forEach((entry) => {
      const total = Math.max(1, Math.floor(roll.total * multiplier));
      const amount = entry !== target && action.effect.includes("절반 피해") ? Math.max(1, Math.floor(total / 2)) : total;
      damage += applyBattleDamage(unit, entry, amount, { allowCounter: !options.isCounter,
        planId: options.planId, hit, critical: !!critical, attackPower: roll.total });
      if (!entry.lastHitEvaded && !effect.includes("[사용 시]") && !effect.includes("[충돌 시]")) applyBattleEffectText(unit, entry, effect);
      recordBattleExecution('hit-effects-applied', { unitId: unit.id, targetId: entry.id,
        planId: options.planId, hit, effect, evaded: entry.lastHitEvaded });
    });
    if (critical) consumeBattleStatus(unit, "집중");
    if (critical) consumeBattleStatus(unit, "강타");
    unit.criticalReady = false;
    unit.criticalBonus = 0;
    pushBattleLog(`${action.name} ${hit}타: 파형 ${formatSigned(roll.wave)} / 누적 ${formatSigned(waveSum)}, 위력 ${roll.total}.`);
  }
  recordBattleExecution('attack-end', { unitId: unit.id, planId: options.planId, damage });
  return damage;
}

function displaceSequenceUnit(source, target, distance, retreat = false) {
  const dx = target.x - source.x, dy = target.y - source.y;
  const sx = Math.abs(dx) >= Math.abs(dy) ? Math.sign(dx) || 1 : 0;
  const sy = sx ? 0 : Math.sign(dy) || 1;
  const moving = retreat ? source : target;
  const sign = retreat ? -1 : 1;
  let wall = false;
  for (let n = 0; n < distance; n++) {
    const x = moving.x + sx * sign, y = moving.y + sy * sign;
    if (x < 1 || x > 8 || y < 1 || y > 5 || (battleDummy.walls || []).some(tile=>tile.x === x && tile.y === y)) { wall = true; break; }
    if ([...battleDummy.allies, ...battleDummy.enemies].some(unit=>unit !== moving && unit.hp > 0 && unit.x === x && unit.y === y)) break;
    moving.x = x; moving.y = y;
  }
  recordBattleExecution('unit-displaced', { unitId: moving.id, x: moving.x, y: moving.y, wall });
  return wall;
}

function resolveSequenceAction(unit, action, target, options = {}) {
  const targets = getActionTargets(unit, action, target);
  const roll = options.actionRoll || rollHitPower(unit, action);
  const totals = new Map();
  let damage = 0;
  recordBattleExecution('attack-start', { unitId: unit.id, targetId: target.id, targetIds: targets.map(entry=>entry.id), planId: options.planId, action: { ...action }, isCounter: !!options.isCounter });
  recordBattleExecution('attack-roll', { unitId: unit.id, planId: options.planId, hit: 1, roll, reused: !!options.actionRoll });
  action.sequence.forEach((step, index) => {
    if (unit.hp <= 0 || unit.actionCanceled) return;
    if (step.effectTiming === 'before') applyBattleEffectText(unit, target, step.effect);
    const focus = getBattleStatus(unit, '집중'), strong = getBattleStatus(unit, '강타');
    const critical = !!unit.criticalReady || !!(focus && Math.random() * 100 < focus.power);
    const multiplier = critical ? 1.5 + ((strong?.power || 0) + (unit.criticalBonus || 0)) / 100 : 1;
    if (step.ratio > 0 && critical) consumeBattleStatus(unit, '집중');
    if (critical) consumeBattleStatus(unit, '강타');
    unit.criticalReady = false; unit.criticalBonus = 0;
    targets.filter(entry=>entry.hp > 0).forEach(entry=>{
      const amount = Math.max(0, Math.floor(roll.total * step.ratio * multiplier));
      const dealt = applyBattleDamage(unit, entry, amount, { planId: options.planId, hit: index + 1, allowCounter: !options.isCounter, critical, attackPower: roll.total });
      damage += dealt; totals.set(entry.id, (totals.get(entry.id) || 0) + dealt);
      if (entry.lastHitEvaded) return;
      if (step.effectTiming !== 'before') applyBattleEffectText(unit, entry, step.effect);
      if (entry.hp > 0 && step.push && displaceSequenceUnit(unit, entry, step.push) && step.wallRatio) {
        damage += applyBattleDamage(unit, entry, Math.floor(totals.get(entry.id) * step.wallRatio), { statusDamage: true, planId: options.planId, hit: index + 1 });
      }
      recordBattleExecution('hit-effects-applied', { unitId: unit.id, targetId: entry.id, planId: options.planId, hit: index + 1, effect: step.effect });
    });
    if (step.retreat && unit.hp > 0) displaceSequenceUnit(unit, target, step.retreat, true);
    if (step.nextMove && unit.hp > 0) unit.nextMoveBonus = (unit.nextMoveBonus || 0) + step.nextMove;
  });
  recordBattleExecution('attack-end', { unitId: unit.id, planId: options.planId, damage });
  return damage;
}

function changeBattleMentality(unit, amount, reason) {
  const composure = amount < 0 ? getBattleStatus(unit, "평정") : null;
  if (composure) {
    amount = -Math.max(0, -amount - composure.power);
    consumeBattleStatus(unit, "평정");
  }
  const previous = unit.sp;
  unit.sp = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, unit.sp + amount));
  recordBattleExecution('mentality-changed', { unitId: unit.id, before: previous, after: unit.sp, reason });
  pushBattleLog(`${unit.name}: ${reason}, 정신력 ${formatSigned(unit.sp - previous)} (${unit.sp}).`);
}

function applyBattleDamage(attacker, target, amount, options = {}) {
  if (target.hp <= 0) return 0;
  target.lastHitEvaded = false;
  if (!options.statusDamage) prepareIncomingDefense(target, attacker);
  if (!options.statusDamage && target.guardReady && target.activeGuard?.type === "회피") {
    const defenseRoll = target.activeGuard.legacy ? (target.defenseWaveRoll ||= rollHitPower(target, target.activeGuard)) : rollHitPower(target, target.activeGuard);
    const incomingPower = options.attackPower ?? amount;
    recordBattleExecution('defense-roll', { unitId: target.id, targetId: attacker.id, action: { ...target.activeGuard }, defense: '회피', roll: defenseRoll, incomingPower, success: defenseRoll.total >= incomingPower });
    if (defenseRoll.total >= incomingPower) {
      target.lastHitEvaded = true;
      pushBattleLog(`${target.name}: 회피 성공.`);
      battleDummy.filament = Math.min(100, battleDummy.filament + 3);
      recordBattleExecution('hit-evaded', { unitId: attacker.id, targetId: target.id, planId: options.planId, hit: options.hit });
      return 0;
    }
    target.guardReady = false;
    target.activeGuard = null;
  }
  if (!options.statusDamage && target.guardReady && target.activeGuard?.type === "방어") {
    const defenseRoll = target.activeGuard.legacy ? (target.defenseWaveRoll ||= rollHitPower(target, target.activeGuard)) : rollHitPower(target, target.activeGuard);
    const incomingPower = amount;
    amount = Math.max(0, amount - defenseRoll.total);
    recordBattleExecution('defense-roll', { unitId: target.id, targetId: attacker.id, action: { ...target.activeGuard }, defense: '방어', roll: defenseRoll, incomingPower, blocked: incomingPower - amount });
  }
  const protection = !options.ignoreProtection ? getBattleStatus(target, "보호") : null;
  const rawAmount = amount;
  if (protection) {
    amount = Math.max(0, amount - protection.power);
    consumeBattleStatus(target, "보호");
  }
  const previousHp = target.hp;
  target.hp = Math.max(0, target.hp - amount);
  recordBattleExecution('damage-applied', { unitId: attacker.id, targetId: target.id,
    planId: options.planId, hit: options.hit, requestedDamage: rawAmount,
    damage: previousHp - target.hp, beforeHp: previousHp, afterHp: target.hp,
    statusDamage: !!options.statusDamage, critical: !!options.critical });
  if (!options.statusDamage && rawAmount > 0 && !getBattleTeam(attacker).includes(target)) changeBattleMentality(attacker, 5, "적 적중");
  if (previousHp > 0 && target.hp === 0) {
    recordBattleExecution('unit-defeated', { unitId: target.id });
    getBattleTeam(target).filter((entry) => entry.id !== target.id && entry.hp > 0)
      .forEach((entry) => changeBattleMentality(entry, -10, "아군 사망"));
  }
  if (!options.statusDamage && target.hp > 0) {
    triggerBattleStatus(target, "상처");
    triggerBattleStatus(target, "잠식");
    if (options.allowCounter !== false && target.hp > 0 && target.guardReady && target.activeGuard?.type === "반격"
      && isBattleTargetInRange(target, target.activeGuard, attacker)) {
      target.guardReady = false;
      const counter = target.activeGuard;
      target.activeGuard = null;
      pushBattleLog(`${target.name}: 반격.`);
      recordBattleExecution('counter-start', { unitId: target.id, targetId: attacker.id, action: { ...counter } });
      resolveRemainingHits(target, counter, attacker, Math.max(1, counter.hits || 1), { isCounter: true });
    }
  }
  return previousHp - target.hp;
}

function rollHitPower(unit, action, context = {}) {
  let wave = 0;
  let waveSum = action.sequence ? 0 : context.previousWaveSum || 0;
  const waves = [];
  const count = action.sequence ? 1 : context.clash ? context.remainingHits ?? Math.max(1, action.hits || 1) : 1;
  for (let hit = 0; hit < count; hit += 1) {
    wave = rollWaveValue(unit.sp);
    waveSum += wave;
    waves.push({ hit: context.clash ? hit + 1 : context.hit || 1, wave, waveSum,
      power: getPowerAtWave(unit, action, waveSum, context) });
  }
  return { wave, waveSum, waves, basePower: action.power,
    startingPower: getPowerAtWave(unit, action, context.previousWaveSum || 0, context), waveValue: action.wave || 0,
    sp: unit.sp, total: getPowerAtWave(unit, action, waveSum, context) };
}

function getPowerAtWave(unit, action, wave, context = {}) {
  const clashBonus = context.clash ? Number(action.effect?.match(/\[충돌 시\]\s*기본 위력\s*\+(\d+)/)?.[1] || 0) : 0;
  const hitBonus = context.hit ? Number(action.effect?.match(new RegExp(`${context.hit}타 위력\\s*\\+(\\d+)`))?.[1] || 0) : 0;
  const movementBonus = action.sequence && unit.id === 'ryeona' && unit.movedThisTurn ? 1 : 0;
  const total = Math.max(1, action.power + (action.wave || 0) * wave + clashBonus + hitBonus + movementBonus - (getBattleStatus(unit, "충격")?.power || 0));
  return total;
}

function getWaveDistribution(sp = 50) {
  const focus = (Math.max(0, Math.min(100, sp)) - 50) / 50;
  const candidates = [-3, -2, -1, 0, 1, 2, 3].map((value) => ({
    value,
    weight: Math.max(.12, 1 + focus * value)
  }));
  const totalWeight = candidates.reduce((sum, entry) => sum + entry.weight, 0);
  return candidates.map((entry) => ({ value: entry.value, probability: entry.weight / totalWeight }));
}

function rollWaveValue(sp = 50) {
  let cursor = Math.random();
  for (const entry of getWaveDistribution(sp)) {
    cursor -= entry.probability;
    if (cursor <= 0) return entry.value;
  }
  return 0;
}

function formatSigned(value) {
  return `${Number(value) >= 0 ? "+" : ""}${value}`;
}

function getEnemyAction(enemy) {
  if (enemy.tutorialAction) {
    const action = enemy.tutorialAction;
    if (!action.sequence && action.hits > 0) {
      action.legacy = { ...action };
      action.sequence = [{ ratio: 1, effect: action.effect }];
      action.power = 18; action.wave = 3;
      action.effect = `무기로 적을 공격해 (위력 100%)의 피해를 입힙니다. ${describeSequenceKeywords(action.sequence[0].effect)}`;
    }
    return action;
  }
  const isSmoke = enemy.id === "e2";
  const isHeavy = enemy.id === "e3";
  return {
    name: enemy.intent || "개념물 공격",
    type: isHeavy ? "방어" : "개념",
    keyword: enemy.keyword || "충격",
    range: isHeavy ? 0 : isSmoke ? 3 : 1,
    scope: isHeavy ? "자신" : "단일",
    hits: isHeavy ? 0 : 2,
    power: isHeavy ? 15 : isSmoke ? 22 : 18,
    wave: isHeavy ? 4 : isSmoke ? 4 : 3,
    legacy: { hits: isHeavy ? 0 : 2, power: isHeavy ? 8 : isSmoke ? 14 : 8, wave: isSmoke ? 2 : 1, effect: `[${enemy.keyword || "충격 2 / 1"}]` },
    sequence: isHeavy ? undefined : [{ ratio: .5, effect: `[${enemy.keyword || "충격 2 / 1"}]` }, { ratio: .25, effect: '' }],
    effect: isHeavy ? '몸을 단단히 굳혀 들어오는 공격의 피해를 판정 위력만큼 줄입니다.' : `적에게 힘을 실어 부딪쳐 (위력 50%)의 피해를 입힙니다. ${describeSequenceKeywords(`[${enemy.keyword || '충격 2 / 1'}]`)} 이후 다시 적을 덮쳐 (위력 25%)의 피해를 입힙니다.`
  };
}

function consumeReservedCard(unit) {
  if (unit.reservedHandIndex == null) return;
  const [skillIndex] = unit.hand.splice(unit.reservedHandIndex, 1);
  if (skillIndex != null) unit.discardPile.push(skillIndex);
}

function findNearestEnemy(unit, action) {
  const range = typeof action.range === "number" ? action.range : 99;
  return battleDummy.enemies
    .filter((enemy) => enemy.hp > 0)
    .map((enemy) => ({ enemy, distance: Math.abs(unit.x - enemy.x) + Math.abs(unit.y - enemy.y) }))
    .filter((entry) => entry.distance <= range)
    .sort((a, b) => a.distance - b.distance)[0]?.enemy;
}

function findActionTarget(unit, action) {
  const allTargets = [...battleDummy.enemies, ...battleDummy.allies];
  const requested = allTargets.find((entry) => entry.id === unit.targetId);
  return isBattleTargetInRange(unit, action, requested) ? requested : null;
}

function pushBattleLog(line) {
  battleDummy.log.push(line);
}

function renderPrologueScene() {
  const player = document.querySelector("#prologue-player");
  if (!player) return;
  const scenes = getActiveStoryScenes();
  const scene = scenes[prologueSceneIndex];
  if (!scene) {
    advanceToNextStage();
    return;
  }
  if(scene.kind === 'battle') { startMindBattleTutorial(); return; }
  const lineText = scene.line || "";
  const awakeIndex = scenes.findIndex((item) => item.line === "‘음…’");
  const isCenterText = lineText === "목적을 잃고 떠도는 이들이여, 소원을 다시 떠올려 나아가라."
    || lineText === "[버려진 자들의 어둠 속에서 스스로 빛을 밝히고, 타인의 소원을 기꺼이 책임져라.]";
  const isMonologue = scene.kind === 'narration' || (!scene.kind && scene.name === "나");
  const isSpeakerlessNarration = !scene.kind && (scene.name === ""
    || (scene.name === "???"
      && scene.affiliation === "???"
      && !/[\"“”]/.test(lineText)));
  const showSpeakerBlock = !isMonologue && !isSpeakerlessNarration;
  const isPreAwake = awakeIndex !== -1 && prologueSceneIndex < awakeIndex;
  const visualClass = [
    "visual-novel",
    isCenterText ? "center-message" : "",
    isPreAwake && !isCenterText ? "system-boot" : ""
  ].filter(Boolean).join(" ");
  const characterMarkup = !isPreAwake && !isCenterText
    ? getStandingPlacements(getSceneCharacterEntries(scene)).map((entry) => {
        const isSpeaking = entry.active ?? entry.alt === scene.name;
        return `
          <img class="vn-character vn-character-${entry.side || "center"} ${isSpeaking ? "is-speaking" : "is-muted"}"
            src="${entry.src}" alt="${entry.alt || ""}" data-height-cm="${entry.heightCm}"
            style="--standing-height:${entry.canvasHeight}%;--standing-bottom:${entry.bottom}%" draggable="false">
        `;
      }).join("")
    : "";
  const bootMarkup = isPreAwake && !isCenterText
    ? `
      <div class="eisenberg-screen" aria-hidden="true">
        <div class="eisenberg-logo">
          <span class="eisenberg-mark">E</span>
          <strong>EISENBERG</strong>
          <small>prosthetic cranial interface</small>
        </div>
        <div class="boot-columns">
          <pre>root://eisenberg.cranium.boot
neural_bridge.init()
body_owner.transfer = forced
memory.fetch(last_breath)
permission.override = denied
fallback.common_sense = damaged
visual_sensor.relink()
...
status: unstable</pre>
          <pre>00101100 10111001 11101011
module_call: nerve / success
module_call: body / success
module_call: central / failed
access_key: expired
network: disconnected
life_support: converted
identity: unreadable
signal: searching</pre>
        </div>
      </div>
    `
    : "";
  const storyMarkup = isCenterText
    ? `
      <div class="center-line" id="dialogue-line" role="button" tabindex="0"></div>
    `
    : `
      <div class="vn-character-layer" aria-hidden="true">${characterMarkup}</div>
      <div class="dialogue-box ${isMonologue ? "monologue" : ""}" id="dialogue-box" role="button" tabindex="0">
        ${showSpeakerBlock ? `<div class="speaker-block"><strong>${getSpeakerLabel(scene)}</strong></div>` : ""}
        <p id="dialogue-line"></p>
      </div>
    `;
  typedText = "";
  isTyping = true;
  clearTimeout(autoTimer);
  clearTimeout(typeTimer);
  player.innerHTML = `
    <div class="${visualClass}" style="--scene-bg: url('${scene.background}')" tabindex="0">
      <button class="vn-menu-button" type="button" id="vn-menu-button" aria-label="메뉴">☰</button>
      ${bootMarkup}
      ${storyMarkup}
      <aside class="vn-menu-panel" id="vn-menu-panel">
        <div class="vn-menu-actions">
          <button class="ghost-button" type="button" id="log-open">로그</button>
          <button class="ghost-button" type="button" id="auto-toggle">AUTO ${autoAdvance ? "ON" : "OFF"}</button>
          <button class="ghost-button" type="button">설정</button>
          <button class="ghost-button" type="button" id="vn-exit">나가기</button>
          <button class="ghost-button" type="button" id="vn-skip">스킵</button>
        </div>
      </aside>
      <aside class="vn-log-modal" id="vn-log-modal" aria-hidden="true">
        <div class="vn-log-window">
          <button class="vn-log-close" type="button" id="log-close" aria-label="로그 닫기">×</button>
          <h3>대화 로그</h3>
          <div class="log-list">
            ${scenes.slice(0, prologueSceneIndex + 1).map((item) => `
              <p>${item.kind === 'narration' || (!item.kind && item.name === '나') ? '' : `<strong>${escapeHtml(getSpeakerLabel(item))}</strong>`}${escapeHtml(item.line)}</p>
            `).join("")}
          </div>
        </div>
      </aside>
    </div>
  `;

  const visualNovel = document.querySelector(".visual-novel");
  visualNovel.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
    if (event.target.closest(".vn-menu-button, .vn-menu-panel, .vn-log-modal")) return;
    advanceDialogue();
  });
  visualNovel.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
    if (event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " ") {
      event.preventDefault();
      advanceDialogue();
    }
  });
  visualNovel.focus();
  document.querySelector("#vn-menu-button").addEventListener("click", (event) => {
    event.stopPropagation();
    document.querySelector("#vn-menu-panel").classList.toggle("open");
  });
  document.querySelector("#vn-menu-panel").addEventListener("click", (event) => {
    event.stopPropagation();
  });
  document.querySelector("#log-open").addEventListener("click", (event) => {
    event.stopPropagation();
    const logModal = document.querySelector("#vn-log-modal");
    logModal.classList.add("open");
    logModal.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "false");
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      const logList = logModal.querySelector(".log-list");
      if (logList) logList.scrollTop = logList.scrollHeight;
    });
  });
  document.querySelector("#log-close").addEventListener("click", (event) => {
    event.stopPropagation();
    document.querySelector("#vn-log-modal").classList.remove("open");
    document.querySelector("#vn-log-modal").setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
  });
  document.querySelector("#vn-log-modal").addEventListener("click", (event) => {
    event.stopPropagation();
    if (event.target.id === "vn-log-modal") {
      event.currentTarget.classList.remove("open");
      event.currentTarget.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
    }
  });
  document.querySelector("#auto-toggle").addEventListener("click", (event) => {
    event.stopPropagation();
    autoAdvance = !autoAdvance;
    renderPrologueScene();
  });
  document.querySelector("#vn-exit").addEventListener("click", (event) => {
    event.stopPropagation();
    showChapterMap(activeChapterId);
  });
  document.querySelector("#vn-skip").addEventListener("click", (event) => {
    event.stopPropagation();
    const nextBattle = scenes.findIndex((item,index) => index > prologueSceneIndex && item.kind === 'battle');
    prologueSceneIndex = nextBattle >= 0 && !completedTutorials.has(activeStageId) ? nextBattle : scenes.length - 1;
    renderPrologueScene();
  });
  typeDialogue(lineText);
}

function typeDialogue(text) {
  const line = document.querySelector("#dialogue-line");
  if (!line) return;
  let index = 0;
  const tick = () => {
    index += 1;
    typedText = text.slice(0, index);
    line.textContent = typedText;
    if (index < text.length) {
      typeTimer = setTimeout(tick, 45);
      return;
    }
    completeTyping(text);
  };
  tick();
}

function completeTyping(text) {
  const line = document.querySelector("#dialogue-line");
  if (line) line.textContent = text;
  typedText = text;
  isTyping = false;
  clearTimeout(typeTimer);
  clearTimeout(autoTimer);
  const scenes = getActiveStoryScenes();
  if (autoAdvance && prologueSceneIndex < scenes.length - 1) {
    autoTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      prologueSceneIndex += 1;
      renderPrologueScene();
    }, 1500);
  } else if (autoAdvance && prologueSceneIndex >= scenes.length - 1) {
    autoTimer = setTimeout(advanceToNextStage, 1500);
  }
}

function advanceDialogue() {
  const scenes = getActiveStoryScenes();
  const scene = scenes[prologueSceneIndex];
  if (!scene) return;
  if (isTyping) {
    completeTyping(scene.line || "");
    return;
  }
  if (prologueSceneIndex < scenes.length - 1) {
    prologueSceneIndex += 1;
    renderPrologueScene();
    return;
  }
  advanceToNextStage();
}

function advanceToNextStage() {
  clearTimeout(autoTimer);
  clearTimeout(typeTimer);
  const chapterData = chapterStages[activeChapterId] || chapterStages.ch0;
  const currentIndex = chapterData.stages.findIndex((item) => item.id === activeStageId);
  const nextStage = chapterData.stages[currentIndex + 1];
  if (!nextStage) {
    showChapterMap(activeChapterId);
    return;
  }
  showChapterMap(activeChapterId);
  selectStage(nextStage.id);
}

function renderIdentities() {
  const grid = document.querySelector("#identity-grid");
  const roleFilter = document.querySelector("#role-filter");

  function draw() {
    const role = roleFilter.value;
    const filtered = identities.filter((item) => role === "all" || item.role === role);
    grid.innerHTML = filtered.map((item, index) => `
      <button class="identity-card ${index === 0 ? "active" : ""}" data-identity="${item.name}" style="--roster-bg:url('${item.background}')">
        <img src="${item.image}" alt="${item.name} ${item.identity}">
        <span class="identity-info">
          <span class="eyebrow">이동 ${item.move}칸 · ${roleLabel(item.role)}</span>
          <h4>${item.name}</h4>
          <p>${item.identity}</p>
          <span class="tag-row">${item.keywords.map((tag, tagIndex) => `<span class="tag ${tagIndex === 1 ? "blue" : tagIndex === 2 ? "green" : ""}">${tag}</span>`).join("")}</span>
        </span>
      </button>
    `).join("");

    grid.querySelectorAll(".identity-card").forEach((card) => {
      card.addEventListener("click", () => selectIdentity(card.dataset.identity));
    });

    if (filtered[0]) selectIdentity(filtered[0].name);
  }

  roleFilter.addEventListener("change", draw);
  draw();
}

function roleLabel(role) {
  return { front: "전열", support: "지원", control: "제어" }[role] || "전체";
}

function selectIdentity(name) {
  const item = identities.find((identity) => identity.name === name);
  document.querySelectorAll(".identity-card").forEach((card) => {
    card.classList.toggle("active", card.dataset.identity === name);
  });

  document.querySelector("#identity-detail").innerHTML = `
    <img src="${item.image}" alt="${item.name} 선택 이미지">
    <div>
      <p class="eyebrow">${roleLabel(item.role)} · 이동 ${item.move}칸</p>
      <h3>${item.name} / ${item.identity}</h3>
      <p class="summary">${item.description}</p>
      <div class="skill-list">
        ${item.skills.map((skill, index) => `
          <div class="skill">
            <span>${index < 4 ? `${index + 1}스킬` : "수비"}</span>
            <strong>${skill}</strong>
          </div>
        `).join("")}
      </div>
    </div>
  `;
}

function renderFilaments() {
  const board = document.querySelector("#filament-board");
  board.innerHTML = filaments.map(([name, virtue, status, color, glow]) => `
    <article class="filament-card ${status === "미획득" ? "locked" : ""}" style="--orb:${color};--glow:${glow}">
      <div class="filament-orb" aria-hidden="true"></div>
      <h4>${name}</h4>
      <p>${virtue}의 미덕</p>
      <span class="tag ${status === "획득" ? "green" : status === "진행 중" ? "blue" : ""}">${status}</span>
    </article>
  `).join("");
}

function renderFormationArtwork(item) {
  return `<img class="slot-character" src="${item.image}" alt="${item.name}" draggable="false">
    <img class="slot-logo" src="${item.logo}" alt="${item.name} 로고" draggable="false">
    <strong class="slot-name">${item.name}</strong>`;
}

function renderSquad() {
  const slots = document.querySelector("#squad-slots");
  const squad = identities;
  slots.innerHTML = squad.map((item, index) => `
    <article class="slot-card" data-slot="${String(index + 1).padStart(2, "0")}" style="--slot-bg: url('${item.background}')">
      ${renderFormationArtwork(item)}
      <div>
        <h4>${item.name}</h4>
        <p>${item.identity}</p>
        <span class="tag-row">${item.keywords.slice(0, 2).map((tag) => `<span class="tag">${tag}</span>`).join("")}</span>
      </div>
    </article>
  `).join("");
}

renderChapters();
renderIdentities();
renderFilaments();
renderSquad();
````

## C077. 이루다 소설/게임 UI 프로토타입/battle-effects.js

원본: `이루다 소설/게임 UI 프로토타입/battle-effects.js` / 12,486 bytes / SHA-256 `0421d763b709abaae2efa8c8279c4f3876f634063f69050f7c2e9b0ec0c270b6`

````js
(() => {
  const actions = {
    '결말 예측': { key: 'prediction', color: '#83d9ff', accent: '#e4f5ff' },
    '확신의 일격': { key: 'certainty', color: '#f6d17d', accent: '#fff6dc' },
    '계획 수정': { key: 'revision', color: '#66b8ee', accent: '#bbecff' },
    '결말 주석': { key: 'annotation', color: '#e8bd63', accent: '#fff0c4' },
    '결말 주석 · 개념 폭주': { key: 'overdrive', color: '#80ccff', accent: '#ffe1a2' },
    '이루어질 · 회피': { key: 'evade', color: '#94d9ff', accent: '#effbff' }
  };
  const dreamActions = {
    '꾸벅꾸벅': { key: 'dream-blanket', color: '#ac9de9', accent: '#e8e1ff' },
    '비관의 잔향': { key: 'dream-echo', color: '#8a82c3', accent: '#d1bcf2' },
    '수면 유도': { key: 'dream-sleep', color: '#9aa8df', accent: '#e2e9ff' },
    '비관의 침수': { key: 'dream-sink', color: '#7974bb', accent: '#bfb4ee' },
    '비관의 침수 · 개념 폭주': { key: 'dream-flood', color: '#aaa0ec', accent: '#f2e7ff' },
    '이루어져 · 방어': { key: 'dream-guard', color: '#b0a2de', accent: '#e6ddfc' }
  };
  function effectFor(unit, action) {
    if (unit?.side !== 'ally') return null;
    if (unit.name === '이루어질') return actions[action?.name] || null;
    return unit.name === '이루어져' ? dreamActions[action?.name] || null : null;
  }
  window.battleEffectFor = effectFor;
  window.createBattleEffects = root => {
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.className = 'playback-fx-layer'; canvas.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    root.append(canvas);
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d'), effects = [];
    const reduced = matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
    let raf = 0, disposed = false, width = 0, height = 0;
    function resize() {
      const rect = root.getBoundingClientRect(), ratio = Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
      width = rect.width; height = rect.height;
      canvas.width = Math.round(width * ratio); canvas.height = Math.round(height * ratio);
      ctx.setTransform(ratio, 0, 0, ratio, 0, 0);
    }
    resize();
    const observer = new ResizeObserver(resize); observer.observe(root);
    function point(actor, hand = false) {
      const rect = actor?.querySelector('.playback-figure')?.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (!rect) return null;
      const frame = root.getBoundingClientRect(), facing = actor.classList.contains('right') ? -1 : 1;
      return { x: rect.left + rect.width / 2 - frame.left + (hand ? facing * rect.height * .3 : 0),
        y: rect.top + rect.height * .48 - frame.top, size: rect.height, facing };
    }
    function path(points, color, thickness, alpha = 1) {
      ctx.globalAlpha = alpha; ctx.strokeStyle = color; ctx.lineWidth = thickness;
      ctx.beginPath(); points.forEach((p,i)=>i ? ctx.lineTo(p.x,p.y) : ctx.moveTo(p.x,p.y)); ctx.stroke();
    }
    function arc(p, radius, start, end, color, thickness, alpha) {
      ctx.globalAlpha = alpha; ctx.strokeStyle = color; ctx.lineWidth = thickness;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,radius,start,end);ctx.stroke();
    }
    // Procedural particles never consume the combat engine's random-number stream.
    function sparks(p, progress, color, count, size, rotation = 0) {

        const angle=rotation+i*2.399963, distance=(.2+progress*.8)*size*(.65+(i%4)*.12);
        const tip={x:p.x+Math.cos(angle)*distance,y:p.y+Math.sin(angle)*distance*.65};
        path([{x:tip.x-Math.cos(angle)*size*.12,y:tip.y-Math.sin(angle)*size*.08},tip],color,i%3===0?3:1.5,1-progress);
      }
    }
    function brackets(p, r, color, alpha, tilt=0) {
      ctx.save();ctx.translate(p.x,p.y);ctx.rotate(tilt);
      for(const side of [-1,1])path([{x:side*r*.55,y:-r},{x:side*r,y:-r},{x:side*r,y:r},{x:side*r*.55,y:r}],color,2,alpha);
      ctx.restore();
    }
    function drawDream(e, t, s, fade) {
      const {a,b,spec,kind,hit}=e;
      const flood=spec.key==='dream-flood', sleep=spec.key==='dream-sleep';
      const sink=spec.key==='dream-sink'||flood, echo=spec.key==='dream-echo';
      ctx.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';
      ctx.shadowBlur=3;
      const ellipse=(p,rx,ry,alpha,angle=0)=>{
        ctx.globalAlpha=alpha;ctx.strokeStyle=spec.accent;ctx.lineWidth=1.8;
        ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(p.x,p.y,rx,ry,angle,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.stroke();
      };
      const cloth=(start,end,bend,alpha,width)=>{
        ctx.globalAlpha=alpha;ctx.strokeStyle=spec.color;ctx.lineWidth=width;
        ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(start.x,start.y);
        ctx.bezierCurveTo(start.x+(end.x-start.x)*.3,start.y+bend,
          start.x+(end.x-start.x)*.7,end.y-bend,end.x,end.y);ctx.stroke();
        ctx.globalAlpha=alpha*.8;ctx.strokeStyle=spec.accent;ctx.lineWidth=1.6;
        ctx.setLineDash([4,7]);ctx.stroke();ctx.setLineDash([]);
      };
      const petals=(p,count,radius)=>{
        for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
          const angle=i*2.399963+hit*.4;
          const x=p.x+Math.cos(angle)*radius*(.4+t*.6);
          const y=p.y+Math.sin(angle)*radius*.45+t*s*.35;
          ctx.save();ctx.translate(x,y);ctx.rotate(angle+t*.6);
          ctx.globalAlpha=fade*.7;ctx.fillStyle=i%2?spec.accent:spec.color;
          ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,-5);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(7,0,0,5);
          ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-4,0,0,-5);ctx.fill();ctx.restore();
        }
      };
      if(spec.key==='dream-guard'){
        for(let i=0;i<2;i++){
          ctx.globalAlpha=fade*(.55-i*.15);ctx.strokeStyle=i?spec.accent:spec.color;
          ctx.lineWidth=i?2:8;ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(a.x-s*.65,a.y+s*.65);
          ctx.bezierCurveTo(a.x-s,a.y-s*.95,a.x+s,a.y-s*.95,a.x+s*.65,a.y+s*.65);ctx.stroke();
        }
        ellipse({x:a.x,y:a.y+s*.55},s*.65,s*.14,fade*.5);

      }
      if(kind==='cast'){
        const advance=reduced?1:Math.min(1,t*2.6);
        const tip={x:a.x+(b.x-a.x)*advance,y:a.y+(b.y-a.y)*advance};

        for(let i=0;i<ribbons;i++){
          const bend=s*(hit%2?-.65:.65)*(1+i*.22);
          cloth(a,tip,bend,fade*(.65-i*.1),flood?13:9);
        }
        if(sleep||sink)ellipse(b,s*.35,s*.13,fade*.65);

        return;
      }
      if(kind==='impact'){
        if(sleep){
          const closing=1-Math.min(1,t*2);
          ctx.globalAlpha=fade;ctx.strokeStyle=spec.accent;ctx.lineWidth=2.5;
          ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(b.x-s*.5,b.y);
          ctx.quadraticCurveTo(b.x,b.y+s*.35*closing,b.x+s*.5,b.y);ctx.stroke();
          for(let i=-1;i<=1;i++)path([{x:b.x+i*s*.28,y:b.y+s*.03},

        } else {
          const r=s*(sink?.7:.5)*(1+t*.25);
          const fold=Math.sin(Math.PI*t);
          for(const direction of [-1,1]){
            cloth({x:b.x-direction*r,y:b.y-r*.4},
              {x:b.x+direction*r*.4,y:b.y+r*.45},direction*r*fold,fade*.65,flood?15:10);
          }
          const rings=sink?(flood?4:3):echo?2:1;
          for(let i=0;i<rings;i++)ellipse({x:b.x,y:b.y+s*(t*.5+i*.15)},
            r*(.65+i*.18+t*.2),r*.18,fade*(.65-i*.1),echo?(i%2?.15:-.15):0);
        }
        petals(b,flood?12:echo?7:5,s*(.6+hit*.08));
        if(flood&&hit>=3){
          for(let i=0;i<3;i++)cloth({x:b.x-s,y:b.y+s*(i*.25-.2)},

      ctx.shadowColor=spec.color;ctx.shadowBlur=7;

      }
      if(spec.key.startsWith('dream-')){

        const end=reduced?1:Math.min(1,t*2.8), dx=b.x-a.x,dy=b.y-a.y;
        const tip={x:a.x+dx*end,y:a.y+dy*end};
        if(spec.key==='prediction'){
          for(const offset of [-.22,.22]){
            path([{x:a.x,y:a.y+offset*s},{x:a.x+dx*.45,y:a.y+dy*.45-offset*s*.5},tip],spec.color,hit===2?3:1.7,fade);
          }
          brackets(b,s*.32,spec.accent,fade*.7);
        }else if(spec.key==='certainty'){
          path([a,tip],spec.color,hit===2?7:4,fade);
          path([{x:a.x,y:a.y-3},{x:tip.x,y:tip.y-3}],spec.accent,1.5,fade);
          path([{x:tip.x-a.facing*s*.3,y:tip.y-s*.12},tip,{x:tip.x-a.facing*s*.3,y:tip.y+s*.12}],spec.accent,2,fade);
        }else if(spec.key==='revision'){

            const shift=(i-(hit-1)/2)*s*.25;
            path([{x:a.x,y:a.y+shift},{x:a.x+dx*.38,y:a.y+dy*.38-shift},{x:a.x+dx*.65,y:a.y+dy*.65+shift},tip],spec.color,2.2,fade);
          }

          const strips=spec.key==='overdrive'?hit+2:2;

            const shift=(i-(strips-1)/2)*s*.18;
            ctx.globalAlpha=fade;ctx.strokeStyle=i%2?spec.accent:spec.color;ctx.lineWidth=i%2?2:3;
            ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(a.x,a.y+shift);ctx.bezierCurveTo(a.x+dx*.25,a.y-s*.45+shift,a.x+dx*.7,b.y+s*.45-shift,tip.x,tip.y);ctx.stroke();
          }
          brackets(b,s*(spec.key==='overdrive'?.62:.44),spec.accent,fade);
        }
      }else if(kind==='impact'){
        if(spec.key==='prediction'){
          brackets(b,s*(.25+t*.18),spec.accent,fade);
          path([{x:b.x-s*.5,y:b.y},{x:b.x+s*.5,y:b.y}],spec.color,2.4,fade);
          sparks(b,t,spec.color,7,s*.6,hit);
        }else if(spec.key==='certainty'){
          path([{x:b.x-a.facing*s*.65,y:b.y},{x:b.x+a.facing*s*.8,y:b.y}],spec.accent,5*fade+.5,fade);
          sparks(b,t,spec.color,hit===2?14:9,s*.9);
        }else if(spec.key==='revision'){
          for(let i=0;i<3;i++){
            const angle=(hit%2?1:-1)*.55+i*.7;
            path([{x:b.x-Math.cos(angle)*s*.5,y:b.y-Math.sin(angle)*s*.5},{x:b.x+Math.cos(angle)*s*.5,y:b.y+Math.sin(angle)*s*.5}],spec.accent,2,fade);

            path([{x:b.x-r*1.2,y:b.y+r*.65},{x:b.x+r*1.2,y:b.y-r*.65}],spec.color,3,fade);

    function tick(time) {
````

## C078. 이루다 소설/게임 UI 프로토타입/battle-motions.js

원본: `이루다 소설/게임 UI 프로토타입/battle-motions.js` / 1,044 bytes / SHA-256 `624b668e76130c4f7d4c1f5a403d5fffe09b747ae03b7dafc94a3983413f4cdd`

````js
(() => {
  const root = 'assets/battle/motions/single55/';
  function frameFor(name, pose, action, hit = 1) {
    const entry = window.battleSingleMotionLibrary?.[name];
    if (!entry) return null;
    let key = pose;
    if (pose === 'attack') {
      hit = action?.sequence?.[hit - 1]?.motionHit || hit;
      if (action?.type === '반격') key = 'defense';
      else {
        const frame = entry.frames.find(f => f.hit === hit && f.skillName &&
          (f.skillName === action?.name || f.skillName === `${action?.name} · 개념 폭주`));
        if (!frame) return null;
        key = frame.key;
      }
    }
    const frame = entry.frames.find(f => f.key === key);
    const registration = window.battleSpriteRegistration?.(name);
    const renderScale = registration?.renderScale || 1;
    return frame ? { ...frame, src: root + frame.src, renderScale,
      centerX: frame.centerX / frame.canvas[0],
      bottomOffset: (1 - frame.pivotY / frame.canvas[1]) * renderScale } : null;
  }
  window.battleMotionFrame = frameFor;
})();
````

## C079. 이루다 소설/게임 UI 프로토타입/battle-playback.css

````css
.battle-playback { position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:150; color:#f4eee3; overflow:hidden; user-select:none; touch-action:none; background:#0a0e13; }
.battle-dummy.is-playing > :not(.battle-playback) { pointer-events:none; visibility:hidden; }
.playback-world { position:absolute; inset:0; z-index:0; transform-origin:0 0; --hud-scale:1; --playback-unit-height:150px; }
.playback-backdrop { position:absolute; inset:0; z-index:0; pointer-events:none; filter:brightness(.6); }
.playback-damage-layer { position:absolute; inset:0; z-index:100; pointer-events:none; }
.playback-fx-layer { position:absolute; inset:0; width:100%; height:100%; z-index:12; pointer-events:none; }
.battle-playback .playback-field { position:absolute; inset:0; width:100%; height:100%; min-height:0; border:0; background:none; box-shadow:none; filter:brightness(.6); pointer-events:none; }
.playback-field .battle-cell { pointer-events:none; }
.playback-field .battle-cell span { visibility:hidden; }
.playback-header { position:absolute; top:16px; left:20px; right:20px; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; padding:8px 0; font-size:14px; }
.playback-actors { position:absolute; inset:0; pointer-events:none; }
.playback-actor { position:absolute; width:calc(var(--playback-unit-height) * .75); height:var(--playback-unit-height); transform:translate(-50%,-100%); filter:brightness(.23); opacity:1; z-index:2; }
.playback-actor.affected { filter:none; }
.playback-actor.active { filter:none; z-index:5; }
.playback-action { display:none; position:absolute; left:calc(50% + var(--hud-offset,0px)); bottom:calc(100% + 10px); width:210px; text-align:center; transform:translateX(-50%) scale(var(--hud-scale)); transform-origin:bottom center; text-shadow:1px 2px 2px #000; }
.playback-actor.active .playback-action { display:block; }
.battle-playback[data-phase="focus"] .playback-action { visibility:hidden; }
.playback-action small { color:#c5c7c9; font-size:12px; }
.playback-action h3 { font-size:17px; margin:3px 0; overflow-wrap:anywhere; }
.playback-power { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:9px; }
.playback-power strong { font-size:24px; }
.playback-power > span { color:#debc65; font-size:17px; }
.playback-total { font-size:32px; min-width:44px; color:#ffdc79; }
.playback-hits { min-height:28px; display:flex; gap:7px; justify-content:center; }
.playback-hit { position:relative; width:24px; height:28px; }
.playback-hit img { width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:contain; }
.playback-hit b { position:absolute; bottom:0; right:-2px; font-size:13px; text-shadow:1px 1px 2px #000; }
.playback-hit.destroyed { animation:hit-break .4s ease-out forwards; }
@keyframes hit-break { 25% { filter:brightness(3) sepia(1); transform:rotate(-12deg); } 100% { opacity:.15; transform:translateY(8px) rotate(35deg) scale(.65); filter:grayscale(1); } }
.playback-hit.striking { filter:brightness(1.8); }
.playback-action.canceled h3 { color:#bd7373; text-decoration:line-through; }
.playback-action.action-shattered { animation:action-shatter .65s ease-out; }
.playback-action-break { position:absolute; inset:25% -5% auto; padding:8px; color:#ffe9ce; background:#861f32e8; border-block:2px solid #ffb49c; font-size:23px; font-weight:900; transform:rotate(-9deg); animation:break-banner .8s ease-out both; }
.playback-action-break::before,.playback-action-break::after { content:''; position:absolute; left:-8%; top:50%; width:116%; height:3px; background:#ffc4a3; box-shadow:0 0 12px #ff674f; transform:rotate(22deg); }
.playback-action-break::after { transform:rotate(-22deg); }
@keyframes action-shatter { 15% { filter:brightness(3); } 35% { translate:-5px 2px; } 55% { translate:5px -2px; } 100% { filter:brightness(.7); translate:0; } }
@keyframes break-banner { 0% { opacity:0; scale:1.5; } 20%,70% { opacity:1; scale:1; } 100% { opacity:0; scale:.95; } }
.playback-keyword { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; white-space:nowrap; padding:6px 9px; background:#111923e8; border-left:3px solid #9bf0c2; border-radius:3px; }
.playback-keyword img { width:25px; height:25px; flex:none; }
.playback-action.no-action .playback-power,
.playback-action.no-action .playback-hits,
.playback-action.no-action .playback-wave { display:none; }
.playback-wave { display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; }
.playback-wave canvas { width:180px; height:105px; }
.playback-wave canvas.settled { filter:brightness(1.5); }
.playback-roll-label { min-height:17px; font-size:12px; color:#e6d494; }
.playback-figure { width:100%; height:100%; display:flex; justify-content:center; align-items:flex-end; }
.playback-sprite { width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:contain; user-select:none; -webkit-user-drag:none; }
.playback-actor.right .playback-sprite { transform:scaleX(-1); }
.playback-sprite.registered-sprite, .playback-sprite.motion-sprite { position:absolute; left:50%; bottom:calc(-100% * var(--motion-bottom)); width:auto; max-width:none; height:calc(100% * var(--motion-scale)); object-fit:contain; transform:translateX(calc(-100% * var(--motion-center, .5))); }
.playback-actor.right .playback-sprite.registered-sprite, .playback-actor.right .playback-sprite.motion-sprite { transform:translateX(calc(-100% * (1 - var(--motion-center, .5)))) scaleX(-1); }
.playback-concept-body { height:85%; width:70%; display:flex; justify-content:center; align-items:center; }
.playback-concept-body .enemy-core { display:block; width:65%; height:90%; background:#5f4655; border:4px solid #a57667; border-radius:40% 35% 20% 30%; }
.playback-vitals { display:none; position:absolute; left:calc(50% + var(--hud-offset,0px)); top:100%; width:160px; align-items:center; gap:6px; padding-top:5px; transform:translateX(-50%) scale(var(--hud-scale)); transform-origin:top center; }
.playback-actor.active .playback-vitals { display:flex; }
.playback-hp { position:relative; flex:1; height:20px; background:#491b25; border:1px solid #a4474b; }
.playback-hp-fill { display:block; height:100%; background:#b63f49; }
.playback-hp-number { position:absolute; inset:0; text-align:center; font-size:12px; line-height:18px; }
.playback-sp { width:28px; height:28px; line-height:26px; text-align:center; border-radius:50%; background:#175984; border:1px solid #69accd; font-size:12px; }
.playback-verdict { position:absolute; bottom:6%; left:50%; transform:translateX(-50%); max-width:80%; text-align:center; font-size:18px; font-weight:800; color:#ffe39b; text-shadow:1px 2px 3px #000; }
.playback-damage { position:absolute; top:20%; left:50%; font-size:48px; line-height:1; font-weight:900; color:#fff4da; -webkit-text-stroke:1px #351721; text-shadow:3px 3px 0 #57212a; animation:damage-rise 1.2s ease-out forwards; pointer-events:none; }
.playback-damage.critical { color:#ffc256; }
.playback-damage.playback-effect { color:#9bf0c2; font-size:22px; max-width:220px; text-align:center; line-height:1.3; overflow-wrap:anywhere; -webkit-text-stroke:0; text-shadow:1px 2px 3px #102f28; }
@keyframes damage-rise { 0% { opacity:1; transform:translate(-50%,15px) scale(1.15); } 20%,50% { opacity:1; transform:translate(-50%,-6px) scale(1); } 100% { opacity:0; transform:translate(-50%,-38px); } }
.left .clash-contact, .left .attack-contact { animation:contact-left .3s ease-out; }
.right .clash-contact, .right .attack-contact { animation:contact-right .3s ease-out; }
@keyframes contact-left { 40% { transform:translateX(22px); } 100% { transform:translateX(0); } }
@keyframes contact-right { 40% { transform:translateX(-22px); } 100% { transform:translateX(0); } }
@media (max-height:540px) {
 .playback-header { top:4px; left:12px; right:12px; font-size:11px; }
 .playback-action { width:154px; bottom:calc(100% + 4px); }
 .playback-action h3 { font-size:12px; margin:1px 0; }
 .playback-action small { font-size:10px; }
 .playback-power { gap:6px; }
 .playback-power strong { font-size:18px; }
 .playback-power > span { font-size:13px; }
 .playback-total { font-size:24px; }
 .playback-hits { min-height:20px; gap:5px; }
 .playback-hit { width:18px; height:20px; }
 .playback-hit b { font-size:10px; }
 .playback-wave canvas { width:125px; height:73px; }
 .playback-roll-label { font-size:9px; min-height:12px; }
 .playback-verdict { font-size:12px; bottom:auto; top:8px; max-width:35%; }
 .playback-vitals { width:130px; }
 .playback-hp { height:16px; }
 .playback-hp-number { font-size:10px; line-height:14px; }
 .playback-sp { width:22px; height:22px; line-height:20px; font-size:10px; }
 .playback-damage { font-size:36px; }
 .playback-damage.playback-effect { font-size:15px; max-width:160px; }
}
````

## C080. 이루다 소설/게임 UI 프로토타입/battle-playback.js

원본: `이루다 소설/게임 UI 프로토타입/battle-playback.js` / 31,561 bytes / SHA-256 `f7454b726802d53fef460de303bf8843d8f4af8622416dc1fe1647475d16daad`

````js
(() => {
  const wait = ms => new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms * (window.battlePlaybackTimingScale ?? 1)));
  const signed = n => n > 0 ? `+${n}` : String(n);
  const colors = ['#ab4048', '#bb674c', '#ad915c', '#9ca7a7', '#629a9a', '#5f9ec7', '#dac16c'];
  function pairLayout(points, anchorIndex, height) {
    const positions = points.map(point => ({ ...point }));
    if (points.length !== 2) return { positions, mode: 'unchanged' };
    const dx = points[1].x - points[0].x, dy = Math.abs(points[1].y - points[0].y);
    const vertical = dy > Math.max(10, Math.abs(dx) * .65);
    const close = Math.abs(dx) < height * .85;
    const far = Math.hypot(dx, dy) > height * 2.4;
    if (!vertical && !close && !far) return { positions, mode: 'unchanged' };
    const gap = close || far ? height * 1.15 : Math.max(height * .95, Math.min(height * 1.8, Math.abs(dx)));
    const other = 1 - anchorIndex;
    const direction = Math.sign(points[other].x - points[anchorIndex].x) || (other === 0 ? -1 : 1);
    positions[other] = { x: points[anchorIndex].x + direction * gap, y: points[anchorIndex].y };
    return { positions, mode: far ? 'approach' : vertical ? 'align' : 'separate' };
  }
  window.battlePlaybackPairLayout = pairLayout;
  let audio;
  function chime() {
    if (!audio || audio.state !== 'running') return;
    const tone = audio.createOscillator(), volume = audio.createGain();
    tone.frequency.value = 1046;
    volume.gain.setValueAtTime(.025, audio.currentTime);
    volume.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.001, audio.currentTime + .12);
    tone.connect(volume); volume.connect(audio.destination);
    tone.start(); tone.stop(audio.currentTime + .12);
  }

  function drawGauge(canvas, angle, selected = -1) {
    const width = 220, height = 128, ratio = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    if (canvas.width !== width * ratio) { canvas.width = width * ratio; canvas.height = height * ratio; }
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    ctx.setTransform(ratio, 0, 0, ratio, 0, 0); ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
    const x = 110, y = 111;
    for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
      const start = -Math.PI + i * Math.PI / 7 + .014, end = start + Math.PI / 7 - .028;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, 99, start, end); ctx.arc(x, y, 61, end, start, true); ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fillStyle = colors[i]; ctx.globalAlpha = selected < 0 || selected === i ? 1 : .4; ctx.fill();
      if (selected === i) { ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff5c7'; ctx.lineWidth = 3; ctx.stroke(); }
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      const mid = (start + end) / 2;
      ctx.font = 'bold 15px sans-serif'; ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff'; ctx.fillText(signed(i - 3), x + Math.cos(mid) * 80, y + Math.sin(mid) * 80);
    }
    ctx.save(); ctx.translate(x, y); ctx.rotate(angle);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(91, 0); ctx.lineTo(-9, -5); ctx.lineTo(-9, 5); ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff5c7'; ctx.fill(); ctx.restore();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fillStyle = '#f6e4a2'; ctx.fill();
  }

  async function spinGauge(canvas, wave) {
    const first = canvas.dataset.hasSpun !== 'true';
    canvas.dataset.hasSpun = 'true';
    canvas.dataset.spinMode = first ? 'rotate' : 'snap';
    if (!first) {
      drawGauge(canvas, -Math.PI + (wave + 3.5) * Math.PI / 7, wave + 3);
      canvas.dataset.wave = wave;
      canvas.setAttribute('aria-label', `파형 판정 ${signed(wave)}`);
      chime(); await wait(180); return;
    }
    const start = -Math.PI / 2;
    let finish = -Math.PI + (wave + 3.5) * Math.PI / 7 + Math.PI * 2;
    while (finish - start < Math.PI * 2) finish += Math.PI * 2;
    const duration = 720 * (window.battlePlaybackTimingScale ?? 1);
    await new Promise(resolve => {
      let began;
      const frame = time => {
        began ??= time;
        const progress = duration <= 0 ? 1 : Math.min(1, (time - began) / duration);
        drawGauge(canvas, start + (finish - start) * (1 - (1 - progress) ** 3), progress === 1 ? wave + 3 : -1);
        if (progress < 1) requestAnimationFrame(frame); else resolve();
      };
      requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    });
    canvas.dataset.wave = wave;
    canvas.setAttribute('aria-label', `파형 판정 ${signed(wave)}`);
    chime();
    canvas.classList.add('settled'); await wait(150); canvas.classList.remove('settled');
  }

  window.playBattleExecution = async execution => {
    const root = document.querySelector('#battle-dummy');
    if (!root || !execution || battlePresentationActive) return;
    battlePresentationActive = true;
    try {
      const Audio = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
      if (Audio) { audio ||= new Audio(); audio.resume().catch(() => {}); }
    } catch { /* Audio is optional when the browser blocks it. */ }
    const overlay = document.createElement('section');
    overlay.className = 'battle-playback'; overlay.setAttribute('aria-label', '전투 행동 재생');
    overlay.innerHTML = `<div class="playback-world"><div class="playback-actors"></div></div><header class="playback-header"><span>턴 ${execution.turn} · 행동 실행</span><strong class="playback-order"></strong></header><div class="playback-verdict" role="status"></div><div class="playback-damage-layer" aria-live="polite"></div>`;
    root.append(overlay); root.classList.add('is-playing');
    const effects = window.createBattleEffects?.(overlay);
    const controls = [...root.children].filter(el => el !== overlay);
    controls.forEach(el => el.inert = true);
    const units = new Map(execution.steps.flatMap(step => step.units).map(unit => [unit.id, unit]));
    const plans = new Map(execution.steps[0].schedule.flatMap(event => event.plans).map(plan => [plan.id, plan]));
    const actors = new Map();
    const actorActions = new Map();
    const usedActions = new Map();
    const decodedMotions = new Map();
    const world = overlay.querySelector('.playback-world');
    const field = root.querySelector('.battle-field');
    const fieldBounds = field.getBoundingClientRect();
    const backdrop = document.createElement('div');
    backdrop.className = 'playback-backdrop';
    backdrop.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    const fieldAppearance = getComputedStyle(field);
    backdrop.style.background = fieldAppearance.background;
    overlay.prepend(backdrop);
    field.querySelectorAll('.battle-unit-layer, .battle-arrow-overlay').forEach(el => el.remove());
    field.classList.add('playback-field');
    field.style.left = `${fieldBounds.left}px`; field.style.top = `${fieldBounds.top}px`;
    field.style.width = `${fieldBounds.width}px`; field.style.height = `${fieldBounds.height}px`;
    field.style.setProperty('--battle-rot', '0deg');
    field.style.setProperty('--battle-tilt', '60deg');
    field.style.setProperty('--counter-rot', '0deg');
    field.querySelector('.battle-camera').style.transform = 'none';
    field.querySelectorAll('.battle-cell').forEach(cell => cell.className = 'battle-cell');
    world.prepend(field);
    const actorLayer = overlay.querySelector('.playback-actors');
    const origins = new Map();
    const allActors = new Map();
    function emitEffect(kind, unitId, targetId, action, hit = 1) {
      return effects?.emit({kind,unit:units.get(unitId),action,hit,
        source:allActors.get(unitId),target:allActors.get(targetId)});
    }
    function idlePose(id) {
      const actor = allActors.get(id), unit = units.get(id), img = actor?.querySelector('.playback-sprite');
      if (!img || !unit.image) return;
      if (img.getAttribute('src') !== unit.image) img.src = unit.image;
      const registration = window.battleSpriteRegistration?.(unit.name);
      img.classList.toggle('registered-sprite', !!registration);
      if (registration) {
        img.style.setProperty('--motion-scale', registration.renderScale);
        img.style.setProperty('--motion-bottom', registration.bottomOffset);
      }
      img.classList.remove('motion-sprite'); actor.dataset.motion = 'idle';
      img.style.setProperty('--motion-center', .5);
    }
    async function pose(id, key, action, hit = 1) {
      const actor = allActors.get(id), unit = units.get(id), img = actor?.querySelector('.playback-sprite');
      if (!img || unit?.side !== 'ally') return;
      const motion = window.battleMotionFrame?.(unit.name, key, action, hit);
      if (!motion) { idlePose(id); return; }
      if (!decodedMotions.has(motion.src)) {
        const source = new Image(); source.src = motion.src;
        decodedMotions.set(motion.src, source.decode().then(() => source).catch(() => null));
      }
      if (!await decodedMotions.get(motion.src)) { idlePose(id); return; }
      img.src = motion.src; img.classList.add('motion-sprite');
      img.style.setProperty('--motion-scale', motion.renderScale);
      img.style.setProperty('--motion-bottom', motion.bottomOffset);
      img.style.setProperty('--motion-center', motion.centerX ?? .5);
      actor.dataset.motion = motion.key;
    }
    function tilePoint(unit) {
      const cell = field.querySelector(`[data-cell-x="${unit.x}"][data-cell-y="${unit.y}"]`);
      const bounds = cell?.getBoundingClientRect(), frame = overlay.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (!bounds) return { x: frame.width * (unit.side === 'ally' ? .3 : .7), y: frame.height * .65 };
      // Grid positions belong to world space, even after the camera has moved.
      const transform = getComputedStyle(world).transform;
      const inverse = new DOMMatrix(transform === 'none' ? undefined : transform).inverse();
      const point = inverse.transformPoint({ x: bounds.left + bounds.width / 2 - frame.left,
        y: bounds.top + bounds.height / 2 - frame.top });
      return { x: point.x, y: point.y };
    }
    function createActor(unit) {
      const actor = document.createElement('article');
      actor.className = 'playback-actor'; actor.dataset.unit = unit.id;
      actor.innerHTML = `<div class="playback-action"></div><div class="playback-figure">${unit.image
        ? `<img class="playback-sprite" src="${escapeHtml(unit.image)}" alt="${escapeHtml(unit.name)}" draggable="false">`
        : '<div class="playback-concept-body"><span class="enemy-core"></span></div>'}</div>
        <div class="playback-vitals"><div class="playback-hp"><span class="playback-hp-fill"></span><b class="playback-hp-number"></b></div><b class="playback-sp"></b></div>`;
      actorLayer.append(actor); allActors.set(unit.id, actor); idlePose(unit.id); return actor;
    }
    execution.steps[0].units.forEach(unit => {
      const actor = createActor(unit), point = tilePoint(unit);
      origins.set(unit.id, point);
      actor.dataset.originX = point.x; actor.dataset.originY = point.y;
      actor.style.left = `${point.x}px`; actor.style.top = `${point.y}px`;
      if (unit.hp <= 0) actor.hidden = true;
    });
    let pairKey = '';
    const attackStack = [];
    const presentedHits = new WeakMap();
    async function presentStrike(unitId, hit) {
      const attack = attackStack.at(-1);
      if (!attack || attack.unitId !== unitId) return;
      const seen = presentedHits.get(attack) || new Set();
      if (seen.has(hit)) return;
      seen.add(hit); presentedHits.set(attack,seen);
      await pose(unitId,'attack',attack.action,hit);
      if (emitEffect('cast',unitId,attack.targetId,attack.action,hit)) await wait(140);
      const figure = actors.get(unitId)?.querySelector('.playback-figure');
      if (figure) { figure.classList.remove('attack-contact'); void figure.offsetWidth; figure.classList.add('attack-contact'); }
    }
    const verdict = overlay.querySelector('.playback-verdict');
    const state = snapshot => {
      snapshot.forEach(unit => {
        const actor = allActors.get(unit.id); if (!actor) return;
        actor.querySelector('.playback-hp-fill').style.width = `${unit.hp / unit.maxHp * 100}%`;
        actor.querySelector('.playback-hp-number').textContent = `${unit.hp} / ${unit.maxHp}`;
        actor.querySelector('.playback-sp').textContent = unit.sp;
      });
    };
    function floatingText(actor, text, effect = false) {
      if (!actor) return;
      const number = document.createElement('strong');
      number.className = `playback-damage${effect ? ' playback-effect' : ''}`;
      number.textContent = text;
      const body = actor.querySelector('.playback-figure').getBoundingClientRect();
      const frame = overlay.getBoundingClientRect();
      number.style.left = `${Math.max(25, Math.min(frame.width - 25, body.left + body.width / 2 - frame.left))}px`;
      number.style.top = `${Math.max(25, Math.min(frame.height - 55, body.top + body.height * .38 - frame.top))}px`;
      overlay.querySelector('.playback-damage-layer').append(number);
      setTimeout(() => number.remove(), 1250);
      return number;
    }
    function highlightAffected(ids = []) {
      const affected = new Set(ids);
      allActors.forEach((actor, id) => actor.classList.toggle('affected', affected.has(id)));
    }
    async function showPair(leftId, rightId, leftAction, rightAction, snapshot, approach = false, affectedIds = []) {
      let entries = [{ id: leftId, action: leftAction }, { id: rightId, action: rightAction }].filter(entry => entry.id);
      entries = entries.filter((entry, index) => entries.findIndex(other => other.id === entry.id) === index);
      entries.sort((a, b) => origins.get(a.id).x - origins.get(b.id).x || origins.get(a.id).y - origins.get(b.id).y);
      const key = entries.map(entry => `${entry.id}:${entry.action?.name}`).join('|');
      if (pairKey === key) return;
      const samePair = entries.length === actors.size && entries.every(entry=>actors.has(entry.id));
      pairKey = key; actors.clear(); verdict.textContent = '';
      overlay.dataset.camera = 'side';
      if (!samePair) {
      overlay.dataset.phase = 'focus';
      overlay.dataset.focusCount = Number(overlay.dataset.focusCount || 0) + 1;
      // Reset presentation positions only, never the combat grid coordinates.
      allActors.forEach((actor, id) => {
        idlePose(id);
        actor.classList.remove('active', 'left', 'right', 'affected'); actor.style.transition = 'none';
        const point = origins.get(id);
        actor.style.left = `${point.x}px`; actor.style.top = `${point.y}px`;
      });
      }
      entries.forEach((entry, index) => {
        const unit = units.get(entry.id), action = entry.action;
        if (!unit) return;
        const actor = allActors.get(unit.id) || createActor(unit);
        actor.hidden = false; actor.classList.add('active', index === 0 ? 'left' : 'right');
        const changed = !samePair || JSON.stringify(actorActions.get(unit.id)) !== JSON.stringify(action);
        if (changed) {
        actor.querySelector('.playback-action').className = `playback-action${action ? '' : ' no-action'}`;
        actor.querySelector('.playback-action').innerHTML = `<small>${escapeHtml(unit.name)}</small><h3>${escapeHtml(action?.name || (isBattleSupportAction(leftAction) ? '지원 대상' : '피격'))}</h3>
            <div class="playback-power"><strong>${action?.power ?? '—'}</strong><span>${action ? signed(action.wave || 0) : ''}</span><b class="playback-total">${action?.power ?? '—'}</b></div>
            <div class="playback-hits">${action?.sequence || action?.legacy ? '' : Array.from({ length: Math.max(0, action?.hits || 0) }, (_, hit) => `<span class="playback-hit" data-hit="${hit + 1}"><img src="assets/icons/hit-sword.png" alt=""><b>${hit + 1}</b></span>`).join('')}</div>
            <div class="playback-wave"><canvas aria-label="파형 판정 게이지"></canvas><span class="playback-roll-label"></span></div>
          `;
        drawGauge(actor.querySelector('canvas'), -Math.PI / 2);
        }
        actors.set(actor.dataset.unit, actor);
        actorActions.set(unit.id, action);
      });
      highlightAffected(affectedIds);
      state(snapshot);
      // A response changes the HUD, not the participants' positions or camera.
      if (samePair) { overlay.dataset.phase = 'judgment'; return; }
      const small = overlay.clientHeight <= 540;
      const unitHeight = small ? 82 : 150;
      const anchorIndex = Math.max(0, entries.findIndex(entry=>entry.id===(approach ? rightId : leftId)));
      const originalPoints = entries.map(entry => origins.get(entry.id));
      const layout = pairLayout(originalPoints, anchorIndex, unitHeight);
      if (approach && originalPoints.length === 2) {
        const moving = 1 - anchorIndex;
        const direction = Math.sign(originalPoints[moving].x - originalPoints[anchorIndex].x) || (moving === 0 ? -1 : 1);
        layout.positions[moving] = { x: originalPoints[anchorIndex].x + direction * unitHeight * 1.15, y: originalPoints[anchorIndex].y };
        layout.mode = 'approach';
      }
      const points = layout.positions;
      // Swap only artwork: the approach never changes simulation coordinates.
      for (let index = 0; index < entries.length; index++) {
        if (Math.hypot(points[index].x-originalPoints[index].x, points[index].y-originalPoints[index].y) > 1)
          await pose(entries[index].id, 'move');
      }
      overlay.dataset.layout = layout.mode;
      const center = { x: points.reduce((sum, p) => sum + p.x, 0) / points.length,
        y: points.reduce((sum, p) => sum + p.y, 0) / points.length };
      const spanX = Math.max(...points.map(p=>p.x)) - Math.min(...points.map(p=>p.x));
      const spanY = Math.max(...points.map(p=>p.y)) - Math.min(...points.map(p=>p.y));
      const scale = Math.max(.35, Math.min(small ? 1.15 : 1.35,
        (overlay.clientWidth - (small ? 320 : 460)) / (spanX + unitHeight),
        (overlay.clientHeight * .89 - (small ? 190 : 290)) / (spanY + unitHeight)));
      world.style.setProperty('--hud-scale', 1 / scale);
      world.style.setProperty('--playback-unit-height', `${unitHeight}px`);
      world.getBoundingClientRect();
      const duration = 550 * (window.battlePlaybackTimingScale ?? 1);
      const hudOffset = Math.max(0, (small ? 80 : 115) / scale - spanX / 2);
      world.style.transition = `transform ${duration}ms ease-out`;
      const lastFoot = Math.max(...points.map(p=>p.y));
      world.style.transform = `translate(${overlay.clientWidth * .5 - center.x * scale}px, ${overlay.clientHeight * (small ? .89 : .83) - lastFoot * scale}px) scale(${scale})`;
      entries.forEach((entry, index) => {
        const direction = index === 0 ? -1 : 1;
        const actor = actors.get(entry.id);
        actor.dataset.positionRole = index === anchorIndex ? 'anchor' : 'moving';
        actor.style.transition = `left ${duration}ms ease-in-out, top ${duration}ms ease-in-out`;
        actor.style.left = `${points[index].x}px`; actor.style.top = `${points[index].y}px`;
        actor.style.setProperty('--hud-offset', `${entries.length === 1 ? 0 : direction * hudOffset}px`);
      });
      await wait(550);
      for (const entry of entries) idlePose(entry.id);
      overlay.dataset.phase = 'judgment'; await wait(150);
    }
    async function showRolls(entries) {
      entries.forEach(({ id, roll }) => {
        const actor = actors.get(id);
        if (actor) actor.querySelector('.playback-total').textContent = roll.startingPower;
      });
      const count = Math.max(...entries.map(entry => entry.roll.waves.length));
      for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        await Promise.all(entries.map(async ({ id, roll }) => {
          const actor = actors.get(id), wave = roll.waves[i]; if (!actor || !wave) return;
          actor.querySelector('.playback-roll-label').textContent = `${wave.hit}번째 파형 판정`;
          await spinGauge(actor.querySelector('canvas'), wave.wave);
          actor.querySelector('.playback-total').textContent = wave.power;
          actor.querySelector('.playback-roll-label').textContent = `${roll.basePower} ${signed(roll.waveValue)} × (${signed(wave.waveSum)}) → ${wave.power}`;
        }));
      }
    }
    try {
      for (const step of execution.steps) {
        overlay.dataset.step = step.type;
        overlay.dataset.sequence = step.sequence;
        overlay.querySelector('.playback-order').textContent = `순서 ${step.order || '—'}`;
        if (step.type === 'action-start') {
          pairKey = '';
        } else if (step.type === 'action-used') {
          usedActions.set(step.unitId, step.action);
        } else if (step.type === 'clash-start') {
          const a = plans.get(step.attackerPlanId), b = plans.get(step.defenderPlanId);
          await showPair(step.attackerId, step.defenderId, a?.action, b?.action, step.units,
            isBattleWholeAreaAction(a?.action) || isBattleWholeAreaAction(b?.action), step.targetIds);
          await pose(step.attackerId, 'clash'); await pose(step.defenderId, 'clash');
        } else if (step.type === 'clash-roll') {
          await pose(step.attackerId, 'clash'); await pose(step.defenderId, 'clash');
          verdict.textContent = '패링 판정';
          await showRolls([{ id: step.attackerId, roll: step.attackerRoll }, { id: step.defenderId, roll: step.defenderRoll }]);
        } else if (step.type === 'clash-compare') {
          const sourceId = [...actors.keys()].find(id=>units.get(id)?.name==='이루어질');
          if (sourceId) emitEffect('clash',sourceId,[...actors.keys()].find(id=>id!==sourceId),actorActions.get(sourceId));
          actors.forEach(actor => {
            actor.querySelector('.playback-figure').classList.remove('clash-contact');
            void actor.offsetWidth;
            actor.querySelector('.playback-figure').classList.add('clash-contact');
          });
          verdict.textContent = `${step.attackerPower} ${step.winnerId ? '≠' : '='} ${step.defenderPower} · ${step.winnerId ? `${units.get(step.winnerId).name} 패링 성공` : step.parry ? '동률 · 상쇄' : '동률 · 재판정'}`;
          await wait(380);
        } else if (step.type === 'hit-destroyed') {
          await pose(step.unitId, 'clash-loss');
          for (const id of actors.keys()) if (id !== step.unitId) await pose(id, 'clash-win');
          const hit = actors.get(step.unitId)?.querySelector(`[data-hit="${step.hit}"]`);
          hit?.classList.add('destroyed');
          hit?.setAttribute('aria-label', `${step.hit}타 파괴`);
          await wait(450);
        } else if (step.type === 'clash-end') {
          if (step.winnerId) await pose(step.winnerId, 'clash-win');
        } else if (step.type === 'action-canceled') {
          if (step.reason === 'parried') await pose(step.unitId, 'clash-loss');
          const actor = actors.get(step.unitId);
          actor?.querySelector('.playback-action').classList.add('canceled');
          if (step.reason === 'parried' || step.reason === 'hits-destroyed') {
            const hud = actor?.querySelector('.playback-action');
            if (hud) {
              hud.classList.add('action-shattered');
              const burst = document.createElement('span');
              burst.className = 'playback-action-break';
              burst.textContent = '행동 파괴';
              hud.append(burst);
            }
          }
          verdict.textContent = `${units.get(step.unitId).name} · 행동 ${step.reason === 'parry-tie' ? '상쇄' : '파괴'}`; await wait(450);
        } else if (step.type === 'clash-followup') {
          verdict.textContent = `${units.get(step.unitId).name} · 공격 연결`;
          await wait(400);
        } else if (step.type === 'attack-start') {
          attackStack.push(step);
          // Retain the clash framing and broken hit icons for its surviving attack.
          if (!actors.has(step.unitId) || !actors.has(step.targetId)) {
            const action = step.action || plans.get(step.planId)?.action;
            const response = execution.steps.find(s=>s.sequence>step.sequence && s.order===step.order &&
              (s.type==='defense-roll'||s.type==='counter-start') && s.unitId===step.targetId && s.targetId===step.unitId);
            await showPair(step.unitId, step.targetId, action, response?.action, step.units, true, step.targetIds);
          }
          highlightAffected(step.targetIds);
          verdict.textContent = step.isCounter ? '반격' : '공격'; await wait(250);
        } else if (step.type === 'support-start') {
          await showPair(step.unitId, step.targetId, step.action, null, step.units, true, step.targetIds);
          verdict.textContent = '지원'; await wait(250);
        } else if (step.type === 'defense-ready') {
          if (!step.respondingToId) await showPair(step.unitId, step.unitId, plans.get(step.planId)?.action, null, step.units);
          await pose(step.unitId, 'clash');
          verdict.textContent = `${step.defense} · 대응 대기`; await wait(350);
        } else if (step.type === 'defense-roll') {
          const attack = attackStack.at(-1);
          await showPair(step.targetId, step.unitId, attack?.action, step.action, step.units, true, attack?.targetIds);
          await showRolls([{ id: step.unitId, roll: step.roll }]);
          if (step.defense === '방어' || step.success) await pose(step.unitId, 'defense');
          if (step.success || step.defense === '방어') emitEffect('response',step.unitId,step.unitId,step.action);
          verdict.textContent = step.defense === '회피' ? (step.success ? '회피 성공' : '회피 실패 · 해제') : `방어 · 피해 ${step.blocked} 감소`;
          await wait(350);
        } else if (step.type === 'counter-start') {
          await showPair(step.unitId, step.targetId, step.action, null, step.units, true);
          verdict.textContent = '반격 · 1회 대응'; await wait(250);
        } else if (step.type === 'attack-roll' || step.type === 'support-roll') {
          verdict.textContent = step.reused ? '공격 · 승리 파형 유지' : actorActions.get(step.unitId)?.sequence ? '행동 위력 판정' : `${step.type === 'support-roll' ? '지원 · ' : ''}${step.hit}타`;
          if (!step.reused) await showRolls([{ id: step.unitId, roll: step.roll }]);
          else {
            const actor = actors.get(step.unitId);
            if (actor) {
              actor.querySelector('.playback-total').textContent = step.roll.total;
              actor.querySelector('.playback-roll-label').textContent = `${step.roll.basePower} ${signed(step.roll.waveValue)} × (${signed(step.roll.wave)}) → ${step.roll.total}`;
            }
          }
          if (step.type === 'support-roll') {
            const action = actorActions.get(step.unitId) || usedActions.get(step.unitId);
            await pose(step.unitId,'attack',action,step.hit);
            const targetId=execution.steps.find(s=>s.type==='support-start'&&s.planId===step.planId)?.targetId;
            if (emitEffect('cast',step.unitId,targetId,action,step.hit)) await wait(140);
          }
          actors.get(step.unitId)?.querySelector(`[data-hit="${step.hit}"]`)?.classList.add('striking');
        } else if (step.type === 'damage-applied') {
          if (!step.statusDamage) await presentStrike(step.unitId,step.hit);
          if (!step.statusDamage && step.damage > 0) await pose(step.targetId, 'hurt');
          if (!step.statusDamage && step.damage > 0) emitEffect('impact',step.unitId,step.targetId,
            attackStack.at(-1)?.action || usedActions.get(step.unitId),step.hit);
          const actor = allActors.get(step.targetId);
          if (actor) {
            const number = floatingText(actor, step.damage);
            if (step.critical) number.classList.add('critical');
            number.setAttribute('aria-label', `피해 ${step.damage}`);
          }
          state(step.units); await wait(650);
          idlePose(step.targetId);
        } else if (step.type === 'unit-displaced') {
          const unit = step.units.find(entry=>entry.id === step.unitId);
          const actor = allActors.get(step.unitId);
          if (unit && actor) {
            const previous = origins.get(step.unitId), next = tilePoint(unit);
            actor.style.left = `${parseFloat(actor.style.left) + next.x - previous.x}px`;
            actor.style.top = `${parseFloat(actor.style.top) + next.y - previous.y}px`;
            origins.set(step.unitId, next);
            if (step.wall) floatingText(actor, '벽 충돌', true);
            await wait(300);
          }
        } else if (step.type === 'support-applied') {
          await pose(step.unitId, 'attack', actorActions.get(step.unitId) || usedActions.get(step.unitId), step.hit);
          step.targetIds.forEach(id => allActors.get(id)?.classList.add('affected'));
          step.targetIds.forEach(id => emitEffect('impact',step.unitId,id,
            actorActions.get(step.unitId) || usedActions.get(step.unitId),step.hit));
          state(step.units); await wait(650);
        } else if (step.type === 'status-added') {
          const icons = { '상처':'wound', '잠식':'erosion', '강타':'impact', '집중':'focus', '자원':'resource', '충격':'shock', '보호':'protection', '평정':'composure', '회복':'recovery', '격려':'encouragement' };
          const popup = floatingText(allActors.get(step.unitId), `${step.keyword} +${step.power} | +${step.count}`, true);
          if (popup) {
            popup.classList.add('playback-keyword');
            popup.style.top = `${parseFloat(popup.style.top) + 42}px`;
            popup.dataset.keyword = step.keyword;
            const icon = document.createElement('img');
            icon.src = `assets/icons/keywords/${icons[step.keyword]}.svg`;
            icon.alt = '';
            popup.prepend(icon);
            popup.setAttribute('aria-label', `${step.keyword} 부여: 위력 ${step.power}, 횟수 ${step.count}`);
          }
          state(step.units); await wait(250);
        } else if (step.type === 'support-end') {
          await wait(300);
        } else if (step.type === 'hit-evaded') {
          await presentStrike(step.unitId,step.hit);
          await pose(step.targetId, 'defense');
          floatingText(allActors.get(step.targetId), '회피', true);
          verdict.textContent = '회피 성공 · 피해 없음'; await wait(500);
        } else if (step.type === 'unit-defeated') {
          const actor = allActors.get(step.unitId); if (actor) actor.hidden = true;
        } else if (step.type === 'attack-end') {
          attackStack.pop();
          const attack = attackStack.at(-1);
          if (attack) await showPair(attack.unitId, attack.targetId, attack.action, null, step.units, true, attack.targetIds);
          overlay.querySelectorAll('.striking').forEach(hit => hit.classList.remove('striking'));
          await wait(300);
        } else if (step.type === 'action-skipped') {
          verdict.textContent = step.reason === 'out-of-range' ? '사거리 밖 · 행동 건너뜀' : '행동 불가'; await wait(250);
        } else if (step.type === 'clash-stalemate') {
          verdict.textContent = '장기 동률 · 행동 상쇄'; await wait(600);
        } else if (step.type === 'action-end') {
          allActors.forEach((actor,id)=>{ actor.classList.remove('affected', 'active'); idlePose(id); });
          actors.clear();
        }
        state(step.units);
      }
      await wait(400);
    } finally {
      effects?.dispose();
      overlay.remove(); controls.forEach(el => el.inert = false);
      root.classList.remove('is-playing'); battlePresentationActive = false;
      renderBattleDummy();
    }
  };
})();
````

````js
// Register each native idle by crown-to-sole height, without changing its anatomy.
window.battleSpriteRegistration = name => {
  const sprite = window.battleSpriteAssets[name];
  if (!sprite?.combat) return null;
  const renderScale = sprite.canvas[1] / (sprite.bodyHeight || 900);
  return { renderScale, bottomOffset: (1 - sprite.footPivot[1] / sprite.canvas[1]) * renderScale,
    motionRenderScale: 1024 / 900 };
};
````
