<a id="source-c090"></a>

## C090. 이루다 소설/게임 UI 프로토타입/styles.css

원본: `이루다 소설/게임 UI 프로토타입/styles.css` / 91,450 bytes / SHA-256 `d8d1b89bcf4d8362ebe376f963d3e13025fb1bbd9647721643d836d667d20767`

````css
:root {
  color-scheme: dark;
  --bg: #0b0c0f;
  --panel: #17191f;
  --panel-2: #20232b;
  --text: #f2f0e8;
  --muted: #a9abb4;
  --gold: #c9a45c;
  --gold-2: #f0d48a;
  --blue: #7eafff;
  --green: #83c58a;
  --red: #d66e6e;
  --shadow: 0 22px 70px rgba(0, 0, 0, .45);
}

* { box-sizing: border-box; }

body {
  margin: 0;
  min-height: 100vh;
  overflow-x: hidden;
  background:
    linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, .035) 1px, transparent 1px) 0 0 / 44px 44px,
    radial-gradient(circle at 74% 18%, rgba(126, 175, 255, .16), transparent 34rem),
    radial-gradient(circle at 18% 88%, rgba(201, 164, 92, .14), transparent 28rem),
    #0b0c0f;
  color: var(--text);
  font-family: "Segoe UI", "Pretendard", "Apple SD Gothic Neo", sans-serif;
  letter-spacing: 0;
}

button, select { font: inherit; }
button { cursor: pointer; }

.app-shell { min-height: 100vh; }

.sr-only {
  position: absolute;
  width: 1px;
  height: 1px;
  padding: 0;
  margin: -1px;
  overflow: hidden;
  clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);
  white-space: nowrap;
  border: 0;
}

.hidden { display: none !important; }

body.story-focus {
  overflow: hidden;
}

body.story-focus .content {
  padding: 0;
}

body.story-focus .main-nav {
  display: none;
}

body.story-focus #story-view {
  height: 100vh;
}

.content {
  min-height: 100vh;
  padding: 1rem 1rem 7.2rem;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 1rem;
}

.eyebrow {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: .72rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.view {
  display: none;
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 0;
}

.view.active { display: block; }

.home-layout {
  min-height: calc(100vh - 9.5rem);
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 23rem;
  grid-template-rows: minmax(20rem, 1fr) auto;
  grid-template-areas:
    "standby notice"
    "wallet notice";
  gap: 1rem;
}

.standby-panel,
.notice-card,
.wallet-panel,
.chapter-card,
.identity-card,
.filament-card,
.slot-card,
.chapter-detail,
.identity-detail,
.formation-presets,
.preset-slot,
.placeholder-panel {
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .11);
  background: rgba(23, 25, 31, .9);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow);
}

.standby-panel {
  grid-area: standby;
  min-height: 100%;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: #111319;
}

.standby-art {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background:
    linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(11, 12, 15, .92) 0%, rgba(11, 12, 15, .28) 45%, rgba(11, 12, 15, .82) 100%),
    url("../이루다 1획 삽화/03_이루리_펜타R비행선_도착_삽화.png") center / cover;
  filter: saturate(.95) contrast(1.05);
}

.standby-copy {
  position: absolute;
  left: 1.4rem;
  bottom: 1.25rem;
  max-width: 34rem;
}

.standby-copy h3 {
  margin: .25rem 0 .6rem;
  font-size: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 4.2rem);
}

.standby-copy p:last-child {
  margin: 0;
  color: #d8dbe2;
  line-height: 1.65;
}

.notice-stack {
  grid-area: notice;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-rows: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 1rem;
}

.notice-card {
  padding: 1rem;
  min-height: 12rem;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.notice-card::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  width: 10rem;
  height: 10rem;
  right: -3.8rem;
  bottom: -4rem;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .1);
  transform: rotate(25deg);
}

.notice-card h4,
.wallet-panel h4,
.placeholder-panel h3 {
  margin: .35rem 0;
  font-size: 1.3rem;
}

.notice-card p:not(.eyebrow) {
  color: var(--muted);
  line-height: 1.55;
}

.notice-card strong {
  color: var(--gold-2);
  font-size: 1.45rem;
}

.wallet-panel {
  grid-area: wallet;
  padding: .9rem;
}

.wallet-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: .8rem;
  margin-bottom: .8rem;
}

.wallet-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: .55rem;
}

.wallet-grid div {
  min-height: 4.1rem;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .1);
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .04);
  padding: .65rem;
}

.wallet-grid span {
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: .8rem;
}

.wallet-grid strong {
  display: block;
  margin-top: .3rem;
  color: var(--gold-2);
  font-size: 1.2rem;
}

.main-nav {
  position: fixed;
  right: 1rem;
  bottom: 1rem;
  z-index: 10;
  width: min(44rem, calc(100vw - 2rem));
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(6, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: .55rem;
  padding: .45rem;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .12);
  background: rgba(10, 11, 15, .88);
  backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow);
}

.main-nav .nav-item {
  min-height: 4.7rem;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .13);
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(38, 41, 50, .96), rgba(15, 17, 22, .96));
  color: var(--text);
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  gap: .25rem;
}

.menu-icon {
  width: 1.55rem;
  height: 1.55rem;
  position: relative;
  display: block;
  color: var(--gold);
}

.main-nav .nav-item strong {
  font-size: .86rem;
}

.menu-icon::before,
.menu-icon::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  border-color: currentColor;
}

.icon-home::before {
  width: 1.1rem;
  height: 1.1rem;
  left: .22rem;
  top: .34rem;
  border: .16rem solid currentColor;
  transform: rotate(45deg);
}

.icon-home::after {
  width: .56rem;
  height: .56rem;
  left: .49rem;
  top: .61rem;
  background: currentColor;
}

.icon-squad {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, .58rem);
  grid-template-rows: repeat(2, .58rem);
  gap: .24rem;
  align-content: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.icon-squad::before {
  position: static;
  content: "";
  width: .58rem;
  height: .58rem;
  background: currentColor;
  box-shadow: .82rem 0 0 currentColor, 0 .82rem 0 currentColor, .82rem .82rem 0 currentColor;
}

.icon-story::before {
  width: 1.15rem;
  height: 1.25rem;
  left: .18rem;
  top: .14rem;
  border: .16rem solid currentColor;
  border-radius: .06rem;
}

.icon-story::after {
  width: .72rem;
  height: .16rem;
  left: .42rem;
  top: .48rem;
  background: currentColor;
  box-shadow: 0 .35rem 0 currentColor;
}

.icon-archive::before {
  width: 1.22rem;
  height: .94rem;
  left: .15rem;
  top: .43rem;
  border: .16rem solid currentColor;
}

.icon-archive::after {
  width: .62rem;
  height: .32rem;
  left: .42rem;
  top: .18rem;
  border: .16rem solid currentColor;
  border-bottom: 0;
}

.icon-extract::before {
  width: 1rem;
  height: 1rem;
  left: .28rem;
  top: .25rem;
  border: .16rem solid currentColor;
  transform: rotate(45deg);
}

.icon-extract::after {
  width: .28rem;
  height: .28rem;
  left: .64rem;
  top: .61rem;
  background: currentColor;
  border-radius: 50%;
  box-shadow: 0 0 .55rem currentColor;
}

.icon-shop::before {
  width: 1.08rem;
  height: .95rem;
  left: .23rem;
  top: .45rem;
  border: .16rem solid currentColor;
}

.icon-shop::after {
  width: .78rem;
  height: .42rem;
  left: .38rem;
  top: .16rem;
  border: .16rem solid currentColor;
  border-bottom: 0;
  border-radius: .45rem .45rem 0 0;
}

.nav-item.active,
.main-nav .nav-item:hover {
  border-color: rgba(201, 164, 92, .72);
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(76, 61, 32, .98), rgba(24, 20, 16, .98));
}

.section-head {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: end;
  gap: 1rem;
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.section-head h3 {
  margin: .2rem 0 0;
  font-size: 1.35rem;
}

.segmented {
  display: inline-flex;
  padding: .25rem;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .12);
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .04);
}

.segmented button {
  min-width: 4.4rem;
  min-height: 2rem;
  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--muted);
}

.segmented button.active {
  color: #17120b;
  background: var(--gold);
}

.story-layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(18rem, 26rem) minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 1rem;
}

.dokkaebi-shell {
  display: grid;
  gap: 1rem;
}

.dokkaebi-hub {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: .9rem;
}

.mode-card {
  min-height: 12rem;
  padding: 1rem;
  color: var(--text);
  text-align: left;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .12);
  background:
    linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(201, 164, 92, .12), transparent 48%),
    rgba(18, 20, 27, .94);
  display: grid;
  align-content: end;
  gap: .45rem;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.mode-card::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  width: 8rem;
  height: 8rem;
  right: -2.8rem;
  top: -2.8rem;
  border: 1px solid rgba(240, 212, 138, .22);
  transform: rotate(28deg);
}

.mode-card.active,
.mode-card:hover {
  border-color: rgba(240, 212, 138, .65);
  background:
    linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(201, 164, 92, .24), transparent 52%),
    rgba(26, 24, 21, .96);
}

.mode-card strong {
  font-size: 1.35rem;
}

.mode-card small {
  color: var(--muted);
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.mode-icon {
  width: 2.7rem;
  height: 2.7rem;
  border: 1px solid rgba(240, 212, 138, .52);
  background: rgba(5, 6, 9, .42);
  position: relative;
}

.mode-icon::before,
.mode-icon::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
}

.story-mode::before {
  inset: .55rem;
  border: .22rem solid var(--gold);
  transform: rotate(45deg);
}

.event-mode::before {
  width: 1.4rem;
  height: 1.4rem;
  left: .62rem;
  top: .62rem;
  border: .22rem solid var(--gold);
  border-radius: 50%;
}

.event-mode::after {
  width: .42rem;
  height: .42rem;
  left: 1.13rem;
  top: 1.13rem;
  background: var(--gold-2);
  border-radius: 50%;
}

.tower-mode::before {
  left: .58rem;
  right: .58rem;
  bottom: .52rem;
  height: 1.65rem;
  border: .22rem solid var(--gold);
  border-top-width: .42rem;
}

.battle-mode::before {
  left: .44rem;
  top: .44rem;
  width: 1.55rem;
  height: 1.55rem;
  border: .18rem solid var(--gold);
  transform: rotate(45deg);
}

.battle-mode::after {
  left: 1.15rem;
  top: .24rem;
  width: .22rem;
  height: 2.18rem;
  background: var(--gold-2);
  transform: rotate(45deg);
  box-shadow: 0 0 .6rem rgba(240, 212, 138, .45);
}

.federation-map,
.node-stage {
  display: none;
}

.federation-map.active,
.node-stage.active {
  display: block;
}

.federation-map {
  position: relative;
}

.story-back-button {
  position: absolute;
  left: 1rem;
  top: 1rem;
  z-index: 9;
  min-width: 7rem;
  min-height: 2.9rem;
  border: 1px solid rgba(240, 212, 138, .55);
  color: var(--text);
  background: rgba(5, 6, 9, .78);
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  box-shadow: 0 .7rem 1.8rem rgba(0, 0, 0, .38);
}

.map-board {
  min-height: min(42rem, calc(100vh - 13rem));
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .12);
  background:
    linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(7, 8, 11, .9), rgba(7, 8, 11, .25) 55%, rgba(7, 8, 11, .86)),
    radial-gradient(circle at 20% 65%, rgba(116, 168, 255, .2), transparent 22rem),
    radial-gradient(circle at 68% 30%, rgba(201, 164, 92, .18), transparent 20rem),
    linear-gradient(135deg, #151922, #090a0d);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow);
  --marker-x: 29%;
  --marker-y: 61%;
}

body.story-focus .map-board {
  height: 100vh;
  min-height: 100vh;
  border: 0;
}

.map-board::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  opacity: .28;
  background:
    linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, .08) 1px, transparent 1px) 0 0 / 4rem 4rem,
    linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, .07) 1px, transparent 1px) 0 0 / 4rem 4rem;
}

.federation-landmass {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 4rem 2rem 2.5rem 2rem;
  z-index: 1;
}

.federation-landmass::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 2%;
  top: 7%;
  width: 74%;
  height: 82%;
  clip-path: polygon(40% 0%, 70% 6%, 88% 23%, 95% 53%, 81% 82%, 48% 100%, 16% 86%, 0% 56%, 10% 24%);
  background:
    linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(68, 78, 70, .88), rgba(28, 34, 35, .96)),
    rgba(255, 255, 255, .04);
  border: 1px solid rgba(240, 212, 138, .18);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 .18rem rgba(8, 9, 13, .42), inset 0 0 3rem rgba(0, 0, 0, .56);
}

.federation-landmass::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  right: 8.5%;
  top: 14%;
  width: 22%;
  height: 63%;
  clip-path: polygon(24% 0%, 100% 12%, 88% 92%, 0% 100%, 26% 52%);
  background:
    linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(78, 92, 82, .78), rgba(26, 38, 42, .98));
  border-right: .32rem solid rgba(126, 175, 255, .44);
  box-shadow: 1.2rem 0 2.2rem rgba(65, 120, 150, .2);
}

.nation {
  position: absolute;

}

.coast {

}

.wall {

}

.heavy-wall {
  border-width: .46rem;

  box-shadow: inset 0 0 1.8rem rgba(0, 0, 0, .38), 0 0 0 .18rem rgba(0, 0, 0, .45);
}

.partial-wall {

}

.broken-wall {
  border: .3rem dashed rgba(210, 184, 150, .78);

    linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(70, 38, 36, .58), rgba(25, 27, 30, .92));
}

.sea-lane {
  position: absolute;
  right: 0;

  width: 31%;

  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 30% 44%, rgba(126, 175, 255, .22), transparent 12rem),

  border-left: 1px solid rgba(126, 175, 255, .28);

.mega-bridge {

  background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(240, 212, 138, .95) 0 .7rem, rgba(72, 67, 54, .95) .7rem 1rem);
  box-shadow: 0 0 1.1rem rgba(240, 212, 138, .24);

.nation-9 {

  filter: saturate(1.04) contrast(1.02);
}

.federation-landmass::before {
  display: none;
  left: 7%;
  top: 7%;
  width: min(72vh, 62%);
  max-width: 39rem;
  aspect-ratio: 1;
  height: auto;
  border-radius: 50%;
  clip-path: none;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, rgba(18, 20, 27, .96) 0 17%, transparent 17.5%),
    repeating-conic-gradient(from -22.5deg, rgba(240, 212, 138, .34) 0deg 1.2deg, transparent 1.2deg 45deg),
    conic-gradient(
      from -22.5deg,
      rgba(70, 87, 81, .9) 0deg 45deg,
      rgba(61, 82, 72, .9) 45deg 90deg,
      rgba(73, 71, 58, .9) 90deg 135deg,
      rgba(82, 75, 62, .9) 135deg 180deg,

      rgba(58, 77, 76, .9) 225deg 270deg,
      rgba(68, 72, 88, .9) 270deg 315deg,
      rgba(82, 57, 54, .9) 315deg 360deg
    );
  border: .34rem solid rgba(240, 212, 138, .36);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 0 0 5.8rem rgba(13, 15, 20, .58),
    inset 0 0 0 6.05rem rgba(240, 212, 138, .25),
    0 1.2rem 4rem rgba(0, 0, 0, .48);
}

.federation-landmass::after {
  left: calc(7% + min(72vh, 62%) * .365);
  top: calc(7% + min(72vh, 62%) * .365);
  width: min(72vh, 62%);
  max-width: 39rem;
  height: auto;
  aspect-ratio: 1;
  clip-path: none;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: transparent;
  border:
    min(72vh, 62%) solid transparent;
  display: none;
}

.federation-landmass .nation,
````
