````css
.route-lines {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 2;
  pointer-events: none;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  overflow: visible;
}

.route-lines path {
  fill: none;
  stroke: rgba(126, 220, 255, .68);
  stroke-width: 3;
  stroke-linecap: round;
  vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 0 .28rem rgba(126, 220, 255, .6));
}

.route-lines .route-open { stroke: #d8c58a; }
.route-lines .route-locked { stroke: #8296a2; stroke-dasharray: 7 7; opacity: .6; }

.map-node {
  position: absolute;
  left: var(--x);
  top: var(--y);
  z-index: 3;
  width: 1.35rem;
  height: 1.35rem;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(240, 212, 138, .78);
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: rgba(8, 9, 13, .88);
  padding: 0;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 .22rem rgba(10, 11, 15, .8), 0 .45rem 1rem rgba(0, 0, 0, .45);
}

.node-core {
  position: absolute;
  inset: .32rem;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--gold-2);
  box-shadow: 0 0 .85rem rgba(240, 212, 138, .66);
}

.map-node.active,
.map-node:hover {
  border-color: var(--gold-2);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 .36rem rgba(240, 212, 138, .18), 0 .45rem 1rem rgba(0, 0, 0, .45);
}

.map-node.locked {
  opacity: .62;
}

.dokkaebi-marker {
  position: absolute;
  left: var(--marker-x);
  top: var(--marker-y);
  z-index: 4;
  width: 4.6rem;
  height: 4.6rem;
  transform: translate(-50%, calc(-100% - .55rem));
  padding: .48rem;
  border: 1px solid rgba(240, 212, 138, .64);
  background: rgba(5, 6, 9, .84);
  box-shadow: 0 .85rem 1.8rem rgba(0, 0, 0, .5), 0 0 1.4rem rgba(240, 212, 138, .18);
  pointer-events: none;
  transition: left .22s ease, top .22s ease, transform .18s ease;
}

.dokkaebi-marker::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 50%;
  bottom: -.42rem;
  width: .78rem;
  height: .78rem;
  transform: translateX(-50%) rotate(45deg);
  border-right: 1px solid rgba(240, 212, 138, .64);
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(240, 212, 138, .64);
  background: rgba(5, 6, 9, .84);
}

.dokkaebi-marker img {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  display: block;
}

.chapter-nodes {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 3;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.chapter-nodes .map-node {
  pointer-events: auto;
}

.node-pop {
  position: absolute;
  left: calc(100% + .75rem);
  top: 50%;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  width: 13rem;
  padding: .7rem .78rem;
  color: var(--text);
  text-align: left;
  border: 1px solid rgba(240, 212, 138, .5);
  background: rgba(9, 10, 14, .94);
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  transition: opacity .16s ease, transform .16s ease;
}

.node-pop::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: -.55rem;
  top: 50%;
  width: .85rem;
  height: .85rem;
  transform: translateY(-50%) rotate(45deg);
  border-left: 1px solid rgba(240, 212, 138, .5);
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(240, 212, 138, .5);
  background: rgba(9, 10, 14, .94);
}

.map-node:hover .node-pop,
.map-node:focus-visible .node-pop {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translateY(-50%) translateX(.2rem);
}

.node-pop strong,
.node-pop small {
  display: block;
}

.node-pop small {
  margin-top: .25rem;
  color: var(--muted);
}

.node-rail {
  position: absolute;
  top: 1.2rem;
  right: 1.2rem;
  z-index: 4;
  width: min(34rem, calc(100% - 2.4rem));
  display: flex;
  gap: .55rem;
  overflow-x: auto;
  padding: .45rem;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .12);
  background: rgba(5, 6, 9, .72);
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
}

body.story-focus .node-rail {
  top: 1rem;
  right: 1rem;
  width: 17rem;
  max-height: calc(100vh - 2rem);
  display: grid;
  grid-auto-rows: minmax(4.8rem, auto);
  overflow-x: hidden;
  overflow-y: auto;
}

body.story-focus .rail-node {
  flex: none;
  width: 100%;
}

.rail-node {
  flex: 0 0 10.5rem;
  min-height: 4.2rem;
  color: var(--text);
  text-align: left;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .12);
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .05);
  padding: .55rem;
}

.rail-node.active,
.rail-node:hover {
  border-color: rgba(240, 212, 138, .65);
  background: rgba(201, 164, 92, .14);
}

.rail-node span,
.rail-node small {
  display: block;
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: .72rem;
}

.rail-node strong {
  display: block;
  margin: .18rem 0;
  color: var(--gold-2);
}

.node-hero {
  min-height: 16rem;
}

.map-back {
  margin-bottom: .75rem;
}

.placeholder-panel.compact {
  min-height: min(28rem, calc(100vh - 14rem));
}

.mode-placeholder {
  height: 100vh;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  text-align: center;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 50% 34%, rgba(126, 175, 255, .16), transparent 30rem),
    #080a0f;
}

.mode-placeholder h3 {
  margin: .35rem 0;
  font-size: 2rem;
}

.mode-placeholder p:not(.eyebrow) {
  color: var(--muted);
}

.chapter-stage-map {
  height: 100vh;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  background:
    linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(5, 6, 9, .72), rgba(5, 6, 9, .14) 42%, rgba(5, 6, 9, .78)),
    var(--stage-bg) center / cover;
}

.chapter-stage-map::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  background:
    linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(126, 220, 255, .08) 1px, transparent 1px) 0 0 / 4rem 4rem,
    linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(126, 220, 255, .06) 1px, transparent 1px) 0 0 / 4rem 4rem;
  opacity: .48;
}

.chapter-progress {
  position: absolute;
  top: 1rem;
  right: 1rem;
  z-index: 8;
  min-width: 13rem;
  padding: .8rem 1rem;
  text-align: center;
  border: 1px solid rgba(240, 212, 138, .5);
  color: var(--gold-2);
  background: rgba(5, 6, 9, .76);
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  font-weight: 900;
}

.stage-node-layer {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 3;
}

.stage-node {
  position: absolute;
  left: var(--x);
  top: var(--y);
  width: 1.55rem;
  height: 1.55rem;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  padding: 0;
  border: 1px solid rgba(240, 212, 138, .8);
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: rgba(5, 6, 9, .86);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 .25rem rgba(5, 6, 9, .74), 0 0 1.2rem rgba(240, 212, 138, .4);
}

.stage-node.active,
.stage-node:hover {
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 .42rem rgba(240, 212, 138, .2), 0 0 1.5rem rgba(240, 212, 138, .7);
}

.stage-marker {
  z-index: 5;
  width: 5.8rem;
  height: 5.8rem;
  transform: translate(-50%, calc(-100% - .75rem)) scale(1.1);
}

.stage-card {
  position: absolute;
  right: 1.35rem;
  bottom: 1.25rem;
  z-index: 8;
  width: min(28rem, calc(100vw - 2.7rem));
  min-height: 11rem;
  padding: 1.15rem;
  display: grid;
  align-content: end;
  gap: .7rem;
  border: 1px solid rgba(240, 212, 138, .62);
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(17, 18, 24, .9), rgba(5, 6, 9, .94));
  box-shadow: 0 1.2rem 3rem rgba(0, 0, 0, .55);
}

.stage-card span {
  color: var(--muted);
  font-weight: 900;
}

.stage-card strong {
  color: var(--gold-2);
  font-size: 1.8rem;
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.chapter-list,
.identity-grid,
.filament-board,
.squad-slots {
  display: grid;
  gap: .8rem;
}

.chapter-card,
.identity-card {
  color: var(--text);
  text-align: left;
}

.chapter-card {
  min-height: 6.2rem;
  padding: .75rem;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 4.8rem 1fr;
  gap: .85rem;
  align-items: center;
  border-left: .24rem solid transparent;
}

.chapter-card.active {
  border-color: rgba(201, 164, 92, .7);
  border-left-color: var(--gold);
  background: rgba(201, 164, 92, .12);
}

.chapter-thumb {
  height: 4.6rem;
  background-size: cover;
  background-position: center;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .14);
}

.chapter-card h4,
.identity-card h4,
.mission-panel h4 { margin: 0; font-size: 1rem; }

.chapter-card p,
.identity-card p {
  margin: .35rem 0 0;
  color: var(--muted);
  line-height: 1.45;
  font-size: .85rem;
}

.chapter-detail {
  min-height: 35rem;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.detail-hero {
  min-height: 18rem;
  background-size: cover;
  background-position: center;
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: end;
}

.detail-hero::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 10%, rgba(13, 15, 20, .78) 74%, rgba(13, 15, 20, .96));
}

.detail-title {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  padding: 1.25rem;
}

.detail-title h4 {
  margin: .25rem 0 0;
  font-size: clamp(1.7rem, 4vw, 2.6rem);
}

.detail-body {
  padding: 1.25rem;
  display: grid;
  gap: 1rem;
}

.summary {
  margin: 0;
  color: #d7dde5;
  line-height: 1.7;
}

.meta-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: .75rem;
}

.meta-box,
.skill,
.mission-panel div {
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .1);
  padding: .75rem;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .04);
}

.meta-box span,
.skill span,
.mission-panel dt {
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: .78rem;
}

.meta-box strong,
.skill strong {
  display: block;
  margin-top: .35rem;
}

.primary-button,
.ghost-button {
  min-height: 2.7rem;
  padding: 0 .95rem;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .15);
}

.primary-button {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #c9a45c, #f0d48a);
  color: #17120b;
  font-weight: 800;
}

.ghost-button {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .06);
  color: var(--text);
}

.identity-controls label {
  display: grid;
  gap: .25rem;
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: .8rem;
}

select {
  min-height: 2.4rem;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .14);
  background: #161922;
  color: var(--text);
  padding: 0 .6rem;
}

.identity-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(6, minmax(0, 1fr)); }

.identity-card {
  min-height: 16rem;
  padding: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.identity-card.active { outline: 2px solid var(--gold); }

.identity-card img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 10.5rem;
  display: block;
  object-fit: cover;
  object-position: top;
}

.identity-card .identity-info {
  display: block;
  padding: .75rem;
}

.tag-row {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: .35rem;
  margin-top: .6rem;
}

.tag {
  min-height: 1.55rem;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 0 .48rem;
  color: #101217;
  background: var(--gold);
  font-size: .72rem;
  font-weight: 800;
}

.tag.blue { background: var(--blue); }
.tag.green { background: var(--green); }
.tag.red { background: var(--red); }

.identity-detail {
  margin-top: 1rem;
  padding: 1rem;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(15rem, 22rem) minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 1rem;
}

.identity-detail img {
  width: 100%;
  aspect-ratio: 4 / 3;
  object-fit: cover;
  object-position: top;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .12);
}

.skill-list {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(5, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: .5rem;
  margin-top: 1rem;
}

.skill { min-height: 4.5rem; }

.filament-board { grid-template-columns: repeat(5, minmax(0, 1fr)); }

.filament-card {
  min-height: 12rem;
  padding: 1rem;
}

.filament-card.locked { opacity: .52; }

.filament-orb {
  width: 3.2rem;
  height: 3.2rem;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .45);
  background: var(--orb);
  box-shadow: 0 0 28px var(--glow);
}

.filament-card h4 { margin: 1rem 0 .45rem; }

.filament-card p {
  margin: 0 0 .8rem;
  color: var(--muted);
  line-height: 1.45;
}

.squad-layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 14rem minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 1rem;
}

.formation-presets {
  padding: .7rem;
  display: grid;
  gap: .55rem;
  align-content: start;
}

.preset-slot {
  min-height: 4.8rem;
  color: var(--text);
  text-align: left;
  padding: .75rem;
  display: grid;
  gap: .2rem;
}

.preset-slot span {
  color: var(--gold-2);
  font-size: .78rem;
  font-weight: 900;
}

.preset-slot strong {
  font-size: .95rem;
}

.preset-slot.active {
  border-color: rgba(201, 164, 92, .72);
  background: rgba(201, 164, 92, .13);
}

.preset-slot.empty {
  opacity: .52;
}

.squad-slots { grid-template-columns: repeat(5, minmax(0, 1fr)); }

.slot-card {
  min-height: 0;
  aspect-ratio: 5 / 7;
  overflow: hidden;
  position: relative;
  padding: 0;
  background:
    linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(7, 8, 11, .08), rgba(7, 8, 11, .52) 72%, rgba(7, 8, 11, .88)),
    radial-gradient(circle at 50% 22%, rgba(240, 212, 138, .16), transparent 42%),
    var(--slot-bg),
    rgba(7, 8, 11, .92);
  background-size: cover, cover, cover, auto;
  background-position: center, center, center 38%, center;
}

.slot-card .slot-character {
  width: 100%;
  height: 118%;
  object-fit: contain;
  object-position: center top;
  transform: translateY(13%) scale(1.72);
  transform-origin: center top;
  display: block;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 1.6rem 1.8rem rgba(0, 0, 0, .58));
}

.slot-card::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: auto 0 0;
  height: 34%;
  z-index: 2;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent, rgba(4, 5, 8, .86));
  pointer-events: none;
}

.slot-logo {
  position: absolute;
  left: .55rem;
  bottom: .5rem;
  z-index: 3;
  width: 3.4rem;
  height: 3.4rem;
  object-fit: contain;
  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
  box-shadow: none;
  mask-image: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, #000 48%, transparent 74%);
  -webkit-mask-image: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, #000 48%, transparent 74%);
}

.slot-name {
  position: absolute;
  right: .6rem;
  bottom: .72rem;
  z-index: 3;
  max-width: calc(100% - 5rem);
  color: #f6e8bc;
  font-size: clamp(.78rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
  text-align: right;
  text-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, .8);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.slot-card div { display: none; }

.story-player {
  margin-top: .35rem;
}

.story-player.fullscreen {
  margin: 0;
  height: 100vh;
}

.visual-novel {
  min-height: min(38rem, calc(100vh - 12rem));
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  user-select: none;
  -webkit-user-select: none;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .12);
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 50% 46%, rgba(5, 6, 9, 0) 38%, rgba(5, 6, 9, .5) 74%, rgba(5, 6, 9, .9) 100%),
    linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(5, 6, 9, .78), rgba(5, 6, 9, .12) 45%, rgba(5, 6, 9, .78)),
    linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(5, 6, 9, .38), rgba(5, 6, 9, 0) 38%, rgba(5, 6, 9, .72)),
    var(--scene-bg) center / cover;
}

.visual-novel img {
  user-select: none;
  -webkit-user-drag: none;
  -webkit-user-select: none;
}

.story-player.fullscreen .visual-novel {
  min-height: 100vh;
  height: 100vh;
  border: 0;
}

.visual-novel.center-message {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  background: #000;
}

.center-line {
  max-width: min(64rem, calc(100vw - 4rem));
  padding: 2rem;
  color: #f5f6f8;
  font-size: clamp(1.55rem, 3vw, 3.1rem);
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1.55;
  text-align: center;
  text-shadow: 0 0 1.2rem rgba(255, 255, 255, .18);
  white-space: pre-wrap;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.visual-novel.system-boot {
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, rgba(60, 82, 92, .28), rgba(0, 0, 0, .92) 62%, #000 100%),
    repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(122, 213, 255, .04) 0 1px, transparent 1px 4px),
    linear-gradient(135deg, #030609, #0a0d12 48%, #020304);
}

.eisenberg-screen {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 0;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  padding: 5rem 3rem 12rem;
  color: rgba(165, 230, 255, .82);
  pointer-events: none;
}

.eisenberg-screen::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 8%;
  border: 1px solid rgba(130, 220, 255, .2);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 4rem rgba(94, 181, 255, .08), 0 0 4rem rgba(94, 181, 255, .05);
}

.eisenberg-screen::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background:
    linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 49.8%, rgba(136, 224, 255, .18) 50%, transparent 50.2%),
    linear-gradient(0deg, transparent 0 49.8%, rgba(136, 224, 255, .12) 50%, transparent 50.2%);
  opacity: .42;
}

.eisenberg-logo {
  position: absolute;
  top: 12%;
  left: 50%;
  z-index: 1;
  display: grid;
  justify-items: center;
  gap: .35rem;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  letter-spacing: .08em;
}

.eisenberg-mark {
  width: 5.2rem;
  height: 5.2rem;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  border: 1px solid rgba(165, 230, 255, .55);
  color: rgba(224, 247, 255, .95);
  font-size: 3rem;
  font-weight: 950;
  box-shadow: 0 0 1.4rem rgba(122, 213, 255, .24);
  clip-path: polygon(50% 0, 92% 24%, 92% 76%, 50% 100%, 8% 76%, 8% 24%);
}

.eisenberg-logo strong {
  color: rgba(231, 250, 255, .94);
  font-size: clamp(1.1rem, 2vw, 2rem);
}

.eisenberg-logo small {
  color: rgba(165, 230, 255, .58);
  font-size: .75rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.boot-columns {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  width: min(68rem, 88vw);
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 1.25rem;
  margin-top: 7rem;
}

.boot-columns pre {
  min-height: 16rem;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 1rem;
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid rgba(130, 220, 255, .18);
  background: rgba(0, 8, 14, .38);
  color: rgba(178, 237, 255, .68);
  font: 600 .82rem/1.7 Consolas, "Courier New", monospace;
  white-space: pre-wrap;
}

.vn-menu-button {
  position: absolute;
  right: 1rem;
  top: 1rem;
  z-index: 6;
  width: 3.1rem;
  height: 3.1rem;
  border: 1px solid rgba(240, 212, 138, .55);
  color: var(--gold-2);
  background: rgba(5, 6, 9, .78);
  font-size: 1.5rem;
  line-height: 1;
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
}

.vn-character-layer {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 1;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.vn-character {
  position: absolute;
  left: 50%;
  bottom: -22%;
  z-index: 2;
  width: min(48rem, 72%);
  height: 112%;
  object-fit: contain;
  object-position: center bottom;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  opacity: 1;
  filter: brightness(.46) saturate(.72) drop-shadow(0 1.6rem 2.2rem rgba(0, 0, 0, .66));
  transition: opacity .2s ease, filter .2s ease, transform .2s ease;
}

.vn-character.is-speaking {
  opacity: 1;
  filter: brightness(1) saturate(1) drop-shadow(0 1.6rem 2.2rem rgba(0, 0, 0, .66));
}

.vn-character.is-muted {
  pointer-events: none;
}

.vn-character-left {
  left: 34%;
  width: min(43rem, 58%);
  transform: translateX(-50%);
}

.vn-character-right {
  left: 66%;
  width: min(43rem, 58%);
  transform: translateX(-50%);
}

.vn-character-center {
  z-index: 3;
}

.vn-character[data-height-cm] {
  width: auto;
  max-width: none;
  height: var(--standing-height);
  bottom: var(--standing-bottom);
}

.dialogue-box {
  position: absolute;
  left: 2rem;
  right: 2rem;
  bottom: 1.25rem;
  z-index: 2;
  min-height: 8.4rem;
  padding: 1rem 1.15rem;
  border: 1px solid rgba(240, 212, 138, .48);
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(14, 15, 20, .94), rgba(6, 7, 10, .94));
  box-shadow: 0 1.2rem 3rem rgba(0, 0, 0, .52);
}

.speaker-block {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: stretch;
  min-height: 2.2rem;
  border: 1px solid rgba(240, 212, 138, .7);
  background: rgba(5, 6, 9, .72);
}

.speaker-block strong {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  min-width: 9rem;
  padding: 0 .95rem;
  font-weight: 900;
  justify-content: center;
  color: #17120b;
  background: var(--gold);
}

.dialogue-box p {
  margin: .8rem 0 0;
  color: #eef0f4;
  line-height: 1.72;
  white-space: pre-wrap;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  word-break: keep-all;
}

.dialogue-controls {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  gap: .75rem;
  margin-top: .8rem;
}

.vn-menu-panel {
  position: absolute;
  top: 4.5rem;
  right: 1rem;
  z-index: 7;
  width: min(13rem, calc(100vw - 2rem));
  display: none;
  padding: .9rem;
  border: 1px solid rgba(240, 212, 138, .55);
  background: rgba(5, 6, 9, .92);
  box-shadow: 0 1.2rem 3rem rgba(0, 0, 0, .58);
  backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
}

.vn-menu-panel.open {
  display: grid;
}

.log-list {
  overflow-y: auto;
  display: grid;
  gap: .55rem;
  padding-right: .35rem;
}

.log-list p {
  margin: 0;
  padding: .65rem;
  color: #dfe5ec;
  line-height: 1.55;
  white-space: pre-wrap;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  word-break: keep-all;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .1);
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .04);
}

.log-list strong {
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: .25rem;
  color: var(--gold-2);
}

.vn-menu-actions {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  gap: .45rem;
}

.vn-log-modal {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 9;
  display: none;
  place-items: center;
  padding: 2rem;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, .48);
  backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
}

.vn-log-modal.open {
  display: grid;
}

.vn-log-window {
  position: relative;
  width: min(56rem, calc(100vw - 4rem));
  height: min(34rem, calc(100vh - 4rem));
  display: grid;
  grid-template-rows: auto minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: .9rem;
  padding: 1.1rem;
  border: 1px solid rgba(240, 212, 138, .62);
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(16, 17, 22, .96), rgba(5, 6, 9, .98));
  box-shadow: 0 2rem 5rem rgba(0, 0, 0, .66);
}

.vn-log-window h3 {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--gold-2);
  font-size: 1.05rem;
}

.vn-log-close {
  position: absolute;
  right: .8rem;
  top: .65rem;
  width: 2.2rem;
  height: 2.2rem;
  border: 1px solid rgba(240, 212, 138, .42);
  color: var(--gold-2);
  background: rgba(5, 6, 9, .86);
  font-size: 1.4rem;
  line-height: 1;
}

.battle-dummy {
  min-height: 100vh;
  padding: 1rem;
  color: var(--text);
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 50% 35%, rgba(126, 175, 255, .16), transparent 36rem),
    linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(35, 38, 47, .98), rgba(6, 7, 10, .98));
  overflow: hidden;
}

.battle-topbar {
  min-height: 4.8rem;
  margin-left: 8rem;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 1rem;
  padding: .75rem 1rem;
  border: 1px solid rgba(240, 212, 138, .24);
  background: rgba(5, 6, 9, .58);
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
}

.battle-topbar h3 {
  margin: .18rem 0 0;
  font-size: 1.08rem;
}

.battle-meters {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  gap: .5rem;
}

.battle-meters span,
.battle-help,
.wave-panel,
.battle-log,
.battle-roster,
.battle-command {
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .12);
  background: rgba(8, 9, 13, .68);
}

.battle-meters span {
  min-height: 2.35rem;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 0 .72rem;
  color: var(--gold-2);
  font-weight: 900;
}

.battle-layout {
  height: calc(100vh - 11.2rem);
  min-height: 33rem;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 15rem minmax(33rem, 1fr) 23rem;
  gap: .8rem;
  margin-top: .8rem;
}

.battle-roster,
.battle-command {
  min-height: 0;
  padding: .65rem;
  display: grid;
  gap: .55rem;
  align-content: start;
  overflow: auto;
}

.battle-unit {
  min-height: 5.2rem;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 2.3rem 1fr;
  gap: .35rem .55rem;
  align-items: center;
  padding: .55rem;
  color: var(--text);
  text-align: left;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .1);
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .045);
}

.battle-unit img {
  grid-row: span 3;
  width: 2.3rem;
  height: 2.3rem;
  object-fit: contain;
}

.battle-unit strong,
.battle-unit span,
.battle-unit small {
  min-width: 0;
}

.battle-unit strong {
  color: var(--gold-2);
}

.battle-unit span,
.battle-unit small {
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: .78rem;
}

.battle-unit.active {
  border-color: rgba(240, 212, 138, .72);
  background: rgba(201, 164, 92, .14);
}

.battle-field-wrap {
  min-width: 0;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-rows: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  gap: .65rem;
}

.battle-field {
  min-height: 0;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(8, minmax(0, 1fr));
  grid-template-rows: repeat(5, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: .42rem;
  padding: .8rem;
  border: 1px solid rgba(240, 212, 138, .18);
  background:
    linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(5, 6, 9, .72), rgba(5, 6, 9, .18), rgba(5, 6, 9, .78)),
    radial-gradient(circle at 74% 22%, rgba(214, 110, 110, .2), transparent 18rem),
    radial-gradient(circle at 25% 80%, rgba(126, 175, 255, .16), transparent 20rem),
    url("../이루다 1획 삽화/01_이루리_쓰레기장_각성_삽화.png") center / cover;
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 5rem rgba(0, 0, 0, .62);
}

.battle-cell {
  min-width: 0;
  min-height: 0;
  position: relative;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .1);
  background:
    linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, .06), rgba(255, 255, 255, .015));
}

.battle-cell.in-range {
  border-color: rgba(126, 175, 255, .52);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 1.5rem rgba(126, 175, 255, .13);
}

.battle-cell.selected-origin {
  border-color: rgba(240, 212, 138, .84);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 1.7rem rgba(240, 212, 138, .18), 0 0 .9rem rgba(240, 212, 138, .22);
}

.battle-token {
  width: 86%;
  height: 86%;
  position: relative;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  padding: .12rem;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .2);
  background: rgba(5, 6, 9, .72);
  color: var(--text);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.battle-token img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: contain;
  object-position: center bottom;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 .8rem .9rem rgba(0, 0, 0, .7));
}

.battle-token b {
  position: absolute;
  left: .2rem;
  right: .2rem;
  bottom: .34rem;
  z-index: 2;
  font-size: clamp(.55rem, .75vw, .72rem);
  text-align: center;
  text-shadow: 0 2px 5px #000;
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.battle-token i {
  position: absolute;
  left: .2rem;
  right: .2rem;
  bottom: .12rem;
  height: .18rem;
  background:
    linear-gradient(90deg, var(--red) 0 var(--hp), transparent var(--hp) 100%),
    rgba(255, 255, 255, .12);
}

.battle-token i::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  top: -.24rem;
  height: .16rem;
  width: var(--sp);
  background: var(--blue);
}

.battle-token.enemy {
  border-color: rgba(214, 110, 110, .45);
  background: rgba(32, 10, 12, .78);
}

.enemy-core {
  width: 58%;
  height: 58%;
  border-radius: 46% 54% 38% 62%;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 45% 40%, rgba(240, 212, 138, .9), rgba(214, 110, 110, .72) 24%, rgba(15, 5, 8, .95) 65%);
  box-shadow: 0 0 1.2rem rgba(214, 110, 110, .55);
}

.battle-help {
  min-height: 3.3rem;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: .75rem;
  padding: .65rem .85rem;
  color: var(--muted);
}

.battle-help strong {
  color: var(--gold-2);
}

.selected-unit-panel {
  min-height: 7.8rem;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 5rem 1fr;
  gap: .7rem;
  align-items: center;
  padding: .6rem;
  border: 1px solid rgba(240, 212, 138, .2);
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .04);
}

.selected-unit-panel img {
  width: 100%;
  aspect-ratio: 1;
  object-fit: contain;
  object-position: center bottom;
}

.selected-unit-panel h4 {
  margin: .18rem 0 .45rem;
}

.selected-unit-panel span {
  display: inline-flex;
  margin: 0 .35rem .25rem 0;
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: .76rem;
}

.move-pad {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: .35rem;
}

.move-pad button {
  min-height: 2.35rem;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .12);
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .05);
  color: var(--text);
  font-weight: 900;
}

.move-pad button:first-child {
  grid-column: 2;
}

.move-pad button:nth-child(2) {
  grid-column: 1;
}

.move-pad button:nth-child(3) {
  grid-column: 3;
}

.move-pad button:nth-child(4) {
  grid-column: 2;
}

.skill-hand {
  display: grid;
  gap: .45rem;
}

.battle-skill {
  display: grid;
  gap: .18rem;
  min-height: 5.2rem;
  padding: .58rem;
  color: var(--text);
  text-align: left;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .11);
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(35, 38, 47, .92), rgba(12, 13, 17, .94));
}

.battle-skill.active,
.battle-skill:hover:not(:disabled) {
  border-color: rgba(240, 212, 138, .72);
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(68, 51, 28, .95), rgba(15, 13, 12, .96));
}

.battle-skill:disabled {
  opacity: .44;
  cursor: not-allowed;
}

.battle-skill.ego {
  border-color: rgba(126, 175, 255, .36);
  background:
    linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(126, 175, 255, .14), transparent 50%),
    rgba(12, 13, 17, .94);
}

.battle-skill span,
.battle-skill small,
.battle-skill em,
.battle-skill p {
  color: var(--muted);
  font-style: normal;
  font-size: .72rem;
}

.battle-skill strong {
  color: var(--gold-2);
  font-size: .92rem;
}

.battle-skill p {
  margin: .12rem 0 0;
  line-height: 1.35;
}

.battle-resolve {
  width: 100%;
}

.battle-bottom {
  height: 4.8rem;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(26rem, .72fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: .8rem;
  margin-top: .8rem;
}

.wave-panel {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(7, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: .35rem;
  padding: .45rem;
}

.wave-panel span {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  gap: .12rem;
  min-width: 0;
  color: var(--muted);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .1);
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .035);
  font-size: .72rem;
  font-weight: 800;
}

.wave-panel span.active {
  color: #101217;
  border-color: var(--wave-color);
  background: var(--wave-color);
  box-shadow: 0 0 1rem color-mix(in srgb, var(--wave-color), transparent 45%);
}

.wave-panel b {
  font-size: .82rem;
}

.battle-log {
  overflow-y: auto;
  padding: .45rem .6rem;
}

.battle-log p {
  margin: 0 0 .24rem;
  color: #dce2ea;
  font-size: .78rem;
  line-height: 1.35;
}

.battle-layout {
  height: calc(100vh - 10.4rem);
  min-height: 35rem;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  margin-top: .75rem;
}

.battle-field-wrap {
  position: relative;
  min-height: 0;
}

.battle-field {
  position: relative;
  min-height: 0;
  height: 100%;
  display: block;
  padding: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  perspective: none;
  border-color: rgba(240, 212, 138, .24);
}

.battle-field::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 50%;
  top: 55%;
  width: min(72rem, 86vw);
  height: min(44rem, 64vh);
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotateX(58deg) rotateZ(45deg);
  transform-origin: center;
  background:
    linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, .08) 1px, transparent 1px) 0 0 / 4.5rem 4.5rem,
    linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, .08) 1px, transparent 1px) 0 0 / 4.5rem 4.5rem,
    rgba(25, 29, 33, .72);
  border: 1px solid rgba(240, 212, 138, .2);
  box-shadow: 0 3rem 5rem rgba(0, 0, 0, .48);
}

.battle-cell {
  position: absolute;
  left: var(--iso-x);
  top: var(--iso-y);
  width: clamp(4.4rem, 8vw, 7.2rem);
  height: clamp(4.4rem, 8vw, 7.2rem);
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotateX(58deg) rotateZ(45deg);
  transform-style: preserve-3d;
  border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, .14);
  background:
    linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(126, 175, 255, .1), rgba(255, 255, 255, .035)),
    rgba(10, 13, 16, .72);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 1.2rem rgba(0, 0, 0, .32), 0 .5rem 1.4rem rgba(0, 0, 0, .22);
}

.battle-cell.in-range {
  border-color: rgba(126, 175, 255, .74);
  background:
    linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(126, 175, 255, .22), rgba(255, 255, 255, .045)),
    rgba(10, 13, 16, .78);
}

.battle-cell.selected-origin {
  border-color: rgba(240, 212, 138, .92);
  background:
    linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(240, 212, 138, .28), rgba(255, 255, 255, .045)),
    rgba(10, 13, 16, .82);
}

.battle-token {
  position: absolute;
  left: 50%;
  top: 22%;
  z-index: 4;
  width: clamp(4.2rem, 7.4vw, 6.8rem);
  height: clamp(6rem, 10vw, 9rem);
  transform: translate(-50%, -68%) rotateZ(-45deg) rotateX(-58deg);
  transform-origin: center bottom;
  overflow: visible;
  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
}

.battle-token::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 16%;
  right: 16%;
  bottom: 1.85rem;
  height: .65rem;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, .48);
  filter: blur(.18rem);
}

.battle-token.selected img {
  filter: drop-shadow(0 0 .65rem rgba(240, 212, 138, .75)) drop-shadow(0 1.3rem 1.2rem rgba(0, 0, 0, .72));
}

.battle-token img {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
  width: 100%;
  height: calc(100% - 2.1rem);
  object-fit: contain;
  object-position: center bottom;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 1.3rem 1.2rem rgba(0, 0, 0, .72));
}

.battle-token b {
  display: none;
}

.battle-token .unit-hp {
  position: absolute;
  left: 50%;
  bottom: .6rem;
  z-index: 5;
  width: 5.4rem;
  height: .62rem;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(10, 8, 8, .95);
  background:
    linear-gradient(90deg, #d33131 0 var(--hp), rgba(64, 16, 16, .92) var(--hp) 100%);
  box-shadow: 0 .16rem .4rem rgba(0, 0, 0, .55);
}

.battle-token .unit-hp span {
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  top: 50%;
  color: #fff3f3;
  font-size: .58rem;
  font-weight: 950;
  line-height: 1;
  text-align: center;
  text-shadow: 0 1px 3px #000;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
}

.battle-token .unit-hp::after {
  display: none;
}

.battle-token .unit-sp {
  position: absolute;
  right: -.3rem;
  bottom: .22rem;
  z-index: 6;
  width: 1.65rem;
  height: 1.65rem;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  border: 2px solid rgba(220, 242, 255, .92);
  border-radius: 50%;
  color: #eaf8ff;
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, #7fd5ff, #1f64bd 68%, #10264f);
  box-shadow: 0 0 .75rem rgba(126, 175, 255, .52);
  font-style: normal;
  font-size: .72rem;
  font-weight: 950;
}

.battle-token.enemy .unit-sp {
  display: none;
}

.battle-token.enemy .unit-hp {
  width: 4.7rem;
}

.enemy-core {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
  width: 72%;
  height: 58%;
  margin-bottom: 2.1rem;
}

.unit-move-arrows {
  position: absolute;
  inset: -1.85rem;
  z-index: 9;
  transform: rotateZ(-45deg) rotateX(-58deg);
  pointer-events: none;
}

.unit-move-arrows button {
  position: absolute;
  width: 2.15rem;
  height: 2.15rem;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  border: 1px solid rgba(240, 212, 138, .86);
  border-radius: 50%;
  color: #18130a;
  background: var(--gold-2);
  box-shadow: 0 .45rem 1rem rgba(0, 0, 0, .42);
  font-weight: 950;
  pointer-events: auto;
}

.unit-move-arrows button:disabled {
  opacity: .38;
}

.unit-move-arrows .arrow-up { left: 50%; top: -1.1rem; transform: translateX(-50%); }
.unit-move-arrows .arrow-left { left: -1.1rem; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); }
.unit-move-arrows .arrow-right { right: -1.1rem; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); }
.unit-move-arrows .arrow-down { left: 50%; bottom: -1.1rem; transform: translateX(-50%); }

.battle-card-fan {
  position: fixed;
  left: 50%;
  bottom: .6rem;
  z-index: 20;
  width: min(57rem, calc(100vw - 9rem));
  height: 12.6rem;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  pointer-events: none;
}

.battle-card-fan .battle-skill {
  position: absolute;
  left: calc(50% - 5.5rem);
  bottom: 0;
  width: 11rem;
  min-height: 10.6rem;
  padding: .72rem;
  border-width: 2px;
  border-radius: .35rem;
  pointer-events: auto;
  box-shadow: 0 1.4rem 2.4rem rgba(0, 0, 0, .54);
  transition: transform .16s ease, border-color .16s ease, filter .16s ease;
}

.battle-card-fan .battle-skill:nth-child(1) { transform: translateX(-18rem) translateY(1.3rem) rotate(-16deg); }
.battle-card-fan .battle-skill:nth-child(2) { transform: translateX(-9rem) translateY(.25rem) rotate(-8deg); }
.battle-card-fan .battle-skill:nth-child(3) { transform: translateX(0) translateY(-.25rem) rotate(0deg); }
.battle-card-fan .battle-skill:nth-child(4) { transform: translateX(9rem) translateY(.25rem) rotate(8deg); }
.battle-card-fan .battle-skill:nth-child(5) { transform: translateX(18rem) translateY(1.3rem) rotate(16deg); }

.battle-card-fan .battle-skill:hover,
.battle-card-fan .battle-skill.active {
  z-index: 5;
  border-color: rgba(240, 212, 138, .95);
  filter: brightness(1.12);
}

.battle-card-fan .battle-skill:nth-child(1):hover,
.battle-card-fan .battle-skill:nth-child(1).active { transform: translateX(-18rem) translateY(-1.5rem) rotate(-10deg) scale(1.08); }
.battle-card-fan .battle-skill:nth-child(2):hover,
.battle-card-fan .battle-skill:nth-child(2).active { transform: translateX(-9rem) translateY(-2.3rem) rotate(-4deg) scale(1.08); }
.battle-card-fan .battle-skill:nth-child(3):hover,
.battle-card-fan .battle-skill:nth-child(3).active { transform: translateX(0) translateY(-2.7rem) rotate(0deg) scale(1.08); }
.battle-card-fan .battle-skill:nth-child(4):hover,
.battle-card-fan .battle-skill:nth-child(4).active { transform: translateX(9rem) translateY(-2.3rem) rotate(4deg) scale(1.08); }
.battle-card-fan .battle-skill:nth-child(5):hover,
.battle-card-fan .battle-skill:nth-child(5).active { transform: translateX(18rem) translateY(-1.5rem) rotate(10deg) scale(1.08); }

.floating-resolve {
  position: fixed;
  right: 1rem;
  bottom: .9rem;
  z-index: 22;
  width: 4.8rem;
  min-width: 4.8rem;
  padding-inline: .85rem;
  box-shadow: 0 .8rem 1.8rem rgba(0, 0, 0, .48);
}

.battle-field {
  cursor: grab;
  user-select: none;
  touch-action: none;
}

.battle-field.rotating {
  cursor: grabbing;
}

.battle-field::before {
  display: none;
}

.battle-board-3d {
  --tile-w: clamp(4.7rem, 8.1vw, 7.2rem);
  --tile-h: clamp(4.7rem, 8.1vw, 7.2rem);
  position: absolute;
  left: 50%;
  top: 51%;
  width: calc(var(--tile-w) * 8);
  height: calc(var(--tile-h) * 5);
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(8, var(--tile-w));
  grid-template-rows: repeat(5, var(--tile-h));
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(var(--battle-zoom)) rotateX(var(--battle-tilt,60deg)) rotateZ(var(--battle-rot));
  transform-origin: center;
  transform-style: preserve-3d;
  border: 1px solid rgba(240, 212, 138, .2);
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 50% 45%, rgba(126, 175, 255, .16), transparent 60%),
    linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(17, 21, 26, .95), rgba(8, 10, 12, .92));
  box-shadow: 0 3.2rem 5.4rem rgba(0, 0, 0, .55);
}

.battle-cell {
  position: relative;
  left: auto;
  top: auto;
  width: auto;
  height: auto;
  transform: none;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .13);
  border-radius: .22rem;
  background:
    linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(126, 175, 255, .1), rgba(255, 255, 255, .035)),
    rgba(10, 13, 16, .74);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 1.2rem rgba(0, 0, 0, .34);
}

.battle-cell::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: .22rem;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .06);
  pointer-events: none;
}

.battle-cell.move-cell {
  cursor: pointer;
  border-color: rgba(131, 197, 138, .72);
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, rgba(131, 197, 138, .24), transparent 58%),
    linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(131, 197, 138, .18), rgba(255, 255, 255, .045)),
    rgba(10, 13, 16, .8);
}

.battle-cell.move-cell:hover {
  border-color: rgba(176, 235, 153, .96);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 0 1.2rem rgba(131, 197, 138, .28),
    0 0 1.2rem rgba(131, 197, 138, .36);
}

.battle-action-lines {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 8;
  overflow: visible;
  pointer-events: none;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
}

.battle-arrow-overlay {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 8;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.battle-action-lines .action-arc {
  fill: none;
  stroke: currentColor;
  stroke-width: .025;
  stroke-linecap: round;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 2px 2px #000);
}
.battle-action-lines .red { color: #f06c69; }
.battle-action-lines .blue { color: #6bbdff; }
.battle-action-lines .gold { color: #ffda70; }
.battle-action-lines marker path { fill: currentColor; }

.enemy-action-badge {
  position: absolute;
  top: -28px;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  height: 28px;
  min-width: 42px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 4px;
  padding: 2px 6px;
  background: #251417;
  border: 1px solid #ef9182;
  border-radius: 4px;
  color: #ffe8c3;
  font-size: 16px;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.mini-action-icon { display: block; width: 18px; height: 18px; background: center / contain no-repeat; }
.mini-action-icon.sword { background-image: url("assets/icons/hit-sword.png"); }
.mini-action-icon.shield { background-image: url("assets/icons/hit-shield.png"); }
.unit-status-badges {
  position: absolute;
  top: -54px;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  width: 140px;
  gap: 3px;
  margin-top: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.unit-status-badges > span { padding: 2px 4px; font-size: 10px; background: #10201e; border: 1px solid #77ba9b; color: #c6f4dd; border-radius: 2px; }
.unit-status-badges > .debuff { background: #30191e; border-color: #cc8088; color: #ffd6d7; }

.battle-action-lines line {
  fill: none;
  stroke-linecap: round;
  stroke-width: .055;
  vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 0 .14rem rgba(0, 0, 0, .8));
  marker-end: url(#battle-arrow-head);
}

.battle-action-lines path {
  fill: currentColor;
}

.battle-action-lines .enemy-intent {
  color: #d66e6e;
  stroke: rgba(214, 110, 110, .72);
  stroke-dasharray: .12 .12;
}

.battle-action-lines .primary-target {
  color: #f0d48a;
  stroke: rgba(240, 212, 138, .92);
}

.battle-action-lines .clash {
  color: #f0d48a;
  stroke: rgba(240, 212, 138, .95);
  stroke-width: .07;
}

.battle-action-lines .enemy-half {
  color: #d66e6e;
  stroke: rgba(214, 110, 110, .95);
}

.battle-token {
  left: 50%;
  top: 18%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -66%) rotateZ(var(--counter-rot)) rotateX(-58deg);
}

.battle-token.primary-targeted img,
.battle-token.primary-targeted .enemy-core {
  filter: drop-shadow(0 0 .75rem rgba(240, 212, 138, .95)) drop-shadow(0 1.3rem 1.2rem rgba(0, 0, 0, .72));
}

.battle-token.secondary-targeted img,
.battle-token.secondary-targeted .enemy-core {
  outline: 2px dashed #e5ad65;
}

.unit-move-arrows {
  left: 50%;
  top: 50%;
  right: auto;
  bottom: auto;
  width: 6.6rem;
  height: 6.6rem;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotateZ(var(--counter-rot)) rotateX(-58deg);
}

.unit-move-arrows .arrow-up { left: 50%; top: -.85rem; transform: translateX(-50%); }
.unit-move-arrows .arrow-left { left: -.85rem; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); }
.unit-move-arrows .arrow-right { right: -.85rem; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); }
.unit-move-arrows .arrow-down { left: 50%; bottom: -.85rem; transform: translateX(-50%); }

.battle-card-detail {
  position: fixed;
  left: 1rem;
  top: 50%;
  z-index: 24;
  width: min(18rem, 28vw);
  padding: 1rem;
  border: 1px solid rgba(240, 212, 138, .35);
  border-radius: .55rem;
  color: var(--text);
  background:
    linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(44, 31, 16, .86), rgba(12, 15, 18, .93)),
    var(--panel);
  box-shadow: 0 1.2rem 2.6rem rgba(0, 0, 0, .48);
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  max-height: calc(100dvh - 17rem);
  overflow-y: auto;
}

.battle-card-detail-right { left: auto; right: 1rem; border-color: #c06468; }
.battle-card-detail-left { border-color: #639fcb; }
.battle-power-preview { display: flex; gap: .6rem; padding-bottom: .65rem; margin-bottom: .7rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #787060; }
.battle-power-preview span { flex: 1; white-space: nowrap; font-size: .7rem; }
.battle-power-preview b { display: block; font-size: 1.3rem; color: #f1df9c; }
.battle-clash-forecast { position: fixed; z-index: 26; top: 6rem; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto auto; gap: .15rem .8rem; padding: .65rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #c7b071; background: #14191eef; text-align: center; pointer-events: none; }
.battle-clash-forecast small, .battle-clash-forecast span { grid-column: 1 / -1; color: #c1c8ce; font-size: .7rem; }
.battle-clash-forecast strong { color: #f1df9c; font-size: 1.4rem; }
.battle-clash-forecast b { align-self: center; color: #f1df9c; }
.has-right-action .floating-log { max-height: 3.5rem; overflow-y: auto; }

@media (max-height: 540px) and (orientation: landscape) {
  .battle-dummy .battle-card-detail { top: 105px; width: 166px; max-height: calc(100dvh - 212px); padding: .5rem; }
  .battle-dummy .battle-card-detail-right { left: auto; right: 8px; }
  .battle-dummy .battle-clash-forecast { top: 52px; padding: .25rem .65rem; gap: 0 .6rem; }
  .battle-dummy .battle-clash-forecast strong { font-size: 1rem; }
  .battle-dummy .battle-power-preview { gap: .3rem; }
  .battle-dummy .battle-power-preview span { font-size: .6rem; }
  .battle-dummy .battle-power-preview b { font-size: 1rem; }
  .battle-dummy .battle-card-detail h3 { font-size: .7rem; margin: .1rem 0 .3rem; }
  .battle-dummy .battle-card-detail p, .battle-dummy .battle-card-detail span { font-size: .65rem; }
  .battle-dummy .battle-card-detail strong { font-size: .8rem; }
  .battle-dummy .battle-card-detail .skill-power { font-size: 1.1rem; }
  .battle-dummy .battle-card-detail .hit-effect-row { font-size: .65rem; }
  .battle-dummy.has-right-action .floating-log { max-height: 40px; }
}

.battle-card-detail h3 {
  margin: .15rem 0 .55rem;
  color: var(--gold-2);
  font-size: 1rem;
}

.battle-card-detail strong {
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: .28rem;
  font-size: 1.15rem;
}

.battle-card-detail span,
.battle-card-detail p {
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: .86rem;
}

.battle-card-detail dl {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: .4rem;
  margin: .8rem 0;
}

.battle-card-detail dl > div {
  padding: .4rem;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .1);
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .035);
}

.battle-card-detail dt {
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: .68rem;
}

.battle-card-detail dd {
  margin: .1rem 0 0;
  font-weight: 900;
}

.skill-label {
  display: block;
  color: #e9c889;
  font-size: .74rem;
  font-weight: 900;
}

.battle-skill .skill-label {
  margin-bottom: .22rem;
}

.skill-statline {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: .42rem;
  margin: .45rem 0 .38rem;
}

.skill-power {
  min-width: 2.15rem;
  color: #f1d789;
  font-size: 1.85rem;
  line-height: 1;
  text-shadow: 0 2px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, .7);
}

.skill-wave {
  color: #f0d48a;
  font-size: 1.25rem;
  font-weight: 900;
  line-height: 1;
}

.target-count {
  margin-left: auto;
  color: #d7c197;
  font-size: .72rem;
  font-weight: 900;
}

.sequence-description { white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: anywhere; line-height: 1.65; margin: 0; }
.sequence-description .sequence-step { margin: 0; padding: 10px 0; color: #edf1f4; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.65; }
.sequence-step + .sequence-step { border-top: 1px solid #ffffff20; }
.sequence-description .effect-damage { display: inline; font-size: inherit; color: #ffe09a; }
.sequence-description .effect-keyword { color: #9edbcb; font-weight: 700; }
.skill-effects {
  display: grid;
  gap: .26rem;
  margin-top: .5rem;
}

.hit-effect-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1.7rem minmax(0, 1fr);
  align-items: center;
  gap: .38rem;
}

.hit-badge {
  width: 1.55rem;
  height: 1.55rem;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  color: #fff5dd;
  font-size: .68rem;
  font-weight: 950;
  text-shadow: 0 2px 3px #000, 0 0 .3rem #000;
  background: center / contain no-repeat;
}

.hit-badge.sword {
  background-image: url("assets/icons/hit-sword.png");
}

.hit-badge.shield {
  background-image: url("assets/icons/hit-shield.png");
}

.hit-effect-row.support .hit-badge {
  opacity: .72;
}

.hit-effect-row p {
  margin: 0;
  color: #dce7f1;
  font-size: .76rem;
  line-height: 1.3;
}

.hit-effect-row p::first-letter {
  color: inherit;
}

.battle-cell.effect-area {
  background: rgba(223, 155, 66, .46);
  border-color: #ffd383;
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 18px rgba(255, 184, 78, .35);
}

.battle-card-detail .skill-power {
  font-size: 2.35rem;
}

.battle-card-detail .skill-wave {
  font-size: 1.55rem;
}

.battle-card-detail .hit-effect-row {
  grid-template-columns: 2.05rem minmax(0, 1fr);
}

.battle-card-detail .hit-badge {
  width: 1.88rem;
  height: 1.88rem;
  font-size: .82rem;
}

.battle-card-detail .hit-effect-row p {
  font-size: .9rem;
}

.battle-log.floating-log {
  position: fixed;
  right: 1rem;
  top: 5.2rem;
  z-index: 24;
  width: min(21rem, 32vw);
  max-height: 14rem;
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid rgba(126, 175, 255, .24);
  background: rgba(9, 12, 15, .78);
  backdrop-filter: blur(.65rem);
  box-shadow: 0 1rem 2rem rgba(0, 0, 0, .42);
}

.cursor-aim-line {
  position: fixed;
  z-index: 30;
  height: 0;
  border-top: 3px solid rgba(240, 212, 138, .9);
  transform-origin: 0 50%;
  pointer-events: none;
  opacity: 0;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 0 .5rem rgba(240, 212, 138, .72));
}

.cursor-aim-line::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  right: -.3rem;
  top: -.43rem;
  border-left: .65rem solid rgba(240, 212, 138, .95);
  border-top: .35rem solid transparent;
  border-bottom: .35rem solid transparent;
}

.cursor-aim-line.active {
  opacity: 1;
}

.battle-card-fan {
  width: min(68rem, calc(100vw - 11rem));
}

.battle-card-fan .battle-skill:nth-child(1) { transform: translateX(-28rem) translateY(1.65rem) rotate(-20deg); }
.battle-card-fan .battle-skill:nth-child(2) { transform: translateX(-16.8rem) translateY(.65rem) rotate(-12deg); }
.battle-card-fan .battle-skill:nth-child(3) { transform: translateX(-5.6rem) translateY(-.12rem) rotate(-4deg); }
.battle-card-fan .battle-skill:nth-child(4) { transform: translateX(5.6rem) translateY(-.12rem) rotate(4deg); }
.battle-card-fan .battle-skill:nth-child(5) { transform: translateX(16.8rem) translateY(.65rem) rotate(12deg); }
.battle-card-fan .battle-skill:nth-child(6) { transform: translateX(28rem) translateY(1.65rem) rotate(20deg); }

.battle-card-fan .battle-skill:nth-child(1):hover,
.battle-card-fan .battle-skill:nth-child(1).active { transform: translateX(-28rem) translateY(-1.25rem) rotate(-14deg) scale(1.08); }
.battle-card-fan .battle-skill:nth-child(2):hover,
.battle-card-fan .battle-skill:nth-child(2).active { transform: translateX(-16.8rem) translateY(-2rem) rotate(-8deg) scale(1.08); }
.battle-card-fan .battle-skill:nth-child(3):hover,
.battle-card-fan .battle-skill:nth-child(3).active { transform: translateX(-5.6rem) translateY(-2.55rem) rotate(-3deg) scale(1.08); }
.battle-card-fan .battle-skill:nth-child(4):hover,
.battle-card-fan .battle-skill:nth-child(4).active { transform: translateX(5.6rem) translateY(-2.55rem) rotate(3deg) scale(1.08); }
.battle-card-fan .battle-skill:nth-child(5):hover,
.battle-card-fan .battle-skill:nth-child(5).active { transform: translateX(16.8rem) translateY(-2rem) rotate(8deg) scale(1.08); }
.battle-card-fan .battle-skill:nth-child(6):hover,
.battle-card-fan .battle-skill:nth-child(6).active { transform: translateX(28rem) translateY(-1.25rem) rotate(14deg) scale(1.08); }

.battle-skill.guard {
  border-color: rgba(126, 175, 255, .42);
}

.battle-skill.ego {
  border-color: rgba(240, 212, 138, .62);
}

.placeholder-panel {
  min-height: calc(100vh - 12rem);
  display: grid;
  place-content: center;
  text-align: center;
  padding: 2rem;
}

.placeholder-panel p:not(.eyebrow) { color: var(--muted); }

@media (max-width: 1180px) {
  .home-layout {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    grid-template-areas:
      "standby"
      "notice"
      "wallet"
      "dock";
  }
  .notice-stack {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    grid-template-rows: auto;
  }
  .identity-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
  .dokkaebi-hub { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
  .battle-layout {
    height: auto;
    min-height: 0;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
  .battle-bottom {
    height: auto;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
  .squad-layout {
    grid-template-columns: 11rem minmax(0, 1fr);
  }
  .story-layout, .identity-detail { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}

@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .content { padding: .75rem .75rem 6.8rem; }
  .section-head {
    display: flex;
    align-items: stretch;
    flex-direction: column;
  }
  .standby-panel { min-height: 24rem; }
  .standby-copy h3 { font-size: 2rem; }
  .wallet-grid,
  .notice-stack,
  .main-nav,
  .identity-grid,
  .filament-board,
  .meta-grid,
  .skill-list {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }
  .squad-layout { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .squad-slots { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
  .dokkaebi-hub { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .battle-dummy {
    overflow: auto;
  }
  .battle-topbar {
    margin-left: 0;
    margin-top: 3.5rem;
    align-items: stretch;
    flex-direction: column;
  }
  .battle-layout {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
  .battle-field {
    min-height: 28rem;
  }
  .main-nav {
    right: .75rem;
    bottom: .75rem;
    width: calc(100vw - 1.5rem);
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }
}

.unit-info-backdrop {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 100;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  padding: 12px;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, .62);
}

.battle-unit-info {
  width: min(760px, 94vw);
  height: min(640px, calc(100dvh - 32px));
  min-height: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  border: 1px solid #b7a16d;
  border-radius: 4px;
  background: #161b20;
  color: #f0eee7;
  box-shadow: 0 12px 48px #000;
}

.battle-unit-info > header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 14px 20px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #41464a;
}

.battle-unit-info h3 { margin: 4px 0 0; font-size: 21px; }
.battle-unit-info h4 { margin: 12px 0; font-size: 15px; }
.battle-unit-info small { color: #c8c4b8; }
.battle-unit-info button { color: inherit; cursor: pointer; }
.battle-unit-info [data-close-unit-info] {
  width: 36px;
  height: 36px;
  border: 1px solid #60615a;
  background: #252b30;
  font-size: 24px;
}

.unit-info-tabs, .unit-ego-tabs { display: flex; gap: 4px; padding: 8px 12px; }
.unit-info-tabs button, .unit-ego-tabs button {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
  padding: 10px 4px;
  border: 1px solid #454b50;
  background: #252b30;
  font-size: 14px;
}
.unit-info-tabs button[aria-selected="true"], .unit-ego-tabs button[aria-selected="true"] {
  color: #ffe199;
  border-color: #d3b76e;
  background: #3d392b;
}
.unit-info-content { overflow-y: auto; min-height: 0; padding: 0 20px 16px; overscroll-behavior: contain; }
.unit-info-entry { padding: 12px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #41464a; }
.unit-info-entry h4 { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; }
.unit-info-entry > strong { display: block; font-size: 18px; }
.unit-info-entry p, .unit-info-statuses p { line-height: 1.6; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.unit-info-empty { color: #a3a8aa; font-size: 14px; }
.unit-info-stats { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 16px; padding: 18px 0; }
.unit-info-stats span, .unit-info-stats strong { display: block; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.unit-info-stats meter { width: 100%; }
.unit-info-statuses { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
.unit-info-statuses li { padding: 8px 0; }
.unit-info-statuses span { margin-left: 16px; color: #cfcec8; }
.unit-ego-tabs { padding-left: 0; padding-right: 0; }
.battle-unit-info .hit-effect-row { justify-content: flex-start; }

@media (max-width: 520px) {
  .wallet-grid,
  .main-nav,
  .identity-grid,
  .filament-board,
  .squad-slots {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
  .wave-panel {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}

@media (max-height: 540px) and (orientation: landscape) {
  .battle-dummy { padding: 8px; height: 100dvh; min-height: 0; overflow: hidden; }
  .battle-dummy .story-back-button { top: 8px; left: 8px; width: 70px; min-width: 0; min-height: 32px; font-size: 12px; padding: 6px; }
  .battle-topbar { margin: 0 0 0 78px; min-height: 36px; padding: 5px 8px; flex-direction: row; gap: 6px; }
  .battle-topbar .eyebrow { display: none; }
  .battle-topbar h3 { font-size: 12px; max-width: 200px; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
  .battle-meters { gap: 3px; flex-wrap: nowrap; }
  .battle-meters span { min-height: 24px; padding: 2px 5px; font-size: 11px; white-space: nowrap; }
  .battle-layout { height: calc(100dvh - 60px); min-height: 0; margin-top: 6px; }
  .battle-field { height: 100%; min-height: 0; }
  .battle-board-3d { width: min(54vw, 27rem); top: 63%; }
  .battle-card-fan { bottom: -8px; transform: translateX(-50%) scale(.48); transform-origin: bottom center; }
  .battle-card-detail { left: 8px; top: 54px; transform: none; width: 168px; max-height: calc(100dvh - 172px); overflow-y: auto; padding: 8px; }
  .battle-card-detail .skill-power { font-size: 22px; }
  .battle-card-detail .hit-effect-row p { font-size: 11px; }
  .battle-log.floating-log { top: 54px; right: 8px; width: 190px; max-height: 70px; opacity: .9; }
  .battle-log.floating-log p { font-size: 10px; }
  .floating-resolve { right: 8px; bottom: 8px; width: 66px; min-width: 0; padding: 8px; font-size: 14px; }
}

.battle-lineup { height: 100dvh; padding: 20px; display: grid; grid-template-rows: auto minmax(0,1fr) auto; gap: 16px; background: #14181e; color: #e7e9ed; overflow: hidden; }
.battle-lineup header, .battle-lineup footer { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; }
.battle-lineup h2, .battle-lineup h3 { margin: 0; }
.battle-lineup h2 { font-size: 22px; }
.battle-lineup h3 { font-size: 14px; }
.battle-lineup small { font-size: 12px; color: #d8bc73; }
.battle-formation-layout { min-height:0; grid-template-columns:220px minmax(0,1fr); }
.lineup-orders { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px; min-height:0; overflow-y:auto; }
.lineup-slots { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:5px; width:100%; }
.lineup-slots button { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 40px; padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid #527c99; background: #172430; }
.lineup-slots img { width: 32px; height: 44px; object-fit: cover; object-position: top; }
.bench-slots button { background: #23211a; border-color: #a68b57; }
.lineup-roster { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr)); grid-template-rows:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)); gap:10px; min-height:0; }
.lineup-roster .slot-card { aspect-ratio:auto; width:100%; height:100%; cursor:pointer; border:1px solid #515b69; }
.lineup-roster .slot-card:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #f0d48a; outline-offset:-3px; }
.lineup-rank { position:absolute; top:8px; right:8px; z-index:4; background:#e1c27a; color:#191b20; width:28px; height:28px; display:grid; place-items:center; font-weight:700; }
.lineup-state { position:absolute; top:8px; left:8px; z-index:4; padding:4px 7px; background:#111820e8; color:#c8ccd2; font-size:12px; border:1px solid #656b74; }
.lineup-roster .unavailable { cursor:not-allowed; filter:grayscale(1); }
.lineup-roster .unavailable .slot-character { filter:brightness(.4); }
.lineup-roster .unavailable .slot-logo { opacity:.5; }
.lineup-roster .chosen { border-color: #e1c27a; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #e1c27a; }
.battle-swap-backdrop { position: fixed; inset: 0; background: #05080dc9; z-index: 60; display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 16px; }
.battle-swap-picker { width: min(760px,100%); max-height: 85dvh; overflow-y: auto; padding: 20px; background: #1c232c; border: 1px solid #d0b979; }
.battle-swap-picker header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; }
.battle-swap-picker h3 { font-size: 18px; }
.battle-swap-picker > div { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr)); gap: 10px; }
.battle-swap-picker button[data-swap-unit] { display: grid; gap: 8px; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid #657b91; background: #26323e; }
.battle-swap-picker img { height: 130px; width: 100%; object-fit: contain; }
.battle-swap-picker span { font-size: 12px; }
.battle-dummy .battle-card-fan .battle-skill { transform: translateX(calc(var(--fan-position) * 10rem)) translateY(calc(var(--fan-bend) * .45rem)) rotate(calc(var(--fan-position) * 6deg)); }
.battle-dummy .battle-card-fan .battle-skill:hover, .battle-dummy .battle-card-fan .battle-skill.active { transform: translateX(calc(var(--fan-position) * 10rem)) translateY(-2rem) rotate(calc(var(--fan-position) * 4deg)) scale(1.06); }
.battle-dummy .battle-card-fan .battle-skill:disabled { filter: grayscale(1); opacity: .5; }
.battle-skill.swap { border-color: #82bd9e; min-height: 10.6rem; }
.battle-skill.swap strong { font-size: 44px; display: block; color: #b5e8ce; }
.battle-action-queue { position: fixed; bottom: 14rem; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); z-index: 25; display: flex; gap: 5px; max-width: 50vw; overflow-x: auto; }
.battle-action-queue button { font-size: 12px; white-space: nowrap; padding: 5px 8px; background: #192732; border: 1px solid #7599b5; }
@media (max-height: 540px) and (orientation: landscape) {
  .dialogue-box {
    left: 1rem;
    right: 1rem;
    bottom: .5rem;
    min-height: 0;
    max-height: 25vh;
    overflow-y: auto;
    padding: .5rem .8rem;
  }
  .speaker-block { min-height: 1.5rem; font-size: 12px; }
  .speaker-block strong { padding: 0 .6rem; }
  .dialogue-box p { margin-top: .35rem; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5; }
  .battle-lineup { padding: 8px; gap: 6px; }
  .battle-lineup header button, .battle-lineup footer button { padding: 5px 12px; min-height: 28px; }
  .battle-lineup h2 { font-size: 16px; }
  .battle-formation-layout { grid-template-columns:150px minmax(0,1fr); gap:8px; }
  .lineup-orders { gap:4px; padding:6px; }
  .lineup-slots { gap:3px; }
  .lineup-slots button { min-height:22px; height:22px; font-size:10px; padding:1px 4px; }
  .lineup-slots img { width:16px; height:20px; }
  .lineup-roster .slot-logo { width:2.8rem; height:2.8rem; left:.2rem; bottom:.2rem; }
  .lineup-roster .slot-name { font-size:11px; right:.3rem; bottom:.45rem; max-width:calc(100% - 2.8rem); }
  .lineup-state { top:4px; left:4px; padding:2px 4px; font-size:10px; }
  .lineup-rank { width:20px; height:20px; font-size:12px; }
  .lineup-slots { gap: 4px; }
  .lineup-slots button { min-height: 30px; font-size: 11px; gap: 4px; padding: 2px 4px; }
  .lineup-slots img { width: 16px; height: 24px; }
  .lineup-roster { gap: 4px; }
  .lineup-roster strong { font-size: 11px; }
  .lineup-roster b { width: 20px; height: 20px; font-size: 12px; }
  .battle-action-queue { bottom: 128px; max-width: 48vw; }
  .battle-action-queue button { font-size: 10px; padding: 3px 5px; }
  .battle-swap-picker img { height: 70px; }
  .battle-swap-picker { padding: 8px; }
  .battle-swap-picker > div { grid-template-columns: repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr)); }
  .battle-topbar h3 { max-width: 150px; }
}
.battle-menu-button { position:absolute; top:16px; right:16px; z-index:40; width:40px; height:36px; background:#15191e; border:1px solid #9ba4ae; color:#eee; font-size:24px; cursor:pointer; }
.battle-menu-panel { position:absolute; top:58px; right:16px; z-index:41; padding:8px; background:#15191e; border:1px solid #9ba4ae; }
.battle-menu-panel button { color:#eee; background:#242a31; border:1px solid #727b86; padding:10px 25px; cursor:pointer; }
.battle-meters { margin-right:48px; }
.enemy-action-badge.ally-action-badge { border-color:#77b7eb; color:#d7efff; background:#12354b; }
.action-slot { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:3px; padding:2px 4px; border-right:1px solid currentColor; }
.action-slot:last-child { border-right:0; }
.battle-token.sd-token { width:calc(clamp(4.8rem,8vw,7.5rem) * var(--sd-scale,1)); height:calc(clamp(7.2rem,12vw,10.5rem) * var(--sd-scale,1)); }
/* Keep sprites out of the board's nested 3D rasterization. */
.battle-unit-layer { position:absolute; inset:0; z-index:9; pointer-events:none; }
.battle-arrow-overlay { z-index:10; }
.battle-camera { position:absolute; inset:0; transform-origin:0 0; perspective:1100px; }
.battle-camera-tools { position:absolute; top:10px; left:10px; z-index:26; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; }
.battle-camera-tools > div { display:flex; }
.battle-camera-tools button { height:34px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:6px; padding:0 10px; border:1px solid #777f86; color:#e5e8eb; background:#151b22ed; cursor:pointer; font-size:12px; }
.battle-camera-tools > div button + button { border-left:0; }
.battle-camera-tools button[aria-pressed="true"] { background:#6c562d; color:#ffe4a2; border-color:#d4b56b; }
.battle-camera-tools button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #ffdf84; outline-offset:2px; }
.battle-camera-tools img { width:18px; height:18px; pointer-events:none; }
.battle-dummy:has(.unit-info-backdrop) .battle-camera-tools { display:none; }
.battle-unit-layer .battle-token {
  --sprite-width:calc(clamp(4.8rem,8vw,7.5rem) * var(--sprite-zoom,1));
  --sprite-height:calc(clamp(7.2rem,12vw,10.5rem) * var(--sprite-zoom,1));
  width:var(--sprite-width); height:var(--sprite-height);
  margin-left:calc(var(--sprite-width) * -.5);
  margin-top:calc(var(--sprite-height) * -1 + 2.5rem);
  transform:none; pointer-events:auto;
}
.battle-unit-layer .battle-token img { filter:none; image-rendering:auto; }
.battle-unit-layer .battle-token.sd-token > img {
  position: absolute;
  left: 50%;
  bottom: calc(2.5rem - (var(--sprite-height) - 2.5rem) * var(--sd-foot-offset));
  height: calc((var(--sprite-height) - 2.5rem) * var(--sd-render-scale));
  width: auto;
  max-width: none;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
}
.battle-unit-layer .battle-token.enemy { background:transparent; }
.battle-unit-layer .battle-token.selected img,
.battle-unit-layer .battle-token.primary-targeted img { filter:drop-shadow(0 0 3px #f0d48a); }
.unit-info-backdrop { position:fixed; padding:24px; background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 35%,rgba(7,10,13,.45) 65%); }
.battle-inspection {
  position:absolute; right:24px; top:24px; width:44vw; height:calc(100dvh - 48px); min-height:0;
  display:flex;
  animation:inspection-open .18s ease-out;
}
.battle-inspection .battle-unit-info { width:100%; height:100%; min-width:0; }
.battle-inspection .unit-info-content { flex:1; }
.battle-dummy:has(.unit-info-backdrop) .battle-field-wrap { position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:50; display:block; }
.battle-dummy:has(.unit-info-backdrop) .battle-field { width:100%; height:100%; border:0; }
.battle-dummy:has(.unit-info-backdrop) .battle-token { pointer-events:none; }
.battle-dummy:has(.unit-info-backdrop) .battle-token:not(.inspection-focus) { filter:brightness(.55); }
.battle-dummy:has(.unit-info-backdrop) .enemy-action-badge,
.battle-dummy:has(.unit-info-backdrop) .unit-hp,
.battle-dummy:has(.unit-info-backdrop) .unit-sp,
.battle-dummy:has(.unit-info-backdrop) .unit-status-badges,
.battle-dummy:has(.unit-info-backdrop) .battle-arrow-overlay { visibility:hidden; }
@keyframes inspection-open { from { opacity:0; transform:scale(.96); } to { opacity:1; transform:scale(1); } }
@media (max-width:900px), (max-height:520px) {
  .unit-info-backdrop { padding:10px; }
  .battle-inspection { right:10px; top:10px; width:49vw; height:calc(100dvh - 20px); }
  .battle-inspection .battle-unit-info > header { padding:8px 12px; }
  .battle-inspection .battle-unit-info h3 { font-size:17px; }
  .battle-inspection .unit-info-tabs { padding:6px; }
  .battle-inspection .unit-info-tabs button { font-size:12px; padding:7px 2px; }
  .battle-inspection .unit-info-content { padding:0 12px 12px; }
  .battle-inspection .unit-info-stats { gap:8px; padding:10px 0; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .battle-inspection { animation:none; } }
.battle-token.sd-token img { user-select:none; -webkit-user-drag:none; }
.action-slot { cursor:pointer; touch-action:none; pointer-events:auto; }
.action-slot:hover, .action-slot:focus-visible, .action-slot[aria-pressed="true"] { background:#806526; outline:2px solid #ffdd78; outline-offset:1px; }
#battle-log-modal { z-index:100; }
.identity-card { background: linear-gradient(180deg,#090e1133,#090e11dd),var(--roster-bg) center/cover; }
#squad-view, #identity-view { background:linear-gradient(#080b0eda,#080b0ef0),url('assets/story/backgrounds/stage03_dokkaebi_interior_v2.jpg') center/cover; }
.battle-lineup { background:linear-gradient(#080b0ed9,#080b0ef0),url('assets/story/backgrounds/stage03_hangar_v2.jpg') center/cover; }
.battle-dummy.tutorial-battle { background: linear-gradient(#05070bb3,#05070be6),url('assets/story/backgrounds/ch1_mind_camp.jpg') center/cover; }
.tutorial-battle .battle-field { background:linear-gradient(#05070b55,#05070bbb),url('assets/story/backgrounds/ch1_mind_camp.jpg') center/cover; }
.battle-tutorial-guide { position:absolute; top:92px; left:50%; transform:translateX(-50%); z-index:45; width:min(520px,46vw); max-height:36vh; overflow:auto; padding:14px 18px; border:1px solid #d8bc79; background:#0d1219f2; color:#eee9d9; box-shadow:0 8px 30px #0009; }
.battle-tutorial-guide header,.battle-tutorial-guide footer { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; gap:12px; }
.battle-tutorial-guide header { color:#d8bc79; font-size:12px; }
.battle-tutorial-guide h3 { font-size:18px; margin:10px 0; }
.battle-tutorial-guide p { font-size:14px; line-height:1.65; margin:0 0 12px; }
.battle-tutorial-guide button { background:#d8bc79; color:#131419; border:0; padding:6px 14px; cursor:pointer; }
.battle-tutorial-guide button:disabled { opacity:.4; cursor:default; }
.battle-tutorial-guide footer span { font-size:12px; }
.battle-tutorial-guide.folded .tutorial-copy { display:none; }
.battle-dummy .battle-tutorial-guide.folded { left:16px; top:105px; transform:none; width:288px; box-sizing:border-box; }
.battle-lineup.tutorial-battle { grid-template-rows:auto auto minmax(0,1fr) auto; }
.battle-lineup .battle-tutorial-guide { position:static; transform:none; width:100%; max-height:180px; box-sizing:border-box; }
.tutorial-focus { box-shadow:0 0 16px #e6c970,inset 0 0 0 2px #e6c970 !important; }
@media (max-height:540px) and (orientation:landscape) {
 .battle-tutorial-guide { top:70px; width:min(420px,48vw); padding:8px 12px; max-height:36vh; }
 .battle-tutorial-guide h3 { font-size:14px; margin:5px 0; }
 .battle-tutorial-guide p { font-size:12px; line-height:1.45; margin-bottom:6px; }
 .battle-lineup .battle-tutorial-guide { max-height:100px; }
 .battle-dummy .battle-tutorial-guide.folded { top:48px; left:8px; width:166px; padding:5px 8px; }
 .battle-dummy .battle-tutorial-guide.folded header strong { font-size:10px; white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; }
 .battle-dummy .battle-tutorial-guide.folded footer span { display:none; }
 .battle-dummy .battle-tutorial-guide.folded button { padding:3px 8px; font-size:11px; }
}

.battle-card-fan { bottom: 44px; }
.battle-card-fan .battle-skill:not(.swap) {
  height: 192px;
  min-height: 192px;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-rows: 22px 48px 50px 34px;
  gap: 4px;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-align: left;
  background: #192027;
}
.battle-card-fan .battle-skill.guard { background: #17252a; }
.battle-card-fan .battle-skill.ego { background: #29221a; }
.compact-card-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; }
.compact-card-header img { width: 22px; height: 22px; object-fit: contain; }
.battle-card-fan .compact-card-header .skill-label { font-size: 13px; margin: 0; color: #d7dfe6; }
.battle-card-fan .compact-card-name { display: flex; align-items: center; font-size: 19px; line-height: 1.25; color: #fff0c7; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.compact-card-power { display: flex; gap: 16px; align-items: center; border-top: 1px solid #ffffff24; }
.compact-card-power > span { display: grid; gap: 4px; }
.battle-card-fan .compact-card-power small { font-size: 11px; color: #bbc8d3; line-height: 1; }
.battle-card-fan .compact-card-power .skill-power { font-size: 32px; }
.battle-card-fan .compact-card-power .skill-wave { font-size: 26px; color: #9fcbfa; }
.compact-card-meta { display: grid; align-content: center; gap: 3px; }
.battle-card-fan .compact-card-meta span { font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.2; color: #d2dce4; }
.battle-card-detail { border-radius: 4px; background: #121a22f5; }
.battle-card-detail .skill-effects { margin-top: 12px; }
.battle-card-detail .sequence-description .sequence-step { font-size: 14px; }
.battle-unit-info .sequence-description .sequence-step { font-size: 15px; }
@media (max-height: 540px) and (orientation: landscape) {
  .battle-card-fan { bottom: 24px; transform: translateX(-50%) scale(.56); }
  .battle-card-fan .compact-card-name { font-size: 23px; }
  .battle-card-fan .compact-card-power .skill-power { font-size: 38px; }
  .battle-card-fan .compact-card-power .skill-wave { font-size: 30px; }
  .battle-card-fan .compact-card-meta span { font-size: 13px; }
  .battle-card-fan .compact-card-power small { font-size: 13px; }
  .battle-card-detail .sequence-description .sequence-step { font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.6; padding: 8px 0; }
  .battle-dummy .battle-card-detail { top: 54px; transform: none; width: 210px; max-height: calc(100dvh - 175px); }
  .battle-card-detail > .eyebrow, .battle-card-detail > .skill-label { display: none; }
  .battle-card-detail > h3 { margin: 4px 0; }
  .battle-card-detail > strong { margin: 4px 0; }
}
````

## C108. 이루다 소설/게임 UI 프로토타입/assets/battle/motions/preview.html

원본: `이루다 소설/게임 UI 프로토타입/assets/battle/motions/preview.html` / 2,706 bytes / SHA-256 `e0375aa4eaeedffd346435526615c86c2cffa7858b22c60c7461093f8db7e860`

````html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="ko"><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>이루다 모션 검수</title>
<style>
*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;background:#202329;color:#edf0f4;font:14px system-ui}header{position:sticky;top:0;background:#17191e;padding:12px 20px;display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:center;z-index:2}h1{font-size:18px;margin:0}select,button{background:#303641;color:inherit;border:1px solid #697382;padding:8px}main{display:grid;grid-template-columns:260px 1fr;min-height:90vh}aside{padding:20px;border-right:1px solid #454b55}aside img{width:220px}#poses{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(210px,1fr));gap:1px;background:#454b55}figure{margin:0;padding:12px;background:#272c34}figure img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:3/4;object-fit:contain;background:repeating-conic-gradient(#363d47 0% 25%,#303640 0% 50%) 0/20px 20px}figcaption{padding:8px 0}small{color:#e2bb70}.mirror #poses img{transform:scaleX(-1)}@media(max-width:700px){main{grid-template-columns:150px 1fr}aside{padding:8px}aside img{width:130px}#poses{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(130px,1fr))}header{flex-wrap:wrap}}
</style><header><h1>전투 모션</h1><select id="character" aria-label="캐릭터"></select><button id="mirror">↔</button></header><main><aside><img id="reference" alt="기준 SD"><p id="name"></p><small>핵심 포즈 초안 · 연속 프레임 아님</small></aside><section id="poses"></section></main>
<script src="motion-assets-v2.js"></script><script>
const picker=document.querySelector('#character'),assets=window.irudaMotionAssets;
for(const c of assets.characters)picker.add(new Option(c.name,c.id));
function show(){const c=assets.characters.find(c=>c.id===picker.value);document.querySelector('#reference').src=c.reference;document.querySelector('#name').textContent=c.name;document.querySelector('#poses').replaceChildren(...c.frames.map(f=>{const figure=document.createElement('figure'),img=document.createElement('img'),caption=document.createElement('figcaption'),status=document.createElement('small'),native=document.createElement('a');img.src=f.src;img.alt=f.label;img.draggable=false;caption.textContent=f.label;status.textContent=f.review==='check-source-edge'?'원본 가장자리 재검수':'기준 SD 대비 검수';native.href=f.nativeSrc;native.target='_blank';native.textContent=`원본 ${f.nativeSize.join(' × ')}`;native.style.cssText='display:block;color:#8dd8f6;margin-top:6px';figure.append(img,caption,status,native);return figure;}));}
picker.addEventListener('change',show);document.querySelector('#mirror').onclick=()=>document.body.classList.toggle('mirror');show();
</script></html>
````

````json
  "revision": 3,
  "authority": "approved idle SD; no generic head-count substitution",
````
