Right arm extends mostly in the picture plane. Left hand holds her SAME tablet close to left hip/chest, visible and attached to a correctly articulated left forearm. Restrained forward stance, knees only mildly flexed, heel of trailing boot may rise slightly. Spine nearly upright with slight forward intent; not a squat or dramatic lunge. Face and eyes screen right, shallow three-quarter camera like base, orthographic, NO depth foreshortening.\nABSOLUTE IDENTITY LOCK: same adult woman's face, gray-blue eyes, long black hair, small gold flower hairpin, diamond blue earrings, royal-blue tie and coat lining, black/gold long coat, TWO gold waist belt buckles, gloved hands, chunky black/gold boots. Same head/skull and face dimensions as base, same neck length, shoulder width, upper/lower arm lengths, pelvis, thigh and shin lengths, boot size. Do not enlarge head to convey aggression. Retain base's approximately 5.47-head anatomical proportions; flexed stance may be lower but must NOT be enlarged to refill the image.\nCANVAS/PIXEL SCALE: portrait canvas SAME 3:4 aspect as base; treat its coordinate system as 1086 x 1448. Base crown-to-chin height is 237 px, head width about 255 px, upright crown-to-sole height1297 px, ground line y1375. Keep head size 237px in that coordinate system (16.37% canvas height), no normalization by posed bounding-box height. Soles at approximately y1375 (95%height). Center body's foot support near x543. All hair, pen, coat and boots fit inside canvas, no cropping, no floor or shadow. Use generous lateral space without shrinking the whole person. Virtual construction grid only, NOT visible.\nBADGE: outer RIGHT upper sleeve plainly visible; midnight-blue round embroidered patch, thin gold circular border, central upright vintage LIGHTBULB silhouette with filament and screw base, TEN slender radial gold threads each ending a little pointed star exactly as image2. NOT a question mark, sun, stickman, flower or random circular glyph. Integrate into sleeve perspective. Match image1 clean simple cel shading and dark outline, no extra ornate costume details, no FX, no text. High native resolution, request 2172x2896 but identical subject scale proportions to source.",
````json
    "correction": "Precise localized correction of image1, ONE complete transparent character sprite. Image1 is the attack sprite to EDIT. Correct ONLY the oversized anatomical HEAD: reduce the skull/face and crown-to-chin dimension by TEN PERCENT (0.90), bring it into agreement with image2 head-to-torso ratio. Original attack head is about263px and should become237px at same1086x1448 scale. Reduce the fringe/upper hair volume attached to skull accordingly, preserve long hanging hair length and clean natural neck connection, no stretched face. Don't scale body or entire figure. Same gray-blue eyes face identity, flower clip earrings. Also bring the pen's tip comfortably inside canvas with about4% right margin, by shortening only the pen barrel slightly, not shortening arm. Badge remains correct vintage LIGHTBULB and ten gold star-ended threads on round midnight-blue patch, matching image3, not a question mark. Same original simple cel shading. Exactly two connected arms/two hands/two legs. Both boot soles grounded near same baseline; only slight knee bend and slight torso tilt, not a tiny crouching chibi. Expression winces with mouth slightly open, gray-blue eyes partly closed. Head is SAME SIZE as approved base even though expression changes. Long black hair follows motion modestly; calm clean silhouette, no gore, FX, ground shadow or scenery.\nPROPORTIONS: use same 1086x1448 portrait coordinate system: head crown-to-chin 237px EXACT (16.37% canvas height), crown-to-sole upright1297px (5.47heads), same shoulder width, neck length, waist, thigh/shin, upper/lower arms, hand size and boot size as approved reference. Do not enlarge head. Body/head keep same scale; bent pose naturally a little shorter. Foot support pivot x543 y1375. No parts of character clipped; lateral padding. Uniform patch MUST be reference2 midnight blue round badge with gold border, upright vintage lightbulb FILAMENT AND SCREW BASE, TEN gold radial lines each ending star, visible on outer upper sleeve.     "correction": "Localized proportion correction of image1 HURT sprite. ONE complete figure, no parts, no sprite sheet.     "enlargement": "Fine localized correction to image1, the HURT reaction. ONE whole transparent sprite. Image2 approved base is anatomy reference, image3 sleeve badge. ## C157. 이루다 소설/게임 UI 프로토타입/assets/battle/sd/sd-55/preview.html
````

원본: `이루다 소설/게임 UI 프로토타입/assets/battle/sd/sd-55/preview.html` / 2,998 bytes / SHA-256 `8ffa9062028b19b93c531993998309a7210c4004d394f1502318bf14519c8086`

````html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="ko"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>SD 5.5 비율 검수</title>
<style>
*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;background:#171b1c;color:#edf1f0;font:15px Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:0}header{padding:18px 24px;border-bottom:1px solid #465154;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:20px;flex-wrap:wrap}h1{font-size:20px;margin:0}label{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center}main{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:0}.item{min-width:0;border-right:1px solid #394044;border-bottom:1px solid #394044;padding:16px}.title{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px}.approx{color:#91cad3}.stage{height:560px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:#22282a;margin-top:12px}.stage img{position:absolute;width:auto;max-width:none;user-select:none;-webkit-user-drag:none}.guide{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none}.guide i{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;border-top:1px dashed #6faaad;color:#a5c6c8;font-style:normal;font-size:11px;padding-left:5px}.hide .guide{display:none}a{color:#d0dde0;text-underline-offset:3px}.links{margin-top:12px;display:flex;gap:18px}small{color:#bcc6c7}@media(max-width:900px){main{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.stage{height:460px}}@media(max-width:520px){main{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
</style></head><body><header><h1>기본 SD / 5.5등신 목표</h1><label><input id="grid" type="checkbox" checked>기준선</label><small>표시 등신은 머리 외곽 기준의 수동 근사치입니다.</small></header><main></main><script src="review-data.js"></script><script>
const main=document.querySelector('main');
for(const data of window.sd55Review){
 const section=document.createElement('section');section.className='item';
 section.innerHTML='<div class="title"><strong>'+data.name+'</strong><span class="approx">약 '+data.approxHeads.toFixed(2)+'등신</span></div><div class="stage"><img draggable="false" alt="'+data.name+'"><div class="guide"></div></div><div class="links"><a href="'+encodeURI(data.file)+'" target="_blank">PNG 원본</a></div>';
 const img=section.querySelector('img');img.src=data.file;const stage=section.querySelector('.stage'),guide=section.querySelector('.guide');
 function layout(){const visibleHeight=stage.clientHeight-48,s=visibleHeight/(data.sole-data.crown);img.style.height=data.height*s+'px';img.style.left=(stage.clientWidth-data.width*s)/2+'px';img.style.top=(24-data.crown*s)+'px';guide.replaceChildren();for(let n=0;n<=5.5;n+=n===5?.5:1){const line=document.createElement('i');line.style.top=(24+visibleHeight*n/5.5)+'px';line.textContent=n===0?'0 / 정수리':n===1?'1 / 목표 턱선':n===5.5?'5.5 / 발바닥':n;guide.append(line);}}
 main.append(section);new ResizeObserver(layout).observe(stage);layout();
}
document.querySelector('#grid').addEventListener('change',event=>document.body.classList.toggle('hide',!event.target.checked));
</script></body></html>
````

````cjs
const path = require('node:path');
const { pathToFileURL } = require('node:url');
const { chromium } = require('C:/Users/user/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/node/node_modules/playwright');
(async () => {
  const browser = await chromium.launch({ headless: true, channel: 'msedge' });
  try {
    for (const [width, height] of [[1440,900],[844,390]]) {
      const page = await browser.newPage({viewport:{width,height}});
      await page.goto(pathToFileURL(path.resolve(__dirname,'../index.html')).href);
      await page.evaluate(() => {
        document.querySelectorAll('.view').forEach(v=>v.classList.toggle('active',v.id==='story-view'));
        startBattleLineup(createBattleRoster().map(u=>u.id));
        const a=battleDummy.allies[0],e=battleDummy.enemies[0];a.x=3;a.y=2;e.x=4;e.y=2;
        a.skills[0]={...a.skills[0],power:30};
        const ap={id:`${a.id}:0`,unit:a,action:a.skills[0],target:e,handIndex:0};
        const ep={id:`${e.id}:0`,unit:e,action:{...getEnemyAction(e),power:5},target:a};
        getBattleSchedule=()=>({events:[{plans:[ap,ep]}],plans:[ap,ep],ranks:new Map()});
        rollWaveValue=()=>0;window.battlePlaybackTimingScale=1;
        renderBattleDummy();window.visualPlayback=resolveBattleTurn();
      });
      await page.locator('.playback-action-break').waitFor({state:'attached'});
      await page.waitForTimeout(150);
      await page.screenshot({path:path.resolve(__dirname,`action-break-${width}.png`)});
      await page.locator('.playback-keyword').first().waitFor({state:'attached'});
      await page.waitForTimeout(100);
      await page.screenshot({path:path.resolve(__dirname,`keyword-grant-${width}.png`)});
      await page.evaluate(()=>window.visualPlayback);
      await page.close();
    }
  } finally { await browser.close(); }
})().catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exitCode=1;});
````

````cjs
   syncBattleReservation(u); renderBattleDummy();
  });
  const slot=(unit,index)=>page.locator(`[data-slot-unit="${unit}"][data-action-slot="${index}"]`);
  await slot('sosuh',0).click();
  assert.equal(await page.evaluate(()=>getBattleActionComparison().left.action.name),await page.evaluate(()=>battleDummy.allies[0].skills[0].name));
  assert.equal(await page.locator('.unit-info-backdrop').count(),0);
  await slot('sosuh',1).click();
  assert.equal(await page.evaluate(()=>getBattleActionComparison().left.action.name),await page.evaluate(()=>battleDummy.allies[0].skills[1].name));
  await page.locator('[data-skill-index="2"]').dispatchEvent('pointerdown',{button:0,clientX:300,clientY:800});
  await page.evaluate(()=>assignBattleTarget(battleDummy.enemies[0].id));
  assert.deepEqual(await page.evaluate(()=>battleDummy.allies[0].queuedActions.map(p=>p.handIndex)),[0,2]);
  await slot('sosuh',0).click();
  await page.locator('[data-skill-index="0"]').dispatchEvent('pointerdown',{button:0,clientX:300,clientY:800});
  await page.evaluate(()=>assignBattleTarget(battleDummy.enemies[1].id));
  assert.equal(await page.evaluate(()=>battleDummy.allies[0].queuedActions[0].targetId===battleDummy.enemies[1].id),true);
  await page.evaluate(()=>cancelBattleSelection());
  const enemyId=await page.evaluate(()=>battleDummy.enemies[0].id);
  await slot(enemyId,0).click();
  assert.equal(await page.locator('.battle-card-detail-right').count(),1);
  const checkArrowSlots = () => page.evaluate(() => {
   updateBattleArrowPositions();
   const frame=document.querySelector('#battle-arrow-overlay').getBoundingClientRect();
   return [...document.querySelectorAll('.action-arc')].every(arc=>{
    const [unit,index]=arc.dataset.fromSlot.split(':');
    const slot=document.querySelector(`[data-slot-unit="${unit}"][data-action-slot="${index}"]`);
    if(!slot)return false;
    const rect=slot.getBoundingClientRect();
    const start=arc.getAttribute('d').match(/^M ([\d.-]+) ([\d.-]+)/);
    return Math.abs(Number(start[1])-(rect.left+rect.width/2-frame.left)/frame.width*8)<.002
     && Math.abs(Number(start[2])-(rect.top+rect.height/2-frame.top)/frame.height*5)<.002;
   });
  });
  assert.ok(await checkArrowSlots());
  await page.evaluate(()=>{
   const u=battleDummy.allies[0],e=battleDummy.enemies[0];
   e.actionsPerTurn=2;
   e.preparedAction={...u.skills[0],range:'전체',scope:'적 전체'};e.targetId=u.id;
   u.queuedActions=[{action:u.skills[0],source:'hand',handIndex:0,targetId:e.id,targetSlot:1,decisionOrder:200}];
   syncBattleReservation(u);renderBattleDummy();
  });
  const pair=await page.evaluate(()=>getBattleSchedule().events.find(e=>e.plans.some(p=>p.id==='sosuh:0')).plans.map(p=>p.id));
  assert.ok(pair.includes(`${enemyId}:1`));
  assert.ok(await checkArrowSlots());
  await page.evaluate(()=>{const u=battleDummy.allies[0];u.queuedActions=[];syncBattleReservation(u);battleDummy.selectedActionSlot=null;battleDummy.selected=u.id;renderBattleDummy();});
  await page.locator('[data-skill-index="0"]').dispatchEvent('pointerdown',{button:0,clientX:300,clientY:800});
  await slot('sosuh',0).click();
  assert.ok(await checkArrowSlots());
  assert.equal(await page.evaluate(()=>battleDummy.aiming?.unitId),'sosuh');
  await page.evaluate(()=>assignBattleTarget(battleDummy.enemies[0].id));
  const from=await slot('sosuh',0).boundingBox();
  const to=await page.locator(`[data-battle-target="${enemyId}"]`).boundingBox();
  await page.mouse.move(from.x+from.width/2,from.y+from.height/2);
  await page.mouse.down();
  await page.mouse.move(to.x+to.width/2,to.y+to.height/2,{steps:12});
  await page.mouse.up();
  assert.equal(await page.evaluate(()=>battleDummy.aiming),null);
  assert.equal(await page.evaluate(()=>battleDummy.allies[0].queuedActions.length),1);
  await slot('sosuh',1).click();
  const card=await page.locator('[data-skill-index="1"]').boundingBox();

  assert.equal(await page.evaluate(()=>battleDummy.aiming?.unitId),'sosuh');
  await page.evaluate(()=>assignBattleTarget(battleDummy.enemies[0].id));
  assert.deepEqual(await page.evaluate(()=>battleDummy.allies[0].queuedActions.map(p=>p.handIndex)),[0,1]);
  await page.evaluate(()=>{
   const u=battleDummy.allies[0],e=battleDummy.enemies[0];
   e.x=u.x+1; e.y=u.y; e.preparedAction={...u.skills[0],range:'전체',scope:'적 전체'};e.targetId=u.id;
   u.queuedActions[1].targetId=e.id;u.queuedActions[1].decisionOrder=100;
   renderBattleDummy();
  });
  await slot('sosuh',1).click();
  assert.equal(await page.evaluate(()=>getBattleActionComparison().clash),true);
  assert.equal(await page.locator('.battle-card-detail-left').count(),1);
  assert.equal(await page.locator('.battle-card-detail-right').count(),1);
  await page.screenshot({path:path.join(__dirname,'action-slots-desktop.png')});
  await page.setViewportSize({width:844,height:390});
  await slot('sosuh',0).click();
  await page.screenshot({path:path.join(__dirname,'action-slots-mobile.png')});
  assert.deepEqual(errors,[]);
  console.log('PASS slot-specific card display, replacement, retargeting, enemy inspection, card-to-slot click and slot drag.');
 } finally {await browser.close();}
})().catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exitCode=1;});
````

````cjs
const fs = require("node:fs");
const path = require("node:path");
const vm = require("node:vm");
const assert = require("node:assert/strict");

const source = fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname, "../app.js"), "utf8");
const cutoff = source.indexOf("renderChapters();", source.lastIndexOf("function renderSquad"));
run("evade compares rolled action power, not sequence ratios or critical damage", `
  const attacker=battleDummy.enemies[0],target=battleDummy.allies[0];
  battleDummy.allies=[target];battleDummy.enemies=[attacker];battleDummy.bench=[];
  attacker.x=4;attacker.y=2;target.x=3;target.y=2;
  attacker.buffs=[];attacker.debuffs=[];target.buffs=[];target.debuffs=[];
  rollWaveValue=()=>0;
  const guard={name:'회피 검증',type:'회피',power:8,wave:0,hits:0,range:0,scope:'자신',effect:''};
  const arm=()=>{target.hp=target.maxHp=200;target.guardReady=true;target.activeGuard={...guard};target.defenseWaveRoll=null;};
  const action={name:'비율 검증',type:'타격',scope:'단일',range:1,power:20,wave:0,hits:2,effect:'',
    sequence:[{ratio:.25,effect:''},{ratio:.5,effect:''}]};
  battleExecution={turn:1,order:1,status:'running',steps:[]};
  arm();resolveSequenceAction(attacker,action,target);
  assert.equal(target.hp,185);
  assert.equal(target.guardReady,false);
  const failed=battleExecution.steps.find(s=>s.type==='defense-roll');
  assert.equal(failed.incomingPower,20);assert.equal(failed.success,false);
  arm();attacker.criticalReady=true;
  resolveSequenceAction(attacker,{...action,power:6,sequence:[{ratio:1,effect:''}]},target);
  assert.equal(target.hp,200);assert.equal(target.lastHitEvaded,true);
  arm();attacker.criticalReady=true;
  resolveRemainingHits(attacker,{name:'legacy 검증',type:'타격',scope:'단일',range:1,power:6,wave:0,hits:1,effect:''},target,1);
  assert.equal(target.hp,200);assert.equal(target.lastHitEvaded,true);
  arm();applyBattleDamage(attacker,target,5,{statusDamage:true,attackPower:20});
  assert.equal(target.hp,195);assert.equal(target.guardReady,true);
  battleExecution=null;
`);
run("whole-area, self-centered and friendly support actions execute against the correct team", `
  const a=battleDummy.allies[0],friend=battleDummy.allies[1],e=battleDummy.enemies[0];
  a.x=1;a.y=1;friend.x=8;friend.y=5;
  const whole={name:'전체 공격',type:'타격',scope:'전 구역',range:'전장',hits:1,power:8,wave:0,effect:''};
  assert.equal(getActionTargets(a,whole,e).length,3);
  assert.ok(isBattleTargetInRange(a,whole,e));assert.ok(!isBattleTargetInRange(a,whole,friend));
  const center={...whole,scope:'자신 중심 십자',range:1};
  assert.ok(isBattleTargetInRange(a,center,a));
  e.x=2;e.y=1;assert.ok(getActionTargets(a,center,a).includes(e));
  const support={...whole,type:'지원',scope:'아군 전체',effect:'[격려 4 / 1]'};
  battleExecution={turn:1,order:1,status:'running',steps:[]};
  resolveUnitAction(a,{id:a.id+':0',action:support,target:friend});
  assert.ok(battleDummy.allies.every(unit=>unit.sp===54));
  assert.ok(battleDummy.enemies.every(unit=>!getBattleStatus(unit,'격려')));
  assert.ok(battleExecution.steps.some(s=>s.type==='support-start'));
  assert.ok(battleExecution.steps.some(s=>s.type==='support-roll'));
  assert.equal(battleExecution.steps.find(s=>s.type==='support-applied').targetIds.length,4);
  assert.ok(!battleExecution.steps.some(s=>s.type==='damage-applied'));
  battleExecution=null;
`);
run("global actions recover a missing primary and support per-hit effects do not multiply whole-team applications", `
  const a=battleDummy.allies[0],e=battleDummy.enemies[0];
  const whole={name:'전장 공격',type:'타격',scope:'적 전체',range:'전장',hits:1,power:8,wave:0,effect:''};
  e.hp=0;const before=battleDummy.enemies[1].hp;
  resolveUnitAction(a,{action:whole,target:e});assert.equal(battleDummy.enemies[1].hp,before-8);
  const support={...whole,type:'지원',scope:'아군 전체',hits:2,effect:'아군 전체 [보호 2 / 1]'};
  resolveUnitAction(a,{action:support,target:a});
  assert.ok(battleDummy.allies.every(unit=>getBattleStatus(unit,'보호').count===2));
  const typed={...support,scope:'단일',range:2};
  assert.ok(!isBattleTargetInRange(a,typed,battleDummy.enemies[1]));
`);
run("turn execution records clash rounds, destroyed hits, cancellation and surviving attacks", `
  const a=battleDummy.allies[0], b=battleDummy.enemies[0];
  battleDummy.allies=[a]; battleDummy.enemies=[b]; battleDummy.bench=[];
  a.x=3; a.y=2; b.x=4; b.y=2; b.hp=b.maxHp=200;
  const attack={name:'테스트 공격',type:'타격',scope:'단일',range:1,power:10,wave:1,hits:2,effect:''};
  const defense={...attack,name:'테스트 적 공격',power:5};
  a.queuedActions=[{action:attack,targetId:b.id,decisionOrder:99}];
  b.preparedAction=defense; b.targetId=a.id;
  rollWaveValue=()=>0;
  resolveBattleTurn();
  const execution=getLastBattleExecution();
  assert.equal(execution.status,'completed'); assert.equal(execution.turn,1);
  const steps=execution.steps;
  assert.deepEqual(steps.filter(s=>s.type==='hit-destroyed').map(s=>s.hit),[2,1]);
  const rounds=steps.filter(s=>s.type==='clash-roll');
  assert.equal(rounds.length,2);
  assert.equal(rounds[0].attackerRoll.waves.length,2);
  assert.ok(rounds[1].attackerRoll.waves.length===1||rounds[1].defenderRoll.waves.length===1);
  assert.equal(steps.filter(s=>s.type==='action-canceled')[0].planId,b.id+':0');
  assert.equal(steps.filter(s=>s.type==='attack-roll').length,2);
  assert.equal(steps.filter(s=>s.type==='damage-applied').reduce((sum,s)=>sum+s.damage,0),20);
  assert.ok(steps.findIndex(s=>s.type==='action-canceled')<steps.findIndex(s=>s.type==='attack-start'));
  assert.equal(steps[0].type,'turn-start'); assert.equal(steps.at(-1).type,'turn-complete');
  assert.ok(steps.every((s,index)=>s.sequence===index+1));
  assert.equal(steps[0].units.find(u=>u.id===b.id).hp,200);
  execution.steps[0].units[0].hp=-1;
  assert.notEqual(getLastBattleExecution().steps[0].units[0].hp,-1);
  assert.equal(battleExecution,null);
`);
run("ties reroll without destroying hits and surviving hit damage starts a fresh waveform chain", `
  const a=battleDummy.allies[0], b=battleDummy.enemies[0];
  const skill={name:'공방',type:'타격',scope:'단일',range:1,power:10,wave:1,hits:1,effect:''};
  battleExecution={turn:1,order:1,status:'running',steps:[]};
  const waves=[0,0,3,-3,2]; rollWaveValue=()=>waves.shift()??0;
  const result=resolveClash(a,skill,b,skill);
  assert.equal(result.attackerHits,1); assert.equal(result.defenderHits,0);
  assert.equal(battleExecution.steps.filter(s=>s.type==='clash-compare').length,2);
  assert.equal(battleExecution.steps.filter(s=>s.type==='hit-destroyed').length,1);
  b.hp=100; resolveRemainingHits(a,skill,b,1);
  assert.equal(battleExecution.steps.find(s=>s.type==='attack-roll').roll.total,12);
  battleExecution=null;
`);
run("enemies remain in their rear column during first-turn preparation", `
  resetBattleDummy();
  assert.ok(battleDummy.enemies.every(unit=>unit.x===8&&unit.startX===8));
  assert.equal(new Set(battleDummy.enemies.map(unit=>unit.x+':'+unit.y)).size,3);
  assert.ok(battleDummy.enemies.every(unit=>unit.preparedAction));
  battleDummy.turn=2;

  assert.ok(battleDummy.enemies.some(unit=>unit.x<8));
`);
run("swap card is visible only in rear column and ally slots show scheduled rank", `
  const unit=battleDummy.allies[0];
  unit.x=2; assert.equal(renderBattleSwapCard(unit),'');
  unit.x=1; assert.ok(renderBattleSwapCard(unit).includes('data-skill-index="swap"'));
  unit.actionCapacity=2;
  let markup=renderBattleToken(unit,'ally');
  assert.ok(markup.includes('ally-action-badge'));
  assert.equal((markup.match(/class="action-slot"/g)||[]).length,2);
  unit.queuedActions=[{action:unit.skills[0],targetId:battleDummy.enemies[0].id,decisionOrder:1}];
  markup=renderBattleToken(unit,'ally');

  assert.ok(markup.includes('<strong>'+rank+'</strong>'));
`);
run("power preview shares modifiers and handles negative waves", `
  const unit = battleDummy.allies[0];
  const action = {...unit.skills[0], hits:1, power:10, wave:-2, effect:'[충돌 시] 기본 위력 +1'};
  addBattleStatus(unit, '충격', 2, 1);
  assert.equal(getPowerBounds(unit,action).min,2);

run("clash forecast considers mental state, hit counts and ties", `

  a.sp=b.sp=50;
  assert.ok(Math.abs(getClashForecast(ap,bp).probability-.5)<1e-10);
  a.sp=100; b.sp=0; assert.ok(getClashForecast(ap,bp).probability>.5);

  e.preparedAction=getEnemyAction(e); e.targetId=a.id;

function run(name, test) {
  const context = vm.createContext({ window: {}, document: { querySelectorAll: () => [] }, console, assert });
  vm.runInContext(fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname,'../battle-tutorial.js'),'utf8'),context);
  vm.runInContext(source.slice(0, cutoff), context);
  vm.runInContext("renderBattleDummy = () => {}; ensureBattleState(); resetBattleDummy();", context);
  vm.runInContext(test, context);
  console.log(`PASS ${name}`);
}

run('parry cancels the loser then executes the winner with the same wave', `
  const a=battleDummy.allies[0],e=battleDummy.enemies[0];a.x=3;a.y=2;e.x=4;e.y=2;
  const ah=a.hp,eh=e.hp;let draws=0;rollWaveValue=()=>{draws++;return 0};
  const action={...a.skills[0],power:30};
  battleExecution={turn:1,order:1,steps:[]};
  const ap={id:'a',unit:a,action,target:e},ep={id:'b',unit:e,action:{...getEnemyAction(e),power:10},target:a};
  resolveBattleClashEvent(ap,ep);assert.equal(ep.canceled,true);
  assert.equal(draws,2);assert.equal(a.hp,ah);assert.ok(e.hp<eh);
  assert.equal(battleExecution.steps.filter(s=>s.type==='clash-roll').length,1);
  assert.ok(!battleExecution.steps.some(s=>s.type==='hit-destroyed'));
  const types=battleExecution.steps.map(s=>s.type);
  assert.ok(types.indexOf('action-canceled')<types.indexOf('clash-followup'));
  assert.ok(types.indexOf('clash-followup')<types.indexOf('attack-start'));
  assert.equal(battleExecution.steps.find(s=>s.type==='attack-roll').reused,true);
  assert.ok(battleExecution.steps.some(s=>s.type==='status-added'));
`);

run("late defensive slots react to earlier attacks and never rearm at their scheduled order", `
 for(const type of ['회피','방어','반격','실패회피']){
  const a=battleDummy.allies[0],e=battleDummy.enemies[0];
  battleDummy.allies=[a];battleDummy.enemies=[e];battleDummy.bench=[];
  a.hp=a.maxHp=100;e.hp=e.maxHp=100;a.x=3;a.y=2;e.x=4;e.y=2;
  a.guardReady=false;a.activeGuard=null;a.buffs=[];a.debuffs=[];e.buffs=[];e.debuffs=[];
  const guard={name:'guard',type:type==='실패회피'?'회피':type,range:1,scope:type==='반격'?'단일':'자신',hits:type==='반격'?1:0,power:type==='실패회피'?2:8,wave:0,effect:''};
  a.guard=guard;
  const attack={name:'attack',type:'타격',range:1,scope:'단일',hits:3,power:4,wave:0,effect:''};
  const plans=[{id:'early',unit:e,action:attack,target:a},{id:'pause',unit:e,action:{name:'wait',type:'지원',scope:'자신',range:0,hits:0,power:0,wave:0,effect:''},target:e},
   {id:'late-guard',unit:a,action:guard,target:a},{id:'after',unit:e,action:{...attack,hits:1},target:a}];
  getBattleSchedule=()=>({events:plans.map(plan=>({plans:[plan]})),plans,ranks:new Map()});

  const steps=getLastBattleExecution().steps;

  assert.equal(steps.find(s=>s.type==='defense-ready').respondingToId,e.id);
  assert.equal(steps.filter(s=>s.type==='action-used'&&s.planId==='late-guard').length,1);
  if(type==='반격'){assert.equal(a.hp,84);assert.equal(e.hp,92);assert.equal(steps.filter(s=>s.type==='counter-start').length,1);}
  else if(type==='실패회피'){assert.equal(a.hp,84);assert.equal(steps.filter(s=>s.type==='defense-roll').length,1);}
  else {assert.equal(a.hp,100);assert.equal(steps.filter(s=>s.type==='defense-roll').length,4);}
 }
`);

run("waves accumulate per hit in display, damage and remaining-hit clashes", `

  assert.equal(getPowerBounds(unit,skill,{hit:2}).max,10);
  assert.equal(getDirectDamageBounds(unit,skill,target).max,17);
  rollWaveValue = () => 3;
  assert.equal(rollHitPower(unit,skill,{clash:true,remainingHits:2}).total,10);
  assert.equal(rollHitPower(unit,skill,{clash:true,remainingHits:1}).total,7);
  let hp=target.hp; resolveRemainingHits(unit,skill,target,2);
  assert.equal(target.hp,hp-17);
  let sequence=[3,-3]; rollWaveValue=()=>sequence.shift();
  hp=target.hp; resolveRemainingHits(unit,skill,target,2); assert.equal(target.hp,hp-11);
  sequence=[-3,-3]; rollWaveValue=()=>sequence.shift();
  hp=target.hp; resolveRemainingHits(unit,{...skill,power:8},target,2); assert.equal(target.hp,hp-7);
  sequence=[3,3]; rollWaveValue=()=>sequence.shift();

  assert.equal(rollHitPower(unit,{...skill,power:10,wave:-1},{hit:2,previousWaveSum:first.waveSum}).total,4);
`);

run("defenses persist on incoming hits and counters respond only once", `
  const enemy = battleDummy.enemies[0], dodger = battleDummy.allies[2], counter = battleDummy.allies[0];
  rollWaveValue = () => 0;
  dodger.reserved = dodger.guard; resolveUnitAction(dodger);
  const hp = dodger.hp, sp = enemy.sp;
  for (let i=0;i<3;i++) assert.equal(applyBattleDamage(enemy,dodger,2),0);
  assert.equal(dodger.hp,hp); assert.equal(enemy.sp,sp); assert.equal(dodger.guardReady,true);
  applyBattleDamage(enemy,dodger,99);
  assert.equal(dodger.guardReady,false); assert.equal(dodger.activeGuard,null);
  const blocker = battleDummy.allies[1]; blocker.reserved=blocker.guard; resolveUnitAction(blocker);
  const blockHp=blocker.hp;
  applyBattleDamage(enemy,blocker,2); applyBattleDamage(enemy,blocker,2);
  assert.equal(blocker.hp,blockHp); assert.equal(blocker.guardReady,true);
  enemy.x=counter.x+1; enemy.y=counter.y; enemy.hp=enemy.maxHp=1000;
  counter.reserved=counter.guard; resolveUnitAction(counter);
  applyBattleDamage(enemy,counter,1);
  const afterCounter=enemy.hp;
  assert.ok(afterCounter<1000); assert.equal(counter.activeGuard,null);
  applyBattleDamage(enemy,counter,1);
  assert.equal(enemy.hp,afterCounter); assert.equal(counter.guardReady,false);
`);

  const original=a.queuedActions[0];

  assert.equal(a.queuedActions.length,1); assert.equal(a.queuedActions[0],original);
  cancelBattleSelection(); assert.equal(a.reserved,original.action);
  reserveBattleSkill('1'); assignBattleTarget(e.id);
  assert.equal(a.queuedActions.length,2);
  reserveBattleSkill('2'); assert.equal(a.queuedActions.length,2); assert.equal(battleDummy.aiming,null);
  reserveBattleSkill('0'); assert.equal(a.queuedActions.length,1); assert.equal(a.queuedActions[0].handIndex,1);
`);

run("multiple actions execute and consume their own hand indexes", `
  const a=battleDummy.allies[0],e=battleDummy.enemies[0];
  a.actionCapacity=2;a.hand=[0,1,2,3];a.x=3;a.y=3;e.x=4;e.y=3;e.hp=e.maxHp=200;
  battleDummy.enemies.slice(1).forEach(unit=>unit.hp=0);
  e.preparedAction={...getEnemyAction(e),range:0};
  reserveBattleSkill('0');assignBattleTarget(e.id);reserveBattleSkill('1');assignBattleTarget(e.id);
  const schedule=getBattleSchedule(); assert.equal(schedule.plans.filter(plan=>plan.unit===a).length,2);
  rollWaveValue=()=>0; resolveBattleTurn();
  assert.equal(e.hp,163); assert.deepEqual(a.discardPile,[1,0]);
  assert.equal(a.hand[0],2);assert.equal(a.hand[1],3);assert.equal(a.queuedActions.length,0);
`);

run("death reinforcement follows queue, same row and rear-column occupancy", `
  showBattleDummy=()=>{};startBattleLineup(createBattleRoster().map(unit=>unit.id));
  const dead=battleDummy.allies[0], next=battleDummy.bench[0];dead.hp=0;
  const blocker=battleDummy.allies[1];blocker.x=1;blocker.y=dead.y;
  processBattleReplacements(true);assert.ok(battleDummy.allies.includes(dead));
  blocker.y=5;processBattleReplacements(true);
  assert.equal(battleDummy.allies[0],next);assert.equal(next.x,1);assert.equal(next.y,dead.y);
  assert.equal(battleDummy.bench.length,4);assert.equal(next.formationOrder,1);
`);

run("swap clears actions, locks actions and movement, cancels, preserves health on return", `
  showBattleDummy=()=>{};startBattleLineup(createBattleRoster().map(unit=>unit.id));
  const a=battleDummy.allies[0],other=battleDummy.allies[1],next=battleDummy.bench[0];
  a.x=1;a.y=1;other.x=1;other.y=2;battleDummy.selected=a.id;
  reserveBattleSkill('guard');assert.equal(a.queuedActions.length,1);
  a.hp=40; assert.equal(reserveBattleSwap(a.id,next.id),true);
  assert.equal(a.queuedActions.length,0);assert.equal(a.reserved,null);
  reserveBattleSkill('0');assert.equal(a.reserved,null);assert.equal(battleDummy.aiming,null);
  assert.equal(canMoveSelectedUnitTo(2,1),false);
  assert.equal(reserveBattleSwap(other.id,next.id),false);
  toggleBattleSwap(a);assert.equal(a.swapTargetId,null);reserveBattleSkill('guard');assert.equal(a.queuedActions.length,1);
  reserveBattleSwap(a.id,next.id);processBattleReplacements(true);assert.ok(battleDummy.allies.includes(a));
  processBattleReplacements();assert.equal(battleDummy.allies[0],next);assert.equal(next.x,1);assert.equal(next.y,1);
  assert.equal(battleDummy.bench.at(-1),a);assert.equal(a.hp,40);assert.equal(a.swapTargetId,null);
`);

run("one lost clash cancels only its own action slot", `
  const a=battleDummy.allies[0],e=battleDummy.enemies[0];a.x=3;a.y=3;e.x=4;e.y=3;
  const ap={unit:a,action:{...a.skills[0],sequence:undefined},target:e,handIndex:0}, ep={unit:e,action:{...getEnemyAction(e),sequence:undefined},target:a};
  resolveClash=()=>({attackerHits:0,defenderHits:1});rollWaveValue=()=>0;
  resolveBattleClashEvent(ap,ep);
  assert.equal(ap.canceled,true);assert.equal(a.actionCanceled,false);
  const before=e.hp;
  resolveUnitAction(a,{unit:a,action:{...a.skills[1],effect:''},target:e,handIndex:1});
  assert.ok(e.hp<before);
`);
````

````cjs
const path = require('node:path');

(async () => {

      await page.locator('button[data-camera-mode="rotate"]').click();

      const state = await page.evaluate(() => ({rotation:battleDummy.rotation,tilt:battleDummy.tilt,x:battleDummy.cameraX,y:battleDummy.cameraY}));
      assert.ok(Math.abs(state.rotation-13.2)<.001);

      await page.locator('#battle-camera-reset').click();
````

````cjs
const fs=require('node:fs');
const path=require('node:path');
const vm=require('node:vm');
const assert=require('node:assert/strict');
const root=path.resolve(__dirname,'..');
const context={window:{}};
vm.runInNewContext(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,'story-ch1-stage1-data.js'),'utf8'),context);
const stage1=context.window.chapter1Stage1Scenes,stage2=context.window.chapter1Stage2Scenes;
const scenes=[...stage1,...stage2];
assert.ok(stage1.every(s=>s.sourceParagraph<81));
assert.equal(stage2[0].sourceParagraph,81);
assert.equal(stage2.filter(s=>s.kind==='battle').length,1);
assert.ok(stage2.findIndex(s=>s.kind==='battle')<stage2.findIndex(s=>s.sourceParagraph===169));
const source=fs.readFileSync(path.resolve(root,'../이루다 2획 - 헌신을 이루다.md'),'utf8').split(/\n\s*-----/)[0];
const paragraphs=source.split(/\r?\n\s*\r?\n/).map(p=>p.replace(/&#x20;/g,'').trim()).filter(Boolean);
const norm=s=>s.replace(/\s+/g,'');
paragraphs.forEach((p,i)=>assert.equal(norm(scenes.filter(s=>s.sourceParagraph===i).map(s=>s.line).join('')),norm(p)));
for(const scene of scenes){
 assert.ok(fs.existsSync(path.join(root,scene.background)),scene.background);
 for(const sprite of scene.characters) assert.ok(fs.existsSync(path.join(root,sprite.src)),sprite.src);
 if(scene.sourceParagraph>=134) assert.ok(!scene.characters.some(s=>s.alt==='이루어도'));
 if(scene.kind==='dialogue' && !scene.cinematic && ![83,85].includes(scene.sourceParagraph)){
  assert.deepEqual(Array.from(scene.characters.filter(s=>s.active),s=>s.alt),[scene.speakerId]);
 }
 if(scene.kind==='narration') assert.equal(scene.characters.filter(s=>s.active).length,0);
}
for(const p of [83,85,87]) assert.equal(scenes.find(s=>s.sourceParagraph===p&&s.kind==='dialogue').name,'???');
assert.equal(scenes.find(s=>s.sourceParagraph===89&&s.kind==='dialogue').name,'제이크 설리번');
console.log(`PASS chapter 1 preserves ${paragraphs.length} paragraphs, speaker reveals, assets and mind-world restrictions`);
````

````cjs
const path = require('node:path');
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const { pathToFileURL } = require('node:url');
const { chromium } = require('C:/Users/user/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/node/node_modules/playwright');

(async () => {
  const browser = await chromium.launch({ headless: true, channel: 'msedge' });
  try {
    const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 900 } });
    const errors = [];
    page.on('pageerror', error => errors.push(error.message));
    await page.goto(pathToFileURL(path.resolve(__dirname, '../index.html')).href);
    for (const viewport of [{ width: 1440, height: 900 }, { width: 844, height: 390 }]) {
      await page.setViewportSize(viewport);
      await page.evaluate(() => {
        document.querySelectorAll('.view').forEach(v => v.classList.toggle('active', v.id === 'story-view'));
        startBattleLineup(['sosuh', 'eodo', 'ryeona', 'getne', 'eojil', 'eojyeo', 'eora', 'gena', 'dorok']);
      });
      const tile = page.locator('[data-cell-x="5"][data-cell-y="3"]');
      const before = await tile.boundingBox();
      const anchor = { x: before.x + before.width / 2, y: before.y + before.height / 2 };
      await page.mouse.move(anchor.x, anchor.y);
      for (const deltaY of [-100, -100, 100, 100]) {
        await page.mouse.wheel(0, deltaY);
        await page.waitForTimeout(60);
        const after = await tile.boundingBox();
        assert.ok(Math.abs(after.x + after.width / 2 - anchor.x) < 1);
        assert.ok(Math.abs(after.y + after.height / 2 - anchor.y) < 1);
      }
      await page.evaluate(() => { battleDummy.rotation = -30; renderBattleDummy(); });
      const rotated = await tile.boundingBox();
      const otherAnchor = { x: rotated.x + rotated.width / 2, y: rotated.y + rotated.height / 2 };
      await page.mouse.move(otherAnchor.x, otherAnchor.y);
      await page.mouse.wheel(0, -100);
      await page.waitForTimeout(70);
      const after = await tile.boundingBox();
      assert.ok(Math.abs(after.x + after.width / 2 - otherAnchor.x) < 1);
      assert.ok(Math.abs(after.y + after.height / 2 - otherAnchor.y) < 1);
      const saved = await page.evaluate(() => ({ x: battleDummy.cameraX, y: battleDummy.cameraY, zoom: battleDummy.zoom, transform: document.querySelector('#battle-camera').style.transform }));
      await page.evaluate(() => { battleDummy.inspectedUnitId = battleDummy.allies[0].id; renderBattleDummy(); });
      await page.locator('[data-close-unit-info]').click();
      assert.deepEqual(await page.evaluate(() => ({ x: battleDummy.cameraX, y: battleDummy.cameraY, zoom: battleDummy.zoom, transform: document.querySelector('#battle-camera').style.transform })), saved);
      for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) await page.mouse.wheel(0, -100);
      await page.waitForTimeout(100);
      assert.ok(await page.evaluate(() => battleDummy.zoom <= 1.38));
      await page.screenshot({ path: path.join(__dirname, `cursor-zoom-${viewport.width}.png`) });
    }
    assert.deepEqual(errors, []);
    console.log('PASS cursor stays on the same map point during zoom in/out and rotation; inspection restores view; zoom limits; desktop/mobile.');
  } finally { await browser.close(); }
})().catch(error => { console.error(error); process.exitCode = 1; });
````

````cjs
const path = require('node:path');
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const {pathToFileURL} = require('node:url');
const {chromium} = require('C:/Users/user/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/node/node_modules/playwright');
(async () => {
  const browser = await chromium.launch({headless:true,channel:'msedge'});
  try {
    for (const width of [1440,844]) for (const type of ['회피','반격','방어']) {
      const page = await browser.newPage({viewport:{width,height:width===1440?900:390}});
      const errors=[]; page.on('pageerror',e=>errors.push(e.message));
      await page.goto(pathToFileURL(path.resolve(__dirname,'../index.html')).href);
      await page.evaluate(type => {
        document.querySelectorAll('.view').forEach(v=>v.classList.toggle('active',v.id==='story-view'));
        const roster=createBattleRoster(); startBattleLineup(roster.map(u=>u.id));
        const a=roster[0],e=battleDummy.enemies[0];
        battleDummy.allies=[a]; battleDummy.enemies=[e]; battleDummy.bench=[];
        a.x=3;a.y=3;e.x=4;e.y=3;a.hp=a.maxHp=100;e.hp=e.maxHp=100;
        a.buffs=[];a.debuffs=[];e.buffs=[];e.debuffs=[];
        const guard={name:'대응 검증',type,scope:type==='반격'?'단일':'자신',range:1,hits:type==='반격'?1:0,power:8,wave:0,effect:''};
        a.guard=guard;
        const attack={name:'연속 공격 검증',type:'타격',scope:'단일',range:1,hits:3,power:4,wave:0,effect:''};
        const plans=[{id:e.id+':0',unit:e,action:attack,target:a,slot:0},
          {id:'wait',unit:e,action:{name:'wait',type:'지원',scope:'자신',range:0,hits:0,power:0,wave:0,effect:''},target:e,slot:1},
          {id:a.id+':0',unit:a,action:guard,target:a,slot:0}];
        getBattleSchedule=()=>({events:plans.map(plan=>({plans:[plan]})),plans,ranks:new Map()});
        rollWaveValue=()=>0; window.battlePlaybackTimingScale=.2;renderBattleDummy();
        window.firstAttackFrames=[];
        new MutationObserver(records=>records.forEach(record=>{
          if(record.attributeName!=='data-step')return;
          const overlay=record.target;
          if(overlay.querySelector('.playback-order')?.textContent!=='순서 1')return;
          firstAttackFrames.push({step:overlay.dataset.step,focus:Number(overlay.dataset.focusCount),
            camera:overlay.querySelector('.playback-world').style.transform,
            positions:[...overlay.querySelectorAll('.playback-actor.active')].map(el=>({id:el.dataset.unit,x:el.style.left,y:el.style.top}))});
        })).observe(document.querySelector('#node-stage'),{subtree:true,attributes:true,attributeFilter:['data-step']});
      },type);
      await page.locator('#battle-resolve').click();
      await page.waitForFunction(()=>document.querySelector('.battle-playback')?.dataset.step==='attack-roll');
      assert.equal(await page.locator('.playback-actor[data-unit="eojil"] .playback-action h3').textContent(),'대응 검증');
      assert.ok(await page.locator('.playback-actor.active').evaluateAll(els=>{
        const defender=els.find(el=>el.dataset.unit==='eojil'),attacker=els.find(el=>el.dataset.unit!=='eojil');
        return defender.dataset.positionRole==='anchor'&&attacker.dataset.positionRole==='moving'
          &&Math.abs(parseFloat(defender.style.left)-Number(defender.dataset.originX))<.01
          &&Math.abs(parseFloat(defender.style.top)-Number(defender.dataset.originY))<.01;
      }));
      if(type==='반격') {
        await page.waitForFunction(()=>document.querySelector('.battle-playback')?.dataset.step==='counter-start');
        await page.waitForFunction(()=>document.querySelector('.playback-verdict')?.textContent.includes('1회'));
      } else {
        await page.waitForFunction(()=>document.querySelector('.battle-playback')?.dataset.step==='defense-roll');
        await page.waitForFunction(()=>document.querySelector('.playback-verdict')?.textContent.includes('회피 성공') || document.querySelector('.playback-verdict')?.textContent.includes('피해 4 감소'));
        assert.ok(await page.locator('.playback-actor.active').count()===2);
      }
      await page.screenshot({path:path.join(__dirname,`defense-${type}-${width}.png`)});
      await page.waitForFunction(()=>!battlePresentationActive,{},{timeout:30000});
      const result=await page.evaluate(()=>({hp:battleDummy.allies[0].hp,enemyHp:battleDummy.enemies[0].hp,steps:getLastBattleExecution().steps,frames:firstAttackFrames}));
      const firstRoll=result.frames.find(f=>f.step==='attack-roll');
      for(const frame of result.frames.filter(f=>['defense-ready','defense-roll','hit-evaded','counter-start','damage-applied'].includes(f.step))){
        assert.equal(frame.focus,1,'Unexpected repeat approach at '+frame.step);
        assert.deepEqual(frame.positions,firstRoll.positions,'Participants moved during '+frame.step);
        assert.equal(frame.camera,firstRoll.camera,'Camera restarted during '+frame.step);
      }
      assert.equal(result.steps.filter(s=>s.type==='defense-ready').length,1);
      assert.equal(result.steps.find(s=>s.type==='defense-ready').order,1);
      if(type==='반격') {
        assert.equal(result.hp,88);assert.equal(result.enemyHp,92);
        assert.equal(result.steps.filter(s=>s.type==='counter-start').length,1);
      } else {
        assert.equal(result.hp,100);
        assert.equal(result.steps.filter(s=>s.type==='defense-roll').length,3);
        if(type==='회피') assert.equal(result.steps.filter(s=>s.type==='hit-evaded').length,3);
        const firstDefense=result.steps.findIndex(s=>s.type==='defense-roll');
        const firstContact=result.steps.findIndex(s=>s.type===(type==='회피'?'hit-evaded':'damage-applied'));
        assert.ok(firstDefense>=0&&firstDefense<firstContact,'First hit must be defended before contact');
      }
      assert.deepEqual(errors,[]);await page.close();
    }
    console.log('PASS persistent dodge/block, single counter, reaction playback and desktop/mobile.');
  } finally {await browser.close();}
})().catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exitCode=1;});
````

````cjs
const path = require('node:path');
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const { pathToFileURL } = require('node:url');
const { chromium } = require('C:/Users/user/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/node/node_modules/playwright');
(async () => {
  const browser = await chromium.launch({ headless:true, channel:'msedge' });
  try {
    for (const [width,height] of [[1440,900],[844,390]]) {
      const page = await browser.newPage({viewport:{width,height}});
      const errors=[];page.on('pageerror',e=>errors.push(e.message));
      await page.goto(pathToFileURL(path.resolve(__dirname,'../index.html')).href);
      await page.evaluate(() => {
        document.querySelectorAll('.view').forEach(v=>v.classList.toggle('active',v.id==='story-view'));
        startBattleLineup(createBattleRoster().map(u=>u.id));
        const [a,b]=battleDummy.allies,[e,f]=battleDummy.enemies;
        a.x=3;a.y=2;e.x=5;e.y=2;b.x=2;b.y=4;f.x=6;f.y=4;
        const action={name:'이동 검증',type:'타격',scope:'단일',range:8,hits:1,power:10,wave:0,effect:'',sequence:[{ratio:1,effect:'',push:1}]};
        const plans=[{id:a.id+':0',unit:a,action,target:e,slot:0},{id:b.id+':0',unit:b,action,target:f,slot:0}];
        getBattleSchedule=()=>({events:plans.map(p=>({plans:[p]})),plans,ranks:new Map()});
        rollWaveValue=()=>0;window.battlePlaybackTimingScale=.4;renderBattleDummy();
        window.backgroundSamples=[];window.displacementErrors=[];window.cameraResets=0;
        const observer=new MutationObserver(records=>{
          const overlay=document.querySelector('.battle-playback');if(!overlay)return;
          const bg=overlay.querySelector('.playback-backdrop'),world=overlay.querySelector('.playback-world');
          if(bg){const r=bg.getBoundingClientRect();backgroundSamples.push([r.x,r.y,r.width,r.height]);}
          if(Number(overlay.dataset.focusCount)>1 && world.style.transform==='none')cameraResets++;
          if(!records.some(r=>r.attributeName==='data-step')||overlay.dataset.step!=='unit-displaced')return;
          const step=getLastBattleExecution().steps.find(s=>s.sequence===Number(overlay.dataset.sequence));
          const actor=overlay.querySelector(`[data-unit="${step.unitId}"]`),unit=step.units.find(u=>u.id===step.unitId);
          const matrix=new DOMMatrix(getComputedStyle(world).transform).inverse();
          const point=(x,y)=>{const r=overlay.querySelector(`[data-cell-x="${x}"][data-cell-y="${y}"]`).getBoundingClientRect();return matrix.transformPoint({x:r.x+r.width/2,y:r.y+r.height/2});};
          const initial=getLastBattleExecution().steps[0].units.find(u=>u.id===unit.id);
          const from=point(initial.x,initial.y),to=point(unit.x,unit.y);
          displacementErrors.push(Math.abs(parseFloat(actor.style.left)-Number(actor.dataset.originX)-(to.x-from.x)),Math.abs(parseFloat(actor.style.top)-Number(actor.dataset.originY)-(to.y-from.y)));
````

````cjs
const path = require('node:path');
````

````cjs
const { pathToFileURL } = require('node:url');
const { chromium } = require('C:/Users/user/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/node/node_modules/playwright');
(async () => {
  const browser = await chromium.launch({ headless: true, channel: 'msedge' });

      const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width, height: width === 1440 ? 900 : 390 } });
      const errors = []; page.on('pageerror', e => errors.push(e.message));
      await page.goto(pathToFileURL(path.resolve(__dirname, '../index.html')).href);
      await page.evaluate(() => {
        document.querySelectorAll('.view').forEach(v => v.classList.toggle('active', v.id === 'story-view'));
        startBattleLineup(createBattleRoster().map(u => u.id));
        const a = battleDummy.allies[0], e = battleDummy.enemies[0];
        a.x = 3; a.y = 2; e.x = 4; e.y = 2;
        battleDummy.selected = a.id;
        battleDummy.previewAction = a.skills[0]; renderBattleDummy();
      });
      assert.equal(await page.locator('.battle-card-detail .hit-badge').count(), 0);
      assert.equal(await page.locator('.battle-card-fan .skill-effects, .battle-card-fan .sequence-description').count(), 0);
      assert.equal(await page.locator('.battle-card-detail .sequence-step').count(), 2);
      assert.ok(await page.locator('.battle-card-fan .compact-card-power').count() >= 5);
      const registration = await page.evaluate(async () => {
        const images = [...document.querySelectorAll('.sd-token > img')];
        await Promise.all(images.map(img=>img.decode()));
        const errors = images.map(img=>{
          const token = img.closest('.battle-token');
          const unit = [...battleDummy.allies,...battleDummy.enemies].find(unit=>unit.id === token.dataset.battleUnit);
          const sprite = battleSpriteAssets[unit.name];
          const cell = document.querySelector(`[data-cell-x="${unit.x}"][data-cell-y="${unit.y}"]`).getBoundingClientRect();
          const box = img.getBoundingClientRect();
          return Math.abs(box.top + box.height * sprite.footPivot[1] / sprite.canvas[1] - cell.top - cell.height / 2);
        });
        return errors;
      });
      assert.ok(registration.every(error=>error<2), `idle foot alignment ${registration}`);
      assert.ok((await page.locator('.sequence-description').first().textContent()).includes('50%'));
      await page.screenshot({ path: path.resolve(__dirname, `sequence-actions-${width}.png`) });
      for (const parry of [false, true]) {
        await page.evaluate(async parry => {
          const a = battleDummy.allies[0], e = battleDummy.enemies[0];
          a.hp = a.maxHp; e.hp = e.maxHp; a.buffs = []; a.debuffs = []; e.buffs = []; e.debuffs = [];
          a.x = 3; a.y = 2; e.x = 4; e.y = 2;
          const ap = { id: `${a.id}:0`, unit: a, action: a.skills[0], target: e, handIndex: 0 };
          const ep = { id: `${e.id}:0`, unit: e, action: { ...getEnemyAction(e), power: 5 }, target: a };
          getBattleSchedule = () => ({ events: [{ plans: parry ? [ap, ep] : [ap] }], plans: parry ? [ap, ep] : [ap], ranks: new Map() });
          rollWaveValue = () => 0; window.battlePlaybackTimingScale = .03;
          renderBattleDummy();
          window.registrationSamples=[];
          window.presentationChecks={broken:false,keyword:false,icons:[],maxScale:0};
          const observer=new MutationObserver(records=>records.forEach(record=>{
            presentationChecks.broken ||= !!document.querySelector('.playback-action-break');
            presentationChecks.keyword ||= !!document.querySelector('.playback-keyword');
            document.querySelectorAll('.playback-keyword img').forEach(img=>{if(!presentationChecks.icons.includes(img.src))presentationChecks.icons.push(img.src);});
            const world=document.querySelector('.playback-world');
            if(world)presentationChecks.maxScale=Math.max(presentationChecks.maxScale,new DOMMatrix(getComputedStyle(world).transform).a);
            if(record.attributeName!=='data-motion')return;
            const actor=record.target,img=actor.querySelector('.playback-sprite');
            if(!img?.classList.contains('registered-sprite'))return;
            const unitName=actor.querySelector('img').alt;
            const pivot=img.classList.contains('motion-sprite') ? battleMotionLibrary[unitName].pivot[1]/battleMotionLibrary[unitName].canvas[1] : battleSpriteAssets[unitName].footPivot[1]/battleSpriteAssets[unitName].canvas[1];
            const box=img.getBoundingClientRect(),body=actor.getBoundingClientRect();
            registrationSamples.push(Math.abs(box.top+box.height*pivot-body.bottom));
          }));
          observer.observe(document.body,{subtree:true,childList:true,attributes:true,attributeFilter:['data-motion','class','style']});
          try{await resolveBattleTurn();}finally{observer.disconnect();}
        }, parry);
        const result = await page.evaluate(() => getLastBattleExecution());
        assert.equal(result.status, 'completed');
        assert.equal(result.steps.filter(s => s.type === (parry ? 'clash-roll' : 'attack-roll')).length, 1);
        if (parry) {
          assert.ok(result.steps.some(s => s.type === 'damage-applied'));
          assert.ok(result.steps.some(s => s.type === 'clash-followup'));
          assert.ok(!result.steps.some(s => s.type === 'hit-destroyed'));
        }
        assert.equal(await page.locator('.battle-playback').count(), 0);
        const presentation=await page.evaluate(()=>presentationChecks);
        assert.ok(presentation.keyword);
        if(parry)assert.ok(presentation.broken);
        assert.ok(presentation.maxScale <= (width===1440?1.35:1.15)+.001);
        for(const src of presentation.icons)assert.equal(await page.evaluate(async src=>{const img=new Image();img.src=src;try{await img.decode();return true;}catch{return false;}},src),true);
        const samples=await page.evaluate(()=>registrationSamples);
        assert.ok(samples.length>0);
        assert.ok(samples.every(error=>error<2), `motion foot alignment ${samples}`);
      }
      assert.deepEqual(errors, []);
      console.log(`PASS sequence and parry UI ${width}`);
      await page.close();
    }
  } finally { await browser.close(); }
})().catch(error => { console.error(error); process.exitCode = 1; });
````

````cjs
const vm=require('node:vm');
const assert=require('node:assert/strict');
const root=path.resolve(__dirname,'..');
const c={window:{}};
const read=file=>fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,file),'utf8');
vm.runInNewContext(read('story-stage2-data.js'),c);
const raw=c.window.stage2Scenes;
vm.runInNewContext(read('story-stage2-presentation.js'),c);
vm.runInNewContext(read('story-stage3-data.js'),c);
const {stage2Scenes:stage2,stage3Scenes:stage3}=c.window;
const norm=text=>text.replace(/\s+/g,'');
raw.forEach((s,i)=>assert.equal(norm(stage2.filter(x=>x.sourceParagraph===i).map(x=>x.line).join('')),norm(s.line)));
console.log('PASS stage 2 preserves every original line');
const novel=fs.readFileSync(path.resolve(root,'../이루다 1획 - 빛을 이루다.md'),'utf8');
const paragraphs=novel.slice(novel.indexOf('투하가 뭔지 몰라도')).split(/\n\s*-----/)[0].split(/\r?\n\s*\r?\n/).map(x=>x.replace(/&#x20;/g,'').trim()).filter(Boolean);
paragraphs.forEach((p,i)=>assert.equal(norm(stage3.filter(x=>x.sourceParagraph===i).map(x=>x.line).join('')),norm(p)));
console.log('PASS stage 3 preserves all 137 source paragraphs');
for(const s of [...stage2,...stage3]) {
  assert.ok(fs.existsSync(path.join(root,s.background)),s.background);
  for(const sprite of s.characters) assert.ok(fs.existsSync(path.join(root,sprite.src)),sprite.src);
  if(s.kind==='dialogue' && !(s.speakerId==='drink' && s.sourceParagraph>=60 && s.sourceParagraph<=62)) assert.equal(s.characters.filter(x=>x.active).length,1,s.line);
  if(s.kind==='narration') assert.equal(s.characters.filter(x=>x.active).length,0,s.line);
}
console.log('PASS all backgrounds/sprites exist and dialogue highlights one actual speaker');
const speakerAt=i=>stage2.find(s=>s.sourceParagraph===i&&s.kind==='dialogue').speakerId;
for(const [i,id] of Object.entries({19:'brother',20:'hazard',24:'eojil',26:'brother',51:'hazard',53:'hazard',61:'hazard',69:'iruri'})) assert.equal(speakerAt(+i),id);
for(const s of stage2.filter(x=>x.sourceParagraph>=47)) assert.ok(!s.characters.some(x=>/월정커/.test(x.src)));
assert.ok(stage2.every(s=>!s.characters.some(x=>x.src.endsWith('pentar_bio.png'))));
assert.equal(stage2.find(s=>s.sourceParagraph===0&&s.kind==='dialogue').name,'???');
assert.equal(stage2.find(s=>s.sourceParagraph===72&&s.kind==='dialogue').name,'시가렛');
assert.equal(stage3.find(s=>s.sourceParagraph===12&&s.kind==='dialogue').name,'???');
assert.equal(stage3.find(s=>s.sourceParagraph===88&&s.kind==='dialogue').name,'이루도록');
assert.equal(stage3.find(s=>s.sourceParagraph===70&&s.kind==='dialogue').name,'나');
assert.equal(stage3.find(s=>s.sourceParagraph===72&&s.kind==='dialogue').name,'이루리');
console.log('PASS speaker corrections, reveal timing, cockpit restriction and no deceased sprites');
for(const s of stage3.filter(s=>s.sourceParagraph>=9&&s.sourceParagraph<=13)) {
 assert.deepEqual(Array.from(s.characters,x=>x.alt),['이루리','이루도록']);
}
for(const [paragraph,partner] of [[16,'이루게나'],[19,'이루소서'],[22,'이루겠네'],[30,'이루어질'],[65,'이루어질'],[93,'이루어질'],[121,'이루어도']]) {
 assert.ok(stage3.find(s=>s.sourceParagraph===paragraph&&s.kind==='dialogue').characters.some(x=>x.alt===partner));
}
console.log('PASS catching sequence and protagonist replies retain correct scene partners');
````

````cjs
     third.x=4;third.y=2;third.sp=50;third.buffs=[];third.debuffs=[];

     battleDummy.allies=[a,friend,third];battleDummy.bench=[];battleDummy.selected=a.id;
     battleDummy.enemies=battleDummy.enemies.slice(0,2);
     battleDummy.enemies.forEach((e,i)=>{
      e.hp=e.maxHp=100;e.x=i?1:2;e.y=i?3:2;
      e.preparedAction={name:'대기 방어',type:'방어',scope:'자신',range:0,hits:0,power:1,wave:0,effect:''};e.targetId=e.id;
     });
     const action=mode.startsWith('support')?a.skills[3]:{name:'광역 행동 검증',type:'타격',scope:mode==='whole'?'전 구역':'자신 중심 십자',range:mode==='whole'?'전장':1,hits:1,power:10,wave:1,effect:''};
     a.queuedActions=[{action,targetId:mode.startsWith('support')?friend.id:mode==='center'?a.id:battleDummy.enemies[0].id,decisionOrder:99}];
     rollWaveValue=()=>3;window.battlePlaybackTimingScale=.25;renderBattleDummy();
    },mode);

    assert.ok(await secondary.evaluateAll(els=>els.every(el=>getComputedStyle(el).filter==='none'&&getComputedStyle(el).opacity==='1')));
    if(mode==='support-right'){
     assert.ok(await page.locator('.playback-actor[data-unit="getne"]').evaluate(el=>el.classList.contains('right')));
     assert.ok(await page.locator('.playback-actor[data-unit="eojil"]').evaluate(el=>el.classList.contains('left')));
    }
    if(mode.startsWith('support')){
     assert.equal(await page.locator('.battle-playback').getAttribute('data-layout'),'approach');
     await page.waitForFunction(()=>!!document.querySelector('.playback-effect'));
     assert.ok(await page.locator('.playback-effect').count()>=2);
    } else {
     await page.waitForFunction(()=>!!document.querySelector('.playback-damage'));
    }
    await page.screenshot({path:path.join(__dirname,`${mode}-playback-${width}.png`)});
    await page.waitForFunction(()=>!battlePresentationActive,{},{timeout:30000});
    const result=await page.evaluate(()=>({steps:getLastBattleExecution().steps.map(s=>s.type),sp:battleDummy.allies.map(u=>u.sp),hp:battleDummy.enemies.map(u=>u.hp)}));
    assert.ok(!result.steps.includes('clash-start'));
    if(mode.startsWith('support')){assert.ok(result.steps.includes('support-end'));assert.deepEqual(result.sp,[54,54,54]);assert.deepEqual(result.hp,[100,100]);}
    else assert.deepEqual(result.hp,[88,88]); // Each prepared block reduces the incoming hit by 1.
    assert.deepEqual(errors,[]);await page.close();
   }
  }
  console.log('PASS real whole-team support, whole-area attacks, self-centered attacks, effect presentation and desktop/mobile.');
 }finally{await browser.close();}
})().catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exitCode=1;});
````

````cjs
const path = require('node:path');
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const { pathToFileURL } = require('node:url');
const { chromium } = require('C:/Users/user/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/node/node_modules/playwright');

(async () => {
  const browser = await chromium.launch({ headless: true, channel: 'msedge' });
  try {
    const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 900 }, deviceScaleFactor: 2 });
    const errors = [];
    page.on('pageerror', error => errors.push(error.message));
    await page.goto(pathToFileURL(path.resolve(__dirname, '../index.html')).href);
    await page.evaluate(() => {
      document.querySelectorAll('.view').forEach(v => v.classList.toggle('active', v.id === 'story-view'));
      startBattleLineup(['eojil', 'eojyeo', 'eora', 'gena', 'sosuh', 'eodo', 'ryeona', 'getne', 'dorok']);
    });
    await page.waitForFunction(() => [...document.querySelectorAll('.battle-token.ally img')].every(img => img.complete && img.naturalWidth === 768));
    await page.waitForTimeout(100);
    assert.equal(await page.locator('.battle-board-3d .battle-token').count(), 0);
    assert.equal(await page.locator('.battle-unit-layer .battle-token.ally').count(), 4);
    const checkOriginalProjection = () => page.evaluate(() => {
      const field = document.querySelector('#battle-field');
      const current = document.querySelector('#battle-board-3d');
      const referenceFrame = document.createElement('div');
      referenceFrame.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;inset:0;perspective:1100px;visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none';
      referenceFrame.style.transformOrigin = '0 0';
      referenceFrame.style.transform = document.querySelector('#battle-camera').style.transform;
      const reference = current.cloneNode(true);
      reference.removeAttribute('id');
      reference.style.transform = `translate(-50%, -50%) scale(var(--battle-zoom)) rotateX(${90 - battleDummy.tilt}deg) rotateZ(var(--battle-rot))`;
      reference.style.transformStyle = 'preserve-3d';
      reference.style.top = matchMedia('(max-height:540px) and (orientation:landscape)').matches ? '63%' : '51%';
      reference.style.width = matchMedia('(max-height:540px) and (orientation:landscape)').matches ? 'min(54vw, 27rem)' : 'calc(var(--tile-w) * 8)';
      referenceFrame.append(reference);
      field.append(referenceFrame);
      try {
        const original = [...reference.querySelectorAll('.battle-cell')].map(cell => cell.getBoundingClientRect());
        return [...current.querySelectorAll('.battle-cell')].every((cell, index) => {
          const actual = cell.getBoundingClientRect();
          return ['left', 'top', 'width', 'height'].every(key => Math.abs(actual[key] - original[index][key]) < 1);
        });
      } finally { referenceFrame.remove(); }
    });
    for (const rotation of [45, 90, -25]) {
      await page.evaluate(rotation => {
        battleDummy.rotation = rotation;
        battleDummy.zoom = 1.2;
        renderBattleDummy();
      }, rotation);
      await page.waitForTimeout(80);
      const aligned = await page.evaluate(() => battleDummy.allies.every(unit => {
        const cell = document.querySelector(`[data-cell-x="${unit.x}"][data-cell-y="${unit.y}"]`).getBoundingClientRect();
        const token = document.querySelector(`[data-battle-unit="${unit.id}"]`).getBoundingClientRect();
        return Math.abs(cell.left + cell.width / 2 - token.left - token.width / 2) < 1;
      }));
      assert.ok(aligned);
      assert.ok(await checkOriginalProjection());
    }
    await page.evaluate(() => { battleDummy.rotation = 45; battleDummy.zoom = 1; renderBattleDummy(); });
    await page.waitForTimeout(80);
    await page.screenshot({ path: path.join(__dirname, 'crisp-sd-battle-desktop.png') });
    await page.locator('.battle-token.ally').first().dblclick({ position: { x: 50, y: 50 } });
    await page.waitForSelector('.battle-inspection');
    await page.waitForTimeout(220);
    assert.equal(await page.locator('.unit-inspection-art').count(), 0);
    const imageBox = await page.locator('.battle-token.inspection-focus img').boundingBox();
    const infoBox = await page.locator('.battle-unit-info').boundingBox();
    assert.ok(imageBox.x + imageBox.width <= infoBox.x);
    assert.ok(imageBox.height > 350);
    assert.ok(await page.locator('#battle-camera').evaluate(el => getComputedStyle(el).transform !== 'none'));
    await page.evaluate(() => { window.inspectionPanel = document.querySelector('.battle-inspection'); window.inspectionCamera = document.querySelector('#battle-camera'); });
    for (const tab of ['passive', 'actions', 'ego', 'status']) {
      await page.locator(`[data-unit-info-tab="${tab}"]`).click();
      assert.equal(await page.locator(`[data-unit-info-tab="${tab}"]`).getAttribute('aria-selected'), 'true');
      assert.ok(await page.evaluate(() => window.inspectionPanel === document.querySelector('.battle-inspection') && window.inspectionCamera === document.querySelector('#battle-camera')));
    }
    await page.locator('[data-unit-info-tab="ego"]').click();
    for (const tab of ['action', 'passive']) {
      await page.locator(`[data-ego-info-tab="${tab}"]`).click();
      assert.equal(await page.locator(`[data-ego-info-tab="${tab}"]`).getAttribute('aria-selected'), 'true');
    }
    await page.locator('[data-unit-info-tab="status"]').click();
    assert.equal(await page.locator('#battle-camera').evaluate(el => getComputedStyle(el).perspective), '1100px');
    await page.waitForTimeout(220);
    await page.screenshot({ path: path.join(__dirname, 'unit-inspection-desktop.png') });
    await page.setViewportSize({ width: 844, height: 390 });
    await page.waitForTimeout(250);
    const fits = await page.locator('.battle-unit-info').evaluate(el => {
      const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
      return rect.right <= innerWidth && rect.bottom <= innerHeight;
    });
    assert.ok(fits);
    await page.screenshot({ path: path.join(__dirname, 'unit-inspection-mobile.png') });
    await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
    assert.equal(await page.locator('.battle-inspection').count(), 0);
    assert.equal(await page.locator('#battle-camera').evaluate(el => getComputedStyle(el).transform), 'none');
    assert.ok(await checkOriginalProjection());
    await page.screenshot({ path: path.join(__dirname, 'restored-board-mobile.png') });
    await page.locator('.battle-token.enemy').first().dblclick({ position: { x: 35, y: 40 } });
    assert.equal(await page.locator('.inspection-focus .enemy-core').count(), 1);
    await page.locator('[data-close-unit-info]').click();
    assert.deepEqual(errors, []);
    console.log('PASS original board reference: all 40 tiles match before-change projection at 3 angles and mobile; inspection tabs, slots and Escape.');
  } finally {
    await browser.close();
  }
})().catch(error => { console.error(error); process.exitCode = 1; });
````

````cjs
  const changes=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir,'eojyeo-revision-20261009.json')));
  const promptFile=path.join(dir,'additional-prompts.json');
  const prompts=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(promptFile));
  Object.assign(prompts,changes.prompts);
  for(const [key,revision] of Object.entries(changes.frames)){
    const target=path.join(dir,'eojyeo',key+'.png');
    const backup=path.join(dir,'eojyeo',key+'-before-head-revision.png');
    assert.ok(!fs.existsSync(backup),'Already applied');
    const {data,info}=await sharp(revision.source).ensureAlpha().raw().toBuffer({resolveWithObject:true});
    assert.equal(info.width,1086);assert.equal(info.height,1448);
    let minX=info.width,minY=info.height,maxX=-1,maxY=-1,clear=0;
    for(let y=0;y<info.height;y++)for(let x=0;x<info.width;x++){
      const a=data[(y*info.width+x)*4+3];if(!a)clear++;
      if(a>=128){minX=Math.min(minX,x);minY=Math.min(minY,y);maxX=Math.max(maxX,x);maxY=Math.max(maxY,y);}
    }
    assert.ok(clear>info.width*info.height*.1);
    fs.copyFileSync(target,backup);fs.copyFileSync(revision.source,target);
    const file=path.join(dir,'eojyeo',key+'.json'),record=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file));
    Object.assign(record,{source:revision.source,prompt:revision.prompt,revision:'20261009-eojyeo-v2',
      visibleBounds:[minX,minY,maxX,maxY],footPivotApprox:[record.footPivotApprox[0],maxY]});
    fs.writeFileSync(file,JSON.stringify(record,null,2));
    prompts['eojyeo/'+key]=revision.prompt;
  }
  fs.writeFileSync(promptFile,JSON.stringify(prompts,null,2));
  console.log('Applied eojyeo head/leg/badge revisions and saved all prompts.');
})().catch(error=>{console.error(error);process.exitCode=1;});
````

````cjs
const fs=require('node:fs'),path=require('node:path');
const sharp=require('C:/Users/user/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/node/node_modules/sharp');
const dir=path.resolve(__dirname,'../assets/battle/motions');
async function visibleHeight(file){
 const {data,info}=await sharp(file).ensureAlpha().raw().toBuffer({resolveWithObject:true});
 let top=info.height,bottom=0;
 for(let y=0;y<info.height;y++)for(let x=0;x<info.width;x++)if(data[(y*info.width+x)*4+3]>24){top=Math.min(top,y);bottom=Math.max(bottom,y);}
 return (bottom-top+1)/info.height;
}
(async()=>{
 const m=require(path.join(dir,'motion-manifest-v2.json')),result={};
 for(const c of m.characters){
  const upright=c.frames.find(f=>f.key==='clash-win');
  const renderScale=await visibleHeight(path.resolve(dir,c.reference))/await visibleHeight(path.join(dir,upright.src));
  result[c.name]={renderScale,canvas:m.canvas,pivot:m.footPivot,frames:c.frames};
 }
 fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir,'motion-runtime-v2.js'),'window.battleMotionLibrary='+JSON.stringify(result)+';\n');
 console.log('Prepared runtime motion catalog for '+Object.keys(result).length+' identities.');
})().catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exitCode=1;});
````

````cjs
}
````

````cjs
const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const sharp = require('C:/Users/user/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/node/node_modules/sharp');
const definitions = require('./rig55-definitions.cjs');
const root = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
const motionRoot = path.join(root, 'assets/battle/motions');
const sourceRoot = path.join(root, 'assets/battle/sd/sd-55');
const plan = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(motionRoot, 'motion-plan.json')));
const selection = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(sourceRoot, 'selection-records.json'))).selection;
const W = 1086, H = 1448, CW = 1800, CH = 1800, OX = 357, OY = 200;
const identity = [1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0];
const mul = (a,b) => [a[0]*b[0]+a[2]*b[1],a[1]*b[0]+a[3]*b[1],a[0]*b[2]+a[2]*b[3],a[1]*b[2]+a[3]*b[3],a[0]*b[4]+a[2]*b[5]+a[4],a[1]*b[4]+a[3]*b[5]+a[5]];
const point = (m,p) => [m[0]*p[0]+m[2]*p[1]+m[4],m[1]*p[0]+m[3]*p[1]+m[5]];
const rotate = (p,d) => {const a=d*Math.PI/180,c=Math.cos(a),s=Math.sin(a);return [c,s,-s,c,p[0]-c*p[0]+s*p[1],p[1]-s*p[0]-c*p[1]];};
const angle = (a,b) => Math.atan2(b[1]-a[1],b[0]-a[0])*180/Math.PI;
function inside(x,y,poly) {
  let hit=false;
  for(let i=0,j=poly.length-1;i<poly.length;j=i++){
    const a=poly[i],b=poly[j];
    if((a[1]>y)!==(b[1]>y)&&x<(b[0]-a[0])*(y-a[1])/(b[1]-a[1])+a[0])hit=!hit;
  }
  return hit;
}
const imageTag = (png,m,width=W,height=H) => `<image width="${width}" height="${height}" transform="matrix(${m.join(' ')})" href="data:image/png;base64,${png.toString('base64')}"/>`;
const svg = content => Buffer.from(`<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="${CW}" height="${CH}">${content}</svg>`);

function pose(frame, def, id) {
  const p={body:0,arms:[[0,0],[0,0]],legs:[[0,0],[0,0]]};
  const aim=(i,absolute,elbow=0) => {
    if(def.arms[i].locked)return;
    p.arms[i]=[absolute-angle(...def.arms[i].joints.slice(0,2))-p.body,elbow];
  };
  if(frame.key==='idle')return p;
  if(frame.key==='move'){
    p.body=5;p.legs=[[-12,17],[12,-19]];p.arms=[[15,-8],[-10,8]];
  }else if(frame.key==='hurt'){
    p.body=-7;p.legs=[[4,-5],[-3,5]];aim(0,57,-16);
  }else if(frame.key==='clash-loss'){
    p.body=-5;p.legs=[[7,-9],[-5,8]];p.arms=[[12,-8],[-7,8]];
  }else if(frame.key==='clash'){
    p.body=2;p.legs=[[-5,6],[5,-6]];aim(0,22,-12);
  }else if(frame.key==='clash-win'){
    p.body=4;p.legs=[[-7,9],[5,-7]];aim(0,5,4);
  }else if(frame.key==='defense'){
    p.body=id==='eodo'?0:-5;p.legs=[[7,-10],[-7,9]];aim(0,-30,24);
  }else {
    const hit=frame.hit||1,skill=Number(frame.key.match(/skill-(\d)/)?.[1]||5);
    p.body=(hit===2?-2:3)+(skill===4?2:0);
    p.legs=hit===2?[[4,-6],[-5,7]]:[[-6,8],[6,-8]];
    const target=hit===1?10-skill*5:hit===2?48-skill*7:-22;
    aim(0,target,hit===2?-12:7);
    if(id==='eodo'&&!def.arms[1].locked)aim(1,hit===2?150:105,hit===2?15:-9);
    // Held two-handed props remain intact; these frames use torso/leg key poses.
    if(id==='eojyeo')p.body+=hit===2?3:-2;
    if(frame.key.startsWith('overdrive'))p.body+=2;
  }
  def.arms.forEach((arm,i)=>{if(arm.locked)p.arms[i]=[0,0];});
  return p;
}

function matrices(def,p,sole) {
  const out={body:rotate(def.pelvis,p.body)};
  def.arms.forEach((arm,i)=>{
    out['upper'+i]=mul(out.body,rotate(arm.joints[0],p.arms[i][0]));
    out['lower'+i]=mul(out['upper'+i],rotate(arm.joints[1],p.arms[i][1]));
  });
  def.legs.forEach((leg,i)=>{
    out['thigh'+i]=rotate(leg.joints[0],p.legs[i][0]);
    out['shin'+i]=mul(out['thigh'+i],rotate(leg.joints[1],p.legs[i][1]));
  });
  const feet=def.legs.map((l,i)=>point(out['shin'+i],l.sole));
  const dx=543-(feet[0][0]+feet[1][0])/2;
  const dy=sole-Math.max(...feet.map(f=>f[1]));
  const registration=[1,0,0,1,OX+dx,OY+dy];
  Object.keys(out).forEach(k=>{out[k]=mul(registration,out[k]);});
  return out;
}

async function badgeAsset() {
  const file=path.resolve(root,'../이루다 1팀 컨셉 아트/이루다_1팀_문양_패치_컨셉아트.png');
  const badge=await sharp(file).extract({left:32,top:43,width:530,height:522}).png().toBuffer();
  const mask=Buffer.from('<svg width="530" height="522"><ellipse cx="265" cy="261" rx="258" ry="259" fill="white"/></svg>');
  const isolated=await sharp(badge).composite([{input:mask,blend:'dest-in'}]).png().toBuffer();
  const out=path.join(motionRoot,'rig55');fs.mkdirSync(out,{recursive:true});
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(out,'team-1-patch.png'),isolated);
  return isolated;
}

async function patchedSource(file,def,badge) {
  const source=fs.readFileSync(file);
  const inserts=def.badges.map(([x,y,w,h,d])=>{
    const base=[w/530,0,0,h/522,x-w/2,y-h/2];
    return imageTag(badge,mul(rotate([x,y],d),base),530,522);
  });
  const overlay=Buffer.from(`<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="${W}" height="${H}">${inserts.join('')}</svg>`);
  return sharp(source).composite([{input:overlay}]).png().toBuffer();
}

async function partition(png,def,backingFile) {
  const {data}=await sharp(png).ensureAlpha().raw().toBuffer({resolveWithObject:true});
  const keys=['body','upper0','lower0','upper1','lower1','thigh0','shin0','thigh1','shin1'];
  const buffers=Object.fromEntries(keys.map(k=>[k,Buffer.alloc(data.length)]));
  const owners=new Array(W*H);
  for(let y=0;y<H;y++)for(let x=0;x<W;x++){
    const index=(y*W+x)*4;if(!data[index+3])continue;
    let key='body';
    def.legs.forEach((leg,i)=>{if(inside(x,y,leg.poly))key=y<leg.joints[1][1]?'thigh'+i:'shin'+i;});
    def.arms.forEach((arm,i)=>{
      if(inside(x,y,arm.poly)){
        const [s,e,w]=arm.joints;
        const v=[e[0]-s[0],e[1]-s[1]],projection=(x-e[0])*v[0]+(y-e[1])*v[1];
        key=arm.locked||projection<0?'upper'+i:'lower'+i;
      }
    });
    data.copy(buffers[key],index,index,index+4);owners[y*W+x]=key;
  }
  const clean=Object.fromEntries(keys.map(k=>[k,Buffer.from(buffers[k])]));
  const backing=Buffer.alloc(data.length);
  if(fs.existsSync(backingFile)){
    const plate=await sharp(backingFile).resize(W,H,{fit:'fill'}).ensureAlpha().raw().toBuffer();
    for(let p=0;p<W*H;p++){
      if(owners[p]&&owners[p]!=='body')plate.copy(backing,p*4,p*4,p*4+4);
    }
  }
  // Hidden backing uses sampled coat pixels, never a replacement head or limb.
  for(let y=300;y<960;y++)for(let x=250;x<850;x++){
    const index=(y*W+x)*4;
    if(buffers.body[index+3]||!inside(x,y,def.body))continue;
    let nearest=-1;
    for(let d=1;d<180&&nearest<0;d++)for(const sx of [x-d,x+d]){
      if(sx<0||sx>=W)continue;
      const at=(y*W+sx)*4;
      if(clean.body[at+3]===255&&clean.body[at]<90&&clean.body[at+1]<90&&clean.body[at+2]<100){nearest=at;break;}
    }
    if(nearest>=0){clean.body.copy(buffers.body,index,nearest,nearest+4);}
  }
  const joints=[];
  def.arms.forEach((arm,i)=>{
    joints.push([arm.joints[0],'body','upper'+i,35]);
    if(!arm.locked)joints.push([arm.joints[1],'upper'+i,'lower'+i,45]);
  });
  def.legs.forEach((leg,i)=>joints.push([leg.joints[1],'thigh'+i,'shin'+i,75]));
  for(const [p,a,b,r]of joints){
    for(let y=Math.max(0,Math.floor(p[1]-r));y<Math.min(H,p[1]+r);y++)for(let x=Math.max(0,Math.floor(p[0]-r));x<Math.min(W,p[0]+r);x++){
      const at=(y*W+x)*4;
      if(Math.hypot(x-p[0],y-p[1])>r||![a,b].includes(owners[y*W+x])||data[at+3]<255)continue;
      data.copy(buffers[a],at,at,at+4);data.copy(buffers[b],at,at,at+4);
    }
  }
  const parts={backing:await sharp(backing,{raw:{width:W,height:H,channels:4}}).png().toBuffer()};
  for(const k of keys)parts[k]=await sharp(buffers[k],{raw:{width:W,height:H,channels:4}}).png().toBuffer();
  return parts;
}

(async()=>{
  const badge=await badgeAsset();
  const manifest={revision:'sd55-original-parts',kind:'rigid-cutout-key-poses',canvas:[CW,CH],characters:[],review:'draft-joint-and-occlusion-review-required'};
  const runtime={};
  for(const job of plan.jobs.filter(j=>!process.argv[2]||j.id===process.argv[2])){

    const source=path.join(sourceRoot,item.file),folder=path.join(motionRoot,'rig55',job.id);

    for(const [key,png]of Object.entries(parts))fs.writeFileSync(path.join(folder,'parts',key+'.png'),png);

    for(const frame of [{key:'idle',label:'원본 SD'},...job.frames]){
      const m=matrices(def,pose(frame,def,job.id),item.sole);transforms[frame.key]=m;
      const content=frame.key==='idle'?imageTag(patched,[1,0,0,1,OX,OY]):imageTag(parts.backing,m.body)+order.map(k=>imageTag(parts[k],m[k])).join('');
      const file=path.join(folder,frame.key+'.png');
      await sharp(svg(content)).png().toFile(file);
      frames.push({...frame,src:`rig55/${job.id}/${frame.key}.png`,review:'joint-review-required'});
    }
    const bodyHeight=item.sole-item.crown;
    const entry={id:job.id,name:job.name,source:`../../sd/sd-55/${item.file}`,canvas:[CW,CH],pivot:[900,item.sole+OY],bodyHeight,frames};
    manifest.characters.push(entry);
    runtime[job.name]={registration:'native-body-height',renderScale:CH/bodyHeight,canvas:[CW,CH],pivot:entry.pivot,frames:frames.filter(f=>f.key!=='idle')};
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(folder,'rig.json'),JSON.stringify({source,anatomy:'original pixels; unit-length rigid matrices; no pose-height normalization',definition:def,transforms},null,2));
    console.log(`${job.name}: ${job.frames.length} cutout poses, original head and bone lengths.`);
  }
  const suffix=process.argv[2]?'-'+process.argv[2]:'';
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(motionRoot,'motion-manifest-rig55'+suffix+'.json'),JSON.stringify(manifest,null,2));
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(motionRoot,'motion-runtime-rig55'+suffix+'.js'),'window.battleRig55MotionLibrary='+JSON.stringify(runtime)+';\n');
})();
````

````cjs
const visibleCenterX = (data, info) => {
  let left = info.width, right = -1;
  for (let y = 0; y < info.height; y++) {

      if (data[(y * info.width + x) * 4 + 3] >= 128) {

        right = Math.max(right, x);

  return (left + right) / 2;
};
const flags = {

  'eojil/clash': '머리 축소 수정',

};

  for (const job of plan.jobs) {
````
