````cjs
    const base = await sharp(path.resolve(dir, baseSrc)).ensureAlpha().raw().toBuffer({resolveWithObject:true});
    let figures = figure(job.name+' · 기본 SD', baseSrc, [visibleCenterX(base.data,base.info),job.headReference.sole], [base.info.width,base.info.height], '기준 원본');
    for (const frame of frames) {

      const src = job.id+'/'+frame.key+'.png';
      const {data,info} = await sharp(path.join(dir,src)).ensureAlpha().raw().toBuffer({resolveWithObject:true});
      let clear=0; for(let i=3;i<data.length;i+=4)if(data[i]===0)clear++;

      record.applied = false;

  const html = `<!doctype html><html lang="ko"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>이루다 · 단일 이미지 모션</title><style>
*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;background:#191b1d;color:#ecedef;font:15px system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:0}main{max-width:1540px;margin:auto;padding:20px}header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:16px;border-bottom:1px solid #484a4d;padding-bottom:14px}h1,h2{font-size:20px;margin:0}h2{margin-top:28px}small{font-size:12px;color:#c5b883}label{white-space:nowrap}nav{display:flex;gap:20px;padding:16px 0}a{color:#c6ded4}input{accent-color:#d6be71}.comparison{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px;margin-top:16px}figure{margin:0;border:1px solid #484a4d;border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden;background:#303338}figcaption{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;padding:12px;min-height:66px}figure>a{display:block;padding:8px 12px}.stage{width:100%;aspect-ratio:1600/1700;background:repeating-conic-gradient(#303338 0 25%,#34373c 0 50%) 0/28px 28px}svg{display:block;width:100%;height:100%}image{user-select:none;pointer-events:none}.guides{stroke:#a6c8b7;stroke-width:2;opacity:.8}.guide-off .guides{display:none}.foot{stroke:#edcb6e;stroke-width:4}footer{display:flex;gap:20px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:20px 0}@media(max-width:620px){main{padding:12px}.comparison{grid-template-columns:1fr}h1{font-size:17px}}
</style></head><body><main><header><h1>이루다 · 단일 이미지 모션</h1><label><input id="guides" type="checkbox" checked>기준선</label></header><nav>${sections.map(s=>{const id=s.match(/id="([^"]+)"/)[1];const j=plan.jobs.find(j=>j.id===id);return '<a href="#'+id+'">'+j.name+'</a>';}).join('')}</nav>${sections.join('')}<footer><a href="additional-prompts.json">추가 제작 프롬프트</a><a href="README.md">검수 기록</a><a href="manifest.json">이미지 목록</a></footer></main><script>document.querySelector('#guides').addEventListener('change',e=>document.body.classList.toggle('guide-off',!e.target.checked));document.addEventListener('dragstart',e=>e.preventDefault());</script></body></html>`;
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir,'preview.html'),html);
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir,'README.md'),'# 단일 이미지 모션\n\n파츠 합성 없이 한 자세당 한 장의 투명 PNG로 제작.\n\n- 이루어질: 17 / 17 자세 저장.\n- 이루어져: 17 / 17 자세 저장.\n- 나머지 팀원: 아직 제작하지 않음.\n- 전체 '+catalog.length+' / '+total+' 저장.\n- 실제 원본 크기: 1086 × 1448. 요청한 2172 × 2896이 전달되지는 않았으며 임의 업스케일하지 않음.\n- PNG 투명 배경과 실제 크기 검증 완료.\n- 동일 픽셀 배율로 표시하며 발 기준점은 근사치. 인체 비율의 완전 일치는 보장하지 않음.\n- 이루어질 이동·충돌 및 이루어져 공격·피격 머리 축소 수정. 이루어져 1타 다리 겹침과 소매 문양 수정.\n- 이루어질 1스킬 후속 자세 펜촉 및 이루어져 일부 코트 끝 여백 추가 검수.\n- 이루다 1팀 전구 문양을 참조하여 소매 패치 제작. 작은 자수의 정확한 재현은 별도 검수 필요.\n- 연속 프레임 애니메이션이 아닌 주요 자세 이미지. 실전 게임 연결 완료.\n- 첫 두 장 프롬프트: prompts.json, 추가 프롬프트: additional-prompts.json 및 각 자세 JSON.\n');
````

````cjs
const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const sharp = require('C:/Users/user/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/node/node_modules/sharp');
const dir = path.resolve(__dirname, '../assets/battle/motions/single55');
(async () => {
  const manifest = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir, 'manifest.json')));
  const library = {};
  for (const frame of manifest.frames) {
    const {data,info} = await sharp(path.join(dir,frame.src)).ensureAlpha().raw().toBuffer({resolveWithObject:true});
    let left=info.width,right=-1;
    for(let y=0;y<info.height;y++)for(let x=0;x<info.width;x++){
      if(data[(y*info.width+x)*4+3]>=128){left=Math.min(left,x);right=Math.max(right,x);}
    }
    (library[frame.name] ||= {frames:[]}).frames.push({
      key:frame.key,src:frame.src+(frame.revision?'?v='+frame.revision:''),skillName:frame.skillName,hit:frame.hit,
      canvas:[info.width,info.height],pivotY:frame.footPivotApprox[1],
      centerX:(left+right)/2
    });
  }
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir,'runtime.js'),'window.battleSingleMotionLibrary='+JSON.stringify(library)+';\n');
  console.log('Saved single-image runtime: '+manifest.frames.length+' poses.');
})().catch(error=>{console.error(error);process.exitCode=1;});
````

````cjs
 '02_이루어라_스탠딩.png': [175,true], '03_이루소서_스탠딩.png': [177,true],
 '04_이루리_초반_스탠딩.png': [180,false], '04_이루리_스탠딩.png': [180,false],
 '05_이루어도_스탠딩.png': [200,true], '06_이루게나_스탠딩.png': [181,true],
 '07_이루도록_스탠딩.png': [192,true], '08_이루려나_스탠딩.png': [168,true],
 '09_이루겠네_스탠딩.png': [165,true],
 'pentar_hazard.png': [185,false], 'pentar_bio.png': [155,false],
 'pentar_drink.png': [170,false], 'pentar_cigarette.png': [190,false],
 '월정커_누님_스탠딩.png': [175,false], '월정커_아우_스탠딩.png': [180,false]
};
(async () => {
 const layout = {};
 for (const directory of ['assets/standing','assets/story/standing']) {
  for (const file of fs.readdirSync(path.join(root,directory)).filter(file => file.endsWith('.png'))) {
   const src = `${directory}/${file}`;
   const {data,info} = await sharp(path.join(root,src)).ensureAlpha().raw().toBuffer({resolveWithObject:true});
   let top=info.height,bottom=-1;
   for(let y=0;y<info.height;y++) for(let x=0;x<info.width;x++) {
    if(data[(y*info.width+x)*4+3]>32) { top=Math.min(top,y);bottom=Math.max(bottom,y); }
   }
   if(bottom<top) throw new Error(`Empty sprite: ${src}`);
   const [heightCm,confirmed] = heights[file] || [180,false];
   layout[src] = {heightCm,confirmed,visibleFraction:(bottom-top+1)/info.height,bottomPadding:(info.height-1-bottom)/info.height};
  }
 }
 fs.writeFileSync(path.join(root,'standing-layout.js'), `// Generated image bounds and character height references.\nwindow.vnStandingLayout = ${JSON.stringify(layout,null,2)};\n`);
 console.log(`Measured ${Object.keys(layout).length} standing sprites.`);
})().catch(error=>{console.error(error);process.exitCode=1;});
````

````cjs
const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const vm = require('node:vm');
const root = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
const source = fs.readFileSync(path.resolve(root, '../이루다 1획 - 빛을 이루다.md'), 'utf8');
const excerpt = source.slice(source.indexOf('투하가 뭔지 몰라도')).split(/\n\s*-----/)[0];
const paragraphs = excerpt.split(/\r?\n\s*\r?\n/).map(line => line.replace(/&#x20;/g, '').trim()).filter(Boolean);
const sprites = {
  iruri: 'assets/standing/04_이루리_초반_스탠딩.png',
  eojil: 'assets/standing/00_이루어질_스탠딩.png', eojyeo: 'assets/standing/01_이루어져_스탠딩.png',
  eora: 'assets/standing/02_이루어라_스탠딩.png', sosuh: 'assets/standing/03_이루소서_스탠딩.png',
  eodo: 'assets/standing/05_이루어도_스탠딩.png', gena: 'assets/standing/06_이루게나_스탠딩.png',
  dorok: 'assets/standing/07_이루도록_스탠딩.png', ryeona: 'assets/standing/08_이루려나_스탠딩.png',
  getne: 'assets/standing/09_이루겠네_스탠딩.png',
  hazard: 'assets/story/standing/pentar_hazard.png', bio: 'assets/story/standing/pentar_bio.png',
  drink: 'assets/story/standing/pentar_drink.png', cigarette: 'assets/story/standing/pentar_cigarette.png',
  sister: 'assets/story/standing/월정커_누님_스탠딩.png', brother: 'assets/story/standing/월정커_아우_스탠딩.png'
};
const names = { iruri:'이루리', eojil:'이루어질', eojyeo:'이루어져', eora:'이루어라', sosuh:'이루소서', eodo:'이루어도', gena:'이루게나', dorok:'이루도록', ryeona:'이루려나', getne:'이루겠네', hazard:'하자드', bio:'바이오', drink:'드링크', cigarette:'시가렛', sister:'누님?', brother:'아우?' };
function characters(ids, speaker) {
````

원본: `이루다 소설/게임 UI 프로토타입/tools/inspect-sprite-registration.cjs` / 1,984 bytes / SHA-256 `c5c8f29a9a433c744ee1a4f622d1297c572df9443f6738c0859daae3afbd514d`

````cjs
const fs = require('node:fs'), path = require('node:path'), vm = require('node:vm');
const sharp = require('C:/Users/user/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/node/node_modules/sharp');
const root = path.resolve(__dirname, '..'), folder = path.join(root, 'assets/battle/motions');
const manifest = require(path.join(folder, 'motion-manifest-v2.json'));
const context = { window: {} }; vm.runInNewContext(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, 'battle-sprites.js'), 'utf8'), context);
async function bounds(file) {
  const { data, info } = await sharp(file).ensureAlpha().raw().toBuffer({ resolveWithObject: true });
  let top = info.height, bottom = 0;
  for (let y = 0; y < info.height; y++) for (let x = Math.floor(info.width * .35); x < info.width * .65; x++) {
    if (data[(y * info.width + x) * 4 + 3] > 24) { top = Math.min(top, y); bottom = Math.max(bottom, y); }
  }
  return { top, bottom, width: info.width, height: info.height };
}
(async () => {
  const tiles = [], results = [];
  for (const [row, character] of manifest.characters.entries()) {
    const idle = path.join(root, context.window.battleSpriteAssets[character.name].src);
    const frames = [idle, path.join(folder, character.frames.find(f => f.key === 'clash-win').src), path.join(folder, character.frames.find(f => f.key === 'skill-1-hit-1').src)];
    results.push({ name: character.name, bounds: await Promise.all(frames.map(bounds)) });
    for (let column = 0; column < frames.length; column++) {
      tiles.push({ input: await sharp(frames[column]).resize(160, 210, { fit: 'contain', background: '#192027' }).png().toBuffer(), left: column * 160, top: row * 210 });
    }
  }
  await sharp({ create: { width: 480, height: manifest.characters.length * 210, channels: 4, background: '#192027' } }).composite(tiles).png().toFile(path.join(root, 'tests/sprite-registration-before.png'));
  console.log(JSON.stringify(results));
})().catch(error=>{console.error(error);process.exitCode=1;});
````

## C205. 이루다 소설/게임 UI 프로토타입/tools/plan-battle-motions.cjs

원본: `이루다 소설/게임 UI 프로토타입/tools/plan-battle-motions.cjs` / 7,674 bytes / SHA-256 `6a3e83dc96042d710016848fe07175dc88cfe7fb9a6b8d3e5b4826d8bafda395`

````cjs
const fs=require('node:fs');
const path=require('node:path');
const vm=require('node:vm');
const root=path.resolve(__dirname,'..');
const existingPlan=path.join(root,'assets/battle/motions/motion-plan.json');
if(fs.existsSync(existingPlan)&&JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(existingPlan,'utf8')).jobs.some(job=>job.status!=='planned')){
  throw new Error('Generated motion plan exists. Preserve completed jobs; write a versioned plan instead.');
}
const context=vm.createContext({window:{},document:{querySelectorAll:()=>[]},console});
vm.runInContext(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,'battle-tutorial.js'),'utf8'),context);
const source=fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,'app.js'),'utf8');
vm.runInContext(source.slice(0,source.indexOf('renderChapters();',source.lastIndexOf('function renderSquad'))),context);
vm.runInContext(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,'battle-sprites.js'),'utf8'),context);
const roster=JSON.parse(vm.runInContext('JSON.stringify(createBattleRoster())',context));
const motifs={
  eojil:['Tablet retained in left hand; deliberate precise pointing thrusts with right hand, sharply controlled geometric blue prediction marks.','forward fingertip thrust','cross-body palm thrust','decisive two-finger pointing thrust'],
  eojyeo:['Rabbit plush stays with her; sleepy movements release violet dream ribbons, never give her a sword.','low sleepy palm wave','swaying shoulder and plush outward','forward dream-projecting hand'],
  eora:['Keep cylinder and scientific utility silhouette; blue gravity control through hand gestures, no invented gun.','low gravity-pinning palm','upturned rearranging hand','strong outward releasing palm'],
  sosuh:['Keep brown ponytail, beard and right-hand short dagger, experienced compact knife technique.','horizontal dagger slash','reverse diagonal dagger cut','precise forward dagger thrust'],
  eodo:['Keep two-eye-hole paper bag head and enormous broad body; bare gloved fists and shoulders, no added face or weapon.','heavy backhand punch','shoulder shove','downward hammer fist'],
  gena:['Keep black/crimson hair, fangs and a BROAD axe, not a pickaxe; athletic fierce adult woman.','low axe sweep','diagonal axe chop','overhead axe smash'],
  dorok:['Keep brown-haired tactical man and symmetric harness; controlled coordinates and paired precise hand gestures, no new oversized weapon.','forward coordinate-pointing hand','cross-body symmetric gesture','two-handed force release'],
  ryeona:['Keep brown hair goggles orange right eye detonator; wrench and small handheld pyrotechnic charges only.','wrench flick from wrist','throw compact pyrotechnic charge','press detonator while bracing'],
  getne:['Keep white hair red ribbon red eyes; reassuring gloved hand and clean white/gold sacred marks.','open-palm white light strike','draw short sacred mark with fingertip','protective outstretched palm']
};
const jobs=roster.map(unit=>{
  const sprite=context.window.battleSpriteAssets[unit.name];
  const frames=[
    {key:'move',label:'충돌 접근',pose:'forward running stride, torso leaned toward right, one leading foot near ground, coat trailing left'},
    {key:'clash',label:'충돌',pose:'firm forward interception pose, braced front leg, tool or forearm raised to meet an incoming strike from the right'},
    {key:'clash-loss',label:'충돌 패배',pose:'stagger backward toward left, torso recoiling, bent knees, equipment retained, pained but alive'},
    {key:'clash-win',label:'충돌 승리',pose:'confident forward follow-through, stable stance, tool or fist directed right, not a victory dance'},
    {key:'hurt',label:'피격',pose:'distinct hit reaction: chest recoils, face winces, arms instinctively protect abdomen, no wounds or gore'},
    {key:'defense',label:unit.guard.name,pose:unit.guard.type==='회피'?'low lateral dodge, bent knees, torso pulled backward, preserve balance':unit.guard.type==='반격'?'compact ready-to-counter posture, tool or striking hand near hip, lead forearm guarding':'broad braced guard, both forearms protect head and chest'}
  ];
  unit.skills.forEach((skill,i)=>{
````

````cjs
(async () => {
  const planFile = path.join(dir, 'single-image-plan.json');

  const job = plan.jobs.find(j=>j.id===id), frame = job?.frames.find(f=>f.key===key);
  assert.ok(frame, 'Known frame required');
  const target = path.join(dir, id, key+'.png');
  assert.ok(!fs.existsSync(target), 'Never replace a selected image without review');
  const {data, info} = await sharp(source).ensureAlpha().raw().toBuffer({resolveWithObject: true});
  let clear=0,minX=info.width,minY=info.height,maxX=-1,maxY=-1;
  for(let y=0;y<info.height;y++)for(let x=0;x<info.width;x++){
    const a=data[(y*info.width+x)*4+3];if(!a)clear++;
    if(a>=128){minX=Math.min(minX,x);minY=Math.min(minY,y);maxX=Math.max(maxX,x);maxY=Math.max(maxY,y);}
  }
  assert.ok(clear>info.width*info.height*.1, 'Real transparent background required');
  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(target),{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(source,target);
  const lowY=Math.max(0,maxY-45),columns=[];
  for(let x=0;x<info.width;x++){let count=0;for(let y=lowY;y<=maxY;y++)if(data[(y*info.width+x)*4+3]>=128)count++;if(count>=3)columns.push(x);}
  const pivotX=columns.length?Math.round((columns[0]+columns.at(-1))/2):Math.round(info.width/2);
  const record={...frame,src:`${id}/${key}.png`,nativeSize:[info.width,info.height],visibleBounds:[minX,minY,maxX,maxY],footPivotApprox:[pivotX,maxY],source,review:'needs anatomy and equipment review',alphaChecked:true};
  Object.assign(frame,{status:'saved',source});fs.writeFileSync(planFile,JSON.stringify(plan,null,2));
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir,id,key+'.json'),JSON.stringify(record,null,2));
  console.log(JSON.stringify({id,key,nativeSize:record.nativeSize,bounds:record.visibleBounds,saved:target}));
})().catch(error=>{console.error(error);process.exitCode=1;});
````

````cjs
const fs = require('node:fs');

  for (const record of records) {

      cells.push({input,left:(i+1)*w,top:0});
    }
    await sharp({create:{width:w*(record.frames.length+1),height:h,channels:4,background:'#30343a'}})
      .composite([{input:reference,left:0,top:0},...cells]).png().toFile(path.join(out,file));
    lines.push(`## ${record.name} / ${record.batch}`, '', `- 원본 크기: ${meta.width} x ${meta.height}. 요청 크기와 다를 수 있으며 패딩이나 확대를 원본 해상도로 주장하지 않는다.`,

  }
````

````cjs
    const meta = await sharp(file).metadata();
    const stats = await sharp(file).stats();
    if (!meta.hasAlpha || stats.channels[3].min !== 0 || stats.channels[3].max === 0) throw Error(entry.name + ': invalid alpha');
    items.push({...entry, width: meta.width, height: meta.height, hasAlpha: meta.hasAlpha});
  }
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'review-data.js'), 'window.sd55Review = ' + JSON.stringify(items, null, 2) + ';\n');
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'validation.json'), JSON.stringify({target:5.5, measurement:'manual visible hair-cap crown, chin, sole estimates; not an anatomical guarantee', images:items}, null, 2));
  console.log(JSON.stringify(items, null, 2));
})().catch(error => {console.error(error); process.exitCode = 1;});
````

원본: `이루다 소설/게임 UI 프로토타입/tools/rig-landmark-review.cjs` / 1,051 bytes / SHA-256 `6c6c5f95335e05e7e0758964968ce5bf044b1c879b7d62be98a416a3c951bf1a`

````cjs
const fs=require('node:fs'),path=require('node:path');
const sharp=require('C:/Users/user/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/node/node_modules/sharp');
const root=path.resolve(__dirname,'..'),dir=path.join(root,'assets/battle/motions');
const plan=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir,'motion-plan.json'),'utf8'));
(async()=>{for(const job of plan.jobs){
 const svg='<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="768" height="1024">'+Array.from({length:16},(_,i)=>`<path d="M${i*50} 0V1024" stroke="#ffdf8855"/><text x="${i*50+2}" y="20" font-size="13" fill="#ffe5a0">${i*50}</text>`).join('')+Array.from({length:21},(_,i)=>`<path d="M0 ${i*50}H768" stroke="#ffdf8855"/><text x="2" y="${i*50+15}" font-size="13" fill="#ffe5a0">${i*50}</text>`).join('')+'</svg>';
 await sharp({create:{width:768,height:1024,channels:4,background:'#30343a'}}).composite([{input:job.reference},{input:Buffer.from(svg)}]).png().toFile(path.join(dir,'review-v3',job.id+'-landmarks.png'));
}})().catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exitCode=1;});
````

## C215. 이루다 소설/게임 UI 프로토타입/tools/save-sd-proportions.cjs

원본: `이루다 소설/게임 UI 프로토타입/tools/save-sd-proportions.cjs` / 2,607 bytes / SHA-256 `ef7c05a36727cba4c8b67d5c54151d7e0c6b5bc86f84e88a2ba7eebd0fcec9d8`

````cjs
const fs=require('node:fs');
const path=require('node:path');
const sharp=require('C:/Users/user/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/node/node_modules/sharp');
const root=path.resolve(__dirname,'..');
const jobs=require('./sd-proportion-assets.json');
(async()=>{
 const tiles=[],assets={},report=[];
 for(const [i,job] of jobs.entries()){
  const target=path.join(root,job.target);
  const trimmed=await sharp(job.source).trim().png().toBuffer();
  const resized=await sharp(trimmed).resize({height:900}).png().toBuffer({resolveWithObject:true});
  if(resized.info.width>748)throw new Error('Sprite exceeds horizontal safe area: '+job.id+' '+resized.info.width);
  const left=Math.floor((768-resized.info.width)/2);
  await sharp(resized.data).extend({left,right:768-resized.info.width-left,top:64,bottom:60,background:'#00000000'}).png().toFile(target);
  const jpg=path.join(path.dirname(target),'jpg',path.basename(target,'.png')+'.jpg');
  await sharp(target).flatten({background:'#34363d'}).jpeg({quality:85}).toFile(jpg);
  const {data,info}=await sharp(target).ensureAlpha().raw().toBuffer({resolveWithObject:true});
  let minY=info.height,maxY=-1;
  for(let y=0;y<info.height;y++)for(let x=0;x<info.width;x++)if(data[(y*info.width+x)*4+3]>16){minY=Math.min(minY,y);maxY=Math.max(maxY,y);}
  if(Math.abs(minY-64)>4||Math.abs(maxY-963)>4)throw new Error('Baseline mismatch: '+job.id);
  if(fs.statSync(jpg).size>1000000)throw new Error('JPG exceeds 1MB');
  report.push({name:job.id,visibleTop:minY,visibleBottom:maxY,canvas:[768,1024],height:900});
````

## C216. 이루다 소설/게임 UI 프로토타입/tools/save-sd-sprites.cjs

원본: `이루다 소설/게임 UI 프로토타입/tools/save-sd-sprites.cjs` / 2,297 bytes / SHA-256 `174badd0da83c22f908e7aa878df6fb8b94f0c20bff519e0fa8553b6838eac58`

````cjs
const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const sharp = require('C:/Users/user/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/node/node_modules/sharp');
const root = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
const jobs = require('./sd-sprite-assets.json');
(async () => {
  const tiles = [];
  const assets = {};
  for (const [i, job] of jobs.entries()) {
    const target = path.join(root, job.target);
    fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(target), {recursive:true});
    fs.mkdirSync(path.join(path.dirname(target), 'jpg'), {recursive:true});
    const resized = await sharp(job.source).trim().resize(460,700,{fit:'inside'}).png().toBuffer({resolveWithObject:true});
    const left = Math.floor((512-resized.info.width)/2);
    await sharp(resized.data).extend({left,right:512-resized.info.width-left,top:738-resized.info.height,bottom:30,background:'#00000000'}).png().toFile(target);
    const meta = await sharp(target).metadata();
    const stats = await sharp(target).stats();
    if (meta.width!==512 || meta.height!==768 || !meta.hasAlpha || stats.channels[3].min!==0) throw new Error('Invalid sprite: '+target);
    const jpg = path.join(path.dirname(target),'jpg',path.basename(target,'.png')+'.jpg');
    await sharp(target).flatten({background:'#292b31'}).jpeg({quality:85}).toFile(jpg);
    if(fs.statSync(jpg).size>1000000) throw new Error('JPG too large: '+jpg);
    tiles.push({input:await sharp(target).resize(256,384).toBuffer(),left:(i%5)*256,top:Math.floor(i/5)*414});
    const label = Buffer.from(`<svg width="256" height="30"><text x="128" y="21" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Malgun Gothic" font-size="17" fill="#eee">${job.id}</text></svg>`);
    tiles.push({input:label,left:(i%5)*256,top:Math.floor(i/5)*414+384});
    assets[job.id]={src:job.target,scale:job.scale,combat:job.id!=='이루리'};
    console.log(job.id+': transparent 512x768, JPG '+fs.statSync(jpg).size+' bytes');
  }
  await sharp({create:{width:1280,height:828,channels:4,background:'#34363d'}}).composite(tiles).png().toFile(path.join(root,'assets/battle/sd/이루다_1팀_SD_모음.png'));
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(root,'battle-sprites.js'),'window.battleSpriteAssets = '+JSON.stringify(assets,null,2)+';\n');
})().catch(error=>{console.error(error);process.exitCode=1;});
````

````cjs
const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const sharp = require('C:/Users/user/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/node/node_modules/sharp');
const root = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
const jobs = require('./simple-logo-assets.json');
(async () => {
  const tiles = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < jobs.length; i++) {
    const job = jobs[i];
    const target = path.join(root, job.target);
    await sharp(job.source).trim().resize(512, 512, {fit: 'contain', background: '#00000000'}).png().toFile(target);
    const stats = await sharp(target).stats();
    const meta = await sharp(target).metadata();
    if (!meta.hasAlpha || stats.channels[3].min !== 0 || stats.channels[3].max !== 255) throw new Error('Invalid alpha: ' + target);
    tiles.push({input: await sharp(target).resize(180, 180).toBuffer(), left: (i % 5) * 200 + 10, top: Math.floor(i / 5) * 200 + 10});
    console.log(job.name + ': 512x512 transparent PNG');
  }
  await sharp({create: {width: 1000, height: 400, channels: 4, background: '#26282b'}}).composite(tiles).png().toFile(path.join(root, 'assets/logos/팀원_로고_v3_모음.png'));
})().catch(error => {console.error(error); process.exitCode = 1;});
````

````cjs
const fs=require('node:fs');

const root=path.resolve(__dirname,'..');
const jobs=require('./ui-refresh-assets.json');
(async()=>{
 for(const job of jobs){
  const target=path.join(root,job.target);fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(target),{recursive:true});
  if(job.kind==='logo')await sharp(job.source).trim().resize(512,512,{fit:'contain',background:'#00000000'}).png().toFile(target);
  else if(job.kind==='background'){
   await sharp(job.source).resize(1920,1080,{fit:'cover'}).png().toFile(target);
   await sharp(target).jpeg({quality:86}).toFile(target.replace(/\.png$/,'.jpg'));
  }else fs.copyFileSync(job.source,target);
  console.log(job.target);
 }
})().catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exitCode=1;});
````

````cjs
const fs=require('node:fs');
const path=require('node:path');
const sharp=require('C:/Users/user/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/node/node_modules/sharp');
const root=path.resolve(__dirname,'..'),out=path.join(root,'assets/battle/motions');
const plan=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(out,'motion-plan.json'),'utf8'));
const sources=require('./motion-generated-sources.json');
const transparent={r:0,g:0,b:0,alpha:0};
function bounds(data,w,h){
 let left=w,right=-1,top=h,bottom=-1,empty=0;
 for(let y=0;y<h;y++)for(let x=0;x<w;x++){
  if(data[(y*w+x)*4+3]>24){left=Math.min(left,x);right=Math.max(right,x);top=Math.min(top,y);bottom=Math.max(bottom,y);}else empty++;
 }
 return {left,right,top,bottom,emptyFraction:empty/(w*h)};
}
(async()=>{
 fs.mkdirSync(path.join(out,'sheets'),{recursive:true});
 const manifest={kind:'key-poses',canvas:[768,1024],footPivot:[384,964],review:'draft-needs-visual-approval',characters:[]},montage=[];
 for(const [index,job] of plan.jobs.entries()){
  const source=sources.find(s=>s.id===job.id);if(!source)continue;
  const sheet=path.join(out,'sheets',job.id+'-v1.png');
  if(!fs.existsSync(sheet))fs.copyFileSync(source.source,sheet);
  const meta=await sharp(sheet).metadata();if(!meta.hasAlpha)throw Error('Missing alpha: '+job.id);
  const [cols,rows]=job.grid,cells=[];
  const sheetRaw=await sharp(sheet).ensureAlpha().raw().toBuffer(),bands=[];
  let start=-1,gap=0;
  for(let y=0;y<meta.height;y++){
   let occupied=0;for(let x=0;x<meta.width;x++)if(sheetRaw[(y*meta.width+x)*4+3]>24)occupied++;
   if(occupied>3){if(start<0)start=y;gap=0;}else if(start>=0&&++gap>=6){bands.push({start,end:y-gap});start=-1;gap=0;}
  }
  if(start>=0)bands.push({start,end:meta.height-1});
  const expectedRows=Math.ceil(job.frames.length/cols),useBands=bands.length===expectedRows;
  const rowEdges=useBands?[0,...bands.slice(1).map((b,i)=>Math.floor((bands[i].end+b.start)/2)),meta.height]:Array.from({length:rows+1},(_,i)=>Math.round(i*meta.height/rows));
````

````cjs
const fs = require('node:fs');

const root = path.resolve(__dirname, '../assets/battle/motions/single55');
(async () => {

  for (const file of ['eojil/skill-1-hit-1.png', 'eojil/hurt.png']) {
    const {data, info} = await sharp(path.join(root, file)).ensureAlpha().raw().toBuffer({resolveWithObject: true});
    let clear = 0, visible = 0, minX = info.width, minY = info.height, maxX = -1, maxY = -1;
    for (let y = 0; y < info.height; y++) for (let x = 0; x < info.width; x++) {
      const alpha = data[(y * info.width + x) * 4 + 3];
      if (!alpha) clear++;
      if (alpha >= 128) {visible++; minX = Math.min(minX, x); minY = Math.min(minY, y); maxX = Math.max(maxX, x); maxY = Math.max(maxY, y);}
    }
    assert.equal(info.width, 1086); assert.equal(info.height, 1448);
    assert.ok(clear > info.width * info.height * .1); assert.ok(visible > 100000);
    records.push({file, nativeSize: [info.width, info.height], transparentPixels: clear, visibleBounds: [minX, minY, maxX, maxY], anatomyVerifiedByThisTest: false});
  }
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(root, 'validation.json'), JSON.stringify({kind: 'native PNG and alpha checks only', records}, null, 2) + '\n');
````

## C225. 이루다 소설/버츄얼 아바타/이루겠네/build_aligned_source.py

원본: `이루다 소설/버츄얼 아바타/이루겠네/build_aligned_source.py` / 15,382 bytes / SHA-256 `c79198a284bc62f89343e28c36bbdc9e5a0e4b98690eaf63799db6868ea8a31d`

````py
"""Build coordinate-locked source layers from the approved front illustration.

Every visible pixel comes from the same master image. Masks partition that image
without rescaling it, so a zero-offset composite is pixel-identical to the art.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import struct
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
MASTER = ROOT / "이루겠네_정면.png"
OUT = ROOT / "aligned_source"
LAYERS = OUT / "layers"
W, H = 1024, 1536


def polygon(points: list[tuple[int, int]]) -> np.ndarray:
    image = Image.new("L", (W, H))
    ImageDraw.Draw(image).polygon(points, fill=255)
    return np.asarray(image) > 0


def ellipse(box: tuple[int, int, int, int]) -> np.ndarray:
    image = Image.new("L", (W, H))
    ImageDraw.Draw(image).ellipse(box, fill=255)
    return np.asarray(image) > 0


def box(rect: tuple[int, int, int, int]) -> np.ndarray:
    image = Image.new("L", (W, H))
    ImageDraw.Draw(image).rectangle(rect, fill=255)
    return np.asarray(image) > 0


def save_layer(name: str, pixels: np.ndarray, mask: np.ndarray) -> None:
    layer = pixels.copy()
    layer[~mask] = 0
    Image.fromarray(layer, "RGBA").save(LAYERS / f"{name}.png", optimize=True)


def main() -> None:
    OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    LAYERS.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    source = np.asarray(Image.open(MASTER).convert("RGBA")).copy()
    assert source.shape == (H, W, 4)
    alpha = source[:, :, 3]
    rgb = source[:, :, :3].astype(np.int16)
    y, x = np.indices((H, W))
    visible = alpha > 8
    # Very faint generated backdrop is not character paint. Keep the master
    # untouched as reference, but discard near-invisible fringe on rig layers.
    work = source.copy()
    work[~visible, 3] = 0

    # Pixel ownership is set back-to-front. Later regions take precedence.
    names: list[str] = []
    owner = np.zeros((H, W), dtype=np.uint8)

    def claim(name: str, region: np.ndarray) -> None:
        index = len(names)
        assert index < 255
        names.append(name)
        owner[region & visible] = index

    # Residual side silhouette is long hair, divided at the nape for independent sway.
    claim("00_back_hair_left", x < 512)
    claim("01_back_hair_right", x >= 512)

    # Boots and trousers. Coordinates are fixed against the full-size art.
    claim("02_left_boot", polygon([(351, 1144), (468, 1144), (475, 1310), (489, 1455), (473, 1495), (321, 1490), (335, 1412)]))
    claim("03_right_boot", polygon([(549, 1143), (666, 1142), (685, 1396), (711, 1492), (537, 1495), (528, 1438)]))
    claim("04_left_shin", polygon([(344, 812), (505, 814), (500, 1155), (471, 1206), (365, 1190), (332, 1095)]))
    claim("05_right_shin", polygon([(508, 811), (687, 812), (687, 1090), (664, 1198), (547, 1196), (516, 1111)]))
    claim("06_left_thigh", polygon([(362, 536), (528, 548), (529, 886), (481, 934), (330, 903), (268, 991), (279, 843)]))
    claim("07_right_thigh", polygon([(510, 541), (665, 534), (695, 935), (647, 964), (527, 937), (493, 794)]))

    # Main clothing; independent upper/lower arms and hands are placed above it.
    claim("08_torso_core", polygon([(349, 228), (439, 196), (458, 221), (557, 221), (578, 194), (681, 231), (694, 406), (654, 534), (376, 537), (330, 406)]))
    claim("09_waist_belt", polygon([(385, 502), (633, 502), (649, 558), (625, 577), (374, 570), (366, 537)]))
    claim("10_left_upper_arm", polygon([(348, 247), (431, 238), (416, 376), (394, 498), (376, 554), (284, 539), (295, 436), (305, 327)]))
    claim("11_right_upper_arm", polygon([(579, 233), (676, 245), (712, 338), (737, 481), (747, 540), (647, 560), (622, 469), (608, 350)]))
    claim("12_left_forearm", polygon([(287, 532), (371, 528), (365, 609), (346, 690), (265, 680), (272, 600)]))
    claim("13_right_forearm", polygon([(650, 529), (741, 532), (758, 680), (676, 691), (657, 606)]))
    claim("14_left_hand", polygon([(259, 630), (344, 626), (351, 729), (329, 803), (278, 793), (249, 719)]))
    claim("15_right_hand", polygon([(675, 628), (762, 629), (779, 718), (751, 799), (695, 801), (670, 731)]))

    # Small independent props; names and grouping are Cubism-friendly.
    claim("16_left_sleeve_emblem", ellipse((317, 319, 396, 411)))
    claim("17_chest_medals", polygon([(555, 298), (624, 299), (641, 481), (568, 481), (550, 387)]))
    claim("18_necktie", polygon([(490, 278), (535, 279), (547, 356), (538, 498), (513, 509), (486, 492), (486, 368)]))
    charm_region = polygon([(397, 539), (478, 540), (477, 744), (406, 744)])
    warm = (rgb[:, :, 0] > rgb[:, :, 1] * 1.25) & (rgb[:, :, 0] > 90)
    golden = (rgb[:, :, 0] > 125) & (rgb[:, :, 1] > 85) & (rgb[:, :, 2] < 120)
    claim("19_left_hip_charm", charm_region & (warm | golden))
    claim("20_right_leg_strap", polygon([(579, 541), (617, 539), (643, 688), (664, 798), (683, 961), (651, 960), (622, 809), (606, 671)]))

    # Skin, expression and hair; eyes/mouth override the underlying face.
    claim("21_neck", polygon([(475, 172), (551, 171), (565, 279), (458, 280)]))
    claim("22_face_base", polygon([(465, 105), (495, 107), (538, 105), (563, 121), (568, 167), (548, 194), (517, 207), (483, 194), (458, 165), (454, 134)]))
    claim("23_left_brow", ellipse((469, 104, 505, 121)))
    claim("24_right_brow", ellipse((522, 104, 559, 121)))
    claim("25_left_eye_open", ellipse((464, 114, 510, 149)))
    claim("26_right_eye_open", ellipse((518, 114, 563, 149)))
    claim("27_mouth_closed", ellipse((489, 151, 540, 180)))

    # Hair locks in front of the uniform are selected by pale color inside
    # deliberate shape envelopes. This avoids accidentally taking dark fabric.
    pale = (np.min(source[:, :, :3], axis=2) > 109) & (
        np.max(source[:, :, :3], axis=2) - np.min(source[:, :, :3], axis=2) < 70
    )
    left_locks = polygon([(434, 117), (479, 170), (481, 302), (475, 423), (449, 477), (390, 435), (378, 343)])
    right_locks = polygon([(548, 116), (599, 139), (689, 337), (704, 474), (652, 452), (570, 334), (543, 216)])
    claim("28_front_lock_left", left_locks & pale)
    claim("29_front_lock_right", right_locks & pale)

    # Crown is split into two deformable sections; the short central bangs
    # receive their own layer so they may move without stretching the face.
    crown_left = polygon([(496, 11), (402, 23), (374, 85), (388, 167), (454, 174), (492, 111)])
    crown_right = polygon([(496, 9), (569, 20), (619, 93), (594, 178), (550, 169), (499, 112)])
    bangs = polygon([(427, 62), (565, 61), (583, 133), (561, 155), (536, 129), (515, 153), (492, 125), (465, 157), (434, 137)])
    claim("30_crown_left", crown_left & pale)
    claim("31_crown_right", crown_right & pale)
    claim("32_bangs", bangs & pale)

    # The red ribbon is color-isolated from the white hair behind it.
    red = (rgb[:, :, 0] > rgb[:, :, 1] * 1.45) & (rgb[:, :, 0] > rgb[:, :, 2] * 1.35)
    ribbon = polygon([(160, 143), (443, 142), (479, 210), (365, 272), (312, 540), (142, 380)])
    ribbon &= (x < 325) | (y < 267)
    claim("33_red_ribbon", ribbon & red)

    # Preserve exact source RGBA at rest. The first layer is a tiny unassigned
    # fallback (mainly alpha fringe), so no visible source pixel is omitted.
    ordered = []
    for index, name in enumerate(names):
        mask = (owner == index) & visible
        save_layer(name, work, mask)
        ys, xs = np.nonzero(mask)
        bounds = [int(xs.min()), int(ys.min()), int(xs.max() + 1), int(ys.max() + 1)] if len(xs) else None
        ordered.append({"name": name, "file": f"layers/{name}.png", "bounds": bounds, "x": 0, "y": 0})

    # Hidden paint is intentionally not visible in the default composite.
    # It covers cutouts revealed by small eye or arm motion in Cubism.
    face_fill = Image.new("RGBA", (W, H))
    fill = ImageDraw.Draw(face_fill)
    fill.ellipse((464, 109, 565, 181), fill=(246, 211, 208, 255))
    face_fill.save(LAYERS / "hidden_face_skin.png")
    shirt_fill = Image.new("RGBA", (W, H))
    fill = ImageDraw.Draw(shirt_fill)
    fill.polygon([(336, 244), (688, 243), (688, 558), (344, 558)], fill=(37, 36, 39, 255))
    shirt_fill.save(LAYERS / "hidden_shirt_under_arms.png")
    neck_fill = Image.new("RGBA", (W, H))
    fill = ImageDraw.Draw(neck_fill)
    fill.polygon([(481, 177), (548, 177), (558, 272), (467, 271)], fill=(246, 212, 208, 255))
    neck_fill.save(LAYERS / "hidden_neck_under_head.png")

    # Eye and mouth alternates are separate, hand-restorable overlays. The
    # closed-eye art is a conservative manual paint on transparent canvas.
    alternates = Image.new("RGBA", (W, H))
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(alternates)
    d.arc((469, 118, 506, 136), 5, 165, fill=(107, 41, 47, 255), width=3)
    d.arc((521, 118, 558, 136), 5, 165, fill=(107, 41, 47, 255), width=3)
    alternates.save(LAYERS / "alt_eyes_closed.png")
    mouth = Image.new("RGBA", (W, H))
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(mouth)
    d.ellipse((501, 157, 526, 171), fill=(127, 49, 55, 255))
    d.arc((500, 154, 527, 172), 180, 358, fill=(234, 159, 157, 255), width=2)
    mouth.save(LAYERS / "alt_mouth_open.png")

    # ORA is a genuinely layered, editable open image. It opens in Krita and
    # GIMP, where PSD export can be done without changing the common origin.
    stack = ET.Element("image", {"version": "0.0.3", "w": str(W), "h": str(H), "name": "이루겠네 정면 Live2D 원화"})
    layer_stack = ET.SubElement(stack, "stack")
    hidden_files = ["alt_eyes_closed.png", "alt_mouth_open.png", "hidden_face_skin.png", "hidden_shirt_under_arms.png", "hidden_neck_under_head.png"]
    hidden_entries = [{"name": Path(filename).stem, "file": "layers/" + filename, "hidden": True} for filename in hidden_files]
    turn_names = ["body_without_head.png"]
    for direction, degrees in (("left", 60), ("right", 60), ("up", 25), ("down", 25)):
        turn_names.extend([f"head_{direction}_{degrees}.png", f"head_{direction}_back_hair.png", f"head_{direction}_face_bangs_neck.png"])
    turn_entries = [{"name": "turn_" + Path(filename).stem, "file": "head_turn/" + filename, "hidden": True}
                    for filename in turn_names if (OUT / "head_turn" / filename).exists()]
    hidden_entries.extend(turn_entries)
    for entry in reversed(ordered + hidden_entries):
        ET.SubElement(layer_stack, "layer", {"name": entry["name"], "src": "data/" + Path(entry["file"]).name, "x": "0", "y": "0", "opacity": "1.0", "visibility": "hidden" if entry.get("hidden") else "visible", "composite-op": "svg:src-over"})
    with zipfile.ZipFile(OUT / "이루겠네_정렬원화.ora", "w") as archive:
        archive.writestr("mimetype", "image/openraster", compress_type=zipfile.ZIP_STORED)
        archive.writestr("stack.xml", ET.tostring(stack, encoding="utf-8"))
        for entry in ordered + hidden_entries:
            archive.write(OUT / entry["file"], "data/" + Path(entry["file"]).name, compress_type=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED)
        archive.write(MASTER, "mergedimage.png", compress_type=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED)

    # A flattened round-trip is checked against the source; no crop or scale.
    composite = np.zeros_like(work)
    for entry in ordered:
        part = np.asarray(Image.open(OUT / entry["file"]).convert("RGBA"))
        occupied = part[:, :, 3] > 0
        composite[occupied] = part[occupied]
    Image.fromarray(composite, "RGBA").save(OUT / "이루겠네_레이어합성.png", optimize=True)
    diff = np.abs(composite.astype(np.int16) - work.astype(np.int16))
    max_diff = int(diff[visible].max())
    assert max_diff == 0, f"visible-pixel mismatch: {max_diff}"
    manifest = {"canvas": [W, H], "source": MASTER.name, "layers_back_to_front": ordered,
                "alternates": ["layers/alt_eyes_closed.png", "layers/alt_mouth_open.png"],
                "hidden_paint": ["layers/hidden_face_skin.png", "layers/hidden_shirt_under_arms.png", "layers/hidden_neck_under_head.png"],
                "head_turn_alternates": [entry["file"] for entry in turn_entries],
                "pixel_round_trip_max_difference": max_diff}
    (OUT / "layers.json").write_text(json.dumps(manifest, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    (OUT / "layers.js").write_text("window.ALIGNED_LAYERS = " + json.dumps(ordered, ensure_ascii=False) + ";\n", encoding="utf-8")
    write_psd(OUT / "이루겠네_정렬원화.psd", ordered + hidden_entries, composite)
    print(f"{len(ordered)} aligned layers; maximum pixel difference {max_diff}; {OUT}")


def packbits_row(row: memoryview) -> bytes:
    output = bytearray()
    position = 0
    width = len(row)
    while position < width:
        run = 1
        while position + run < width and run < 128 and row[position + run] == row[position]:
            run += 1
        if run >= 3:
            output.extend((257 - run, row[position]))
            position += run
            continue
        start = position
        position += run
        while position < width and position - start < 128:
            run = 1
            while position + run < width and run < 128 and row[position + run] == row[position]:
                run += 1
            if run >= 3 or position + run - start > 128:
                break
            position += run
        output.append(position - start - 1)
        output.extend(row[start:position])
    return bytes(output)


def rle_channel(plane: np.ndarray) -> bytes:
    lengths = bytearray()
    body = bytearray()
    for row in plane:
        encoded = packbits_row(memoryview(np.ascontiguousarray(row)))
        lengths += struct.pack(">H", len(encoded))
        body += encoded
    return struct.pack(">H", 1) + lengths + body


def write_psd(path: Path, entries: list[dict], composite: np.ndarray) -> None:
    """Write 8-bit RGBA layered PSD with PackBits-compressed channel planes."""
    def be32(value: int) -> bytes:
        return struct.pack(">I", value)

    def be16(value: int) -> bytes:
        return struct.pack(">H", value)

    records = bytearray()
    channel_data = bytearray()
    for entry in reversed(entries):  # Photoshop records topmost first.
        layer = np.asarray(Image.open(OUT / entry["file"]).convert("RGBA"))
        compressed = [rle_channel(layer[:, :, channel]) for channel in range(4)]
        records += struct.pack(">iiiiH", 0, 0, H, W, 4)
        for channel, data in zip([0, 1, 2, -1], compressed):
            records += struct.pack(">hI", channel, len(data))
        records += b"8BIMnorm" + bytes((255, 0, 2 if entry.get("hidden") else 0, 0))
        label = entry["name"].encode("ascii")[:255]
        pascal = bytes([len(label)]) + label
        pascal += b"\0" * ((-len(pascal)) % 4)
        extra = be32(0) + be32(0) + pascal
        records += be32(len(extra)) + extra
        for data in compressed:
            channel_data += data
    layer_info = struct.pack(">h", len(entries)) + records + channel_data
    layer_mask = be32(len(layer_info)) + layer_info + be32(0)
    header = b"8BPS" + be16(1) + b"\0" * 6 + be16(4) + be32(H) + be32(W) + be16(8) + be16(3)
    merged = be16(0)
    for channel in range(4):
        merged += np.ascontiguousarray(composite[:, :, channel]).tobytes()
    with path.open("wb") as stream:
        stream.write(header + be32(0) + be32(0) + be32(len(layer_mask)) + layer_mask + merged)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
````

## C226. 이루다 소설/버츄얼 아바타/이루겠네/build_head_turns.py

원본: `이루다 소설/버츄얼 아바타/이루겠네/build_head_turns.py` / 5,660 bytes / SHA-256 `f3b622bf2f3b303fc0f076fd051d362d45a99b0bcf7f57a28bfebe37ed6fd8c7`

````py
"""Assemble large-yaw head keyframes on the fixed front-art canvas.

The generated turnaround art supplies *newly visible* side geometry. Everything
below the collar remains the approved front illustration.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFilter


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ALIGNED = ROOT / "aligned_source"
OUT = ALIGNED / "head_turn"
W, H = 1024, 1536


def head_mask() -> Image.Image:
    mask = Image.new("L", (W, H))
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(mask)
    # Hair, face, ear and the neck down to the collar. Broad at the crown,
    # narrowing between the shoulders to leave the original uniform intact.
    draw.polygon(
        [(350, 0), (682, 0), (684, 111), (671, 170), (645, 210),
         (616, 238), (564, 257), (554, 283), (468, 283),
         (457, 254), (401, 235), (366, 193), (342, 138)],
        fill=255,
    )
    return mask.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(5))


def alpha_multiply(image: Image.Image, mask: Image.Image) -> Image.Image:
    result = image.copy()
    original_alpha = np.asarray(image.getchannel("A"), dtype=np.uint16)
    mask_alpha = np.asarray(mask, dtype=np.uint16)
    result.putalpha(Image.fromarray(((original_alpha * mask_alpha + 127) // 255).astype("uint8"), "L"))
    return result


def main() -> None:
    front = Image.open(ROOT / "이루겠네_정면.png").convert("RGBA")
    assert front.size == (W, H)
    mask = head_mask()
    headless = alpha_multiply(front, Image.eval(mask, lambda value: 255 - value))
    headless.save(OUT / "body_without_head.png", optimize=True)
    mask.save(OUT / "head_swap_mask.png", optimize=True)

    angles = {"left": {"yaw": -60, "pitch": 0}, "right": {"yaw": 60, "pitch": 0},
              "up": {"yaw": 0, "pitch": 25}, "down": {"yaw": 0, "pitch": -25}}
    manifest = {"canvas": [W, H], "angles": angles,
                "anchor_chin_front": [515, 194], "anchor_collar": [512, 270],
                "headless_body": "body_without_head.png", "turns": {}}

    for direction in angles:
        painted = Image.open(OUT / f"head_{direction}_full.png").convert("RGBA")
        assert painted.size == (W, H)
        turn = alpha_multiply(painted, mask)
        degrees = 60 if direction in ("left", "right") else 25
        turn_name = f"head_{direction}_{degrees}.png"
        preview_name = f"preview_{direction}_{degrees}.png"
        turn.save(OUT / turn_name, optimize=True)

        # Rigging helpers: split the turn art into the scalp/hair back section
        # and the visible face/ear/neck + bangs section. The full turn remains
        # the seam-free source of truth for the keyframe.
        back_mask = Image.new("L", (W, H))
        d = ImageDraw.Draw(back_mask)
        if direction == "left":
            d.polygon([(475, 0), (682, 0), (672, 202), (597, 253), (530, 248), (508, 185)], fill=255)
        elif direction == "right":
            d.polygon([(350, 0), (548, 0), (514, 183), (499, 249), (425, 255), (355, 195)], fill=255)
        else:
            d.polygon([(350, 0), (682, 0), (681, 86), (620, 117), (405, 118), (351, 90)], fill=255)
        back = alpha_multiply(turn, back_mask)
        front_mask = Image.eval(back_mask, lambda value: 255 - value)
        face = alpha_multiply(turn, front_mask)
        split_rebuilt = back.copy()
        split_rebuilt.alpha_composite(face)
        visible_turn = np.asarray(turn.getchannel("A")) > 0
        assert np.array_equal(np.asarray(split_rebuilt)[visible_turn], np.asarray(turn)[visible_turn]), direction
        back.save(OUT / f"head_{direction}_back_hair.png", optimize=True)
        face.save(OUT / f"head_{direction}_face_bangs_neck.png", optimize=True)

        composite = headless.copy()
        composite.alpha_composite(turn)
        composite.save(OUT / preview_name, optimize=True)
        manifest["turns"][direction] = {
            "head": turn_name,
            "back_hair": f"head_{direction}_back_hair.png",
            "face_bangs_neck": f"head_{direction}_face_bangs_neck.png",
            "preview": preview_name,
            "source_full": f"head_{direction}_full.png",
        }

    # Inspect transparency against a flat color rather than relying on PNG
    # viewers that may display RGB values of fully transparent pixels.
    panel = Image.new("RGB", (2100, 440), (28, 30, 35))
    for index, (label, image) in enumerate([
        ("front", front),
        ("left", Image.open(OUT / "preview_left_60.png").convert("RGBA")),
        ("right", Image.open(OUT / "preview_right_60.png").convert("RGBA")),
        ("up", Image.open(OUT / "preview_up_25.png").convert("RGBA")),
        ("down", Image.open(OUT / "preview_down_25.png").convert("RGBA")),
    ]):
        crop = image.crop((302, 0, 722, 400))
        pane = Image.new("RGBA", crop.size, (28, 30, 35, 255))
        pane.alpha_composite(crop)
        panel.paste(pane.convert("RGB"), (index * 420, 25))
        ImageDraw.Draw(panel).text((index * 420 + 12, 5), label, fill=(235, 235, 235))
    panel.save(OUT / "head_turn_contact.png", optimize=True)

    front.crop((280, 0, 744, 520)).save(OUT / "bust_front.png", optimize=True)
    for direction, degrees in (("left", 60), ("right", 60), ("up", 25), ("down", 25)):
        Image.open(OUT / f"preview_{direction}_{degrees}.png").crop((280, 0, 744, 520)).save(
            OUT / f"bust_{direction}.png", optimize=True
        )

    (OUT / "head_turns.json").write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8")
    print("Built four head-angle layers and fixed-canvas previews")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
````

원본: `이루다 소설/버츄얼 아바타/이루겠네/rig.js` / 4,928 bytes / SHA-256 `eb542802c9e7b514ad88baa4b0f73bed7704ea645065a20ea20a080af10eb23d`

````js
(async () => {
  const rig = await (await fetch('rig.json')).json();
  const image = new Image();
  image.src = rig.texture;
  await image.decode();
  const canvas = document.getElementById('avatar');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const sliders = Object.fromEntries(['headX', 'headY', 'bodyX', 'hair'].map(key => [key, document.getElementById(key)]));
  let autoplay = true;
  let pointer = { x: 0, y: 0, inside: false };
  document.getElementById('autoplay').onclick = event => {
    autoplay = !autoplay;
    event.currentTarget.textContent = autoplay ? '자동 움직임 끄기' : '자동 움직임 켜기';
  };
  canvas.addEventListener('pointermove', event => {
    const box = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    pointer = { x: ((event.clientX - box.left) / box.width - 0.5) * 2,
      y: ((event.clientY - box.top) / box.height - 0.5) * 2, inside: true };
  });
  canvas.addEventListener('pointerleave', () => { pointer.inside = false; });

  const W = rig.canvas.width, H = rig.canvas.height;
  const nx = rig.mesh.columns, ny = rig.mesh.rows;
  const clamp = (v, a, b) => Math.max(a, Math.min(b, v));
  const smooth = (a, b, v) => { const t = clamp((v - a) / (b - a), 0, 1); return t * t * (3 - 2 * t); };
  const rotate = (x, y, px, py, angle) => {
    const s = Math.sin(angle), c = Math.cos(angle);
    return [px + (x - px) * c - (y - py) * s, py + (x - px) * s + (y - py) * c];
  };
  function vertex(x, y, p) {
    const torsoWeight = 1 - smooth(480, 1450, y);
    const neckWeight = 1 - smooth(225, 315, y);
    let [dx, dy] = rotate(x, y, 512, 530, p.bodyX * 0.055 * torsoWeight);
    [dx, dy] = rotate(dx, dy, 512, 238, p.headX * 0.13 * neckWeight);
    dx += p.headX * 14 * neckWeight;
    dy += p.headY * 10 * neckWeight;
    dy += (y - 238) * p.headY * 0.045 * neckWeight;
    const hairRegion = smooth(380, 475, Math.abs(x - 512)) * (1 - smooth(760, 1120, y)) * smooth(130, 350, y);
    dx += p.hair * 29 * hairRegion;
    dy += Math.sin((y / 130) + p.time * 2.5) * 4 * hairRegion;
    const chest = smooth(280, 410, y) * (1 - smooth(480, 670, y));
    dx += (x - 512) * chest * p.breath * 0.012;
    dy -= chest * p.breath * 3;
    return [dx, dy];
  }
  function triangle(src, dst) {
    const [a, b, c] = src, [d, e, f] = dst;
    const det = (b[0]-a[0])*(c[1]-a[1])-(c[0]-a[0])*(b[1]-a[1]);
    if (Math.abs(det) < 1e-6) return;
    const m00 = ((e[0]-d[0])*(c[1]-a[1])-(f[0]-d[0])*(b[1]-a[1]))/det;
    const m01 = ((f[0]-d[0])*(b[0]-a[0])-(e[0]-d[0])*(c[0]-a[0]))/det;
    const m10 = ((e[1]-d[1])*(c[1]-a[1])-(f[1]-d[1])*(b[1]-a[1]))/det;
    const m11 = ((f[1]-d[1])*(b[0]-a[0])-(e[1]-d[1])*(c[0]-a[0]))/det;
    const tx = d[0]-m00*a[0]-m01*a[1], ty = d[1]-m10*a[0]-m11*a[1];
    ctx.save();
    const cx = (d[0] + e[0] + f[0]) / 3, cy = (d[1] + e[1] + f[1]) / 3;
    const expand = point => {
      const vx = point[0] - cx, vy = point[1] - cy;
      const scale = 1 + 1.5 / Math.max(1, Math.hypot(vx, vy));
      return [cx + vx * scale, cy + vy * scale];
    };
    const [dd, ee, ff] = [d, e, f].map(expand);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(dd[0], dd[1]); ctx.lineTo(ee[0], ee[1]); ctx.lineTo(ff[0], ff[1]); ctx.closePath(); ctx.clip();
    ctx.setTransform(m00, m10, m01, m11, tx, ty);
    const minX = Math.floor(Math.min(a[0], b[0], c[0]));
    const minY = Math.floor(Math.min(a[1], b[1], c[1]));
    const maxX = Math.ceil(Math.max(a[0], b[0], c[0]));
    const maxY = Math.ceil(Math.max(a[1], b[1], c[1]));
    ctx.drawImage(image, minX, minY, maxX - minX, maxY - minY,
      minX, minY, maxX - minX, maxY - minY);
    ctx.restore();
  }
  function frame(now) {
    const time = now / 1000;
    const input = key => Number(sliders[key].value);
    const follow = pointer.inside ? pointer.x : Math.sin(time * 0.65) * 0.4;
    const followY = pointer.inside ? pointer.y : Math.sin(time * 0.42) * 0.2;
    const p = { headX: clamp(input('headX') + (autoplay ? follow * 0.5 : 0), -1, 1),
      headY: clamp(input('headY') + (autoplay ? followY * 0.35 : 0), -1, 1),
      bodyX: clamp(input('bodyX') + (autoplay ? follow * 0.17 : 0), -1, 1),
      hair: clamp(input('hair') + (autoplay ? Math.sin(time * 1.2) * 0.35 : 0), -1, 1),
      breath: autoplay ? (Math.sin(time * 1.9) + 1) / 2 : 0, time };
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
    const points = Array.from({length: ny+1}, (_, j) => Array.from({length: nx+1}, (_, i) => {
      const x = i * W / nx, y = j * H / ny;
      return {src:[x,y],dst:vertex(x,y,p)};
    }));
    for (let j=0;j<ny;j++) for(let i=0;i<nx;i++) {
      const a=points[j][i], b=points[j][i+1], c=points[j+1][i], d=points[j+1][i+1];
      triangle([a.src,b.src,c.src],[a.dst,b.dst,c.dst]);
      triangle([b.src,d.src,c.src],[b.dst,d.dst,c.dst]);
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
})().catch(error => { document.body.insertAdjacentText('beforeend', '모델을 불러오지 못했습니다: ' + error.message); });
````

## C232. 이루다 소설/버츄얼 아바타/이루겠네/aligned_source/preview.html

원본: `이루다 소설/버츄얼 아바타/이루겠네/aligned_source/preview.html` / 9,424 bytes / SHA-256 `0223b2aad865c1a68323aba168de0fa8723c9b7c513466cb97ea08b1314ae90c`

````html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="ko">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>이루겠네 | 정렬 원화</title>
  <style>
    * { box-sizing: border-box; }
    body { margin: 0; font-family: "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif; color: #eee; background: #15171b; }
    header { height: 58px; padding: 11px 20px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 18px; border-bottom: 1px solid #3a3c42; }
    h1 { font-size: 18px; margin: 0; }
    small { color: #aaa; }
    main { height: calc(100vh - 58px); min-height: 520px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(420px,1fr) 350px; }
    .workspace { min-width: 0; overflow: auto; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; padding: 16px; }
    canvas { display: block; width: auto; max-width: 100%; height: min(calc(100vh - 90px), 900px); max-height: 100%; aspect-ratio: 2/3; border: 1px solid #595d64; cursor: grab; background: #666; }
    canvas.dragging { cursor: grabbing; }
    aside { border-left: 1px solid #3a3c42; display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-height: 0; }
    .tools { padding: 15px; border-bottom: 1px solid #3a3c42; display: grid; gap: 10px; }
    .row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
    .row label { font-size: 12px; color: #bfc3c8; min-width: 55px; }
    button, input { font: inherit; }
    button { background: #2c333b; color: #fff; border: 1px solid #59616b; border-radius: 4px; padding: 7px 10px; cursor: pointer; }
    button:hover { background: #3c454f; }
    button:focus-visible, input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e6bd73; }
    input[type=number] { width: 70px; background: #24282e; color: #fff; border: 1px solid #60636a; border-radius: 3px; padding: 5px; }
    input[type=range] { flex: 1; accent-color: #dfbd79; }
    .tools strong { font-size: 13px; color: #e8c37d; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
    .layers { overflow: auto; padding: 8px; flex: 1; }
    .layer { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 25px 1fr auto; align-items: center; min-height: 34px; gap: 5px; padding: 3px 6px; border: 1px solid transparent; font-size: 12px; }
    .layer.selected { border-color: #b68b4c; background: #303137; }
    .layer .name { cursor: pointer; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
    .layer .offset { color: #9ca3aa; font-family: monospace; font-size: 11px; }
    .footer { border-top: 1px solid #3a3c42; padding: 10px 15px; color: #aaa; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.5; }
    @media (max-width: 860px) { main { grid-template-columns: 1fr; grid-template-rows: minmax(350px, 65vh) 1fr; height: auto; } aside { min-height: 380px; border-left: 0; border-top: 1px solid #3a3c42; } canvas { height: min(60vh, 650px); } }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <header><h1>이루겠네 · 정렬 원화</h1><small>1024 × 1536 · 34개 파츠 · 원화 기준 좌표</small><a href="head_turn/preview.html" style="margin-left:auto;color:#e7c889">고개 회전 원화</a></header>
  <main>
    <section class="workspace"><canvas id="stage" width="1024" height="1536" aria-label="분리 원화 미리보기"></canvas></section>
    <aside>
      <div class="tools">
        <strong id="selectedName">파츠를 선택하세요</strong>
        <div class="row"><label for="offsetX">위치 X</label><input id="offsetX" type="number" step="1"><label for="offsetY">Y</label><input id="offsetY" type="number" step="1"></div>
        <div class="row"><label for="reference">원본 비교</label><input id="reference" type="range" min="0" max="100" value="0"><output id="referenceValue">0%</output></div>
        <div class="row"><button id="reset">위치 초기화</button><button id="export">정렬값 저장</button></div>
      </div>
      <div class="layers" id="layers"></div>
      <div class="footer">파츠 이름을 누르고 그림 위에서 끌거나 방향키로 1px씩 조정할 수 있습니다. Shift+방향키는 10px입니다. 원본 비교는 정렬 상태를 확인할 때 사용하세요.</div>
    </aside>
  </main>
  <script src="layers.js"></script>
  <script>
    const canvas = document.querySelector('#stage');
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    const entries = window.ALIGNED_LAYERS.map((entry) => ({ ...entry, image: new Image(), visible: true, dx: 0, dy: 0 }));
    const original = new Image();
    original.src = '../이루겠네_정면.png';
    let selected = -1;
    let drag = null;
    const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('eogetne_alignment') || '{}');
    for (const entry of entries) {
      entry.image.src = entry.file;
      entry.image.onload = render;
      if (saved[entry.name]) { entry.dx = saved[entry.name].x || 0; entry.dy = saved[entry.name].y || 0; }
    }
    original.onload = render;
    const layerList = document.querySelector('#layers');
    function rowFor(entry, index) {
      const row = document.createElement('div'); row.className = 'layer'; row.dataset.index = index;
      const check = document.createElement('input'); check.type = 'checkbox'; check.checked = true;
      check.addEventListener('change', () => { entry.visible = check.checked; render(); });
      const name = document.createElement('span'); name.className = 'name'; name.textContent = entry.name;
      name.addEventListener('click', () => select(index));
      const offset = document.createElement('span'); offset.className = 'offset'; offset.textContent = '0, 0';
      row.append(check, name, offset); return row;
    }
    entries.forEach((entry, index) => layerList.prepend(rowFor(entry, index)));
    function select(index) {
      selected = index;
      for (const row of layerList.children) row.classList.toggle('selected', Number(row.dataset.index) === selected);
      document.querySelector('#selectedName').textContent = entries[index].name;
      syncInputs();
    }
    function syncInputs() {
      if (selected < 0) return;
      document.querySelector('#offsetX').value = entries[selected].dx;
      document.querySelector('#offsetY').value = entries[selected].dy;
      const row = layerList.querySelector(`[data-index="${selected}"]`);
      row.querySelector('.offset').textContent = `${entries[selected].dx}, ${entries[selected].dy}`;
    }
    function persist() {
      const offsets = Object.fromEntries(entries.map((entry) => [entry.name, { x: entry.dx, y: entry.dy }]));
      localStorage.setItem('eogetne_alignment', JSON.stringify(offsets));
      syncInputs(); render(); return offsets;
    }
    function render() {
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, 1024, 1536);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#44474e'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 1024, 1536);
      for (const entry of entries) if (entry.visible && entry.image.complete && entry.image.naturalWidth) ctx.drawImage(entry.image, entry.dx, entry.dy);
      const value = Number(document.querySelector('#reference').value) / 100;
      if (value && original.complete && original.naturalWidth) { ctx.globalAlpha = value; ctx.drawImage(original, 0, 0); ctx.globalAlpha = 1; }
    }
    function setOffset(axis, value) { if (selected < 0) return; entries[selected][axis] = Number(value) || 0; persist(); }
    document.querySelector('#offsetX').addEventListener('input', (event) => setOffset('dx', event.target.value));
    document.querySelector('#offsetY').addEventListener('input', (event) => setOffset('dy', event.target.value));
    document.querySelector('#reference').addEventListener('input', (event) => { document.querySelector('#referenceValue').textContent = `${event.target.value}%`; render(); });
    document.querySelector('#reset').addEventListener('click', () => { for (const entry of entries) { entry.dx = 0; entry.dy = 0; } localStorage.removeItem('eogetne_alignment'); for (const row of layerList.children) row.querySelector('.offset').textContent = '0, 0'; syncInputs(); render(); });
    document.querySelector('#export').addEventListener('click', () => { const data = JSON.stringify(persist(), null, 2); const link = document.createElement('a'); link.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([data], {type: 'application/json'})); link.download = '이루겠네_정렬값.json'; link.click(); URL.revokeObjectURL(link.href); });
    function canvasPoint(event) { const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect(); return {x: (event.clientX - rect.left) * 1024 / rect.width, y: (event.clientY - rect.top) * 1536 / rect.height}; }
    canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', (event) => { if (selected < 0) return; const p = canvasPoint(event); drag = { x: p.x, y: p.y, dx: entries[selected].dx, dy: entries[selected].dy }; canvas.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId); canvas.classList.add('dragging'); });
    canvas.addEventListener('pointermove', (event) => { if (!drag || selected < 0) return; const p = canvasPoint(event); entries[selected].dx = Math.round(drag.dx + p.x - drag.x); entries[selected].dy = Math.round(drag.dy + p.y - drag.y); syncInputs(); render(); });
    canvas.addEventListener('pointerup', () => { if (drag) persist(); drag = null; canvas.classList.remove('dragging'); });
    document.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => { if (selected < 0 || event.target.matches('input')) return; const step = event.shiftKey ? 10 : 1; const move = {ArrowLeft: [-step,0], ArrowRight: [step,0], ArrowUp: [0,-step], ArrowDown: [0,step]}[event.key]; if (!move) return; event.preventDefault(); entries[selected].dx += move[0]; entries[selected].dy += move[1]; persist(); });
    select(entries.length - 1);
    render();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
````

````html
      right: ['preview_right_60.png', 'bust_right.png', '얼굴이 화면 오른쪽을 향합니다. 귀와 옆머리, 목 옆면이 드러납니다.'],
      up: ['preview_up_25.png', 'bust_up.png', '턱 아래와 목 앞면이 드러납니다.'],

      document.querySelector('#info').textContent = poses[pose][2];
      for (const button of document.querySelectorAll('[data-pose]')) button.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(button.dataset.pose === pose));
    }
    for (const button of document.querySelectorAll('[data-pose]')) button.addEventListener('click', () => choose(button.dataset.pose));
    for (const button of document.querySelectorAll('[data-view]')) button.addEventListener('click', () => {
      currentView = button.dataset.view;
      for (const option of document.querySelectorAll('[data-view]')) option.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(option === button));
      choose(currentPose);
    });
````

## C235. 이루다 소설/버츄얼 아바타/이루겠네/head_rig/build.py

원본: `이루다 소설/버츄얼 아바타/이루겠네/head_rig/build.py` / 7,726 bytes / SHA-256 `c7920dbf1ab5aef94d6e242e73a68c4fbf9c72d30a2b7ad9935ab35026765c3f`

````py
"""Align painted avatar layers on one canvas and export editable artwork."""

from __future__ import annotations

import importlib.util
import json
import struct
import sys
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageCms


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
SOURCE = ROOT / "source"
LAYERS = ROOT / "layers"
BASE_SIZE = (1024, 1536)
SCALE = 3
SIZE = tuple(value * SCALE for value in BASE_SIZE)


def psd_resource(resource_id: int, data: bytes) -> bytes:
    name = b"\0\0"  # Empty Pascal string, padded to an even length.
    content = b"8BIM" + struct.pack(">H", resource_id) + name
    content += struct.pack(">I", len(data)) + data
    return content + (b"\0" if len(data) % 2 else b"")


def add_psd_resources(raw_psd: bytes) -> bytes:
    """Add standard Photoshop resolution and sRGB resources for Cubism import."""
    assert raw_psd[:4] == b"8BPS" and raw_psd[26:34] == b"\0" * 8
    resolution = struct.pack(">IHHIHH", 72 << 16, 1, 1, 72 << 16, 1, 1)
    profile = ImageCms.ImageCmsProfile(ImageCms.createProfile("sRGB")).tobytes()
    resources = psd_resource(1005, resolution) + psd_resource(1039, profile)
    return raw_psd[:30] + struct.pack(">I", len(resources)) + resources + raw_psd[34:]

# Coordinates remain in the original logical canvas; source paintings are
# sampled directly at the export resolution.
PLACEMENTS = [
    # name, source, width, height, x, y, visible by default
    ("back_hair", "back_hair_refined.png", 768, 998, 128, 21, True),
    ("body", "body_refined.png", 870, 1306, 77, 174, True),
    ("face_blank", "face_blank_painted.png", 236, 250, 394, 21, True),
    ("face_neck_reference", "face_neck_painted.png", 236, 241, 394, 21, False),
    ("eyes_open", "eyes_open_painted.png", 118, 31, 453, 101, True),
    ("eyes_closed", "eyes_closed_painted.png", 118, 12, 453, 116, False),
    ("mouth_closed", "mouth_neutral_painted.png", 35, 7, 495, 165, True),
    ("mouth_open", "mouth_open_painted.png", 35, 18, 495, 161, False),
    ("shirt_front", "shirt_hd.png", 420, 430, 302, 170, True),
    ("front_hair", "front_hair_refined.png", 197, 180, 414, 6, True),
]


def build() -> None:
    LAYERS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    merged = Image.new("RGBA", SIZE)
    entries = []
    prepared = {}
    for name, source_name, width, height, x, y, visible in PLACEMENTS:
        art = Image.open(SOURCE / source_name).convert("RGBA")
        # Generated files include near-transparent specks outside the artwork.
        # They must not influence feature alignment or the exported texture.
        alpha = art.getchannel("A")
        if name.startswith(("eyes_", "mouth_")):
            bounds = alpha.point(lambda value: 255 if value > 32 else 0).getbbox()
            art = art.crop(bounds)
            alpha = art.getchannel("A")
        art.putalpha(alpha.point(lambda value: 0 if value < 16 else value))
        art = art.resize((width * SCALE, height * SCALE), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
        if name in ("face_blank", "face_neck_reference"):
            # Keep the neck behind the collar without exposing the painted
            # shoulder tips when the fitted shirt layer is drawn over it.
            yy = np.arange(art.height, dtype=np.float32)[:, None] / SCALE + y
            xx = np.arange(art.width, dtype=np.float32)[None, :] / SCALE + x
            taper = np.clip((yy - 198) / 21, 0, 1)
            half_width = 55 - 21 * taper
            edge = np.clip((half_width - np.abs(xx - 512)) / 4, 0, 1)
            neck_alpha = np.asarray(art.getchannel("A"), dtype=np.float32) * edge
            art.putalpha(Image.fromarray(neck_alpha.astype(np.uint8), "L"))
        layer = Image.new("RGBA", SIZE)
        layer.alpha_composite(art, (x * SCALE, y * SCALE))
        if name == "body":
            neck_backing = layer.crop((430 * SCALE, 175 * SCALE, 594 * SCALE, 295 * SCALE))
            layer.paste((0, 0, 0, 0), (0, 0, SIZE[0], 547 * SCALE))
            layer.paste(neck_backing, (430 * SCALE, 175 * SCALE))
        if name == "shirt_front":
            collar_back = layer.copy()
            collar_back.paste((0, 0, 0, 0), (0, 219 * SCALE, SIZE[0], SIZE[1]))
            prepared["body"].alpha_composite(collar_back)
            layer.paste((0, 0, 0, 0), (0, 0, SIZE[0], 219 * SCALE))
        prepared[name] = layer
        entries.append({"name": name, "file": f"layers/{name}.png", "hidden": not visible})

    body_assembly = prepared["body"].copy()
    body_assembly.alpha_composite(prepared["shirt_front"])
    body_assembly.save(ROOT / "body_assembly.png")

    for entry in entries:
        name = entry["name"]
        layer = prepared[name]
        layer.save(LAYERS / f"{name}.png", optimize=True)
        if not entry["hidden"]:
            merged.alpha_composite(layer)

    merged.save(ROOT / "composite.png", optimize=True)
    matte = Image.new("RGBA", SIZE, (46, 48, 58, 255))
    matte.alpha_composite(merged)
    matte.convert("RGB").save(ROOT / "preview.jpg", quality=94)
    matte.crop(tuple(v * SCALE for v in (210, 0, 815, 605))).convert("RGB").save(ROOT / "preview_bust.jpg", quality=96)
    matte.crop(tuple(v * SCALE for v in (390, 0, 635, 290))).save(ROOT / "detail_face.png")
    matte.crop(tuple(v * SCALE for v in (557, 355, 680, 498))).save(ROOT / "detail_red.png")

    blank_composite = Image.new("RGBA", SIZE)
    for visible_name in ("back_hair", "body", "face_blank", "shirt_front", "front_hair"):
        blank_composite.alpha_composite(Image.open(LAYERS / f"{visible_name}.png").convert("RGBA"))
    blank_composite.save(ROOT / "composite_blank.png", optimize=True)
    if "--preview-only" in sys.argv:
        return

    stack = ET.Element("image", {"w": str(SIZE[0]), "h": str(SIZE[1]), "name": "Irugaetne head-focused rig"})
    layer_stack = ET.SubElement(stack, "stack")
    for entry in reversed(entries):
        ET.SubElement(layer_stack, "layer", {"name": entry["name"], "src": entry["file"], "x": "0", "y": "0", "opacity": "1.0", "visibility": "hidden" if entry.get("hidden") else "visible", "composite-op": "svg:src-over"})
    with zipfile.ZipFile(ROOT / "이루겠네_머리중심_원화.ora", "w") as archive:
        archive.writestr("mimetype", "image/openraster", compress_type=zipfile.ZIP_STORED)
        archive.writestr("stack.xml", ET.tostring(stack, encoding="utf-8"))
        archive.write(ROOT / "composite.png", "mergedimage.png")
        for entry in entries:
            archive.write(ROOT / entry["file"], entry["file"])

    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("aligned_writer", ROOT.parent / "build_aligned_source.py")
    assert spec and spec.loader
    writer = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(writer)
    writer.OUT = ROOT
    writer.W, writer.H = SIZE
    legacy_psd = ROOT / "이루겠네_머리중심_원화_legacy.psd"
    writer.write_psd(legacy_psd, entries, np.asarray(merged))
    cubism_order = ROOT / "이루겠네_머리중심_원화_Cubism_order.psd"
    # Cubism imports this minimal PSD writer's records in reverse draw order.
    writer.write_psd(cubism_order, list(reversed(entries)), np.asarray(merged))
    cubism_psd = add_psd_resources(cubism_order.read_bytes())
    cubism_order.unlink()
    (ROOT / "이루겠네_머리중심_원화_Cubism.psd").write_bytes(cubism_psd)
    (ROOT / "이루겠네_머리중심_원화.psd").write_bytes(cubism_psd)
    (ROOT / "placements.json").write_text(json.dumps({"canvas": SIZE, "scale": SCALE, "layers": [dict(zip(("name", "source", "width", "height", "x", "y", "visible"), item)) for item in PLACEMENTS]}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    build()
````

## C236. 이루다 소설/버츄얼 아바타/이루겠네/head_rig/export_with_photoshop.jsx

원본: `이루다 소설/버츄얼 아바타/이루겠네/head_rig/export_with_photoshop.jsx` / 2,296 bytes / SHA-256 `48a53a19e32d7c746ad46624cec89fdf60ec1777b7e36e30a2bd798737234b6d`

````jsx
#target photoshop

// Run in Photoshop: File > Scripts > Browse. Each PNG already shares one canvas.
(function () {
    var root = File($.fileName).parent;
    var out = File(root.fsName + "/이루겠네_머리중심_원화_Photoshop.psd");
    var report = File(root.fsName + "/photoshop_export_status.txt");
    var originalDialogs = app.displayDialogs;
    var layers = [
        ["back_hair", true],
        ["face_blank", true],
        ["face_neck_reference", false],
        ["body", true],
        ["eyes_open", true],
        ["eyes_closed", false],
        ["mouth_closed", true],
        ["mouth_open", false],
        ["front_hair", true]
    ];
    try {
        app.displayDialogs = DialogModes.NO;
        var doc = app.documents.add(1024, 1536, 72, "이루겠네 머리 중심 원화", NewDocumentMode.RGB, DocumentFill.TRANSPARENT);
        for (var i = 0; i < layers.length; i++) {
            var png = File(root.fsName + "/layers/" + layers[i][0] + ".png");
            if (!png.exists) throw new Error("Missing layer: " + png.fsName);
            var source = app.open(png);
            var targetLayer = source.activeLayer.duplicate(doc, ElementPlacement.PLACEATBEGINNING);
            source.close(SaveOptions.DONOTSAVECHANGES);
            app.activeDocument = doc;
            targetLayer.name = layers[i][0];
            targetLayer.visible = layers[i][1];
        }
        try {
            if (doc.colorProfileName !== "sRGB IEC61966-2.1") {
                doc.convertProfile("sRGB IEC61966-2.1", Intent.RELATIVECOLORIMETRIC, true, true);
            }
        } catch (profileError) {
            // Photoshop's working RGB profile remains usable if conversion is unavailable.
        }
        var options = new PhotoshopSaveOptions();
        options.layers = true;
        options.embedColorProfile = true;
        options.maximizeCompatibility = true;
        doc.saveAs(out, options, true, Extension.LOWERCASE);
        report.open("w");
        report.write("OK: " + out.fsName);
        report.close();
    } catch (error) {
        report.open("w");
        report.write("ERROR: " + error.toString());
        report.close();
        alert("PSD export failed: " + error.toString());
    } finally {
        app.displayDialogs = originalDialogs;
    }
})();
````
