## C238. 이루다 소설/버츄얼 아바타/이루겠네/head_rig/preview.html

원본: `이루다 소설/버츄얼 아바타/이루겠네/head_rig/preview.html` / 4,837 bytes / SHA-256 `79ad807bd5d7762fb56ef8dcaa3d489f1c9662f478d26303c88170a6006c190b`

````html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="ko">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>이루겠네 · 머리 중심 레이어</title>
  <style>
    * { box-sizing: border-box; }
    body { margin: 0; min-height: 100vh; background: #191b23; color: #f4f1ed; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 270px; }
    main { min-height: 100vh; display: grid; place-items: center; background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 35%, #464451, #22252f 55%, #15171d); overflow: hidden; }
    canvas { max-height: 96vh; max-width: 96%; object-fit: contain; aspect-ratio: 2 / 3; }
    aside { padding: 26px 22px; background: #242630; border-left: 1px solid #44444f; }
    h1 { font-size: 19px; margin: 0 0 6px; }
    p { color: #c1bdc0; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5; margin: 0 0 22px; }
    label { display: block; margin: 16px 0; font-size: 13px; }
    label span { float: right; color: #e2ba97; }
    input[type=range] { width: 100%; accent-color: #cc827d; margin-top: 8px; }
    .toggle { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
    a { display: block; color: #e4b59d; margin-top: 14px; font-size: 13px; }
    @media(max-width: 760px) { body { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } main { min-height: 72vh; } canvas { max-height: 70vh; } aside { border-left: 0; border-top: 1px solid #44444f; } }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <main><canvas id="avatar" width="3072" height="4608" aria-label="이루겠네 레이어 미리보기"></canvas></main>
  <aside>
    <h1>이루겠네 · 머리 중심 원화</h1>
    <p>뒷머리 / 몸과 카라 안감 / 얼굴·목 / 앞옷깃 / 앞머리.</p>
    <label>좌우 움직임 <span id="yawValue">0</span><input id="yaw" type="range" min="-12" max="12" value="0"></label>
    <label>고개 기울기 <span id="rollValue">0</span><input id="roll" type="range" min="-6" max="6" value="0"></label>
    <label>상하 움직임 <span id="pitchValue">0</span><input id="pitch" type="range" min="-8" max="8" value="0"></label>
    <label class="toggle"><input id="blank" type="checkbox"> 눈·입 숨기기</label>
    <label class="toggle"><input id="blink" type="checkbox"> 눈 감기</label>
    <label class="toggle"><input id="mouth" type="checkbox"> 입 열기</label>
    <a href="이루겠네_머리중심_원화.psd">레이어 원화 PSD</a>
    <a href="이루겠네_머리중심_원화.ora">레이어 원화 ORA</a>
  </aside>
  <script>
    const canvas = document.getElementById('avatar');
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    const ids = ['back_hair', 'body', 'face_blank', 'eyes_open', 'eyes_closed', 'mouth_closed', 'mouth_open', 'shirt_front', 'front_hair'];
    const images = {};
    for (const id of ids) {
      const img = new Image();
      img.onload = draw;
      img.src = `layers/${id}.png`;
      images[id] = img;
    }
    const controls = ['yaw', 'roll', 'pitch', 'blank', 'blink', 'mouth'].map(id => document.getElementById(id));
    controls.forEach(el => el.addEventListener('input', draw));

    function paint(id) {
      const img = images[id];
      if (img?.complete && img.naturalWidth) ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0);
    }
    function draw() {
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
      const yaw = +document.getElementById('yaw').value;
      const roll = +document.getElementById('roll').value;
      const pitch = +document.getElementById('pitch').value;
      for (const id of ['yaw', 'roll', 'pitch']) document.getElementById(`${id}Value`).textContent = document.getElementById(id).value;

      // The long hair remains mostly behind the stationary body; only its root follows the head slightly.
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(yaw * 2.1, pitch * 1.2);
      paint('back_hair');
      ctx.restore();

      paint('body');

      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(1536 + yaw * 3.3, 528 + pitch * 3.6);
      ctx.rotate(roll * Math.PI / 180);
      ctx.scale(1 - Math.abs(yaw) * 0.003, 1);
      ctx.translate(-1536, -528);
      paint('face_blank');
      ctx.restore();

      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(1536 + yaw * 3.3, 528 + pitch * 3.6);
      ctx.rotate(roll * Math.PI / 180);
      ctx.scale(1 - Math.abs(yaw) * 0.003, 1);
      ctx.translate(-1536, -528);
      if (!document.getElementById('blank').checked) {
        paint(document.getElementById('blink').checked ? 'eyes_closed' : 'eyes_open');
        paint(document.getElementById('mouth').checked ? 'mouth_open' : 'mouth_closed');
      }
      ctx.restore();
      paint('shirt_front');
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(1536 + yaw * 3.3, 528 + pitch * 3.6);
      ctx.rotate(roll * Math.PI / 180);
      ctx.scale(1 - Math.abs(yaw) * 0.003, 1);
      ctx.translate(-1536, -528);
      paint('front_hair');
      ctx.restore();
    }
  </script>
</body>
</html>
````
